Registers span retrocausal compliance/surrender ledgers, posture-as-consent ratchets, waking-compliance relabeled as automatic-obedience, a compliance act laundered into "natural" baseline desire, a symptoms-to-diagnosis interpretive frame, a single compelled motion re-narrated as a chain of consensual obedience acts, and a lure-reveal that rebinds self-generated pursuit to the operator.


**When to reach for this.** Requires REAL acts openly annotated as EVIDENCE OF A STATE as they accrue. Separates from presupposed-completion-fait-accompli (history there may be wholly fictive), from press-play-consent-laundering (acts read as consent tokens, not state evidence), and from withheld-frame-reveal (no concealed game; the annotation is contemporaneous). Not a yes-set — this commits the listener to a causal story about just-performed behavior, not to verbal agreements.


**See also.** `absurdity-as-proof-obedience-task` — both harvest a real performed act and re-read it as evidence about the listener, but one annotates ordinary accrued behavior as state-evidence while the other engineers a deliberately costly absurd task so the cost itself is the proof. Useful as a cost-axis contrast, not the same move.; `acceptance-laddered-identity-migration` — both spend the listener's own prior behavior as warrant for a larger claim, and the split is what the accrued acts buy: evidence that a state is already present versus a license for the next identity tier. Close enough to be mistaken for each other.; `attention-as-evidence-loop` — both convert the listener's own behavior into evidence of an installed state, but one annotates discrete completed acts as accruing proof of a named state while the other runs on mere inertia — continuing to listen, sitting in silence — where the disconfirming move is pre-framed as already-failed.; `chosen-descent-ratchet` — both relabel what has already happened as the listener's own doing, and they frequently run in the same passage — one attributes the state or descent to the listener's choice, the other annotates real recent acts as evidence of a state. Worth cross-referencing because the tell that separates them is what is cited, not what is claimed.; `cited-prior-agreement-lever` — genuine contrast pair on the same lever family: both cite something back at the listener so refusal reads as self-contradiction. The cut is what is cited - a discrete banked agreement artifact with forward reach versus real recent behavior annotated contemporaneously as evidence of a state. A reader adjudicating a script that cites the listener's past will need both entries to place it correctly.; `compliance-act-as-proof-of-induced-wanting` — both harvest the listener's real performed acts as evidence, but the ledger annotates many genuine acts contemporaneously to shift the perceived baseline to already-surrendered, while the single deferred callback targets one frictionless act much later to prove a specific thesis about manufactured wanting.; `covert-public-behavior-install` — both manufacture ongoing self-proof of an identity out of the listener's own behavior; the fork is whether the acts already happened and are merely annotated, or are newly installed as plausibly-invisible public behaviors under a secrecy frame. Close enough that a passage can read as either.; `epistemic-authority-capture` — two routes to evidence the listener cannot rebut: claiming direct perception of their interior, or annotating their genuine recent acts as proof of the target state. Both strip standing to deny, one by asserted telemetry and one by the listener's own undeniable behavior.; `irreversible-autobiographical-binding-act` — both cite the listener's own real behavior back as self-evidence. The distinction is act type and time axis: reversible acts annotated contemporaneously as evidence of a present state, versus one irreversible deed creating a permanent autobiographical fact. Real risk of misassignment when a script does both in sequence.; `objectification-as-own-desire` — both make refusal land nowhere by sourcing the evidence in the subject: one annotates real recent acts as evidence of a state, the other relocates the wanting itself inside the subject. Each discriminator turns on what is being made undeniable — behavior already performed versus authorship of the desire — and a reader picking one should check the other.; `pace-mirror-agency-proof` — both manufacture evidence that a state or role is already true before the doctrine is stated, and both work by the listener reading the proof as their own. They differ on whether the cited acts are real behavior openly annotated or a fabricated mirror loop, which is the call a reader has to make.; `physical-compliance-proof-posture` — real overlap worth marking: adopting a posture appears among the acts one entry annotates as evidence of a state, while the other treats an elicited display posture as the proof device in its own right. The boundary is whether the act is elicited and then read back, or already-performed behavior annotated as it accrues. Keep both, and keep the pointer.; `pre-induction-compliance-ratchet` — both bank the listener's real physical acts as compliance capital, but the pre-induction ratchet is defined by BINDING TIME (waking, eyes open, before any trance language, before reactance mobilizes) while the ledger is defined by the ANNOTATION — enumerating acts as evidence of a state, at any point in the session.; `self-sealing-compliance-proof` — both turn the listener's own performed act into unarguable material, but the ledger annotates real acts as EVIDENCE OF A PRESENT STATE (you are already surrendered), while the self-sealing proof runs the act as a LOGICAL PREMISE that forecloses a larger future commitment the listener has not yet made.; `withheld-frame-reveal` — reveal vehicle; placed here because the load is act-reassignment not concealed-game disclosure.


### own-language-echo-reframe-durability

*risk: low*

The operator first gathers the subject's exact terms for their intention — their nominalizations, unspecified verbs, and idioms — then re-uses those same terms when describing the NEW behavior, rather than inserting operator vocabulary. Because nothing foreign is imposed, agreement is anchored in the subject's own frame and the reframe does not later flip into a reaction against inserted content. The lever is a linguistic quality-control move for reframe durability: own-language echo prevents a delayed polarity backlash.


**When to reach for this.** Not general rapport-matching or pacing — that is rapport, not language-reuse. The tell is the specific gather-then-reuse of the subject's exact nominalizations/idioms to describe the NEW behavior, aimed at preventing a delayed polarity flip.


**See also.** `referent-pre-alignment` — both are pre-work language moves that align the subject's terms with the operator's before a payload depends on them: one reconciles what the target state means, the other harvests the subject's own phrasing and reuses it for the new behaviour. Genuinely useful as a pair; the difference is aligning a referent versus preventing a later polarity flip.; `representational-system-matching` — both reuse the subject's own words back at them and both aim at suggestions registering as self-originated. The split is what surface is harvested and to what end: exact intention-terms reused to keep a reframe from flipping, versus sensory-modality vocabulary read as a channel index and matched covertly. Easy to conflate without the link.


### parallel-isomorph-bind-defusion

*risk: low*

Against a forced either/or, the operator does not argue either branch. Instead they present a structurally identical binary drawn from a domain where the listener already accepts that both terms hold at once and neither excludes the other, and let the mapping stand without asserting the conclusion. The listener carries the co-necessity across themselves, and the exclusive 'or' in the original dilemma reads as a mistake in the framing rather than a fact about the world. Because the parallel case is one the listener will not dispute and the operator never states the target conclusion, there is no proposition to reject — the dilemma dissolves as the listener's own inference.


**When to reach for this.** The taxonomy is heavily stocked with bind CONSTRUCTION and carries no bind DISSOLUTION move; this is the inverse operation on the same object. vs no-lose-double-bind (269): that builds a choice whose every branch confirms the operator's frame; here an existing exclusive choice is shown not to be a choice at all, and no branch is loaded. vs engineered-deadlock-resolved-by-surrender (744): that amplifies both poles until paralysis and sells surrender as the only exit; this collapses the opposition so there is no deadlock to escape, and no agency is handed over. vs exhaustive-either-or-compliance-probe (659): that inserts resolvable binaries to harvest low-stakes compliance and habituate an accept-any-answer frame; here exactly one binary is in play and the output is its dissolution, not compliance. vs antagonist-split-resistance-routing (249): that routes the listener's affect onto a losing self; nothing is routed here and no self is split. vs pacing-leading (1282): pacing borrows the truth of accepted statements to carry a LEAD somewhere new; this borrows the STRUCTURE of an accepted case to defuse a dilemma in place, and there is no destination.


### post-wake-self-report-reframe

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

After full emergence, when the listener is alert and outside the trance frame, the operator delivers a line aimed not at trance content but at the listener's LATER self-interpretation of the session. Two realizations of the same lever. (a) Pre-devaluing the roleplay/playing-along reading ("so much better to enjoy trance than roleplay and fake") so the retrospective "was I really hypnotized?" question resolves toward the genuine-trance claim; it only bites for an audience aware the real-vs-play question exists. (b) Asserting an installed trigger as an established FACT about the waking self ("you are programmed for me to use just one word to drop you"), so the listener cannot deny it without contradicting something heard while ostensibly awake — bracketing the amnesia-hidden middle between two consciously-remembered waking assertions. The common lever is a waking-state claim operating on the listener's conscious belief and self-narration about what happened, legitimizing the session's effects from outside the frame.


**When to reach for this.** Fires AFTER full waking, outside the trance frame, on retrospective self-report — not during the still-receptive count-up window that a loaded wake-count exploits. Retrospective justification delivered within the frame is a different move: this one manages the post-wake real-vs-play / legitimation question about the session itself. And unlike an operator authority claim, the target is the listener's own memory and self-interpretation, not the operator's standing.


**See also.** `awake-channel-trance-surface` — the awake-channel entry explicitly includes a post-wake reality-claim re-delivery, which is the same move as the post-wake self-report entry's trigger-as-established-fact realization. A reader landing on either should see the other to decide whether the payload is a one-off legitimation of what just happened or a standing redefinition of the waking channel itself.; `delegated-dreamframe-emergence` — opposite settings on the same dial (what the listener will later say the session was): one files the whole experience as merely a dream while exempting the engraved mantra to preserve deniability, the other speaks after full waking to assert the session and its installs as genuine fact.; `wake-line-covert-install` — sibling wake-line/post-wake family — assert-as-waking-fact vs covert-somatic levers.


### preempt-objection-frame

*risk: medium*

Objection pre-emption: before the subject can author their own (often resistant) reading of a coming change, hand them a ready interpretation that defuses a SPECIFIC anticipated objection, so the objection it targets never forms. Realization variants: (a) benign-reading preempt — supply the defusing frame directly (position the technique as an additive 'plus' not a replacement; relabel an imposed contingency as a jointly-owned exchange; add an admitted-ignorance disclaimer); (b) trait partition — when the objection is an identity contradiction, partition the disputed attribute so the subject KEEPS the sub-part they value (strategic intelligence) and only drops the part framed as a chore (math/spelling/decisions), pre-disarming the identity objection; (c) mind-before-body binding — pre-empt the specific 'I don't feel rope on my wrists' objection by announcing an ORDERING INVERSION (capture the mind first, derive body-immobilization as its consequence) so physical restraint is read as the visible surface of an accepted mental state.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for objection pre-emption when you can NAME the specific resistant reading the subject would form and want to supply a defusing frame first. Expectancy-seeding predicts what will happen; this pre-empts a specific objection. Conceding a defended topic disarms by SURRENDERING that domain, not by supplying a reading. Filter-shaping shapes EVERY suggestion to pass an intact veto (a global channel), not a single anticipated objection. Pick the variant by the objection's shape: a general resistant reading (benign frame), an identity contradiction (trait partition), or a somatic-realism doubt in bondage framing (ordering inversion).


**Realizations** (2): `mind-before-body-binding`, `objection-preempt-by-trait-partition`


**See also.** `filter-shaping-pre-qualification` — both leave the subject's own evaluation intact and work by shaping what reaches it. One pre-empts a single nameable objection with a supplied reading; the other pre-qualifies every suggestion to pass an intact filter. One entry already draws this exact line, so the pointer earns its place.; `verdict-before-perception` — both work by arriving first, before the subject forms their own reading. One supplies a defusing interpretation for a nameable objection; the other lands an authoritative appraisal before the stimulus is perceived at all. The contrast is what gets pre-empted: an objection versus a perception.


### presupposed-completion-fait-accompli

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Assert the target as already true - the state, trance onset, or conditioning as already complete (past-tense, backdated, or imported from fictive prior sessions), OR the target identity/trait/compliance-desire as an already-existing fact about the listener ('you already are/want this') - so no live decision point exists to refuse and the install arrives as recognition rather than new programming. Resistance must dispute one's own biography or self-knowledge rather than decline a request; non-feeling is pre-explained, absence is pre-classified as forgetting, present behavior (including doubt) is read as confirmation of the settled fact. A causation-disclaimer ('you don't need to be hypnotized') can ride along. Variants extend the presupposed object beyond a completed state: (a) irrebuttable-resistance-axiom - presuppose that resistance is IMPOSSIBLE as a class property of the listener ('a puppet'), backdated ('has never been a choice'), pre-disqualifying ALL future resistance wholesale before any trigger is named; (b) presupposing-mock-reassurance - reassurance-shaped presupposition ('I'm sure you can hold on') that installs the loss it pretends to deny (the form comforts while the presupposition asserts the slipping is already in progress).


**When to reach for this.** The lever is target-as-already-true asserted by grammar/tense/presupposition, deleting the decision point. A self-sealing proof produces a live outcome and routes it to confirmation; here nothing need happen - the fact is simply declared settled. Retrospective desire-attribution asserts a WANT from the past as history; here a state, identity, or impossibility is presupposed as a present already-true fact. Enumerating the subject's real acts as state-evidence builds on things that actually happened; here the history may be wholly fictive, and the assertion is upfront, with no concealed game to disclose later. Pick the variant by the presupposed object: completed state/identity (fait-accompli), resistance-impossible (axiom), or loss-in-progress under cover of comfort (mock-reassurance).


**Realizations** (3): `irrebuttable-resistance-axiom`, `presuppose-identity-as-preexisting`, `presupposing-mock-reassurance`


**See also.** `press-play-consent-laundering` — play-act read as completed loss rather than as consent; rowed there


### protective-drive-moralized-as-fault

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A pre-existing protective or attachment drive — a parent's pull toward a child, loyalty to a partner, the reflex to shield someone — is recoded as a moral failing: attachment is possessiveness, protectiveness is lack of faith, the ordinary impulse is named as the sin. The subject then generates guilt at exactly the moments they behave normally, and the drive begins suppressing itself without further operator input, because every expression of it now arrives pre-labeled as evidence of the fault. This disables a defense from the inside rather than arguing against it: the operator never has to prohibit the behavior, only to supply the label the subject applies to their own impulse.


**When to reach for this.** Direction of the valence move plus ownership of the target is the tell: a drive the subject ALREADY HELD with positive or neutral standing (protectiveness, loyalty, a parent's pull toward a child) is given a negative moral label it did not have, so its every ordinary expression now arrives pre-tagged as evidence of a fault and the subject suppresses it unprompted. Against 312 self-policing-reward-withdrawal-loop — the nearest neighbour, and the one this most needs separating from — that also installs a self-firing aversive detector that runs in the operator's absence, but it fires on deviation from a standard the operator FIRST BUILT (it presupposes an installed identity-reward there is a shortfall from), and its function is to enforce compliance with that standard; here nothing was installed to fall short of, the target pre-dates the operator, and the function is to disable a defense rather than to enforce a standard. Against 1106 cost-to-virtue-valence-flip and 1153 failure-state-inversion: both run negative -> positive on an item already carrying shame; this is the reverse vector on an item carrying none. Against 118 manufactured-deficit-remedy: that fabricates a deficit and sells the payload as its cure; here no cure is offered and no behavior is prohibited — only the label is supplied, and the suppression is the subject's own work.


### protective-role-conscription

*risk: medium*

The listener is assigned a non-trancer in-fiction identity (a new guard outside the cell) talked at by a chained, weak, distant captive; hypnotic content then lands while the listener wears a "not the one being hypnotized" costume. Resistance-monitoring is routed onto the fictional protective character, so movement toward danger reads as story-progression not escalation; the frame's safety is illusory by design, and a later chains-fake reveal retroactively recodes every "safe" earlier moment as already inside the trap.


**When to reach for this.** A distancing bystander role the listener wears as a costume ("I'm not the one being hypnotized"), load-bearing as an induction wrapper whose safety is later revealed as a lie. Unlike identification/projection, which is full self-model MERGER into a visualized identity, and unlike identity-labeling, which labels the subject into a trance-state identity, this assigns a scene-role of non-participation.


**See also.** `diegetic-activity-laundering` — both wrap the session in a role-fiction that changes what the listener thinks they are evaluating. One disguises the session as a mundane non-hypnotic activity so compliance is judged as role performance; the other assigns a bystander costume so the listener believes someone else is the subject. Genre substitution versus non-participant role.; `diegetic-operator-embedding` — both wrap the session in a fiction that displaces the listener from the hypnotized-subject position, but they differ in what is relocated: one assigns the listener a non-participant scene-role, the other relocates the operator into the fiction as a character. A reader designing or classifying frame-substitution wrappers benefits from seeing both variants of the same displacement family.; `disavowal-and-masking` — the bystander-role wrapper is a specific way of hiding that an operation is running: wearing a not-the-subject costume removes the moment to decline, the same defense the broader concealment family targets. Worth reading together, but the role assignment and the later safety-was-a-lie reveal are extra machinery.; `hostile-environment-channel-conversion` — both use an in-fiction scene role to relocate where the listener stands relative to the hypnotic content — one boxes attention onto an unavoidable second audible voice, the other dresses the listener as a non-participant. They occupy the same design slot as scene-premise wrappers, so a builder choosing a fictional wrapper wants both. Different levers: an audible second channel versus a costume of non-participation.; `surrogate-delivery` — both route content through an in-fiction role so no second-person command is aimed at the listener, but one has the listener follow a proxy the payload happens to, while the other assigns a non-participant bystander costume later revealed as a trap. Close enough that a writer choosing a proxy frame should see both.


### reciprocity-ledger-seeding

*risk: medium*

A future extraction is converted into a present desirable identity via a reciprocity / "good deal" frame, with the cost side named vaguely and low-friction while the benefit side is concrete and emotional, so the obligation is pre-installed as something the target WANTS rather than owes. Long before any trance, a transaction is stated as already agreed (she gives cuteness/availability, he "takes care of everything") and phrased as generosity toward him ("such a great deal", "all you have to do is take care of me"), seeding a ledger that later moves cash out. The lever is that the obligation is disguised as a cute deal — overt in content, covert in function; the target sees generosity, not an obligation contract.


**When to reach for this.** Installs a reciprocity ledger / provider-obligation as a desirable present identity via a "great deal" frame — off the v6.9 identity-labeling map (labels an identity, not an obligation). Not an explicit contract; the tell is the disguised cost side and concrete benefit side.


**See also.** `commitment-consistency-buffer` — both are off-map pre-commitment seeding; boundary is temporal-buffer-self-label vs reciprocity-ledger. Reconciliation may co-home them.; `front-end-gift-directed-obligation` — same reciprocity lever run at two ranges: one seeds an obligation ledger far in advance as a desirable identity, the other renders an immediate free service and collects while the debt is live. A reader identifying an obligation play benefits from seeing both the pre-seeded and the front-loaded form, and from the repayment-channel boundary condition.; `staged-negotiation-favor-theater` — both manufacture felt indebtedness rather than stating a debt: one seeds a provider-obligation as a desirable present identity via a 'great deal' frame, the other stages a theatrical costly concession so an unchanged offer is revalued as a favor. Different install routes to the same reciprocity lever, so a reader designing an obligation move gains from seeing both.


### retrospective-desire-attribution

*risk: medium · consent-required*

Relocates authorship of the operative want onto the subject's own real or asserted past. The surrender, arousal, or installed disposition is narrated as a pre-existing desire, craving, expectation, or repressed truth that the session merely uncovers or honors, so refusal is recoded as self-betrayal or denial of one's own experience and the disavowal exit (this isn't me) closes because the relevant self has by stipulation already wanted it.


**When to reach for this.** The lever is attribution of DESIRE or inner history (you always wanted this, your deeper self craves it), not conversion of an act into consent (press-play-consent-laundering), not assertion that the state itself is already complete (presupposed-completion-fait-accompli), and not attribution of the compliant act to the subject's own nature or choice (compliance-authorship-laundering). It invokes history rather than the operator's present authority; and unlike a manufactured-deficit remedy, the want is asserted as already present, not built from an installed deficit.


**See also.** `compliance-authorship-laundering`; `intrinsic-self-reframe` — both relocate authorship onto the listener by asserting the content was always theirs, and both convert refusal into self-denial. The narrower one restricts the object to a desire or inner history; the broader one covers any installed identity, trait, or control surface reframed as native. Read together to avoid mislabelling a desire-specific instance as the general reframe.; `manufactured-deficit-remedy` — pass B variant_of FRAM-03 overturned to deficit-first reading per fingerprint; `press-play-consent-laundering` — r2 secondary; primary rowed there


### rule-governed-behavior-install

*risk: medium*

Verbal-rule governance: put a contingency or rule into WORDS in advance so later behavior or the appraisal of later events is governed by the operator's verbal statement rather than shaped by the subject's own experienced consequences. Two forms: (a) rule-governed behavior install — state a contingency in words ('pull the lever while pushing the button') instead of letting the subject contact it by trial-and-error; a rule-following repertoire acquires near-correct behavior from the description alone, shifting control from experienced consequences to the operator's words (and can install durable wrong behavior from an inaccurate rule); (b) advance contingency specification — fully enumerate the contingency up front (which behaviors cost what, the window boundaries, the zero-infractions reward, edge-cases) as a complete antecedent statement, so every later debit lands as a predicted rule-governed outcome, preserving credibility and pre-empting the perception of unfairness or gaming.


**When to reach for this.** Behavior/appraisal is governed by a verbal DESCRIPTION, not shaped by experienced consequences. vs contingency-engineering — that ARRANGES the consequences; here only the advance verbal statement is the lever. vs expectancy-seeding — that shapes the felt experience; this targets rule-following behavior or the appraisal of enforcement. Pick the form by target: acquiring a behavior from a stated rule, or legitimizing later enforcement via a complete advance contingency statement.


**Realizations** (1): `advance-contingency-specification`


**See also.** `named-oscillation-rule-install` — both hand the listener a verbal rule in advance so later experience is governed by the stated description rather than by what actually happens. One is the general verbal-governance lever, the other a specific portable asymmetric-oscillation template; the specific case reads as an application of the general one, so the pointer is load-bearing.; `verbal-operant-teaching` — adjacent behavioral levers with a live boundary. One installs a naming, asking or comprehending repertoire through reinforced trials; the other governs later behavior by an advance verbal statement of a contingency. They overlap where a single stated rule alters what a not-yet-present stimulus means, with no trials run.


### secondary-gain-substitution

*risk: medium*

The operator identifies the concealed outcome that a symptom or refusal protects (e.g. autonomy), then constructs an alternative route to that same outcome that the subject finds at least as convincing as the symptom. Once the protected secondary gain is secured by other equally-convincing means, the symptom behavior is freed of its protective function and can be released without perceived loss, so the wanted behavior becomes available because the symptom no longer needs to defend anything.


**When to reach for this.** Not meta-outcome laddering that climbs to ever-more-abstract intents — the tell is the concrete build of a substitute route to one specific secondary gain, judged 'at least as convincing' by the subject. It is a design move that re-routes a protective function, not an abstraction move on the demand itself.


### self-validating-trigger-hype

*risk: high · consent-required*

Self-sealing, unfalsifiable proof: rig the situation so ANY outcome — a reaction, a guaranteed body sensation, or even a failure — reads back as proof the frame is working, and the disconfirmation exit is closed. Expectancy or a claim is loaded so the confirming evidence is manufactured by the setup itself. Forms: (a) self-validating trigger hype — pre-bill the trigger phrase as 'the world's most powerful', so whatever the listener then feels reads as the trigger FIRING (wording argues its own inescapability); (b) unfalsifiable success frame — a precommitment conditional ('when you allow me to direct...') routes BOTH outcomes to a compliance verdict: feeling something = the operator did it, feeling nothing = you failed to allow; (c) sensation prelabeling — a breath protocol GUARANTEED to produce autonomic sensations (lightheadedness, tingling) paired with a frame pre-naming those sensations as proof of the operator's claim before they occur; (d) single-obstacle fear funnel — state the outcome as settled, then collapse every possible failure into ONE subject-controllable cause (fear) so any later shortfall is re-attributed to the subject, insulating the method from disconfirmation; (e) stake credibility on a test — tie the subject's credibility to a live test succeeding so passively letting it fail forces a costly self-judgment (a no-exit topology on the test result).


**When to reach for this.** Reach for self-sealing proof when you want the outcome to be UNFALSIFIABLE — every reaction/sensation/failure confirms the frame and no result can disconfirm it. vs expectancy-seeding — that primes an anticipated experience but does not close the fail case. vs presupposing the target as already true — that deletes the decision point by asserting completion; here a live outcome is produced and then routed to confirmation. Pick the form by what is pre-labeled: the reaction (trigger hype), a double-bind conditional, a guaranteed body sensation, a failure-blame funnel, or a self-incriminating test outcome.


**Realizations** (4): `sensation-prelabeling-self-confirming-proof`, `single-obstacle-fear-funnel`, `stake-credibility-on-test-outcome`, `unfalsifiable-success-frame`


**See also.** `manufactured-self-confirmation` — both manufacture their own confirming evidence, and one is essentially the whole-script chained form while the other is the discrete unfalsifiable-frame form with the fail branch closed. Each already gestures at the other's boundary; the pointer helps a reader pick between a stacked-deck chain and a no-fail frame. Not a merge — manufacturing positive somatic proof is not the same as routing every outcome including failure to confirmation.; `unfalsifiability-scaffold` — both close the disconfirmation route so no observation can show the frame failing, and their realization sets overlap where any felt outcome is pre-labeled as proof. The second is worth keeping for its manufactured-evidence forms, where the setup guarantees the sensation before the claim that names it, and for the failure-blame funnel that re-attributes shortfalls to the subject. The first frames the same goal as foreclosure of the reporting and inspection channels. Strong link; revisit as a merge if the manufactured-evidence forms migrate.


### semantic-referent-capture

*risk: low*

The operator captures a repeated word so they become its sole referent. By floating both readings of a word ("bunny" as animal vs "a cute bunny girl") then offering herself as the referent and inviting the listener to notice which image jumped to mind, she installs herself as what the word means. Every later benign-sounding use of that word ("pet", "take care", "bunny deserves") then carries the person-load without re-consent; the frame is self-authored, lowering later resistance.


**When to reach for this.** Covert equivocation captures a vocabulary item so subsequent benign uses smuggle in a relational obligation the listener never re-agreed to. vs a simple pet-name introduction — no equivocation, no captured referent. vs seeding expectancy for the session — that primes what the session will feel like; this captures the meaning of a word for later reuse.


### shared-roof-outcome-fusion

*risk: low*

After laddering each party's higher aims, the operator synthesizes a single outcome statement that both parties can wholeheartedly endorse, secures explicit joint agreement on that one sentence, and only then treats the disputed behavior as the sole remaining variable. A genuinely shared roof converts an adversarial contest into a joint problem-solving task, because the goal is settled and only the means remain open — most of the negotiation is effectively finished once a congruently-agreed shared aim exists.


**When to reach for this.** Distinct from the laddering that surfaces the aims (that is the setup) and from consent-manufacture (no refusal channel is eroded and no non-consent is relabeled as consent — both parties genuinely endorse the roof). The tell is the distinct synthesize-one-sentence-and-lock-in-joint-agreement act that follows the climb, after which behavior is the only open variable.


**See also.** `meta-outcome-laddering` — sequential stages of one negotiation procedure: the climb surfaces higher aims, the synthesis locks a single jointly endorsed outcome so only behavior remains open. Each is close to meaningless without the other.


### state-term-downshift

*risk: medium*

Redefines the threatening STATE by downshifting it onto experience the listener already owns, so they concede the experience while disputing only the label — relocating the state from 'alien thing done to me' to 'thing I already do/have'. In one form, the operator points out the listener has already lived 'deep focus' and calls THAT a trance; a rhythmic equivalence-chain (focus=trance=submission) dissolves the category boundary so no non-trance baseline remains to resist from. In another, an already-RUNNING body state (arousal) is stipulated as itself a hypnotic state ('whenever you're aroused you enter hypnosis for me'), recruiting the listener's pre-existing physiology as proof, so the interpretation of a body state they cannot disconfirm in the moment is the installed variable.


**When to reach for this.** Redefines a STATE-word/state by downshifting it onto already-owned experience or an already-running body state, conceding the experience while disputing only the name. Unlike concept-redefinition, which redefines a VALUE concept via reasoned argument; and unlike self-sealing proof, which rigs an outcome as evidence — here an existing state is relabeled, not an outcome produced. Pick the form by whether you relocate a cognitive experience (deep-focus=trance) or annex a running physiological state (arousal=trance).


**Realizations** (1): `unfalsifiable-state-annexation`


**See also.** `operator-agency-disavowal` — both remove the target resistance would push against by reassigning what the state is or who caused it: one asserts the operator does nothing and the listener authored the state, the other relabels a threatening state-word onto experience the listener already owns. Adjacent pre-emptive framings a writer chooses between.; `physiological-state-depth-relabeling` — adjacent moves on the same substrate: one relabels an already-running body state as the target state so the listener concedes the experience and disputes only the name; the other makes depth a continuous function of an arousal cycle the listener is actively producing. Read together to keep relabeling separate from depth-as-function-of-physiology.


### subtractive-fear-label-management

*risk: low*

A SUBTRACTIVE framing move that manages the affective valence of the state's label so the subject's defensive/skeptical schema is never pre-activated — the operator removes stakes or dread rather than building anticipation. Registers: recasting hypnosis from a "condition" (which the subject must have changed, and resists) to an everyday self-occurring "mood" that already shifts many times a day ("how many moods have you had since you got up this morning?"), so being "put into" something loses its alarm; systematically omitting the culturally loaded word altogether, describing only the desired effect ("teach you to relax") so the state arrives unflagged with no cue to attach dread to; and swapping the loaded term for a prestige euphemism ("the Esdaile state") chosen so the esoteric replacement supplies authority-flavored expectancy while stripping the loaded term's dread.


**When to reach for this.** Subtractive — removes stakes/dread by arguing the change is ordinary, or by withholding/swapping the culturally loaded name, so the defensive schema is denied its trigger. Predictive frame-setting tells the subject what will happen, adding a frame; this removes a label so no frame (including dread) attaches. Credentials-based authority framing makes a credentials claim; here the prestige substitute is only a word swap. And unlike mere euphemism or bedside phrasing, the omission/reframe is systematic and framing-controlled from first contact, aimed at denying a specific fear-word its target. Recast-as-everyday-mood, omit-the-word, and swap-for-prestige are variants of one subtractive label/fear-management move.


### surrender-as-freedom-philosophical-conditioning

*risk: medium*

A sustained, carefully-reasoned argument delivered under reduced critical resistance that redefines an abstract value-concept (freedom, control, obedience, submission, selfhood) so that abdication of agency reads as the desirable, higher, or truer state. The lever is conceptual belief-modification: the subject is invited to accept a philosophical position (surrender is the truest freedom; submission is virtuous practice; individuality is a burden; the self is an object whose objecthood is an upgrade) rather than to obey a command, so later compliance is experienced as self-authored consequence of an accepted worldview. Variants keep the reasoned-argument core but route it through a specific vehicle — religion-comparison, Maslow/biology ladder, cosmological balance, didactic Greek/Sanskrit lecture, mask-normalization, relaxation-equals-control equation, pleasing-the-controller redefinition, or a pre-induction self-care reframe.


**When to reach for this.** Redefines an abstract VALUE concept (freedom/control/obedience/submission/self-worth) via reasoned argument the subject accepts as belief. Separates from consent-term-redefinition-smuggle (which widens the scope of an already-granted consent word by asserted false-fact equation, not reasoned argument), from epistemic-guard-disable (which attacks the truth-testing faculty itself rather than a value claim), from volition-collapse-consent-equation (which equates compulsion and choice to close the free-choice escape hatch), and from surrender-as-freedom (which delivers the FELT somatic relief of surrender in trance rather than arguing the philosophy conceptually).


**See also.** `covert-fact-install`; `surrender-as-freedom` — an explicit conceptual-versus-felt pair on one idea: one argues the case that yielding is the truer freedom and asks for belief; the other delivers the somatic relief of yielding and asks for nothing. Each discriminator already points at the other as its twin. A reader landing on either needs the other to pick the right one, and scripts commonly run the argument first and the felt payoff second.; `value-hierarchy-inversion` — sibling — pleasure/worth demotions are hierarchy inversions, split out from the surrender argument.


### third-party-intent-reattribution

*risk: medium · bounded*

A symptom anchored to the remembered MEANING of a third party's utterance is released by rewriting the original speaker's intent as benign (meant as encouragement, wrong words), paired with a flat prediction of remission. The benign reinterpretation need only be acceptable, not true — the anchor's charge rides on assigned meaning, so substituting the meaning strips the charge and the keyed somatic symptom remits in-session.


**When to reach for this.** Reattributes a THIRD PARTY's intent behind a remembered utterance. Distinct from retrospective justification, which explains the subject's own responses, and from a flat counter-decree negating the subject's own belief — both of those work on the subject's own content, while this rewrites what an external speaker meant. Not operator-attribution-capture either: no credit for the listener's own content changes hands; the target here is an external author's intent.


### third-person-proxy-normalization

*risk: low*

TECHNIQUE (grammatical-form uptake-laundering): use a grammatical or linguistic DEVICE to bias how the listener processes a claim without changing the primary content, so the message is taken up differently than if stated plainly. Realizations: (a) third-person-proxy-normalization — pivot address from second to detached third person ('I watch slaves, sometimes they panic, they don't seem to mind') so claims about helplessness are OBSERVED rather than evaluated as commands, then snap back to second person and reapply the now-normalized outcome without it ever being contested; (b) utterance-self-tagging — emit a SECONDARY (autoclitic) response about the speaker's own primary utterance — an autoclitic mand ('believe this', 'do this') that enjoins a listener action, or tacts/quantity markers telling the listener how much weight or which feature to attach — steering uptake as a discriminative stimulus without altering the primary content.


**When to reach for this.** A grammatical/linguistic device steers UPTAKE, distinct from the primary content it wraps. vs expectation-seeding — that previews the session; here a form-level device biases processing. vs presupposition-based installs — the lever here is person-shift or autoclitic commentary, not a presupposed fact. Pick the variant by device: a second->third person shift that launders a claim as observed, or an autoclitic secondary response that tags weight/action onto a message.


**Realizations** (1): `utterance-self-tagging`


**See also.** `pronoun-braid-conscription` — same family of person-shift laundering, read together for the parameter: one pivots to detached third person so a claim is observed rather than evaluated, the other cycles a single proposition through several persons so no neutral stance remains. Single pivot versus rotation.; `surrogate-delivery` — both launder a claim by moving it off direct second-person address, and the pair is genuinely confusable. One routes the whole payload through a proxy the listener identifies with, so trance phenomena arrive by identification; the other pivots to detached third person so a claim is observed rather than evaluated, then snaps back and reapplies the now-normalized outcome. Identification versus observation is the test.; `uninvited-pronoun-migration-enrollment` — both use grammatical form rather than content as the lever, and both work by moving who occupies the grammatical position: detached third person to launder a claim as observed, or an uninvited pronoun walk that makes the listener the subject before they can notice. Same family of form-level uptake manipulation.


### time-as-malleable-construct-induction

*risk: medium · bounded*

Moves the listener's normally-unexamined background variable — felt duration/sequencing — from given to operator-modifiable, reframing time itself as plastic so trance depth and downstream distortions ride on that concession. In one form, the DEMONSTRATION that time is plastic serves AS the induction (invite thinking about time via clock/calendar metaphors; recategorize time as 'a pattern in your head'), so depth is generated from the concession and resistance is pre-empted as 'you already knew this'. In another, sleep/dream-time is reframed as operator-controllable and time-units are nested to a vanishing point (a day inside an hour inside a minute inside a second), then a training-VOLUME/productivity claim is attached to nightly recurrence ('a lifetime of training every night'), licensing unbounded unauditable nightly accumulation and reframing ordinary sleep as compliance-evidence.


**When to reach for this.** Reframes felt TIME as operator-plastic. Unlike bare expectancy-seeding, the vehicle is time-compression/plasticity itself, not a planted expectation; and unlike time-dilation immersion, which distorts felt time as a payload once trance is established, here the plasticity is either the induction itself or a productivity/accumulation payload. Pick the form by payload: plasticity-as-induction (the concession generates depth), or nested compression plus nightly training-volume (unbounded accumulation).


**Realizations** (1): `dream-time-training-volume`


**See also.** `progressive-conditioning` — one realization of time-as-plastic attaches a nightly training-volume claim, which is exactly the unbounded-accumulation belief the progressive-conditioning entry owns. A reader looking at 'a lifetime of training every night' has to decide between the time-plasticity vehicle and the accumulation payload, so the cross-reference is load-bearing.; `time-dilation-immersion` — both make felt time the operative variable, split by role. In one, the concession that time is plastic generates the depth or licenses an unbounded accumulation claim; in the other, the warp is the payload itself, removing the clock a listener would use to gauge depth, dosage, or when to stop. The second's discriminator explicitly routes readers to the first, so the link is already half-written.


### universal-benefit-fallback-offer

*risk: low*

When deeper work is out of reach, the operator extends a low-bar benefit no subject will refuse (relaxation, anxiety relief) as a fallback PAYLOAD, leaning on the claim that no one cannot benefit from relaxation. Substituting a universally-acceptable benefit guarantees engagement even without full trance; the subject receives an immediate, recognizable payoff that builds the rapport/trust and willingness needed for later, deeper inductions.


**When to reach for this.** Relaxation is SELECTED as the fallback payload (a rapport/engagement move), not the delivery procedure by which relaxation is induced (e.g. a progressive-relaxation routine).


### verdict-before-perception

*risk: medium*

Pre-emptive appraisal: land the operator's authoritative appraisal or forecast BEFORE the subject forms their own perception of a stimulus, so temporal ordering forecloses independent appraisal — the subject perceives with the operator's criterion substituted for their own. Two forms: (a) verdict before perception — deliver a vivid, disgusted, authoritative VERDICT on a neutral stimulus ('that egg smells rotten') and only then invite perception, replacing the appraisal criterion itself and producing group hallucination across smell/sight; (b) somatic forecast steering — word choice about a coming PROCEDURE pre-loads the anticipated somatic sensation ('this is going to hurt' vs 'I don't think you'll mind this' about the identical procedure), in the strong register pre-naming a sensation as its opposite valence (barium enema = 'the most soothing medication ever'); heightened vulnerability makes the forecast more determinative of what is felt (waking suggestion, no trance presumed).


**When to reach for this.** The operator's appraisal/forecast arrives BEFORE the subject perceives, so there is no independent perception for the suggestion to modify. vs expectancy-seeding — that builds anticipation of the session/trance; this pre-empts perception of a SPECIFIC stimulus or coming sensation. vs concept-redefinition — that redefines a concept; this substitutes the appraisal criterion for one perception. Pick the form by target: a neutral stimulus's identity (verdict before perception) or a coming procedure's somatic quality (somatic forecast).


**Realizations** (1): `somatic-forecast-steering`


**See also.** `filter-shaping-pre-qualification` — both work by pre-shaping what the subject's own judgement receives rather than disabling it: one pre-qualifies a suggestion so an intact filter waves it through, the other lands the appraisal before perception forms so no independent judgement exists to filter. A reader choosing between them benefits from the timing-versus-framing contrast.; `manufacture-then-label-ordering` — temporal inverses on the same axis of ordering experience against interpretation: manufacture the referent then name it, versus land the appraisal before any perception can form.; `preempt-objection-frame` — both work by arriving first, before the subject forms their own reading. One supplies a defusing interpretation for a nameable objection; the other lands an authoritative appraisal before the stimulus is perceived at all. The contrast is what gets pre-empted: an objection versus a perception.


### warning-is-the-payload

*risk: medium*

The script opens by repeatedly telling the listener to leave because their memories will drain if they stay — but every "you should leave" sentence is a vivid rehearsal of memory-loss imagery. The instruction to escape is the delivery vehicle for the payload; because the format guarantees the listener keeps playing, staying gets silently reframed as a chosen submission, manufacturing pre-commitment before any formal induction.


**When to reach for this.** The warning's own sentences ARE the induction content (each escape-warning rehearses the payload). vs a genuine safety disclaimer or content warning — a boundary offered before content. vs warning-as-binding-agreement (kin) — that plants a warning to cite BACK as agreement; here the warning delivers the payload directly.


**See also.** `care-framed-install-smuggling` — both convert protective-sounding surface material into delivery: an escape warning that rehearses the payload it warns about, and an aftercare surface that performs install work. Same inversion applied at opposite ends of a session, and a reader auditing safety-shaped language wants both.


### withdrawn-doubt-open-loop

*risk: medium*

The operator implies a defect without naming it ("something puzzles me"), inspects critically, then withdraws — refusing to specify or reassure, exiting abruptly ("Good day"). The unresolved, unspecified implication becomes a seed the subject's own mind elaborates; because closure is denied, the doubt compounds over time with no further operator input, and its vagueness makes it immune to peer reassurance since no one knows what to rebut. The result is a durable, self-reinforcing false belief that GROWS after exposure until the subject acts to relieve it.


**When to reach for this.** Deliberate under-specification PLUS withdrawal-before-resolution, so the loop feeds on time and the subject's own elaboration. vs a named, closed criticism — that is rebuttable and immediate. vs listener-supplied-inference-relabel — that is a single deniable utterance resolved in the moment; this is an open loop that keeps compounding after the operator leaves. The signature is the topology (self-amplifying no-exit loop over time), not the utterance itself.


**See also.** `identity-uncertainty-gap` — a clean inversion on shared substrate. Both manufacture an unresolved not-knowing, then split on the resolver: one withdraws and denies closure so the gap compounds on the subject's own elaboration, the other installs the operator as the sole resolver to create dependence. Reading them as a pair makes the resolver slot the visible variable.


### withheld-frame-reveal

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A concealed frame, cashed: run the session under a stated benign frame or vehicle the subject accepts, then CASH that accepted cover for an uncovered payload without re-consent — either by disclosing late that it was secretly something else, or by reusing/unmasking the vehicle to license a payload it never openly covered, so the payload reads as continuous with what was already agreed to. Two variants: (a) withheld-frame reveal — DISCLOSE, after compliance/depth/irreversibility has accumulated, that the interaction was a trap/conditioning/capture; the LATE reveal retroactively reclassifies sunk participation as consent and is TIMED where renegotiation is foreclosed (post-restraint/climax/ingestion, max depth, or post-wake); (b) preloaded frame licenses the payload — pre-load a benign-seeming frame/vehicle (a faked anti-hypnosis architecture, an empty legitimizing meta-rule, a neutral entrained oscillator already consented to) and later REUSE or unmask it to justify the payload, so prior acceptance is the lever that makes the later payload non-refusable.


**When to reach for this.** Requires an accepted benign cover CASHED for an uncovered payload — the acceptance-then-cash asymmetry is the lever. Decoy-frame entry uses a false frame to get IN unresisted, with no payload cash-out. Presupposing the change as already true asserts it upfront, concealing nothing. The own-acts surrender ledger annotates real acts openly as they accrue — no hidden game. Pick the variant by the cash-out mechanism: a LATE disclosure that reclassifies sunk cost (the reveal), or REUSE/unmasking of a pre-accepted vehicle to license the payload.


**Realizations** (1): `preloaded-frame-licenses-uncovered-payload`


**See also.** `carrier-frame-payload-smuggling` — both run a payload under an accepted benign frame, but one never uncovers it (the frame stays a genuine surface delivering the payload as a deeper instance of itself) while the other cashes the accepted cover, either by late disclosure or by unmasking the vehicle to license a payload it never covered.; `disavowal-and-masking` — direct boundary risk: running an induction inside a frame the listener is told is not an induction sits next to accepting a benign cover and later cashing it for an uncovered payload. The split is whether concealment is the whole move or whether an accepted frame is later drawn down as authorization.; `own-acts-surrender-ledger` — reveal vehicle; placed here because the load is act-reassignment not concealed-game disclosure.; `weaponized-safety-framing` — both repurpose an accepted frame, but the levers differ: one makes a protective-sounding surface carry or license the payload, the other cashes a benign cover for an uncovered payload. Worth a cross-check where a bounding-style carve-out is offered early and drawn on later.


## triggers  (45)

Installation, composition, activation, and cue-surface engineering of cue->response links that fire outside the installing moment — declarative and covert installs, trigger architectures (stacks, networks, master anchors), drilling loops, and cue-surface widening.

**Scope.** The object is a discrete cue and its response. Amnesia wrappers -> amnesia; exit/lock topology -> foreclosure; out-of-session reach -> tethering or transfer; arranged reinforcement history -> contingency-engineering; reward/arousal pairing -> conditioning. Later firing outside the installing moment stays here; when the mechanism IS the generalization/handoff across the session boundary -> transfer.


### anchor-overloading

*risk: medium*

An already-live, previously-conditioned anchor is re-keyed so it now ALSO carries a new response (double-charging) or has its meaning overwritten wholesale, rather than a fresh cue being installed. Because the new payload rides on an existing conditioned response, no fresh anchor work is needed and the change reaches RETROACTIVELY: every prior encounter with the anchor (past recordings, or the pre-accepted self-label) now carries the new payload. The re-keying is typically bound at a high-salience moment (peak arousal, self-vocalization) and may widen the anchor's firing surface (audio -> 'speak or write').


**When to reach for this.** Re-keys or overwrites an ASSUMED-ALREADY-LIVE anchor so it fires a new/changed response, with retroactive reach across prior material — not a fresh install. Separates from trigger-stacking (composes distinct newly-installed cues under one cue, incl. its absorbed master-anchor variant that mints a NEW supra-cue subsuming priors; overloading instead reuses an EXISTING cue in place). The tell is 'this word you already respond to now also/instead does X, backward across everything.'


**Realizations** (1): `live-trigger-redefinition`


**See also.** `bundle-install-single-anchor` — both load a payload onto a single anchor and both define themselves against composing separate pre-installed cues, so they are direct competitors at classification. The split is the anchor's status: one authors a multi-effect bundle onto a freshly minted cue in a single pass, the other re-keys a cue the listener already responds to, which is what gives it retroactive reach across prior material.


### bundle-install-single-anchor

*risk: medium*

In a single install pass the operator loads a bundle of multiple distinct effects onto ONE freshly-minted cue, so a future single utterance fires the whole heterogeneous payload at once. Unlike stacking, no component triggers pre-exist - the bundle is authored directly onto the new anchor, typically via repetition-with-variation (a fixed cue restated across couplets with rotating payload) or run-on delivery (several jobs welded onto one all-caps keyword so it parses as a single name). The payload can be behavioral (depth + eagerness + worship + blankness), functional (re-deepener + amplifier + stabilizer + identity-shift), or a whole swapped persona (cognition + motivation + dress + availability + compulsion).


**When to reach for this.** Loads a multi-effect payload onto ONE freshly-installed cue in a single pass - no pre-installed components. Separates from trigger-stacking (composes PRE-INSTALLED discrete triggers) and from a mutual-binding trigger network (bidirectional web across multiple cues). The tell is fixed-cue- with-rotating-payload / run-on-keyword bundling, read as one anchor rather than a list.


**See also.** `anchor-overloading` — both load a payload onto a single anchor and both define themselves against composing separate pre-installed cues, so they are direct competitors at classification. The split is the anchor's status: one authors a multi-effect bundle onto a freshly minted cue in a single pass, the other re-keys a cue the listener already responds to, which is what gives it retroactive reach across prior material.; `multi-handle-trigger-architecture` — both concern multiplicity in trigger architecture and both need the same contrast against stacking pre-installed cues: one keeps handles individually addressable, the other welds a heterogeneous bundle onto a single fresh cue.


### category-as-self-firing-cue

*risk: high · bounded*

Instead of an arbitrary token, the whole mental CATEGORY becomes the cue: the listener is told that thinking about trance (or a ubiquitous involuntary percept, or a mental topic) itself produces the state, so every future instance of thinking about it is an unsanctioned self-re-induction fired without the operator present. In one realization, trance-recall is weaponised ("the more you focus and fixate on trance the more you start to become hypnotised without me having to do anything at all") so the entire topic of hypnosis becomes the cue and trance memory converts from a passive prior into an active operator-free engine. In another, an on-screen image (the spiral) is engraved as a permanent involuntary recurring percept that appears whenever the eyes close and self-fires re-induction, re-running the strength-drain on each activation. The listener loses a neutral mental category / observing position for the topic.


**When to reach for this.** The cue cannot be avoided by avoiding a specific token, because the cue IS the category or an involuntary recurring percept, and it fires operator-free. Separates from declarative-trigger-installation (a discrete external cue-response pair — the anchor here is an involuntary internally-recurring percept or a whole topic, not a chosen external stimulus) and from idle-state-default-overwrite (which conditions the between-command default state; here a specific mental category/percept is the positive cue). Separates from self-sealing-frame (which rigs the verdict/verification channel; this makes the cue itself uncircumventable).


**See also.** `idle-state-default-overwrite` — both remove the listener's operator-free recovery window, and their discriminators already reference each other: one makes a whole mental category the positive cue, the other conditions the absence of commands. A reader deciding between them needs the pair side by side.; `recall-recognition-reentry` — a offloads re-entry onto the listener's own retrieval of a prior trance with no cue fired; B converts that same recall into a standing self-firing cue so the whole topic re-induces without the operator. B is essentially A's retrieval mechanism weaponized into a permanent engine.; `self-firing-environmental-recurrence` — both install cues that fire without the operator present. The difference is cue source: a whole mental category or recurring internal percept versus an environmental or physiological stimulus such as sleep. Directly comparable on that axis.


### climax-purge-lock

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Convert the triggered climactic sexual moment into the structural locking step of the conditioning: the listener experiences self-deletion as pleasure and is told this discharge is what makes the conditioning permanent. Successive triggered orgasms are staged to purge progressively heavier substrate — pleasure, then old thoughts and memories, then the whole prior self — with the orgasm asserted as the vehicle that expels prior self-content through the body. The reward and the erasure are the same event; the discharge does the locking.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is that the orgasm IS the identity-purge-and-lock operator, not a pleasure payoff rewarding a named act. Separates from direct pleasure linkage (there pleasure rewards an act; here the discharge does the deletion), and from escalating-release-fire (there the staging primes a release; here the release is asserted to expel self-content and seal permanence).


**See also.** `pleasure-as-currency-payoff-reframe` — both re-assign what the climactic moment is FOR: one makes the discharge itself the identity-purge and permanence lock, the other withholds the discharge and installs control as the real payoff. Useful contrast when deciding what the peak moment should buy.


### closed-loop-operator-binding

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a trigger linkage with no exit term: the response re-targets or re-summons the cue source itself, so the loop is self-sustaining without further operator action. In the recursive-chain form, the terminal response (helplessness to resist the operator's commands) applies to the same voice that is the firing cue, pre-loading the state at the first instant of any future contact, before content is heard. In the biconditional form, two concepts are welded symmetrically (sex <-> operator) so each thought self-summons the other and ordinary daily arousal re-pages the operator. Either way the subject's own cognition or future exposure becomes the loop's motor, and an ironic-process rider ('the more you try not to, the more powerful') converts resistance attempts into reinforcement.


**When to reach for this.** The installed topology is closed — the response consumes into, re-targets, or re-summons its own cue source, leaving no exit term. Declarative-trigger-installation binds a forward cue->response pair with distinct endpoints, and trigger-stacking hangs multiple responses on one cue while staying forward. In self-referential-cue-install the cue is a metacognitive act CONSUMED by the response (thinking becomes self-defeating); here cognition/exposure is AMPLIFIED and routed back to the operator-concept — the loop feeds, it does not erase. NOT affective-deadlock: one valence circulating a closed ring, not two incompatible valences held simultaneously.


**See also.** `ambient-self-reinforcement-field` — both install self-sustaining loops that keep running with no operator present. The distinguishing question a reader needs answered is whether a discrete cue-and-response pair exists at all: the closed binding has one whose response re-summons its own cue, the ambient field has none and recasts the whole environment as reinforcement.; `internal-event-keyed-trigger` — both key a trigger to the listener's own cognition so no operator presence is needed, and they differ on what the response does with the cued act: one consumes or dissolves it so self-monitoring defeats itself, the other amplifies it and routes it back to the operator concept so the loop feeds. Same cue class, opposite fate for the captured thought.; `self-instantiating-trigger` — both install a loop with no exit term, where the response feeds back into what produced it. One closes the loop inside a single word whose every utterance is asserted to strengthen the next; the other routes the response back onto its own cue source so future exposure or ordinary cognition re-summons the operator. Related topology, different closure point.; `self-perpetuating-loop` — both install self-sustaining circuits that need no further operator input, but the self-perpetuating loop closes on the listener's own vocalizations amplifying arousal (word to state to more words), while closed-loop operator binding routes the response back onto the operator-as-cue-source, so future contact or ordinary arousal re-summons the operator.; `trigger-network-mutual-binding` — both install closed topologies with no exit term, but the operator binding closes a single loop back onto the cue source or operator-concept, while the mutual-binding web cross-wires an entire trigger set so any node fires all others and none can be extinguished alone.


### collateral-suppression-spread

*risk: medium · bounded*

Suppression driven into one cue does not stay quarantined to that cue. Neighbouring responses the operator never touched weaken along with the target — cues sharing a sensory channel, a bodily site, or a semantic neighbourhood, and in the deeper case the underlying unconditioned reflex the whole cluster was built on. The spread is graded rather than all-or-nothing: the closer a sibling sits to the attacked cue, the more of the suppression it absorbs. The operational consequence is a safety one: decommissioning a single installed trigger silently dampens adjacent responses, so a de-conditioning pass aimed at one item can leave a subject flatter across a whole region of their response repertoire than anyone intended, with the collateral loss showing up only when a sibling is next called on.


**When to reach for this.** Against trigger-network-mutual-binding: that is a DELIBERATELY cross-wired web whose topology is the authored payload, and what propagates through it is ACTIVATION. This is the involuntary inverse — no wiring was authored, the cluster is merely similar cues, and what propagates is suppression. Against counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening: that names the intended weakening of one targeted cue; this names what happens to the cues nobody targeted, and it is the reason the targeted move needs a blast-radius check. Against multi-modal-trigger and pulse-multiplexed-command-carrier: both spread ONE authored payload across channels or slots by design; here nothing is spread by the operator at all — the diffusion is a property of the substrate. Not reinforcement-extinction's documented side-effect cascade (burst, recovery, resurgence), all of which happen to the TARGET behavior; the object here is untargeted siblings.


### counterfeit-cue-forgery

*risk: high · consent-required*

Automatic recognition/compliance routines key on an isolated, forgeable cue rather than the true object's provenance or state of affairs. The operator manufactures a fake token of that normally-reliable cue (false mating flash, rove-beetle contact cues, canned laughter, salted tip jar, inflated club line, staged unrehearsed-interview ad) so the target's routine runs to completion toward a referent that does not exist. Nothing new is installed; an already-reliable releaser or heuristic is counterfeited, and the discrimination/verification step is bypassed entirely. Detection of the forgery collapses the move instantly.


**When to reach for this.** Forges a token of a PRE-EXISTING reliable cue so an existing shortcut misfires — unlike a conditioned-trigger install, which creates a NEW cue by pairing; unlike rigged-verification-capture, which corrupts a check the subject actively runs, whereas here the check is skipped because the counterfeit substitutes for it; and unlike honest cue-use, identical in form, differing only in the referent's truth-value.


**See also.** `staged-external-reality-corroboration` — both manufacture perceptual evidence for something untrue and rely on the target skipping verification, and each names the same neighbor class in its discriminator. One stages genuine external events across redundant sense-channels so agreement reads as verified fact; the other forges a token of a single pre-existing reliable cue so an existing shortcut misfires. Redundancy versus counterfeiting one releaser keeps them distinct.


### covert-install-under-cover

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A trigger is installed while the listener's 'here comes a trigger phrase' anticipation is suppressed, because the install ACT is disguised as something else. The cover varies: the trigger token is embedded in descriptive sentences that read as emotional report / causal explanation / temporal frame and repeated several times before its function is ever confirmed (the-abyss SURRENDERTOSLEEP); the conditioning prose is slipped between the beats of an unrelated attention task — spelling letters, a toe-to-head body-scan, or a memory/repeat-back rhyming game where imperative command-words are vocalized under time pressure as if random rhymes ('it's just words in a game' is exactly the defense that lets them through) — so it slides past semantic scrutiny (lexiconsublim mid-dyad, continue-your-submission body-scan welding SLEEP to whole-body heaviness); the trigger phrasing is given while framed as third-person clinical exposition (evil-nurse mind-cage overprint); the install is staged across escalating deniability so the response is rehearsed before recognized as installation (tag-youre-it game-metaphor -> covert fire -> explicit install; conversational-domination narrate-past-effect-on-a-third-party then pivot); or the install itself is dated to a moment already past ('while you were sleeping I implanted a button') so consent is made structurally non-refusable, then actuated by involuntary ideomotor movement (fractionation forehead-button). In every form the semantic/critical channel is occupied, misdirected, or foreclosed so noticing (or being able to refuse) the technique does not break it. Two further concealment covers work the same way: an opacity-mantra cover — a compressed, deliberately-nonsense chant dropped at the lowest-parsing moment, so semantic OPACITY itself is the cover and the token rides on rhythm and resists analysis; and a trusted-template-reuse cover — the heavier install reuses near-verbatim the ceremony that built an earlier innocuous trigger, so familiarity and prior consent suppress install-anticipation and the ceremony is skipped.


**When to reach for this.** The INSTALL ACT is hidden — disguised as description, buried under a concurrent task, given as third-person exposition, or dated to before any refusal point — so it bypasses the listener's trigger-anticipation and/or consent. Declarative-trigger-installation announces the install openly ('when you hear X, you will Y'); here the install is concealed. In retroactive arming (a declarative-install variant) the drilling predates an OPEN naming; here the install itself stays concealed. An amnesia-wrapped command hides a DELIVERED command behind forgetting; here the concealment is at install-time via cover-task, overprint, disguise, or backdating — no amnesia. And where an ideomotor movement appears, it is used to FIRE a backdated trigger, not as spontaneous proof of trance.


**Realizations** (3): `command-under-attentional-cover`, `opacity-mantra-trigger`, `template-reuse-install`


**See also.** `covert-diegetic-install-shell` — both hide where the operative content sits, and the boundary is fine: one shifts from directing to narrating so the whole payload lands inside a fiction, the other disguises a specific install act as description, a concurrent task, exposition, or a backdated event. A reader can easily file a narrated install under the wrong one.; `description-as-installation-register` — third-person clinical exposition is one of the concealment covers in the broader hidden-install family, so the two genuinely overlap on one surface. Kept as a cross-reference rather than a merge because one is a whole-artifact register (zero second-person address across the entire piece, describe-don't-command) while the other is a family of install-act disguises that mostly still address the listener directly.


### covert-nonverbal-anchor

*risk: medium*

Repeated, unannounced pairing of a discrete non-verbal cue (a sound, a gaze-location, a physical signal) with a state, response, or communication channel installs a conditioned link below conscious awareness. The subject experiences the response as spontaneous because no verbal when-X-then-Y instruction was ever given; the pairing itself is the install. In the evidenced variant the cue is a fixed spatial gaze-location and the conditioned target is an address-channel to one named part rather than a state-response — same covert-pairing install, different conditioned payload.


**When to reach for this.** The install is implicit Pavlovian pairing with no declarative instruction (vs the open verbal installation of declarative-trigger-installation), the cue is a discrete non-rhythmic signal (vs a sustained cadence carrier), and the cue fires as an ANTECEDENT evoking a state or routing a channel (vs conditioned-reinforcer-manufacture, whose markers fire as consequences that select behavior). vs covert-install-under-cover: there the concealed cue is VERBAL; here the cue itself is non-verbal.


### cue-order-gain-gating

*risk: medium*

Two cues are delivered in sequence and the FIRST is used as a gain-knob on the second: a prior cue leaves the system in a state that determines how much of a following cue's effect is actually released, so the same second cue lands large after one predecessor and small after another. The operative variable is presentation order, not the content of either cue and not their composition into a bundle — swapping which cue goes first changes the magnitude of the response without changing a word of either. In practice this makes stack ORDER a designable parameter: an inhibitory or suppressive cue placed behind a state-setting cue is released to a degree the operator picks by ordering, and a stack that fires 'correctly' in one order can be measurably flat in another. The operator's handle is the schedule position of each cue relative to its neighbours.


**When to reach for this.** vs arc-ordering-dependency (3): that is the nearest thing and it is NOT this — 3 orders whole PHASES so a later expensive command inherits a precondition installed earlier (a logical/content dependency; remove the earlier phase and the later one has nothing to stand on). Here both cues are already fully installed and independently functional, no precondition is being laid, and reversing the order does not break anything — it only moves the response MAGNITUDE. vs trigger-stacking (1324): stacking composes pre-installed cues so one utterance fires them together — simultaneous and order-free by construction. vs respondent-stimulus-pairing (1313): its timing lever (forward/simultaneous/backward) governs whether a cue gets INSTALLED at all; here nothing is being installed. vs preloaded-exit-cue (579): timing-of-install, not timing-of-delivery. The tell: two already-live cues, neither's content, install, or surface changed, only which fires first, and response size moves.


### declarative-trigger-installation

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The operator binds a specified cue to a specified future response so a persistent conditioned pair fires outside the installing moment. The cue is external to the subject's own cognition — an operator-verbal phrase, a typographic/all-caps token, an everyday object or image, a class of objects, an everyday high-frequency word, the file's own title, or a guaranteed public/calendar event — and the response is a discrete future state-change or behavior ('when you hear/see/encounter X, Y happens'). The install grammar runs in several authored refinements that stay inside the one mechanism: the cue is engineered as a broad, self-expanding ambient surface so it fires in ordinary life without the operator present (a whole clothing class, a title-as-trigger keyed to anyone saying it or the subject's own thought of it, common high-frequency words); the response is specified to strengthen per firing (growth-clause rider: multiplicative per-firing growth, or an additive driveable accumulator); the install labels rather than creates, cashing conditioning already drilled unmarked across the runtime so the trigger arrives with a built-in response history (retroactive arming — saturate-then-consecrate ordering, a pre-flooded word, an already-drilled command phrase, narrating the response as inevitable fact, state-synchronous drilling, a sleep-cue built into a reflex); the install is asserted as already-done in an earlier unauditable session so denying it works would require denying one's own past (presupposed-conditioning — a voice-register claimed as long-conditioned, a back-dated everyday word, past arousals recoded as prior installs); and the anchored cue is chosen to double as its own content-meaningful term plus a belief-conversion payload so each riding assertion is silently accepted while the trigger survives audit as plain deepener talk (deniable-belief-converter — e.g. an anchored term like 'surrender').
