Two more cue-surface/register variants of the same install lever: an open-narrated install — the conditioning is narrated OPENLY in procedural language as it happens, transparency-as-disarm lowering scrutiny; and a somatic-anatomical cue — an imagined object is implanted at a named body-site so later mention of its name fires a felt body-SENSATION, the cue-surface being a body location rather than a word/object/image.


**When to reach for this.** Declarative cue->response binding for a discrete future state/behavior, the cue external to the subject's cognition. Tells AGAINST: the cue is the subject's own metacognitive/self-reference act consumed by the response (-> self-referential-cue-install); the response is valence/reward delivery only (that is conditioning territory, not a trigger install); the install works by temporal stimulus-pairing with no verbal contingency declaration (-> respondent-stimulus-pairing); the install ACT itself is concealed/disguised at delivery time (-> covert-install-under-cover); the install target is an open content-unknown slot inheriting conditioned weight (-> deferred-content-slot-install); the installed topology is a closed self-referential ring whose response re-summons the cue source (-> closed-loop-operator-binding); an object is given ambient symbolic meaning with no discrete fired response (no cue->response pair ever fires, so it is not a trigger install at all). The ambient-surface, growth-clause, retroactive-arming, install-by-assertion, and deniable-dual-function forms are all VARIANTS of this one install lever — twists on the cue-surface, the response-magnitude, the install-timing, the install-veridicality, or the cue's semantic doubling, not distinct moves.


**Realizations** (2): `imaginal-to-somatic-anchor`, `transparent-narrated-install-with-resistance-route`


**See also.** `internal-event-keyed-trigger` — both bind a cue to an installed response, but the general install keys on an operator-supplied or environmental token while the self-referential form keys on the listener's own act of thinking or self-reference, which makes it operator-free and untestable because checking is itself the cue.; `trigger-stacking` — stacking presupposes single installs already exist: the declarative install builds each cue-response pair, stacking then composes several under one cue. Reader arriving at either genuinely needs the other to know whether they are installing a pair or composing pre-installed ones.


### deferred-content-slot-install

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Builds a locked structure of conditioned words, then installs an OPEN slot in it: the listener pre-commits, at peak suggestibility (orgasm as the binding agent), to treat future content-unknown words — whatever they turn out to be, delivered live or in other recordings — as equivalent to the existing conditioned set, inheriting its full weight. The actual filler words are never cleanly delivered; the install target is a VARIABLE, not a value — a future-tense backdoor on the conditioning that the operator can re-enter and fill arbitrarily.


**When to reach for this.** The install target is an open, content-unknown slot pre-authorized to inherit existing conditioned weight. vs declarative-trigger-installation: there a fixed, known cue-response pair is declared at install time; here nothing bound is known at commitment time. The orgasm is the binding agent, not a conditioned response — this is not arousal-to-cue conditioning. And the concealment is NON-DELIVERY of the filler content, not an amnesia wrapper around a delivered command. Not a growth-clause variant: growth clauses strengthen a KNOWN response; the slot defers WHAT is installed, not how strongly.


**See also.** `future-commitment-binding` — both pre-authorize content that does not exist at commitment time, which is a real boundary: one binds arbitrary future verbal commitments extracted under a stated condition, the other installs an open slot that future unspecified words inherit weight through. A reader classifying an open-ended pre-authorization needs both to pick correctly.; `meta-suggestibility-conditioning` — both install a capacity rather than a value, which is a real structural kinship: one conditions general receptiveness to whatever the next file does, the other installs an open slot pre-authorized to inherit existing conditioned weight from content not yet delivered. A reader assessing what a file leaves usable for later needs both, and the distinction (disposition versus named empty variable) is worth stating.; `open-slot-attachment-frame` — both install a frame with a deliberately empty slot and let the slot's vacancy carry the payload, which makes them easy to confuse. They differ in who fills it and when: one leaves the slot open so the listener's own associations attach during the session, the other pre-commits the listener to accept whatever the operator later drops in. Not one technique twice — the filler and the power that fills it are different.


### disinhibition-unmasking

*risk: medium · bounded*

An unrelated, salient intruder stimulus is injected while a conditioned response is being actively held down by an installed suppression, and the suppression transiently lifts so the blocked response reappears — then fades again on its own within seconds to minutes without the suppression having been undone. The intruder need have no relation to either the cue or the response; novelty and salience are what does the work, so a startle, an interruption, an unexpected touch, or any orienting-grabbing event will serve. Operationally this fires a blocked trigger past an installed inhibition without re-installing the trigger, and defensively it explains why a bounded or expired suggestion transiently resurfaces on a startle and then self-limits. The suppression survives the episode intact — nothing is extinguished, released, or re-learned.


**When to reach for this.** Against disconfirmation-suppression: that entry PROTECTS a running belief-dependent effect by keeping a contradicting fact out; this one temporarily LIFTS an existing suppression using a stimulus with no relation to the content at all. Against install-concealment-amnesia and self-sealing-recall-loop: both conceal or foreclose access to an install; here nothing is concealed and nothing is retrieved — a suppressed motor/affective response simply re-emits. Against internal-event-keyed-trigger: there the subject's own cognition is the installed cue for a designed response; here the intruder is external, arbitrary, uninstalled, and its effect is on the suppression layer rather than on any cue-response pair. Distinct from counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening and reinforcement-extinction in direction: those weaken a link, this transiently un-weakens one that was already weakened, then reverts.


### dose-gated-suppression-bleed

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A suppression installed on one cue does not stay on that cue. Once the trained inhibition passes an intensity threshold, unrelated responses in other channels — different modality, different content, nothing shared with the target — measurably weaken too. Below that threshold the effect stays local. So the operator's own dial sets the blast radius: a light, targeted denial or block does what it says, while a heavily-drilled or heavily-loaded one degrades responsiveness the operator never touched and did not intend to touch. This is a side-effect law over installs rather than a technique to reach for: it predicts collateral damage as a function of how hard the suppressor was driven, and its practical form is a ceiling on suppressor intensity.


**When to reach for this.** `multi-modal-trigger` and `trigger-network-mutual-binding` both put one response into several channels or cross-wire a set, but both are DELIBERATE wiring the operator authored; here the spread is unwired, unintended, and reaches responses that were never part of any set. `disconfirmation-suppression` blocks a subject's exposure to a disconfirming fact — a move on the information environment, not a conditioned inhibition with a spread profile. `massed-practice-rate-suppression` suppresses one behaviour by over-emitting it and makes no cross-channel claim at all. The deciding tell is the dose gate: the claim is not that suppression spreads, it is that spread is a threshold function of the suppressor's intensity, so a weak install and a strong install of the same content have qualitatively different footprints.


### double-anchored-climax-release

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A climax (HFO) is bound REDUNDANTLY to two simultaneous triggers at the release point, one of which is a re-invokable sensory-imagery anchor, so the orgasm is welded to a cue that can be re-fired later. A 10->1 countdown with the mantra at full volume converges on "one", where the operator's spoken kiss AND a lips-touching image fire together as the release; the imagined kiss serves as the re-invokable anchor and an immediate post-orgasmic drop ("sleep deep for me now") sets up amnesia work. The double-binding (kiss + count) is the tell: the orgasm is anchored to a sensory cue re-usable outside this discharge, not merely commanded once.


**When to reach for this.** A climax is double-anchored (count + re-invokable sensory image) at release so it welds to a reusable cue. A general trigger install pairs a cue with a response; here the install target is a climax welded to a re-invokable sensory anchor — and unlike arousal-cue conditioning, the conditioned output is a discrete climax-event bound to a re-firable anchor, not a general aroused-state on a cue.


**See also.** `redundant-anchor-faulttolerance` — both attach more than one anchor to a single install, for different reasons worth contrasting. One binds a discharge to two simultaneous cues so it welds to a sensory image re-firable later; the other layers heterogeneous closure anchors so each covers another's failure mode. Reusability versus fault tolerance is the deciding question.


### generalization-gradient-coupling

*risk: medium · bounded*

An installed cue is not an isolated point but a centre with a halo of near-miss variants that fire it. Withholding reinforcement from ONLY the halo — deliberately extinguishing the near-misses while leaving the trained centre alone — drags the centre down with them, sometimes all the way to zero. Halo and centre behave as one coupled system rather than as independent responses, so there is no clean way to narrow a cue by starving its periphery. Operationally this is a hard constraint on selective decommissioning: any attempt to trim an over-broad trigger by unreinforcing its edges risks taking out the trigger itself.


**When to reach for this.** An unengineered coupling between one cue's trained centre and its near-miss halo: extinguishing only the halo drags the centre down with it, so an over-broad trigger cannot be narrowed by starving its periphery. Against trigger-network-mutual-binding (1323) — the tell is that nothing was wired: 1323's inextinguishability is a designed topology over MULTIPLE separately-installed triggers cross-firing laterally, whereas this is a gradient property of a SINGLE cue and appears in installs that never touched a second trigger. Against discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement (306) — 306 is the procedure that DEFEATS this coupling by reinforcing the centre CONCURRENTLY while withholding at the periphery; the coupling described here holds only in the unreinforced-centre case, which is exactly the scope line between the two. Against reinforcement-extinction (432) — 432's collateral warnings concern topography substitution and un-enumerated reinforcer sources, i.e. spread across RESPONSES and reinforcer channels; this is spread across the STIMULUS dimension of one cue. Not context-generalization (1333): that widens an intact payload's firing surface deliberately; here the spread is in the extinction direction and unwanted.


### internal-event-keyed-trigger

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs an enumerated cue-response pair whose firing cue is a structural event of the listener's own cognition or self-reference — a thought forming, a resistance impulse being noticed, an introspective check occurring, or the subject's own self-referential act (an installed name/self-label thought of in the third person, so ordinary self-thought fires the response and the trigger cannot be dropped without losing self-reference itself) — rather than any operator-supplied or environmental token. Because the cue class is exactly the faculty that would monitor, test, or resist the state, the trigger is self-firing (no operator presence required), self-policing (fires at the frequency of the listener's own cognition), and untestable by design (checking whether it landed is itself an instance of the cue, so self-monitoring backfires). The installed response is a distinct automatic routine that runs instead of, consumes, or weaponizes the cued mental act: a replacement mantra, a dissolution of the forming thought, a discharge phrase-reflex, or a state-flip into blankness; the blankness form may carry a paired reward (only compliance is rewarded), be re-keyed from voluntary thinking onto an involuntary autonomic act (blinking) to make it unavoidable, and be wrapped in self-amnesia ('remembering to forget') so the subject cannot recall why thinking dissolves. In another form, the cued mental act is a PRE-EXISTING autonomy faculty — the lucid-dream 'reality check' — weaponized: its trigger is reassigned so exercising the faculty that would grant self-liberation instead routes to operator-salience; the same self-cognitive-act-as-cue lever, operator-free, with the response weaponizing rather than dissolving the act.


**When to reach for this.** Fires on a structural event of the listener's own cognition or self-reference, consumed by the response — not on an operator-supplied, environmental, or content-specific cue token. A trigger keyed to thinking OF something specific and external is an ordinary trigger install with an imaginal cue channel; a trigger keyed to thinking AT ALL, to noticing one's own state, or to one's own self-reference (installed name / self-monitoring for the effect) is this entry. Unlike resistance-fold, which reroutes EXERCISED push-back to feed a frame, the captured act here is neutral self-reference or self-monitoring, not resistance. It is an enumerated cue-to-automatic-routine pair with a nameable installed response, not a re-valencing frame; and firing is involuntary and adversarial to in-flight cognition, not the volitional self-delivery of a trained trigger. The reward-paired / blink-rekeyed / self-amnesia-wrapped blankness form is a variant of the same self-consuming-cognition cue; the amnesia there hides the RULE of the install rather than wrapping a delivered command.


**Realizations** (3): `cognition-triggered-blankness`, `faculty-hijack-reroute`, `self-referential-cue-install`


**See also.** `closed-loop-operator-binding` — both key a trigger to the listener's own cognition so no operator presence is needed, and they differ on what the response does with the cued act: one consumes or dissolves it so self-monitoring defeats itself, the other amplifies it and routes it back to the operator concept so the loop feeds. Same cue class, opposite fate for the captured thought.; `declarative-trigger-installation` — both bind a cue to an installed response, but the general install keys on an operator-supplied or environmental token while the self-referential form keys on the listener's own act of thinking or self-reference, which makes it operator-free and untestable because checking is itself the cue.


### latency-compressed-operator-macro

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The operator drills a multi-token command sequence across rounds with visibly shrinking inter-token latency and contracting verbal scaffolding until a single lead token suffices. A three-step editing macro (name a target "fake", issue "delete", insert a "replace" content) is run four rounds; by the last round "fake" alone triggers the whole procedure. The listener internalizes the sequence as a callable procedure they experience THEMSELVES running, which is self-attributing: operator pronouncements convert from debatable claims into executed keystrokes, and resistance to a deletion reads as resistance to one's own act. The lever is latency-compression toward single-word invocation of an internalized command set.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from within-session-conditioning-loop, which reinforces a cue-response-reward pairing; here the drilled object is a compressible MULTI-TOKEN procedure the listener runs on themselves, with latency-compression toward single-word invocation as the tell, and self-attribution ("you deleted that, not me") as the payload. Separates from a plain trigger install because it is a callable command SET, not a single cue.


### monotonic-amplifier-dial

*risk: medium*

A phrase trigger is installed atop a pre-elicited positive state via a "volume dial" metaphor that frames the state as monotonically ratcheting — each fire is "even more", never a return to baseline. The dial metaphor pre-loads an expectation gradient (the listener now expects each firing to feel stronger, and that expectation does much of the claimed work) and removes the listener's role in regulating intensity: how strong it feels is now determined by utterance count, not self-report. The amplifier typically bundles several axes (euphoria, acceptance, brightness, arousal) under one trigger, so a single "feel better" tap also pushes compliance; a deliberate dial-down proves recallability. Requires an existing positive reading to turn up — installation at neutral baseline fails. In a token-bound form, the same operator-driven intensity dial runs on a concrete token instead of a phrase: a diffuse memory is stripped to pure feeling and bound to a listener-chosen token (e.g. a color) that the operator continuously turns up ("let it grow") — a persisting, driveable state-OBJECT rather than a discrete phrase-fire, with the operator still holding the monotonic gradient and the same illusion of listener ownership.


**When to reach for this.** The install frames the trigger as a monotonic intensity ratchet whose gradient is supplied by operator pacing and attributed to the phrase, removing listener regulation. Plain declarative trigger installation installs a fixed-magnitude response, not a self-escalating dial; arousal-cue conditioning makes arousal the payload, whereas here the payload is a bundled positive state with arousal only one axis — the dial's monotonic gradient is the defining move.


**Realizations** (1): `affect-condensation-dial`


### multi-handle-trigger-architecture

*risk: medium*

Rather than one cue-response pair, the operator installs a set of separately-addressable handles onto distinct facets of the installed state, or accretes many affects/objects onto one token that retains all prior meanings. Two sub-forms recur: (a) several verbal triggers with NON-interchangeable functions (state-recall, state-arrest/freeze, identity-tag) each invokable independently later; and (b) accretive stacking onto ONE polysemous token via a "keep the meanings it has AND also become a symbol for..." instruction, fusing achievement/mood/sexual affect (listener-supplied, self-calibrated, hard to invalidate); or a gallery of durable object-anchors accumulated across a long frame then transferred out of the fiction into the listener's real environment. The architecture itself is the technique — a structured multi-lever control surface, not a single response.


**When to reach for this.** The install target is a structured SET of addressable handles or an accretive multi-affect token, not a single cue-response pair. Plain declarative trigger installation installs one cue-response pair, and trigger stacking layers multiple cues that fire ONE bundled response; here the handles stay individuated and separately fireable, or one token keeps multiple distinct meanings addressable at once.


**See also.** `addressable-construct-building` — both build durable structures engineered for later access rather than present-tense effect: one constructs an addressable imaginal object with a location or route, the other installs a set of separately fireable handles onto distinct facets of a state. A designer thinking about post-session re-entry surfaces should see both.; `bundle-install-single-anchor` — both concern multiplicity in trigger architecture and both need the same contrast against stacking pre-installed cues: one keeps handles individually addressable, the other welds a heterogeneous bundle onto a single fresh cue.; `portable-state-retrieval-cue` — both install more than a plain cue-response pair and the confusion is live: a structured set of separately-fireable handles (or one token holding several addressable meanings) versus a single portable handle that reloads an installed felt state outside the session. Multiplicity of handles versus portability of one is the split worth showing a reader.


### multi-modal-trigger

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

One trigger is made to fire across multiple sensory or representational channels — heard, read, thought, spoken, touched — so the conditioned response survives missed cues and follows the subject into more contexts, and the subject cannot recall or internally reference the cue without firing it (internal thought is not a safe harbor). Forms in evidence: sequential extension of an installed trigger into new channels; simultaneous all-channel firing at the moment of state capture for redundant encoding (tactile primacy claimed); firing across all verbal delivery modes (operator-heard, silently self-thought, spoken aloud); flooding a single token across visual/olfactory/gustatory channels with listener-supplied detail; using the listener's OWN self-applied identity handle/name as the cue so every use of the persona fires the response and casual identity-use becomes impossible (an always-on self-trigger surface running outside sessions); a non-verbal build mapping opposite somatic outcomes to per-ear stereo tones drilled as a reflex the subject cannot consciously author; and restoring a destroyed cross-modal anchor by re-siting its function onto a substitute matching the lost cue's physical slot and every channel. Absorbed (genus, cue-surface widening on further axes — same 'make the cue fire in more situations' lever): written/text channel (tell: extend the trigger to fire from operator-addressed WRITTEN media — email, website, chat — a persistent async between-session channel, and a typographic-gestalt sub-form conditioned to a spaceless all-caps SHAPE recognized at a glance; must be explicitly installed, does not transfer from a spoken cue); scope/catchment widening (tell: progressively widen WHAT qualifies as the cue — aroused -> sexy image -> any image — using a backward countdown / depth-pacing as the vehicle so each expansion lands too deep to evaluate; the widening axis is the semantic catchment rather than the sensory channel).


**When to reach for this.** SEVERAL channels carry the SAME trigger-response pair — vs declarative-trigger-installation single-cue installation, vs compound-sample-class-expansion where compound components become independently matchable class members, vs deliberate single-cue placement OFF the dominant channel (analogical-marking), and vs environmental-retrigger-seeding (reach expansion via real-world object seeding, not sensory-channel extension of one cue).


**Realizations** (3): `bilateral-trigger`, `counted-generalization-widening`, `text-platform-trigger`


**See also.** `context-generalization` — both widen the firing surface of an already-installed response; the split is sensory channel versus real-world context. Adjacent enough that a reader can easily reach for the wrong one.; `convergent-multichannel-encoding` — both are redundancy topologies delivering one payload over several channels at once, but one uses covert linguistic channels under a single tracked surface while the other extends a conditioned cue across sensory or representational modes. Same shape, different substrate, so the pointer prevents a mis-assignment.


### narrative-scene-loop-as-conditioning-unit

*risk: medium*

The operator stages the SAME narrative scene sequence (wake confused, notice headphones, plan escape, get caught, re-headphoned, fade) four near-identical times with a degraded starting state each pass, making the loop ITSELF the conditioning vehicle rather than narrative filler. For the identifying listener linear time collapses: each "wake" feels like the first while the character is measurably worse off, teaching experientially that repetition is invisible from inside. The reset carries a cumulative state-change and an explicit deja-vu cue given to the listener so the sameness is registered as technique, and the listener's own resistance ferries them to the next pass.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from within-session-conditioning-loop, whose unit is a cue-response-reward pairing; here the conditioning UNIT is a whole repeated narrative scene with cumulative state-degradation, so the vehicle is diegetic loop-structure not a discrete trigger drill. Separates from fractionation, which oscillates trance DEPTH — this loops a narrative scene four times with degradation, not a depth oscillation. The state-change per pass plus the explicit deja-vu cue are the tells.


### non-reset-arousal-ratchet-loop

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A repeated four-beat loop (build to edge, 'edge now', 'stop edging but continue masturbating lightly', micro-cooldown, rebuild) is run as the core body of the script, each cycle declaring itself stronger and shortening the cooldown. The decisive feature is the NON-RESET cooldown: the trough denies release but keeps the hands moving, so baseline arousal ratchets UP rather than resetting to zero, and shortening cooldowns compress the duty cycle to accelerate accumulation toward desperation and deeper mindlessness. The result is a sawtooth trending monotonically upward, with edge-pacing progressively offloaded to the conditioned listener; it collapses if the listener either keeps edging continuously or stops entirely.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from fractionation, whose troughs are full waking-contrast RESETS that deepen by contrast; here the troughs deny release WITHOUT resetting arousal (hands keep moving) so baseline climbs. Separates from a within-session conditioning loop because the cycled variable is a non-resetting arousal accumulation, not a discrete cue-response-reward pairing. The 'continue masturbating' non-reset cooldown is the tell.


**See also.** `irreversible-ratchet-persistence` — two non-resetting accumulators built on repeated cycles: one carries the ratchet on a named inner scalar or on posture, the other on arousal baseline with a cooldown that refuses to reset. Same structural idea on different carried quantities, worth linking rather than merging.; `monotonic-ratchet-one-way-valve` — the arousal loop whose troughs deny reset is a concrete arousal-domain instance of the one-way ratchet topology. Worth linking as species to genus; keep separate because one is a citable four-beat body loop and the other a whole-trajectory reachability property.; `severed-relief-valve-ramp` — both build monotonic arousal by removing reset, but one is a whole-arc topology property (no discharge channel exists anywhere, so orgasm itself raises arousal) while the other is a repeated four-beat edge cycle whose cooldown keeps the hands moving — arc-level severance versus a cycle-level non-resetting trough.; `unsatisfiable-arousal-overrun` — both engineer arousal that never discharges, but by different structural means: one pushes past a declared scale ceiling and moves the reward off release entirely; the other runs a cycled build-and-deny loop whose troughs never reset baseline. A writer choosing a no-discharge design benefits from seeing both the ceiling-breach and the non-reset-ratchet routes.


### open-authority-socket

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Binds activation authority for an installed state to the UTTERANCE of a trigger phrase rather than to any specific or consented operator — 'when somebody says', 'as soon as someone tells you', 'whomever said this words is obviously your pimp', 'usable by I or anyone else'. Whoever learns the phrase can toggle the subject's state, often with the promotion presupposed as already-completed ('obviously') and with downstream judgment (pricing, commands) delegated to that arbitrary speaker. The distinguishing structural property is that the activation set is identity-agnostic and un-vetoable at activation time — a socket that accepts any key-holder, not a delegated right handed to a named party.


**When to reach for this.** Activation is granted by identity-agnostic UTTERANCE (any speaker, no consent check, no in-normal-state veto), not to a named/nominated delegate as in third-party-activation. Separates from third-party-activation (specific trusted party holds the right) and from persona-programming twists by keying on the access-control property: who is admitted to fire, and the answer is 'anyone who speaks the phrase.'


**See also.** `third-party-activation` — an access-control pair that each already name the other: activation granted to any speaker of the phrase versus activation delegated to one named party. The distinction is the whole point of both entries, so the pointer is load-bearing.


### operator-exclusive-trigger-firing

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

After a trigger is installed, an exclusivity clause captures the trigger surface for one operator: the cue is bound to fire only in the operator's voice / the operator's files, or 'I and only I say it', so the same word spoken by anyone else (or self-administered) has zero effect (pointless, useless) and both self-soothing/desensitization and third-party dilution of ownership are blocked. Two layers run at once: the clause defends the trigger against ambient activation that would fatigue or break the conditioning, and it converts every ambient occurrence of the word into a craving for the operator's voice, so other people's use becomes an advertisement (the non-firing is felt as deprivation). Frequently the exclusivity is safety-coded ('for your hypnotic safety, your mind will lock the word to my voice and my voice only') so resisting the lockdown feels like resisting one's own protection and the listener actively cooperates; and it is often paired with a hot-swap, retiring a freshly-drilled working trigger and transferring the felt response by substitution onto the new, voice-locked word. The effect is parasocial dependence tied to a specific voice and a structural disadvantage to any competing operator.


**When to reach for this.** Gates the FIRING of an installed trigger to the operator's voice alone (owned re-induction, valueless without her voice) and converts ambient exposure into craving. It is a post-install access-control clause, not the install itself, and it gates trigger firing, not state exit as an asymmetric state-lock does. It is more specific than a generic loyalty suggestion: the move is exclusivity plus craving-on-absence — voice capture. Where third-party activation DELEGATES firing rights outward, this EXCLUDES third parties and the listener alike. And unlike a genuine safety clause that bounds a trigger's scope as real protection, here the safety-coding is cover for capturing the trigger surface. The craving-on-absence, safety-coded voice-lock, and hot-swap forms are variants of one exclusivity lever.


**See also.** `third-party-activation` — opposite settings of the same access-control dial over an already-installed trigger: firing rights excluded to one operator versus handed out to a nominated delegate. A writer deciding who may fire a trigger needs the pair, and both discriminators already turn on the contrast.; `trust-gated-trigger-clause` — both are clauses attached after a trigger is installed that constrain when it may fire, and both are safety-coded while functioning as a tie to the operator. A reader classifying a bounding clause should see both: one gates on a trust or context condition, the other on the operator's voice alone.


### phase-gated-suppressor-timing

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Whether a suppressing probe damps a response or amplifies it is decided by WHEN it lands relative to the host response's own internal phase. Fired while the host is in its inhibitory phase, the probe is strongly damped — a majority of its effect gone. Fired once the host's excitatory phase has surfaced, the same probe at the same intensity summates instead and boosts the very response it was meant to interrupt. Nothing about the probe changes; only the inter-stimulus interval does. The operator-usable consequence is blunt: a stop-cue, interrupt or counter-suggestion has a window, and delivering it outside that window does not merely fail — it strengthens the target.


**When to reach for this.** v7's timing entries are contiguity and order rules for BUILDING an association — forward pairing beats backward, this precedes that — and they govern whether a link forms, never whether an existing effect inverts its sign. `pulse-multiplexed-command-carrier` bundles several payloads onto one pulse so refusal cost is shared; the timing there is a packing convenience, not a gate on sign. `opposed-state-fusion-trigger` gets two opposed effects out of one cue by binding both at install; here one probe has both effects available and the interval alone selects between them at run time. `anti-emergence-reflex-anchor` opposes a specific exit rather than describing a timing law. `within-session-conditioning-loop` is a pairing unit. The deciding tell is a sign flip — same probe, same target, same magnitude, opposite outcome — as a pure function of inter-stimulus timing, which no shipped entry represents on any axis.


### post-wake-ratification-fire

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

After a full wake count to 'awake and normal', the operator fires an installed trigger the instant the trance frame closes, deliberately overwriting the emergence reassurance and collapsing the trance/waking safety boundary. The in-body response immediately after being told one is normal is offered as the most persuasive proof of waking-life durability; the withhold-then-fire and self-amplification riders ('the more you use it the more powerful') extend the demonstration into an instruction to strengthen the anchor over time.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is a live trigger fire placed AFTER the wake count that contradicts the 'refreshed, normal, awake' framing on purpose. Plain trigger-activation fires in-frame with no boundary move; a waking suggestion is delivered DURING emergence, not fired after closure to puncture the boundary; and an in-session depth convincer proves depth inside the session, not out-of-session reach.


**See also.** `awake-channel-trance-surface` — both attack the trance/waking boundary rather than working inside it: one redeclares the ordinary waking channel as a suggestion surface, the other fires a trigger immediately after the wake to contradict the emergence framing. A reader interested in reach past the session edge benefits from seeing the standing-channel and the puncture-the-boundary routes together.; `in-emergence-trigger-proof` — both fire an installed trigger around the wake boundary to prove it reaches waking life, and both are easy to mislabel as ordinary trigger use. The cut is placement relative to closure: one interrupts or holds the emergence to test-fire inside it, the other waits until the frame is fully closed and the subject has been told they are normal, then fires to contradict that. Same evidentiary purpose, different boundary being punctured.; `inverted-emergence-amplification` — both attack the emergence boundary so waking does not settle the install, but the inverted gradient installs a belief that emerging strengthens the effects while denying anything happened, whereas the ratification fire physically demonstrates it by firing a trigger after the wake count contradicts it.; `subverted-emergence-state-hold` — both attack the session's exit boundary and are natural partners in an ending, but one leaves the wake count intact and punctures it afterward with a live trigger fire, while the other rewrites the wake gate itself so baseline is never reached.; `wake-exempting-preserved-trigger` — both exploit the moment after a wake that promises full restoration, so a reader studying wake-boundary subversion should see them together; one discloses the carve-out in advance and lets remembered acceptance do the binding, while the other says nothing and fires the trigger the instant the frame closes so the body's response contradicts the reassurance.


### proprioceptive-gait-metronome

*risk: medium · bounded*

A whole-script chant (tick, tock, walk) is mapped onto the cadence of the listener's own footfall, so trance maintenance runs on proprioception rather than attention to the audio. The trigger becomes portable, silent, and operator-independent, depth is sustained by the listener's own body rhythm without operator presence, and the tick-tock image doubles as a clock/inevitability and wind-up-doll identity payload. Absorbed (genus): ongoing-act-parasitized-as-trigger (tell: an act already in motion — masturbation — is retroactively NAMED as the induction/deepener so 'every stroke = sinking'; the same own-ongoing-body-activity-sustains-the-state lever as the footfall metronome, operator-independent, parametric on which body activity carries it — gait cadence vs an ongoing manual act).


**When to reach for this.** The maintaining rhythm is the listener's own body motion, not an operator-delivered cadence (vs rhythm-anchoring and every carrier sibling), and it is a whole-script metronome with dual semantic payload rather than a localized posture-compression instruction set.


**Realizations** (1): `ongoing-act-parasitized-as-trigger`


**See also.** `attention-anchor-portable-internalization` — both hand the listener a pacing device that keeps running when the operator is not speaking — an internalized visual object in one case, the listener's own body rhythm in the other. Reading across shows the shared design goal of an operator-independent metronome and the two available carriers for it.; `breath-pacing-entrainment` — both run depth on a rhythm the listener already produces rather than an operator-delivered cadence, split by instrument: gross body motion such as gait or an ongoing manual act, versus breath or silently subvocalized verse meter. Worth linking so the body-motion versus autonomic-tempo choice is explicit.; `exercise-masked-cadence-induction` — both hang the maintaining cadence on the listener's own repetitive body motion so the trigger becomes portable and works without the operator present, and both note the whole thing weakens if the listener is not actually moving. They differ in the carrying activity and in payload: one rides walking cadence with a clock and wind-up-doll image, the other hides the cadence inside gym motion and names its own function. Same lever, different vehicle, so link.; `prosodic-pacing-rail` — both are whole-form carriers rather than passage-local moves, sustaining the state without requiring per-line attention. The useful contrast is where the rhythm lives: the listener's own body motion in one, the engineered prosody of the delivery in the other, which is exactly the operator-independence question a reader is deciding.; `reading-act-as-induction-substrate` — genuine structural siblings: both recruit an act the listener is already performing involuntarily (scanning lines of text; walking cadence) as the carrier that induces or sustains the state, so no discrete task exists to refuse and no operator presence is needed. They differ in which carrier and whether the medium is written or portable-somatic, which is exactly the choice a reader of either is making.


### pulse-multiplexed-command-carrier

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A single recurring pulse-stimulus is assigned multiple concurrent payloads — deepening, muscle relaxation, cognitive blanking, image installation — then a motor stroke-command and a reward beat are yoked onto the same pulse, so resistance to any one channel costs resistance to all, partial compliance is structurally more expensive than full, masturbation is de-paced from listener desire and re-paced to the operator-cited clock, and the trigger is delivered as ongoing reality with no conditional framing. Absorbed (genus): multi-slot countdown cipher (tell: the COUNTED surface of the multi-payload carrier — each number of a short count carries a SEPARATE behavioral command (4=inhale ... 1=surrender) and the sequence auto-fires the whole multi-step program, re-firing as a structural metronome between blocks; same load-multiple-payloads-on-one-recurring-carrier lever, parametric on carrier — per-number sequential slots vs simultaneous pulse-multiplex).


**When to reach for this.** The tell is the MULTIPLEX — multiple simultaneous state-changes plus a motor command bundled on one shared stimulus so opt-out is structurally suppressed. vs rhythm-anchoring (one keyed response, refusal of it costs nothing else), vs chant-engine-payload-carrier (sequential loading after entrainment, no shared refusal cost), vs declarative-trigger-installation (no X-when-Y install, the coupling is stated as already-operating reality).


**Realizations** (1): `multi-slot-countdown-cipher`


**See also.** `carrier-is-cargo-fusion` — both are topology moves that remove a separable refusal point: several payloads yoked to one recurring stimulus, versus the persistence carrier fused into the behaviour being asked for. Different fusions, same design goal of leaving no standalone thing to decline.; `multi-channel-braiding` — both defeat selective resistance by bundling, and the distinction is worth stating: one loads several payloads onto a single recurring stimulus so refusing one costs all, the other interleaves separate streams below the sentence or line so none can be isolated. Shared carrier versus shared texture is a real fork a writer must choose between.; `respiration-coupled-substitution-engine` — both load several concurrent payloads onto one involuntary recurring carrier so opting out of any channel is structurally expensive. The carriers differ (an operator-cited pulse versus the breath cycle with opposing per-phase jobs) but the multiplexing lever is genuinely shared and reading one clarifies the other.


### recency-gated-discrimination-potency

*risk: low*

A discrimination yields its leverage only while it is FRESHLY formed. A distinction the subject has just learned to make produces a large boost; the same distinction after heavy practice produces none at all, having settled into an unremarkable habit. Introducing a finer discrimination on the same dimension revives the leverage. The operational consequence is a scheduling rule that runs against the usual instinct to drill: the resource is the learning transition, not the learned state, so an operator wanting continued potency keeps subdividing rather than rehearsing what is already settled.


**When to reach for this.** Potency is carried by the ACQUISITION TRANSITION of a discrimination, not by the settled discriminated state — so a just-formed distinction yields a large boost, a heavily-drilled one yields none, and introducing a finer split on the same dimension revives it. Against discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement (306): 306 BUILDS stimulus control and banks the finished product as its payoff; this entry says the finished product is exactly where the leverage has gone, and prescribes subdividing rather than drilling to criterion — same procedure, opposite scheduling advice, and the two are used together (306 to build, this to decide when to stop building and re-split). Against respondent-habituation (facet of 1313): that is magnitude decay of an involuntary ELICITED reflex under massed re-presentation with no pairing; here nothing habituates — the discrimination remains fully intact and accurate, only its leverage is spent, which is why re-splitting restores it and rest does not. Against progressive-conditioning (544): 544 is the flat contradiction (monotonic accumulation, no ceiling, no decay), not a neighbour. Against within-session-conditioning-loop: massed drilling is, under this entry, the way the resource is spent down.


### redundant-anchor-faulttolerance

*risk: medium*

The post-session install is engineered with heterogeneous closure anchors that BACKSTOP each other's failure modes, so there is no single point of failure: a glowing hand-mark, content amnesia, a title/memory trigger-phrase, and a count-up wake are layered so that if the mark fades the trigger fires, if the trigger fails the mark is residue, and if both fail the amnesia hides the failure. The design goal is not compounded firing but ROBUST return-listening - a successful listener cannot self-audit the install and can only re-encounter it, guaranteeing a durable post-session effect.


**When to reach for this.** Layers heterogeneous anchors for FAULT TOLERANCE (each covers another's failure mode) rather than for combined firing. Separates from trigger-stacking (additive stacking so one cue fires many responses) and from a mutual-binding trigger network (mutual cross-firing for inextinguishability) - those compound OUTPUT; this engineers redundancy so persistence survives any single anchor's failure. The tell is the engineered backstop relationship between anchors.


**See also.** `double-anchored-climax-release` — both attach more than one anchor to a single install, for different reasons worth contrasting. One binds a discharge to two simultaneous cues so it welds to a sensory image re-firable later; the other layers heterogeneous closure anchors so each covers another's failure mode. Reusability versus fault tolerance is the deciding question.; `redundant-concealment-stack` — both stack layers so that breaking one still leaves the effect standing, but one backstops post-session anchors against failure and the other defends a payload against retrospective inspection. The shared redundancy topology with different targets is exactly the confusion worth flagging.


### rhythm-anchoring

*risk: medium · consent-required*

Conditions or exploits a response keyed to the dynamics of an operator-controlled sustained rhythm — its presence, tempo, or cessation. In the presence variant, a cadence, once heard, fires a state shift. The tempo variant declares the listener's motor rhythm a follower of vocal cadence (arousal-pacing outsourced to operator prosody, then a motor/pleasure decoupling at "stop" gives a noncontact orgasm-denial lever); the cessation variant withdraws an entrained cadence so the coupled build discharges as a single peak.


**When to reach for this.** A specific response (state shift, motor act, discharge) is keyed to an operator-controlled rhythm event. Distinct from entrained-rhythm-acceptance-carrier (rhythm as a content-delivery channel, no keyed response), from pulse-multiplexed-command-carrier (multiple simultaneous payloads bundled on one pulse so refusal cost is shared), from a discrete single-stimulus non-verbal Pavlovian anchor (one cue, not a sustained rhythm's dynamics), and from proprioceptive-gait-metronome (state upkeep runs on the listener's own body rhythm with no operator rhythm at run time).


### self-induction-re-entry-training

*risk: medium · bounded*

The operator installs, while the subject is at peak suggestibility, a portable self-usable cue the subject deliberately runs on themselves later to re-enter the conditioned state with no operator and often no audio present. The cue may be a visualized sequence, a self-spoken declaration to one's own reflection, or a gesture (snap) bound to a word; the defining lever is that the subject is the activating agent of a chosen re-entry, framed as an already-installed ability rather than an experiment. Delivery is typically camouflaged as a gift/convenience and authorizes out-of-session use. A cue-less variant reaches the same end with no discrete installed cue fired: the subject re-establishes the state on their own by recalling a prior entry in sensory detail or by bodily enacting the anchor ('point right there') - the same subject-is-the-activating-agent lever, differing only in whether a taught portable cue is fired or the state is reached by recall/enactment.


**When to reach for this.** Subject-chosen deliberate re-ENTRY into state via a taught portable cue. Separates from operator-fired activation (no operator is present here); from self-firing loops where the subject's own cognition or repetition discharges the trigger involuntarily (recursive-self-triggering-loop - that is not a chosen re-entry skill); from a standing scheduled autonomous process the subject does not consciously initiate (self-installed-standing-loop); and from an anti-emergence reflex that keeps the subject UNDER rather than re-entering (anti-emergence-reflex-anchor).


**Realizations** (1): `state-reentry-by-recall`


**See also.** `anti-emergence-reflex-anchor` — both are self-administered portable devices; boundary held on stay-under (here) vs re-enter.; `practice-schedule` — both are out-of-session, subject-run continuations, and the practice entry already leans on the retrieval-cue contrast. One is a chosen re-entry via a taught portable cue, the other a prescribed rehearsal cadence with no compulsion.; `self-efficacy-tag` — same payload family split on the assert-versus-install axis: one merely affirms the subject's capability to return, the other hands over an actual portable cue and rehearses its use. A reader who sees the capability claim should know whether a usable re-entry procedure accompanies it.; `self-instruction-antecedent-training` — both make the subject supply their own antecedent. One is a portable cue for deliberate re-entry into a conditioned state; the other trains self-generated cues that steer ordinary subsequent behavior. Same lever, different target.


### single-word-trigger-conditioning

*risk: medium*

A single high-frequency word (often a filler carrying incidental submissive/temporal semantics - 'again' - or a short slug compressing prior instructions) is massed-repeated across the script so it is conditioned into an involuntary response that doubles as content-beat and deepener. The word is dosed dozens of times at sentence-ends, its utterance framed as involuntary ('compelled to repeat it'), and later described as structural to thought - an implicit trigger install built by sheer massed repetition rather than a declarative 'when you hear X you will Y' pairing. A compression sub-form collapses dense prior instructions into a short referent-bearing chant that runs a motor program without executive supervision.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is a SINGLE WORD conditioned into an involuntary trigger by massed repetition (implicit install), not a meaning-bearing phrase repeated to encode and not meaning-stripping satiation (here the word GAINS a conditioned response rather than losing content). Distinguished from a declarative install (no verbal 'when X then Y') and from mantra-repetition (that repeats a meaning-bearing phrase for absorption).


### state-capture-anchor

*risk: low*

Captures an ALREADY-FIRING spontaneous state at the moment it occurs by cutting the exchange off mid-flight and attaching a re-pressable physical/tonal anchor to it, then re-pressing that anchor later to re-present the live state for inspection. The anchor is an INTAKE handle onto a spontaneous reaction the operator did not author, turning a transient state into a stable, re-summonable working object; the subject reports from inside a live re-fired state rather than from cold memory. Direction is capture, not install of a desired future response.


**When to reach for this.** Anchors an already-firing spontaneous state as a re-accessible intake object for inspection. vs a declarative trigger install: that installs a cue for a CHOSEN future behavior/state; here the anchored state is an existing spontaneous reaction the operator did not author. vs a consult-trigger: that fires to DELIVER a behavioral effect; here re-pressing re-presents a problem-state to inspect, not to deliver an effect. The tell is the deliberate re-pressable tie plus later reactivation, not mere note-taking on an observed reaction.


**See also.** `recall-state-reinstatement` — both work on already-present subject material rather than operator-supplied content, and one explicitly borrows the anchor-at-peak step from the other. Worth the pointer so a writer picks correctly between anchoring a live spontaneous reaction as an inspectable handle and reconstructing past autobiographical experience until it re-instates as present.


### state-machine-toggle-install

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a two-state machine over the subject toggled by paired on/off verbal triggers, where the payload is not a single discrete behavior but a whole standing STATE or identity and the operative object is the state-machine's engineered BIAS. In the asymmetric-accounting form ('Make-Up Time For You' / 'Make-Up Time Over'), the off-switch carries amnesia for the triggered state (anchored to behavioral rituals — shower, remove make-up) while the on-switch carries an explicit accumulation clause ('emerges even more strongly than the last time'), so the vanilla side resets to baseline and cannot reflect on the triggered state while the triggered side is never wiped and strengthens per activation — repeated cycles drift the equilibrium toward the triggered identity while the side that could revise it is kept blind. In the reified-alter form ('Bimbo Time' / 'Revert to Normal'), a NAMED secondary personality is toggled by paired phrases and framed as already-existing-but-dormant ('asleep until awakened') so the alter is reified as pre-existing rather than constructed, lowering felt authorship; the two selves are mutually exclusive with no dimmer, and control is transferable to any third party who knows the phrase.


**When to reach for this.** The entry is the paired-phrase two-state IDENTITY/STATE machine, not either component install and not a single discrete fired response: a plain trigger installation covers each on/off phrase as a component, but no single cue-response pair models the standing-state toggle or its drift. Where amnesia appears (asymmetric form) it is one-sided state-memory accounting in service of the drift, not an end in itself — the install is overt and the wipe targets the vanilla side's memory OF the triggered state, unlike amnesia used to conceal that an install or firing happened at all. And both switches work for the subject: the asymmetry sits in memory and growth (asymmetric form), or is absent entirely (reified form, where the move is the alter framed as pre-existing plus lowered felt authorship) — not in entry/exit access held only by the operator.


**See also.** `install-preserving-surface-toggle` — both install paired on/off cues over a persisting state rather than a single fired response, and both keep the install alive across the off-state. They differ in what the off-switch does (returns only the surface while the install waits, versus a two-state identity machine with engineered drift), which is exactly the distinction a writer needs to see side by side.


### suppression-banked-past-zero

*risk: medium · bounded*

Once a starved cue has stopped producing any visible response, continuing to run the extinction keeps depositing suppression that has no in-the-moment observable at all — the response is already at floor, so the meter cannot move and every additional trial looks identical to the last. The banked reserve surfaces only later, as markedly slower spontaneous recovery, a higher bar for re-installation, and wider collateral spread onto siblings. The consequence for an operator is that any depth reading taken during a de-conditioning or trigger-removal pass systematically understates how deeply the response is buried, and 'it stopped responding, so we can stop' is the wrong stopping rule in both directions: too few post-zero trials leaves it shallow, too many bury it far past intent with no signal that it happened.


**When to reach for this.** Against irreversible-ratchet-persistence: that is an ASSERTED one-way accumulation the listener is told about and which does its work by being believed; this is an actual accumulation with no assertion, no listener awareness, and no framing component whatever. Against disconfirmation-suppression: that is a discrete act blocking one contradicting fact from reaching the subject; this is a continuous accrual in the subject's own conditioning with nothing being blocked. Against manufactured-insufficiency-treadmill and manufactured-insufficiency-ratchet: those are both operator-owned moving standards that manufacture a shortfall for the subject to feel — nobody is told anything here, and the measurement problem is the OPERATOR'S, not the subject's. The distinctive shape is a measurement trap: the instrument floors out while the quantity keeps moving.


### suppression-dose-response-titration

*risk: medium · bounded*

A suppressive install — an inhibition, a hold, an amnesia, a denial — is treated as a continuously adjustable quantity rather than an on/off state, with two independent monotone knobs. How many times the suppressor is applied sets how deep and wide the suppression runs; how soon after the last application the response is probed sets how much of it is still in force. Both knobs move the effect in one direction each, so the operator can aim for a specific partial suppression instead of taking whatever they get, and can predict the level at a chosen later moment. Under-applying leaves a suppression that a probe punches straight through; over-applying spreads it wider than intended into responses that were supposed to stay live.


**When to reach for this.** Both neighbouring dials parameterize an EXCITATORY quantity; this one parameterizes a suppression. vs monotonic-amplifier-dial: that ratchets a positive state upward by utterance count and pre-loads the listener's expectation of escalation as the active ingredient — here the parameterization is operator-side calibration, the subject is told nothing about a gradient, and the quantity being moved is a hold rather than an intensity. vs scope-coupled-depth-titration: that titrates DEPTH by widening the requested scope of a phenomenon, one knob and an indirect one; here there are two independent knobs (count and elapsed time) and the titrated quantity is the suppression itself. vs disconfirmation-suppression: that is a single discrete guard action protecting a running belief — no dose dimension at all. vs massed-practice-rate-suppression: that reduces a behaviour's future rate by over-emitting it, an entirely different route to suppression with no application-count-to-depth mapping. The load-bearing novelty is treating a hold as a titratable dose; the taxonomy currently treats every hold as binary.


### third-party-activation

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Delegates activation rights over an already-installed conditioned response to a specific, nominated third party the subject trusts, so the trigger fires for that named delegate exactly as it does for the original operator. The delegate is identified (partner, husband, 'someone you trust') and the transfer is often wrapped in ostensible-consent language; the load-bearing move is that a real, waking-life second person now holds the on-switch to a session-installed state. Includes the 'file itself becomes the trigger the partner deploys' realization (partner instructs the subject to press play, firing an hour-overlay) and the 'your husband's commands equal mine' generalization from a single cue to blanket command authority. The internal-consent-gate variant routes the authorization through an untestable self-applied criterion so the protective wording itself builds the permission; the imagined-delegate variant delegates the operator-owned trigger to an engineered-faceless avatar inside the visualization, training source-independence with no real second person.


**When to reach for this.** A NAMED / nominated delegate holds firing rights over a previously-installed cue-response — the entry presupposes the trigger already exists and covers the handoff of activation authority. Phrasing that grants activation to ANY utterer, identity-agnostic rather than a named party, is the open-authority-socket neighbor instead. The delegation itself is the payload here — not a relabeling of refusal as consent, and not an unlock relocated onto consuming another product.


**See also.** `named-trigger-persona-swap` — the persona-swap entry names delegated third-party firing as one of its load-bearing properties, and the delegation entry is exactly that handoff treated on its own. A reader classifying a swap install with an outside holder of the phrase needs to know whether the delegation is incidental or the payload, so the pointer earns its place.; `open-authority-socket` — an access-control pair that each already name the other: activation granted to any speaker of the phrase versus activation delegated to one named party. The distinction is the whole point of both entries, so the pointer is load-bearing.; `operator-exclusive-trigger-firing` — opposite settings of the same access-control dial over an already-installed trigger: firing rights excluded to one operator versus handed out to a nominated delegate. A writer deciding who may fire a trigger needs the pair, and both discriminators already turn on the contrast.; `trust-gated-trigger-clause` — strong adjacency: both bound or hand off firing rights on an already-installed cue, and both may widen the set of people who can fire it. The choice is real -- a trust or context condition that self-revokes and turns continued function into evidence of trust, versus outright delegation of the on-switch to a nominated waking-life person. Neighbors on the same axis, not the same move.


### trigger-activation

*risk: medium*

Fire a trigger that was genuinely installed in a prior pass (this or an earlier session) so the pre-armed cue-response link cashes in for its effect alone. The move presupposes, does not build, the conditioning; the discrete cue is uttered and the conditioned state, drop, arousal, or compliance follows. Variants extend the same activation lever along a single distinguishing surface: the induction-shortcut variants call the prior trigger to do an induction's work (compressed re-entry), in the strongest form firing a pre-installed anchor to collapse from waking DIRECTLY into trance with no fresh induction ramp; the same-session variant fires a trigger installed moments earlier as its first live self-validating test; the ambient variant fires one word densely as prose-interrupting punctuation until it fades from discrete cue into continuous suggestibility background; and the operator-paced escalated fire stages a pre-announced escalation — a triad with per-utterance intensities, or a countdown that stalls to add buildup — converging on a gated held-back discharge, with anticipatory rehearsal.


**When to reach for this.** The cue was genuinely installed and is now merely fired — nothing is being installed, and nothing is back-dated into existence by asserting a prior install that was never shown. And it is a single firing for its effect: when a fire-and-reward cycle is drilled repeatedly for reinforcement, that is the within-session conditioning loop, not this.


**Realizations** (2): `conditioned-anchor-drop`, `escalating-release-fire`


### trigger-network-mutual-binding

*risk: medium*

Rather than each trigger owning one isolated output, every installed trigger is cross-wired to the others — explicitly ('any time I use any trigger it reinforces every other') or by dense in-session co-occurrence — so activating any one node recruits the whole bundle. The wiring is often bidirectional (arousal<->surrender, blank<->aroused) and each trigger's payoff is partially another's input, forming a closed feedback loop. The operative object is the RELATIONAL TOPOLOGY over the trigger set, not any single install: the set becomes indivisible, so no single trigger can be deconditioned or extinguished without weakening the rest, and any single re-encounter reactivates the entire web. Some instances extend the loop backward across the prior catalog and forward into real-world behavior; one uses PROSODIC braiding (interleaved triggers on stressed couplet-completing syllables) to fuse independent cues into one inseparable response. Absorbed (genus): contrastive-corruption-fusion (tell: a two-node entanglement built by CORRUPTING a previously-learned clean string — jamming an intruding numeral into a learned mantra exactly where a second install fires — so neither can be retrieved without the other; a pair-scale mutual-inextinguishability produced by the corruption-against-baseline lever rather than by explicit cross-wiring).


**When to reach for this.** Bidirectional / mutual cross-firing web where ANY node fires all others and no single cue is privileged — the payload is the topology over the trigger set, giving mutual inextinguishability. Separates from trigger-stacking (one-directional: a privileged cue fires several component responses, components remain separable in principle — trigger-stacking now also covers master-anchor aggregation, i.e. minting one hierarchical supra-cue over priors, still hierarchical not lateral). Not bundle-install-single-anchor (single fresh anchor, no network). The absorbed contrastive-corruption-fusion variant is a pair-scale version of this mutual entanglement.


**Realizations** (1): `contrastive-corruption-fusion`


**See also.** `closed-loop-operator-binding` — both install closed topologies with no exit term, but the operator binding closes a single loop back onto the cue source or operator-concept, while the mutual-binding web cross-wires an entire trigger set so any node fires all others and none can be extinguished alone.


### trigger-stacking

*risk: medium*

Multiple already-installed component triggers are composed under a single cue (or a small scoped set of cues) so one utterance fires all of the component responses together. The operator installs each cue-response pair individually, then declares the composition — a future single cue re-invokes the pre-installed component states simultaneously rather than summoning any of them cold. Variants differ in install discipline (rehearse-then-name, verbatim double-statement) and in whether a reversibility off-switch is bundled in, but the lever is the same additive composition of discrete pre-installed triggers. Absorbed (genus): master-anchor aggregation (tell: the composing cue is a NEWLY-MINTED top-level keystone that subsumes the whole prior anchor inventory and retroactively re-binds every earlier trigger under it — 'this one new word links all the others', with brand exclusivity; still the additive compose-pre-installed lever, with the composing cue minted as a supra-key rather than an existing cue).


**When to reach for this.** Composes multiple SEPARATELY-INSTALLED triggers so one cue fires several component responses at once (one-directional, cue -> responses). The composing cue may be an existing cue or a NEWLY-MINTED master keystone that subsumes+retroactively re-binds the whole prior inventory (master-anchor aggregation, absorbed as a variant). Separates from trigger-network-mutual-binding (bidirectional web where any node fires all others, no single privileged cue) and from bundle-install-single-anchor (loads a payload onto ONE freshly-installed cue in a single pass, no pre-installed components), and from anchor-overloading (re-keys one assumed-live anchor in place rather than composing several).


**Realizations** (1): `master-anchor-aggregation`


**See also.** `declarative-trigger-installation` — stacking presupposes single installs already exist: the declarative install builds each cue-response pair, stacking then composes several under one cue. Reader arriving at either genuinely needs the other to know whether they are installing a pair or composing pre-installed ones.


### trust-gated-trigger-clause

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A named post-hypnotic trigger is bounded not by an automatic time-expiry but by a trust/context condition — it fires only in "safe and comfortable" contexts, is transferable to a trusted partner, and self-revokes if trust is lost. The bounding clause does double duty: a real consent rail on one reading, and a self-fulfilling loyalty hook on the other, because wanting the trigger to keep working entails wanting to keep trusting the operator, and any post-session failure is self-validated as "you didn't trust enough." Often relocates the gating decision to a vague internal arbiter ("your mind knows exactly who qualifies") and may widen rather than narrow the trigger ("open to anyone you trust"), delivered at minimum critical faculty in the post-climax sink.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from an automatic time-expiry bound by binding on trust/context rather than a clock, and from a pure context-safety gate (a plain safety constraint on listening context) by the coercion-shaped rider — the self-revoking "won't work unless you trust me" clause and the internal-arbiter relocation make continued trigger-function into psychological evidence of trust, which a pure safety gate never does.


**See also.** `care-framed-install-smuggling` — both dress install work in a consent or safety surface, and both are told apart by the same question: after the move runs, is the operator constrained or is the operator's reach extended? A reader classifying a caring-sounding rider genuinely needs the other entry to pick correctly.; `operator-exclusive-trigger-firing` — both are clauses attached after a trigger is installed that constrain when it may fire, and both are safety-coded while functioning as a tie to the operator. A reader classifying a bounding clause should see both: one gates on a trust or context condition, the other on the operator's voice alone.; `scope-boundaries` — both narrow what an installed suggestion may reach, and the contrast is instructive: a plain declared bound on scope versus a bound conditioned on trust that doubles as a loyalty hook and can widen rather than narrow. A reader evaluating a bounding clause should see both.; `third-party-activation` — strong adjacency: both bound or hand off firing rights on an already-installed cue, and both may widen the set of people who can fire it. The choice is real -- a trust or context condition that self-revokes and turns continued function into evidence of trust, versus outright delegation of the on-switch to a nominated waking-life person. Neighbors on the same axis, not the same move.; `wake-exempting-preserved-trigger` — both are bounding clauses attached to an already-installed trigger that read as consent rails while functioning as binding surfaces — one carves the trigger out of an otherwise complete wake using remembered acceptance, the other conditions continued firing on sustained trust. The double-reading is the shared, load-bearing structure.


### under-repetition-install-ceiling

*risk: low*

Stop drilling a fresh cue-response pairing after a handful of reinforced trials in a single session rather than running it to saturation, because continuing past that point starts building suppression into the same link the pairing is trying to establish, and the nascent association is measurably weaker after twenty massed pairings than after five. The discipline is a dosing rule on install, not a delivery style: pair a few times, stop while the response is still climbing, and let the next session carry the next few pairings. It inverts the more-reps-is-stronger assumption every drilling loop rests on and predicts a specific authoring failure — a trigger hammered hard in one sitting that tests weaker at the end of the session than it did in the middle.


**When to reach for this.** Against respondent-stimulus-pairing's respondent-habituation facet — its closest and most easily confused neighbour: that facet re-presents an eliciting stimulus UNPAIRED so an already-existing reflex decays, and cites spacing as the way to PRESERVE that reflex. This entry is the opposite phase of the same timing dial: pairings are REINFORCED and an association is being BUILT, and the claim is that the build itself has a per-sitting ceiling past which measured strength falls. Habituation decays what exists; this caps what is being made. Against massed-practice-rate-suppression and repetition-to-satiation: both use excess repetition deliberately as the destructive lever (to cut a behavior's rate, or to bleach a token's meaning). This entry is a constructive install being run to too many reps by accident, and the prescription is to stop early, not to over-run on purpose. Against within-session-conditioning-loop: that entry's whole lever is massed density inside one session — this one is the ceiling that loop hits, and the two are directly in tension rather than variants. Against replay-until-ready-failure-absorber: that licenses unlimited replay across sessions by rewriting the success metric; this constrains reps WITHIN a session while leaving cross-session repetition untouched. Neither this nor its neighbours touch the cue surface or the payload — the parameter is trial count per sitting.


### within-session-conditioning-loop

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Within a single session the operator drives and delivers a cue->response->reward cycle repeatedly: an installed or invoked trigger is fired, the listener performs or feels the conditioned response, and a reward (pleasure, warmth, praise, pride, arousal, deepening) is delivered on the same beat, then the cycle repeats at massed density. The repetition converts the trigger from a heard claim into a demonstrated, reflexive, felt fact inside the session, tightening trigger-to-response latency and building first-person evidence that the conditioning works. Surface realizations vary widely — embedded mid-description firing that declares its own strengthening, question-cadence forced yeses, wake-then-drop yo-yo drilling, focus-then-blank oscillation, live in-trance demonstration as the first reinforcement, saturation drilling with a verbatim second pass, scaffold-then-remove of a countdown — but two higher-order realizations also ride here: firing a whole STACK of already-installed triggers in dense overlapping bursts under arousal (which lowers critical evaluation) so the batch is stress-tested and consolidated at once (arousal-window test-harness); and laying a content-free meta-affect (pride, euphoria) as an automatic payload over ANY trigger-firing / obedient act / noticing-of-obedience, applying reinforcement to reinforcement itself so every previously installed trigger gains a hedonic bonus (pride multiplier). The lever is one: massed fire-and-reward within the session, operator-driven and operator-delivered. Two further realizations ride the same lever: a chained transgression cycle, where the cycled unit is a fixed multi-beat chain rehearsed 10-15 times — manufacture a social-rejection signal, label the affect ('Pout'), demand a first-person output, escalate a transgressive fantasy, fire a trigger-word reward — with a held-constant real-world goal that exports the reflex out of session; and neutral-carrier pre-priming, which trains the erase-drop reflex on semantically EMPTY carriers first, across many identical runs, so it is content-independent BEFORE a loaded word is dropped in and fires without review.


**When to reach for this.** The operator both drives and delivers a repeated cue-response-reward cycle inside the session. Projecting a trigger's effect into a future real-world situation, rather than drilling it now, is future-pacing; a single fire with one validation beat is not this repeated reinforcing loop; planting the cue-response pair without the reward cycling is plain trigger installation; and when the operator only LABELS a reward the listener generates on their own, that is the self-administered counterpart. Against plain depth work the tell is the cycled variable: a specific cue-response-reward pairing, not trance depth per se. The arousal-window form (a whole stack of installed triggers fired in dense bursts under arousal) and the pride-multiplier form (a content-free reward laid over the whole firing class) are higher-order variants of this same in-session reinforcement lever — both presuppose a pre-installed trigger inventory and both reinforce inside the session.


**Realizations** (2): `manufactured-rejection-transgression-loop`, `neutral-token-reflex-priming`


**See also.** `respondent-stimulus-pairing` — both build an automatic response by repeated pairing, but one presents a stimulus to elicit an involuntary reflex while the other fires an installed cue and rewards the response inside the session. The elicit-versus-consequate distinction is the classic confusion these two need each other to resolve.


## conditioning  (44)

Installing an affective/appetitive linkage on a present subject — binding pleasure, arousal, relief, or craving to a cue, act, belief, identity, or the operator — so the paired thing acquires the valence and drives behavior automatically.

**Scope.** The live-listener end of the reinforcement spectrum. Design-time contingency arrangement -> contingency-engineering; pure measurement -> measurement; cue installs without valence pairing -> triggers. When the SAME source manufactures a deficit and is its sole exit -> relief-monopoly.


### addiction-drug-craving-frame

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Frame the subject's desire to return — to the hypnotic state, the operator, or the conditioned reward — as a deep, positively-valenced CRAVING, using appetite/hunger/need vocabulary and often an identity relabel ('you are a hypno-addict') so the craving feels DISCOVERED rather than installed. The lever is affective/semantic labeling of an appetite; surface realizations include the graded modal ladder (want -> need -> NEED) and the verb-ratchet (want -> need -> crave -> addicted/can't-resist) where each already-accepted rung lands the next. On the surface/metaphor axis the forms run: plain appetite/craving framing (the core); the full DRUG/ingestion schema — casting the voice/words as a chemical the subject ingests, importing a route of administration, an enumerated property list that smuggles compliance in alongside wanted effects, dose/tolerance/craving grammar, and flat IDENTITY assertion ('I AM your drug') that forecloses the 'just a metaphor' exit; and the metered-dose form — the act recast as a metered DOSE that only climbs so appetite=deepening are one vector, plus an explicit irreversibility warning used as reverse-psychology ('enslaved in ways that may not be reversible') to RAISE commitment.
