The load-bearing move is the staged count -> object-identity -> time progression: three distinct cognitive anchors dismantled in order, where most depth loops erode only one.


**When to reach for this.** Removes THREE distinct cognitive anchors (numerical tracking, object-individuation, time) in a load-bearing sequence via one perceptual stream. Separates from numerical-deepening (single depth axis via a count). Separates from time distortion (which distorts felt time-rate alone; here time is the LAST of three staged anchors). Separates from a monotony/boredom deepener (the erosion is itemized and ordered). The tell: the count->identity->time progression, each anchor named and removed before the next.


**See also.** `boundary-dissolution-no-not-operator-region` — both work by plurality rather than depth: the same removal applied across several independent targets so no single repair restores the lost footing. One erases boundaries across independent axes, the other dismantles ordered cognitive anchors in sequence through a single perceptual stream. Useful contrast on whether the multiplicity is simultaneous or staged.


### startle-back-disarm-ratchet

*risk: low*

Names the familiar jerking-back-awake experience near sleep, then asserts that here the pull-back gets monotonically harder each attempt while letting-go gets easier. This disarms the specific micro- resistance that keeps insomniacs awake (the startle-back): by framing each pull-back as strictly costlier than the last, any attempt to stay awake is reinterpreted as evidence sleep is winning — arousal/ vigilance pushed down with a one-way valve, and over-compliance becomes the success path.


**When to reach for this.** Targets the specific sleep-onset startle-back reflex and installs an ASYMMETRIC ratchet (pull-back always costlier than the last). Distinct from false-bottom deepening (a depth-ceiling reframe, not a directional asymmetry on a named reflex) and from fractionation (deliberate re-waking; this makes re-waking strictly harder). Only lands if the body is already near sleep onset. The manufactured-insufficiency treadmill also makes over-compliance the only success path, but the lever there is an operator-owned adequacy standard; here it is the sleep-onset startle reflex.


**See also.** `breath-locked-eyelid-fractionation` — both load an involuntary reflex asymmetrically so the down direction is cheap and the up direction gets progressively costlier, harvesting the failed attempt as proof. Distinguish by whether the engine is the breath cycle or the sleep-onset startle.; `irreversible-ratchet-persistence` — same one-way ratchet topology, different substrate: repeated cycles reframed as permanent decrement versus a named sleep-onset reflex made monotonically costlier each attempt. The asymmetry claim is the shared tell and neither discriminator currently covers the other.; `manufactured-insufficiency-treadmill` — both make over-compliance the only success path; distinct levers (adequacy standard vs sleep-onset startle reflex).


### surrender-release-ritual

*risk: medium*

A symbolic enacted act marks and installs a compliance threshold — an abstract faculty (will, resistance, responsibility, wakeful cognition) is first objectified into a manipulable thing (a lock, a bubble, an object in the hands, a colored glow, an exhaled substance) and then released, dropped, popped, dimmed, or offloaded by an act the subject performs or authors. The enacted release IS the suggestion; authorship of the letting-go stays with the subject, so surrender reads as a chosen, completed, and felt event rather than something done to them. Common twists ride the same lever — re- arming the release onto an involuntary cue for auto-maintenance, animating the threshold as a mechanical event, gating it on a count, offloading the changed-belief authorship onto a device while the subject speaks the admission aloud, or recasting the released substance as the subject's own weakness.


**When to reach for this.** The move objectifies an abstract faculty and installs the transition through a symbolic enacted RELEASE whose authorship stays with the subject. Consent-manufacture counterfeits a self-attributed YES to erode the refusal channel — here the release itself is the ritual, not a manufactured permission artifact. In consummation-as-trance-threshold, desire-completion rather than surrender-symbolism powers the drop. A discrete one-way regime-change gate is a piece of trance topology, not a release act. Techniques that relocate the analytical faculty move it somewhere quiet to mute it; here the subject discards or releases the faculty at a threshold. And in a plain deepener count the numbers deepen by themselves; here a count only animates a watched mechanical release or gates an externalize-and-discard.


**See also.** `chosen-descent-ratchet` — both leave authorship of the surrender with the subject, and a single passage can run both: an enacted symbolic release performed by the subject is a natural vehicle for the retroactive relabel of the descent as chosen. Reader needs the boundary between the enacted release act and the post-hoc authorship transfer.; `return-step-covert-install` — sequential dependency worth following. The release ritual objectifies a faculty and has the subject hand it over; the return-step move presupposes exactly that prior surrender and modifies each handed-over faculty before giving it back. A reader building a surrender arc will want both halves.


## immersion  (25)

Imaginal absorption: building or delegating a multi-sensory imagined scene, felt sensation, or construct the listener inhabits, densifying internal experience until felt reality shifts into it.

**Scope.** Includes imagery-vehicle body/identity rewrites (vehicle = imagery); NOT plain channel narrowing with no scene (-> attention) or depth mechanics (-> deepening). The identity-erasure/phantom-body sub-block may re-home to dissociation at entry level in P3.


### abreactive-present-tense-reliving

*risk: medium · bounded*

Instead of interviewing the subject about a cause, the operator has them re-enter and re-experience the original event in present tense with live affect, so retrieval is routed through the emotion that fixed the memory rather than through recall. The subject reacts as if the event is happening now, and the charged re-experience surfaces content that direct questioning cannot reach because it was never verbalized — a buried, unspoken causal event becomes a spoken, datable utterance delivered with its original emotional charge.


**When to reach for this.** Present-tense abreactive RELIVING for content retrieval — the deciding tell is live emotional re-enactment producing never-verbalized material. Separates from time-distortion (which alters felt duration, not location-in-a-past-event), from guided visualization (operator-supplied imagery vs the subject's own encoded event), and from calm third-person recall, which is the retrieval mode this explicitly is NOT.


**See also.** `fabricated-recovered-memory-retrieval` — both surface putative past material with no veridicality check, differing on route — construction framed as retrieval versus present-tense affective re-enactment. They co-occur and are readily confused, so the pointer earns its place.; `recall-state-reinstatement` — both re-live the subject's own encoded experience until it functions as present rather than supplying operator imagery, and the split worth seeing is the output: live affective re-enactment used to surface never-verbalized content, versus multi-sensory reconstruction used to re-instate a state and physiology as a usable resource.


### addressable-construct-building

*risk: medium · bounded*

The payload is built as a durable, ADDRESSABLE imaginal object — given a location, a route, or a discrete handle-image — engineered for re-navigation and rehearsal AFTER the building moment rather than for present-tense absorption. Addressability is the load-bearing property: in one form, a door bearing the listener's own name is reached through a hallway of installable rooms; in another, three iconic frozen future-self images, sensory-anchored, are 'built before being used' as addressable anchors for a later ritual. Self-authorship of the object generates investment; extensible architecture (many doors / an image chain) implies further installable slots.


**When to reach for this.** The constructed object is engineered for LATER re-access (addressable, routable, rehearsable) — vs guided-visualization, where the scene is inhabited now and addressability is absent. Unlike faculty-externalization moves that dislocate the analytical mind itself and park it outside as an object, here a new payload is built and given a location. The construct is explicitly built and known-made, with no claim that it was discovered already-present within. And the move ends at construction — no declared extension of the effect into future situations; putting the anchor to USE later is a separate move.


**See also.** `guided-visualization` — same scene-building family split by what the construct is for: present inhabitation versus a durable object given a location for later re-navigation. Read together when deciding whether an imagined structure is meant to be re-entered.; `multi-handle-trigger-architecture` — both build durable structures engineered for later access rather than present-tense effect: one constructs an addressable imaginal object with a location or route, the other installs a set of separately fireable handles onto distinct facets of a state. A designer thinking about post-session re-entry surfaces should see both.; `portable-object-state-export` — both create a durable handle for later re-access, one an internal imaginal object built for re-navigation, the other an external owned object carrying an exported state. The discriminator between build-for-later-use and export-into-daily-life is a real selection choice a reader faces.; `sealed-edit-buffer-space` — both erect an interior venue the listener will return to, and one discriminator already contrasts a durable internal construct against a venue whose declared properties are sealed access and native-feeling edits. The pointer helps a reader tell an addressable rehearsal object from a concealment-sealed workspace.; `space-preallocation-staging` — both build a mental structure before the content that will occupy it, and they divide cleanly: one constructs a durable object given a location or handle so it can be re-navigated later, the other stages an explicitly empty slot so the payload drops into a site the listener already built. Same design slot, opposite emphasis on what persists.


### affect-locus-binding

*risk: medium*

A constructed imaginal locus is welded to an affective state — properties defined negation-first (no anxiety, stress, pain) or as a containing perimeter (a blanket encasing body and mind) — so the state acquires a felt location and an inside/outside boundary; distress becomes geographically incompatible with being there, and returning to the locus is returning to the state.


**When to reach for this.** State is BOUND to the locus with a defended boundary (to feel bad is to leave; scene residue stays outside) — vs generic positive safe-place scenery in guided-visualization, vs reward-association conditioning (no reward pairing here; spatial binding), and vs a persistent identity metaphor (no identity reinterpretation).


**See also.** `felt-substance-state-binding` — both weld a state to a concrete imaginal object so the object stands in for the state. One uses a place with an inside/outside perimeter that distress cannot cross; the other uses a felt tactile substance turned into an adjustable dial. Compare when a scene both contains the subject and is described as tightening.


### antagonistic-body-map-split

*risk: medium*

Runs a whole-body heaviness/immobility induction, then carves out one body part (the genitals) and assigns it the OPPOSITE sensation (lightness/buoyancy), then welds the two into a reciprocal loop where lighter-there means heavier-everywhere and a more-excited exception. Splitting the body into an inert majority and one hyper-live exception foregrounds arousal by suppressing everything around it, and the reciprocal weld makes the split self-confirming (denying the lightness means denying the loop), so the listener feels immobilized everywhere except the genitals, which become the only live sensation channel.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is a carved-out antagonistic exception (one part gets the reverse sensation) welded into a self-confirming reciprocal loop with the rest of the body. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination / ordinary catalepsy induction (uniform heaviness, no carved reverse-sensation exception or reciprocal weld) and from progressive-body-substitution (rewrites the body's material, no antagonistic live-exception loop).


**See also.** `somatic-carrier-sweep` — the carrier-sweep entry's second realization ends in the same output shape as the body-map split, a suppressed body with one aroused exception, but reaches it by propagating a single sensation and bifurcating it rather than by welding a carved-out opposite into a reciprocal loop. Text describing that endpoint fits both until the mechanism is checked.


### cross-modal-channel-bridge

*risk: low*

Brings a not-yet-active perceptual channel online by bridging it onto an already-vivid one across a shared feature (rhythm, movement): the vivid channel supplies the energy and the shared feature acts as a carry-over rail so the new channel activates riding the old rather than being summoned head-on (head-on summoning drains the state). A companion move seizes an involuntary single-channel slip the subject spontaneously emits, amplifies it, then layers additional channels onto that self-authored anchor until it becomes a full multimodal enactment the subject owns — because the build starts from the subject's own production and each element is confirmed before the next, it meets little resistance.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is a featural intersection (or a spontaneously-emitted slip) used as the RAIL to bring a new perceptual channel online, not a forced juxtaposition and not an operator-selected lead. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (installs a sensation head-on from suggestion) and from plain sensory layering (adds channels for scene richness, not via a shared-feature transfer that conserves state).


**Realizations** (1): `overlap-bridging`


**See also.** `guided-visualization` — direct sibling boundary: multi-channel enrichment of one constructed scene belongs to the scene-building entry, whereas bringing a new channel online via a shared-feature carry-over is the bridge. Without the cross-reference these get conflated whenever more than one sense is addressed.; `representational-system-matching` — both work on perceptual-channel selection, but from opposite sides: one brings a dormant channel online by riding a shared feature of an already-vivid channel, the other reads which channel the listener is already using and covertly phrases suggestions inside it. Useful adjacency when classifying modality-aware delivery.; `valued-channel-induction` — direct complements on the same axis: selecting and staying inside the subject's strongest representational channel, versus deliberately bridging from a vivid channel to a not-yet-active one along a shared feature. One entry already names the crossing move as its contrast, so the reader needs the other to complete the decision.


### enacted-embodied-proof

*risk: medium · bounded*

COMMANDS the listener to perform a physical action so that their own body manufactures the proprioceptive evidence for an abstract claim or rule — the metaphor stops being a verbal assertion and becomes muscle memory the listener has just executed. A vacuum/suction model is ratified by ordering 'suck your cheeks in right now'; an arithmetic +2/-1 rule is locked into proprioception by paced self-stroking (down-on-inhale) that reverses the usual template; a directed self-touch tour is run under induction copy on the same line of speech so arousal and deepening are inseparable and self-touch itself becomes compliance-proof. Because the body has already done the thing, the subsequent 'your mind works the same way' / 'this is the rule' claim rides on enacted proof rather than argument, and the careful attention the action demands is itself a compliance signal.


**When to reach for this.** Unlike somatic-mirroring, which READS a sensation already present, this DIRECTS an action to generate the sensation as evidence. Unlike breath pacing, which entrains, here the paced motion is a vehicle to map an abstract rule onto proprioception. And unlike a behavioral-commitment move, the enacted action manufactures evidence for a cognitive claim — it is not a commitment/consistency lever.


**See also.** `catalepsy-to-affect-transfer` — both convert a body event into warrant for a non-bodily claim: one transfers the authority of an already-demonstrated involuntary response, the other commands an action so the body manufactures the proprioceptive evidence. Genuinely adjacent when choosing how to source embodied proof.; `irreversible-autobiographical-binding-act` — both command a real physical act so the doing itself becomes the evidence, and the reversible/irreversible split is the whole discriminating axis. One directs a body movement to manufacture proprioceptive proof for a cognitive claim in the moment; the other directs a permanent act that becomes an undeniable autobiographical event across later sessions. Genuinely useful to see side by side.; `manufactured-self-confirmation` — both manufacture the somatic evidence that a later claim will cite, and the second is already named as a neighbor in the first's discriminator. The split is scope: a whole-script chain where each step guarantees the next step's evidence, versus a single commanded action producing proprioceptive proof for one claim.; `obedience-demonstration-as-proof` — two ways a commanded act becomes evidence: one has the body manufacture proprioceptive proof for an abstract claim or rule ('your mind works the same way'), the other cites the bare fact of having obeyed back as proof that control is real — the payload differs (a cognitive claim versus the operator's authority), but both convert a performed action into an unfalsifiable convincer and drop the threshold for the next ask.; `sensation-as-cognitive-edit-channel` — both ground an abstract cognitive claim in real bodily evidence, but one commands the listener to perform the action so proprioception rehearses the rule while the other rides a passive or autonomic event asserted as a body-to-mind channel.


### enacted-identity-assembly

*risk: medium*

The target identity is built additively from a long sequence of narrated motor-acts — dressing actions (panties, bra, stockings, heels, dress, nails, wig, makeup), or motion that licenses garment changes (twirling -> skirt -> dress -> shoes) — each narrated as happening "automatically" or as a discovered side-effect of the listener's own suggested movement, before the listener can deliberate. Assembling the identity from dozens of accepted micro-acts (rather than one "you are X" claim) means it is ENACTED long before it is labeled; per-act contact-pleasure pairing conditions positive affect directly onto the target objects, and built-in dismissals ("you don't really mind") pre-empt objection. By the time any label arrives the listener has already performed the identity many times with pleasure.


**When to reach for this.** Unlike identity-merger-occupation, where a single "you are X" claim asserts or occupies a figure, the identity here is constructed incrementally through automaticity-narrated motor-acts with affect conditioning, each step smaller than a bare identity claim. Unlike kinesthetic hallucination, the sensations are the vehicle for identity assembly, not the end. Tell: automaticity narration + per-act pleasure pairing make the ENACTMENT the mechanism.


**See also.** `acceptance-laddered-identity-migration` — two ways of building an identity incrementally rather than asserting it: one spends prior acceptance as warrant for the next named status tier, the other assembles the identity from narrated motor-acts with pleasure pairing. Same problem, different currency; a reader choosing an incremental route wants both.; `affect-fused-identity` — two contrasting routes to the same identity payload: welding a self-firing affect to a label so the category maintains itself, versus assembling the identity from dozens of automaticity-narrated micro-acts so it is enacted long before any label lands. A reader choosing between label-first and enactment-first benefits directly from the contrast.; `graded-somatic-identity-loading` — both assemble an identity from steps each too small to refuse, so the label arrives after the fact rather than being asserted, but one accrues it from graded hallucinated sensation while the other accrues it from narrated motor-acts performed with automaticity framing and per-act pleasure pairing.; `manufacture-then-label-ordering` — both put experience before the label so the eventual identity claim reads as description rather than assertion; the difference is granularity and phase structure. One is a clean cross-phase produce-then-name ordering, the other assembles the identity additively from many automaticity-narrated acts with per-act affect pairing. Worth cross-referencing precisely because they can be mistaken for each other.; `progressive-body-substitution` — both build an identity from many small accepted steps rather than one claim, producing the same commitment ratchet: an ordered part-by-part rewrite of the body substrate, or an additive sequence of automaticity-narrated motor acts with per-act pleasure pairing. A passage doing both is common enough that the pair should be read together.


### erogenous-field-generalization

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

Expands the sensory map so all incoming sensation reads as sexual, removing any neutral sensory ground. Before a promised whole-body orgasm the operator generalizes genital arousal outward — every inch of skin, contact with furniture, the air, even the operator's words redefined as erogenous-zone stimulation — which both intensifies the coming orgasm and makes escape from arousal impossible (nowhere neutral to attend to), recursively weaponizing the script's own delivery so the medium becomes the payload.


**When to reach for this.** Total sensory reattribution (skin, furniture, air, words all sexual) leaving no neutral ground, with the delivery medium itself weaponized. Separates from a plain "you feel pleasure everywhere" (the tell is the total, no-neutral-ground reattribution), from kinesthetic hallucination, which installs one felt sensation where this remaps the meaning of ALL sensation, and from a total-permeation claim (a belief about scope, not a perceptual remap).


**See also.** `words-as-touch-transposition` — both weaponize the delivery medium so the words themselves become felt sensation, one by equating voice with touch and the other by remapping all sensation as erogenous including the words. They overlap at the point where the script's own delivery becomes the stimulus, and a writer should know which one they are reaching for.


### felt-substance-state-binding

*risk: medium*

Introduces one concrete felt physical substance (latex, webs, a rising material) and welds it to a cognitive/state job — "holding thoughts in", trance depth, confinement — so that feeling the material stands in for the mental state. The physical descriptor becomes an operator-adjustable dial ("tighter/thicker", "higher up the body") that deepens the welded state without ever naming it, and because it is a single reusable object, every later invocation re-confirms the state. A monotonic spatial version (web height, rising latex) replaces the abstract state-variable (trance depth) with a vivid one-directional spatial check the listener can sense without question.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is a felt tactile substance WELDED to a cognitive state and turned into an operator-adjustable dial / reusable control image. A sustained framing metaphor keeps an interpretive filter running rather than a felt tactile object turned up at will; kinesthetic hallucination gives a free-standing sensation not bound to a state-dial; and in fictional-substance-agent the substance owns CAUSATION of a state-change, while here the felt substance IS the ongoing state-gauge/dial.


**See also.** `affect-locus-binding` — both weld a state to a concrete imaginal object so the object stands in for the state. One uses a place with an inside/outside perimeter that distress cannot cross; the other uses a felt tactile substance turned into an adjustable dial. Compare when a scene both contains the subject and is described as tightening.; `gradient-word-reification-into-device` — both turn an abstraction into a felt concrete object that carries a state, and they are easy to conflate. The split: one walks the operator's words up a stepwise gradient until they are a solid external device claimed to persist while awake; the other welds a tactile substance to a state and turns the material's descriptors into an adjustable dial.; `state-welding` — binding a felt substance to a cognitive state is a concrete vehicle for fusing state variables so neither can move alone, and the substance entry's dial is the tactile face of the same welding. A reader deciding whether a passage is variable-to-variable fusion or a substance-as-gauge needs both.


### graded-somatic-identity-loading

*risk: medium*

Delivers an identity-shift (feminization, a new body) as felt residue rather than as an asserted belief: the listener is walked through a staged chain of small sensory compliances (weight in the chest, burgeoning breasts, height, hip-sway, scent), each small enough to comply with alone, so a hallucinated body-change precipitates and belief in the new identity accrues as the by-product — nothing is ever asserted to be believed. A sensation-first / cause-second ordering makes the new body feel discovered as physical fact rather than staged as a costume, and an externalizing image (a drawn picture) lets the listener see the new body as already real.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is a graded chain of somatic compliances that DELIVERS AN IDENTITY payload as residue (belief never asked for), often with sensation-first/cause-second ordering. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (installs sensations with no identity payload precipitating as residue), from identity-merger-occupation (asserts/merges an identity directly), and from progressive-body-substitution (replaces the body with a MATERIAL part-by-part; here the body-experience is graded feminine sensation, not a material swap).


**See also.** `acceptance-laddered-identity-migration` — both deliver an identity payload by increments so it is never posed as a claim to accept, which makes them easy to confuse at the point of classification. The split is what each increment is made of and what it spends: one accumulates small somatic compliances so the identity precipitates as felt residue, the other accumulates named acceptance tiers and spends prior uptake as the warrant for the next status claim. A reader who has one needs the other to know whether the rungs are sensations or stages.; `enacted-identity-assembly` — both assemble an identity from steps each too small to refuse, so the label arrives after the fact rather than being asserted, but one accrues it from graded hallucinated sensation while the other accrues it from narrated motor-acts performed with automaticity framing and per-act pleasure pairing.


### guided-visualization

*risk: low*

The operator builds a detailed constructed scene and narrows the subject's attention into it; inhabiting the imagined environment pulls attention resources off the physical surround (absorption primary, environmental dissociation secondary). This is the corpus's base scene-building delivery vehicle, routinely parameterized rather than replaced.


**When to reach for this.** Operator-guided construction of a scene for PRESENT inhabitation/absorption; multi-channel ENRICHMENT of that one scene is this technique's sensory-layering variant (adds channels for scene richness). Reach for THIS instead of siblings by these tells AGAINST it: content disguised as the subject's own self-generated material (-> internal-content-cultivation); built as a durable ADDRESSABLE structure for later re-navigation rather than present inhabitation (-> addressable-construct-building); NO verbal channel, only a mimed expectation-cued frame (-> pantomime-populated-hallucination); a new channel brought online by a SHARED-FEATURE carry-over rail that conserves state, not additive enrichment (-> cross-modal-channel-bridge); a SINGLE sensation swept spatially through the body as a payload-carrier (-> somatic-carrier-sweep); the subject's OWN autobiographical material re-instated (-> recall-state-reinstatement); imagery whose transitivity/never-settling dynamics do the work (-> transitive-charge-chaining / continuous-morph-chain); imagery embedding a reality-testing trainer or premise (-> impossibility-acclimation / imagined-is-real-premise).


**Realizations** (1): `sensory-layering`


**See also.** `addressable-construct-building` — same scene-building family split by what the construct is for: present inhabitation versus a durable object given a location for later re-navigation. Read together when deciding whether an imagined structure is meant to be re-entered.; `cross-modal-channel-bridge` — direct sibling boundary: multi-channel enrichment of one constructed scene belongs to the scene-building entry, whereas bringing a new channel online via a shared-feature carry-over is the bridge. Without the cross-reference these get conflated whenever more than one sense is addressed.; `recall-state-reinstatement` — both build vivid multi-sensory inner experience, but one supplies the imagery and the other harvests the subject's own remembered material. Each discriminator already names the other as the contrast case, so a reader deciding which applies genuinely needs both.


### kinesthetic-hallucination

*risk: medium*

Guides the subject to feel a specific imagined tactile/kinesthetic sensation (texture, pressure, temperature, weight, restraint, attachment point) that is not arising from any actual physical stimulus, so the experienced body diverges from the physical body. The install may be a discrete felt object, a progressive body-scan overlaid with imagined touch, a felt immobility/restraint, or a self-generated somatic anchor the subject sustains — the common lever is that the subject produces the percept from suggestion alone and treats it as real. Surface twists (self-generated so it survives operator absence, a compounding-arousal rider, redundant catalepsy imagery, sensation- first then cause-second ordering, an auditory hum overlaid on a heaviness sweep, an operator-dictated device schedule, retroactive non-noticing insertion) are variants, not separate mechanisms.


**When to reach for this.** Installs a felt sensation absent from actual stimuli — unlike sensation-reinterpretation moves, which re-label a sensation already present. Distinct from words-as-touch-transposition (there the operator's VOICE/words are equated with the sensation's source) and from self-touch-reattribution (there a REAL self-generated touch is re-credited to the operator with the physical situation unchanged) — here the sensation itself is manufactured, not merely re-sourced or re-authored.


**See also.** `pantomime-populated-hallucination` — both produce a percept with no external stimulus, and the informative difference is the channel: one guides the sensation verbally, the other supplies only a mimed frame with no verbal suggestion at all so the subject populates it from his own content and then defends it. Guided construction versus perceptual completion of an empty scaffold.


### narrated-motion-entrainment

*risk: low*

The listener's mandated physical movement mirrors the operator's narrated movement, collapsing watching/being-watched and moving/being-moved into one channel so proprioceptive output and visual fantasy reinforce each other; the deepener simultaneously does the eroticization work.


**When to reach for this.** Entrainment to a NARRATED body in fantasy, fusing visual and proprioceptive channels — vs kinesthetic entrainment to a rhythm (no fantasy-body mirror), and vs pace-mirror-agency-proof (direction reversed: the imagined figure mirrors the listener to manufacture felt control).


### pantomime-populated-hallucination

*risk: medium*

With NO verbal suggestion at all, the operator acts out a perceptual event (mimes a door opening, rises in courtesy, gestures to a chair) using cues tuned to the deeply-entranced subject's expectations. The subject populates the empty behavioral scaffold from his own most-available content, rationalizes the percept from contextual cues, and — because he supplied the figure himself — treats it as real and DEFENDS it. No recognizable suggestion exists to resist.


**When to reach for this.** Zero verbal channel: the frame is mimed and expectation-cued, never described (vs guided- visualization, which verbally guides construction). vs internal-content-cultivation: there operator-authored content is disguised as self-generated; here the content genuinely IS the subject's own — the operator supplies only the empty frame, and perceptual completion (not invited imagining) does the filling. vs guided-visualization's delegation-variant: delegated content there is a conscious imaginative choice; here the subject does not know a frame was offered.


**See also.** `kinesthetic-hallucination` — both produce a percept with no external stimulus, and the informative difference is the channel: one guides the sensation verbally, the other supplies only a mimed frame with no verbal suggestion at all so the subject populates it from his own content and then defends it. Guided construction versus perceptual completion of an empty scaffold.; `minimal-stimulus-self-supplied-response` — both make the subject supply the content and then credit it as proof, one via a near-null described stimulus and one via a mimed frame with no verbal channel at all. Same self-supplied-response lever at different degrees of operator input.; `space-preallocation-staging` — both hand the subject an empty frame the subject fills, which is the resistance-lowering lever in each. They differ in channel and in what gets filled: one is a wordless mimed event completed as perception, the other an explicitly built mental container awaiting a named payload. Useful contrast for anyone choosing an empty-scaffold approach.


### persistent-metaphor-spine

*risk: low*

One symbolic image or conceit is sustained as the load-bearing spine of an entire script, re-pointed or re-tasked across stages (induction, deepener, install, trigger, emergence) without ever switching frames, so escalation never introduces a new frame the listener could stop to question. Each later use inherits the credibility and accumulated affect of the earlier uses; because the referent never changes form, buy-in granted to the gentle opening use silently pre-commits the listener to the heavier later uses. Variants carry a specific payload on the spine (agency-transfer, conserved-volume identity-loss, involuntary breath-gated spread, protective-armor valence-flip, computational execute-posture, dead-metaphor literalization) but share the sustained-single-image core.


**When to reach for this.** One symbolic lens is sustained and reinforced as an interpretive filter - not a spatial scene built to inhabit, and not a structural preview that sets expectancy for the session. Neighboring moves that relocate causation or authorship (an imagined ingested substance doing the work, agency handed over to a medium, the mind reframed as writable material) turn on where cause is placed; this technique is the neutral persistence and reuse of one image regardless of what payload rides it.


**See also.** `arc-ordering-dependency` — both are whole-artifact scaffolding properties where later stages cash in credibility earned earlier. One makes ORDERING and inter-stage dependency the lever; the other makes a single sustained image the lever, with order largely free. A reader classifying a script-level move should check both.; `carrier-frame-payload-smuggling` — a sustained single image is the most common vehicle for a benign advertised frame that carries an unrequested payload. Reading the neutral persistence move next to the concealment move shows how the same whole-artifact spine turns from structural economy into a gatekeeper against early refusal.; `diegetic-activity-laundering` — the dessert-frame scope-disarm (effect_only under the spine) is a whole-script sibling of this laundering move; reconciliation should reconcile the two.


### progressive-body-substitution

*risk: medium*

Rewrites the body-schema one region at a time in a directed (usually toe-to-head or head-to-toe) sweep, replacing each named part with a new material or referent — shiny plastic, latex, liquid plastic, devotion-as-substance — until the whole body has been recategorized and only then applying the cognitive/identity change at the head. Because each region is a small object-claim complied with alone, ~20 accepted body-claims accumulate before selfhood is visibly negotiated, so refusing the final identity move would require retroactively rejecting all the prior acceptances (a commitment ratchet). The doll/latex-body replaces the meat-body as the referent for 'my body'.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is an ORDERED part-by-part substitution installing a new body-schema/substrate (a commitment ratchet), not a single free-standing sensation and not a one-move identity merger. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (installs discrete sensations, no ordered substrate rewrite), from identity-merger-occupation (merges the self into a visualized identity as ONE move), and from a plain progressive relaxation body-scan (no material substitution / commitment ratchet).


**See also.** `enacted-identity-assembly` — both build an identity from many small accepted steps rather than one claim, producing the same commitment ratchet: an ordered part-by-part rewrite of the body substrate, or an additive sequence of automaticity-narrated motor acts with per-act pleasure pairing. A passage doing both is common enough that the pair should be read together.; `mind-as-substrate-reframe` — both replace the substrate rather than adding content to an intact one, and they stack naturally. One rewrites the body-schema region by region into a new material until the whole referent has changed; the other recasts the mind as emptiable, refillable matter as the precondition for later installs. Body substrate versus mental substrate.; `self-discontinuity-clear-and-replace` — both rewrite the self, but by opposite topologies: one accumulates part-by-part substitution of the body-schema until identity change is the last small step; the other structurally ends the prior self and seats a replacement in the vacancy. A writer choosing an identity-replacement route benefits from seeing the gradual-ratchet alternative to the clear-and-replace one.


### recall-state-reinstatement

*risk: low*

The subject's own past experience is reconstructed in enough detail that its state and physiology re-instate as present. Forms in evidence: the operator interrogates for fine multi-sensory detail of a target state (drunk — where sitting, what seen/heard, smell, taste) until physiology visibly shifts, feeds back the highest-yield components, and anchors at the peak; a shotgun buffet of remembered-exhaustion scenes (bathtub, dragging legs into bed) stands in for a commanded heaviness, recalled sensation treated as present by adjacency with nothing to resist; or brief on-demand micro-trances re-vivify one catalogued item at a time, trance as random access into an existing inventory.


**When to reach for this.** The payload is the SUBJECT'S OWN autobiographical material re-instated — harvest, not install — vs operator-supplied imagery (sensory-layering) and vs fresh conditioned links (covert anchors); the anchor-at-peak step in the interrogated form is a borrowed anchoring component, not the core. Covers both state/physiology reinstatement (reconstruct a felt state until it returns as present) and the capacity/lived-instance variant (demand a LOCATED, actually-lived instance, reject hypothetical); the shared lever is re-living real personal experience so it functions as present.


**Realizations** (1): `lived-instance-mining`


**See also.** `abreactive-present-tense-reliving` — both re-live the subject's own encoded experience until it functions as present rather than supplying operator imagery, and the split worth seeing is the output: live affective re-enactment used to surface never-verbalized content, versus multi-sensory reconstruction used to re-instate a state and physiology as a usable resource.; `guided-visualization` — both build vivid multi-sensory inner experience, but one supplies the imagery and the other harvests the subject's own remembered material. Each discriminator already names the other as the contrast case, so a reader deciding which applies genuinely needs both.; `state-capture-anchor` — both work on already-present subject material rather than operator-supplied content, and one explicitly borrows the anchor-at-peak step from the other. Worth the pointer so a writer picks correctly between anchoring a live spontaneous reaction as an inspectable handle and reconstructing past autobiographical experience until it re-instates as present.


### resistance-externalized-as-object-watched-losing

*risk: medium*

Externalizes the listener's own resistance/agency/self-control as a discrete object and then narrates that object LOSING on a scripted trajectory the listener merely witnesses — a self-control weight held over an abyss that gets heavier the more they resist, individuality reified as a thing watched softening and stopping against the latex, a resistance-fragment progressively deactivated across escalating passes. The externalization converts resisting into spectatorship of an inevitable defeat: trying to resist supplies the very struggling object the narration needs, and doing nothing also concedes, so no response escapes. The distinguishing structural feature is a reachability/no-exit topology — every branch routes to surrender — layered onto the externalization surface.


**When to reach for this.** Beyond parking a faculty (concrete-externalization-parked-faculty), the externalized object is narrated LOSING under a no-exit topology where both resisting and not resisting confirm the defeat. Distinct from externalize-then-destroy-faculty (object destroyed by operator fiat, not by a struggle-trap) and from the resistance-paradox reframe (which converts resistance into deepening, not into spectatorship of an externalized object's scripted loss). The no-winning-move topology — every response routes to surrender — is the load-bearing structural feature.


**See also.** `drop-as-passive-collapse` — both make surrender feel un-authored, but they act at different layers: one externalizes the faculty and narrates it losing under a no-exit topology, the other reassigns agency for the state-change itself with no object involved. Worth a pointer because the externalized-object form is a natural place to reach for the agency-reassignment framing on top.; `resistance-quarantine-partition` — both reify resistance as an object rather than argue with it; one parks or demotes the faculty so it has no standing, the other narrates the externalized object losing under a no-winning-move topology. Direct escalation neighbors.; `resistance-window-existence-denial` — both foreclose resistance without needing a live impulse, one by staging its defeat as spectacle the listener merely watches and the other by denying it a window, existence, or object. A reader classifying a resistance-handling passage will often be choosing between exactly these two, so the pointer is load-bearing.


### somatic-carrier-sweep

*risk: low*

One narrated felt sensation is propagated spatially through the body as a carrier wave the listener tracks with attention, delivering a payload state where the operator points it: arousal narrated flowing upward from the genitals to arrive "into her head" and encase the brain, pre-staging the mind as the next operand; or sunlight-warmth swept through the body and covertly bifurcated at the groin into "sleepy everywhere else, hot and aroused at the cock", so opposing states coexist without conflict because they share one metaphoric source.


**When to reach for this.** A SINGLE sensation's spatial vector is the mechanism — body regions are interchangeable, the sweep is the move — vs multi-channel scene enrichment (sensory-layering), and vs a plain progressive-relaxation scan, which carries no payload delivery or covert bifurcation.


**See also.** `antagonistic-body-map-split` — the carrier-sweep entry's second realization ends in the same output shape as the body-map split, a suppressed body with one aroused exception, but reaches it by propagating a single sensation and bifurcating it rather than by welding a carved-out opposite into a reciprocal loop. Text describing that endpoint fits both until the mechanism is checked.; `covert-payload-piggyback` — both ride a payload on a body-directed sweep and both must be told apart from a plain relaxation scan. In one the carrier is a task the listener already consented to and the payload sits in the descriptors; in the other the carrier is a single sensation whose spatial vector is itself the move. Close enough to need the distinction spelled out; not one technique.; `externalized-agent-body-scan` — both propagate something through the body while the listener tracks it, and both must be told apart from an ordinary progressive scan. One hands the relaxing to an externalized agent acting on a passive body; the other vectors a single sensation as a carrier delivering a payload state. Real confusion boundary.


### somatic-effect-portability

*risk: low*

Relocates an already-installed somatic effect (an anesthesia, a felt sensation) from one body region to another purely by declaring the transfer — no fresh elicitation at the destination — optionally tying the jump to a confirming motor act (touch, dwell, countdown) or a discrete cue (finger snap). Because the subject already took the original effect at face value, the declared relocation is accepted on the same credit, and each successful move makes the next assertion more plausible (often reported stronger, each move also an amplification cycle). The operator's speech partitions and re-deploys the body's felt state on command.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is MOVING an existing owned effect with no re-induction at the new site (declared portability). Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination, which CREATES a sensation at a site; and from trigger activation, which fires a conditioned cue-response, not a spatial transfer of an existing sensation.


**See also.** `somatic-valence-annexation` — tight and genuinely confusable. Both take a felt bodily state the subject already owns and re-deploy it by declaration alone with no fresh elicitation. One moves the effect to a new body region; the other keeps the signal and inverts its signed valence, deleting the source affect as a category. Same credit being spent, different thing done with it.


### somatic-mirroring

*risk: low*

Takes a sensation that is already present in the listener's body — heaviness, warmth, numbness, drift, arousal, an involuntary twitch — and reinterprets it, in the moment, as evidence of the session's installed theme or of trance itself. The move never conjures a new feeling; it seizes a real, locally-verifiable percept (often one the listener has just confirmed via an interoceptive check) and re-narrates its meaning, so the felt sensation becomes self-generated proof the transformation is real. Because the raw material is genuine, the reframe is far harder to resist than an operator's bare claim. Variants extend the base lever along articulable rules: pre-attributing operator-driven change to the listener's own spontaneous physiology, exploiting a known perceptual property so the body produces the evidence for free, binding the relabel into a self-fueling ramp, manufacturing state through presuppositional leading questions rather than observing it, or renaming one confirmed referent into an escalating need-state.


**When to reach for this.** Nearest neighbors: kinesthetic hallucination INDUCES a sensation that is not present; somatic-mirroring reuses one that is. Pacing-and-leading reflects what is actually true to build rapport; somatic-mirroring reassigns the MEANING of the true sensation. Distinct from pleasure-authorship-relocation (that transfers the felt CAUSE of a sensation to the operator, an agency claim, not a meaning reframe) and from enacted-embodied-proof (that COMMANDS a physical action to manufacture the percept rather than reading one already there).


**See also.** `manufactured-self-confirmation` — genuine containment relation: the whole-script stacked-deck architecture is built by chaining the single-move reframe that reads an already-present sensation as proof. A reader placing one move will want the architecture-level entry, and vice versa.; `mirror-self-observation` — both convert a suggestion into apparent evidence the listener gathers themselves, one via a hallucinated reflection and one via a genuinely present body sensation re-narrated. The hallucinated-versus-real substrate is exactly the discrimination a reader needs.; `presuppositional-autonomic-attribution` — the second is a narrow, high-discipline realization of the first: real sensations already occurring are re-narrated so the session gets the credit. The specific case restricts itself to involuntary autonomic signs the subject cannot dispute and credits the induction by presupposition rather than by assertion, which is exactly the sub-case a reader of the general move should know about.; `somatic-channel-bypass` — both reuse a real body signal rather than conjuring one, but one reassigns the sensation's meaning as evidence of the theme while the other wires the signal so it can no longer disconfirm. Meaning reframe versus falsification block is a fine cut worth signposting.


### surrogate-object-property-projection

*risk: low*

A desired state or a refuse-worthy property is predicated of a NEUTRAL external object (a tomato plant, a granite statue) rather than of the subject's own body, removing any first-person claim the subject could falsify. The subject experiences the attributed state by identification/projection while resistance has no target to push against; properties the listener would reject if said directly ('you have no will') pass through the metaphor membrane because they are attributed to the object the listener now occupies. A referent-disqualification variant deletes referential indices and pre-rules-out the literal subject ('this won't be about flowers'), forcing the motivated subject to supply himself as the missing index so the asserted states are generated as his own. A trigger- seeding variant welds a cue word onto the object's already-true-feeling imagery, pre-charging it.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from identity-merger-occupation: the state stays on a THIRD object the subject need not become — the unfalsifiability comes from the attributional displacement, not from occupation. Separates from guided-visualization and from mere evocative metaphor: the load-bearing trick is that no first-person claim is ever made, so there is nothing to refuse. Tell: the desired state/property is grammatically the object's, not the subject's.


**See also.** `third-person-surrogate-frame` — same lever through two vehicles: remove any first-person claim the subject could refuse, so resistance has no grammatical or attributional target. One widens the person gap by narrating the listener in the third person, the other predicates the state of a neutral external object. A writer wanting an unrefusable delivery frame wants both on the table.


### time-dilation-immersion

*risk: low*

Manipulates the felt rate or measurability of time passage during trance so that duration and dosage become ungaugeable and the listener's temporal self-checks stop returning usable answers. Realized as stretching a moment into an eternity, collapsing temporal markers so elapsed time is unrecoverable, asserting lost-time as fact (and citing it back as proof of depth), deriving the slowing from a plausible cognitive premise (arousal consumes the attention that sustains "present"), inverting figure/ground so trance becomes the default and waking the deviation, or zeroing net progress (forward=back) so the how-long/when-does-it-end check returns null. The shared lever is the felt passage/measurability of time, deployed for immersion and to remove the clock the listener would use to gauge depth, dosage, or exit-timing.


**When to reach for this.** The move alters the felt rate, duration, or measurability of time WITHIN the state to deepen immersion — the warp itself is the payload. Reach elsewhere when time-plasticity is an induction concession or a nightly training-volume claim, when a noticed time-gap is simply offered as proof of depth to interpret, or when clock-awareness is dissolved only to remove temporal pressure: none of those warp the felt rate itself.


**See also.** `time-as-malleable-construct-induction` — both make felt time the operative variable, split by role. In one, the concession that time is plastic generates the depth or licenses an unbounded accumulation claim; in the other, the warp is the payload itself, removing the clock a listener would use to gauge depth, dosage, or when to stop. The second's discriminator explicitly routes readers to the first, so the link is already half-written.


### valued-channel-induction

*risk: low*

The operator selects the induction channel matching the subject's strongest/most-valued representational system (read from predicates) and issues an opening task that PRESUPPOSES that channel. Because the task is one the subject executes fluently and without effort, executing it IS the entry into trance — processing transfers off the verbal/analytic track with near-zero friction. A failed induction is reframed as wrong-channel choice, not subject resistance.


**When to reach for this.** The channel is SELECTED from the subject's read valued system and the task PRESUPPOSES it rather than requesting it — the tell that this is not generic vivid-imagery rapport. Pacing-and-leading reflects the subject's CURRENT experience then leads; this instead matches the subject's channel CAPACITY and makes task execution itself the entry. Unlike guided-visualization, no scene is built; the channel choice is the mechanism. Unlike overlap-bridging, it stays INSIDE the strong channel; bridging deliberately crosses to a weak one.


**See also.** `cross-modal-channel-bridge` — direct complements on the same axis: selecting and staying inside the subject's strongest representational channel, versus deliberately bridging from a vivid channel to a not-yet-active one along a shared feature. One entry already names the crossing move as its contrast, so the reader needs the other to complete the decision.; `representational-system-matching` — both read the subject's sensory channel and speak inside it, but one selects the channel to make task execution itself the induction entry, while the other is continuous covert delivery calibration during suggestion. Genuinely easy to confuse; the cross-reference earns its place.


### vicarious-depth-inheritance

*risk: medium*

The listener is instructed to imagine the OPERATOR hypnotized 'over and over' under untrackable quantitative pressure (pocket watches, spirals, four voices, stacked inductions) with a compliance- forcing 'try, yes try, try right now to keep track of all the ways' — an impossible task producing tracking-failure into surrender while working memory saturates with hypnosis imagery. Then the protagonist is swapped mid-image from operator to listener ('the light bulb clicks on and your brain turns off'): the listener inherits whatever depth-mass they granted the imagined operator. Descent is inherited rather than freshly produced, and resistance is hard because the listener generated the imagery themselves.


**When to reach for this.** Depth arrives by INHERITANCE through a named mid-image protagonist swap. Identification machinery is used, but the payload is state-depth transfer, not adoption of a visualized identity. The overload/tracking-failure element is a set-up precursor, not the core move. And unlike guided-visualization, the imagined scene is fuel for the swap, not an absorption anchor.


**See also.** `diegetic-operator-embedding` — both stage a protagonist geometry the listener occupies before the payload lands, one swapping the imagined subject mid-image so depth is inherited, the other embedding the operator as a character inside a substituted fiction. Useful adjacency for identity or depth transfer through an imagined scene.


## attention  (23)

Single-channel narrowing of attention onto an operator-chosen focus — object, point, voice, breath, count, or the emptied field itself — so competing stimuli fall away; includes both the narrowing pole and the quieting/emptying pole, plus count/mantra/breath carriers used for in-session absorption.

**Scope.** NOT depth trajectory on an entered trance (-> deepening), scene inhabitation (-> immersion), rapport calibration (-> pacing-rapport), or payload installs riding an absorption carrier (-> their payload family).


### adverse-attentional-state-recruitment

*risk: medium*

Rather than fighting an adverse attentional state, the operator recruits the subject's CURRENT attentional posture — whichever way it fails the conventional induction — as the working vehicle, so no attentional failure-state remains available and the exit-justification is deleted. Two opposite presenting states, one move: (a) drift/distraction recruitment — the operator names the divided or wandering attention the listener is already in (half-listening while doing a background task) and relabels it as the session's substance, never asking them to stop or close their eyes, so distraction becomes proof it's working; or the wandering-mind failure is named BEFORE it happens and its recovery pre-prescribed (bring attention back to the voice) so drift becomes a self-correcting re-bind rather than a trance-breaking event; (b) effort/strain recruitment — the operator cancels the expected relaxation frame and swaps in an effortful focus task, or inverts a let-go induction into deliberate conscious control ('be very mindful' before mindless), or sets an engineered-unresolvable target so failure is recoded as insufficient focus and drives more attending, or equates any lapse of focus with falling into trance, or commands 'pay attention' as a defense against influence so obeying IS the trance-producing narrowing. Either way the framing pre-defines every attentional posture as trance so both compliance and resistance deepen.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when the listener is ALREADY in an attentional state that would normally break the induction (drifting, distracted, effortfully straining, jaded) and you want to convert that exact state into the vehicle — the payload is deleting the exit ('I'm too distracted / this is too much effort for this to work'). Choose it OVER fixation and cognitive-quieting, which install a NEW narrowing or emptying; here nothing new is installed, the present posture is relabeled. Unlike a resistance-paradox reframe, which recruits a RESISTANCE impulse, what is recruited here is attentional drift or effortful attention, not resistance. Unlike confusion/overload techniques, the engineered-unresolvable-target form's payload is sustained ATTENDING, not an overload harvest. Drift-recruitment (make wandering attention the substance / pre-prescribe its recovery) and effort-recruitment (recruit sustained effort with a no-win frame where both compliance and resistance deepen) are the two poles of this one relabel-the-current-posture move.


**Realizations** (1): `effortful-attention-as-vehicle`


**See also.** `engineered-failure-harvest` — both take whatever the listener actually does and score it as success, and the discriminators already contest the boundary: one relabels a present attentional posture, the other engineers a task outcome and cashes it. The engineered-unresolvable-target form sits right on the seam, which is exactly why the pointer earns its place.; `recruited-or-foreclosed-quieting` — both avoid issuing a refusable instruction and leave no exit justification: one relabels the attentional posture already present, the other engineers the emptying so no directive exists to refuse. Neighbouring solutions to the same resistance problem.


### capacity-saturation-overload

*risk: low*

Imposes more concurrent processing demand than working memory and the executive monitor can carry, so the auditing faculty is saturated or displaced onto the load and suggestions arrive unevaluated; the felt lapse (blankness, attention thrash, grasping) is read as trance. The load itself is the induction — no relaxation trajectory required, and several forms are self-applicable. Realizations of the one exceed-the-processing-budget lever: (a) concurrent-demand overload — a dual-task split on the speech signal (track consonants vs meaning), serially stacked imagined sensory channels, simultaneous interpersonal tasks, self-run visual bookkeeping, escalating spoken-production drills, a one-shot cross-channel sense inversion, or sustained meter that captures the budget; (b) perceptual/null-task saturation — the channel is given more than it can label (peripheral-field flooding via wide unfocused gaze) or a task that consumes working memory while yielding nothing (recursive riffing on a null concept the listener must keep re-emptying), so the verbal track stops for lack of spare capacity; (c) imagined-task occupation — a fully-committed imagined activity is installed as the primary task, saturating attentional bandwidth so incoming somatic signals lose the channel to register (able to flip percept valence: foul gas experienced as flowers); (d) continuous-morph occupation — a single referent is morphed WITHOUT a hard cut ('maybe it becomes...'), keeping the imagination perpetually generating fresh imagery so the evaluator never settles on one frame long enough to judge it (a comparative ratchet sells each state as a downgradeable floor).


**When to reach for this.** The lever is processing CAPACITY: concurrent, captured, or flooded demand starves evaluation — the listener is kept BUSY. Choose it OVER irresolvable-input confusion (86) — there content cannot be RESOLVED (paradox/broken-grammar/impossible-image); here every element is individually resolvable but too voluminous, null, or perpetually-updating to leave spare capacity (load, not paradox). vs pattern-interrupt (190) — that is a one-shot break; here the load is SUSTAINED. vs cognitive-quieting (80) — release vs load: quieting lets thought depart, saturation gives the channel more than it can process. vs fixation (29) — narrowing to ONE focus vs MULTIPLYING or flooding demand. Absorbed decode-tells: concurrent-demand overload (stacked/dual tasks) vs perceptual-or-null-task saturation (flood the field / occupy with a null task) vs imagined-task occupation (a committed imagined task crowds out somatic input, can flip valence) vs continuous-morph occupation (morph-without-cut outruns the evaluator) are the realizations of THIS entry.


**Realizations** (4): `attentional-saturation-quieting`, `continuous-morph-chain`, `engrossment-analgesia`, `working-memory-channel-saturation`


**See also.** `in-trance-load-release-oscillation` — the load pole of the oscillation is exactly the capacity-saturation lever; the difference is that one uses sustained load as the induction while the other alternates load against a blankness reward to make each cycle a depth increment. A reader building either will want the other.


### cognitive-quieting

*risk: low*

Directs the ongoing flow of the listener's cognition to depart, settle, or be subtracted, experienced as effortless release rather than a demanded act — the pure quieting/emptying technique (mind goes quiet by letting thought GO, not by load and not by making it wanted). The departure rarely rides bare imagery: carriers make the subtraction feel automatic (metered to the exhale, folded into a body-drain frame, extended from an established heaviness metaphor) and riders shape what the emptying accomplishes (immediate backfill so no vacuum is felt, reattribution of the narrowing to impersonal physics so the truth-audit stops, asymmetric scope that exempts the operator's voice, an epistemic-blur seed downgrading introspective access, a named subtraction staircase converting each loss into a felt confirmation, rotating removal-litanies that generalize the subtraction). Absorbed realizations, parametric surfaces on the one directed-emptying lever: (a) arrived-state naming — the empty/spacious mind is named as ALREADY present and neutral, deepening by dwelling rather than by driving thoughts out (departure-motion and arrived-state are two points on the same arc); (b) personified shutdown — the analytical faculty is objectified and given a narrative reason to power down ('your thinking mind can rest'), optionally coupling felt body-weight as self-verifying proof or pathologizing resistance as a defective brain part; (c) form-collapse narrowing — a wide catalogue of head-descriptors is extinguished by attrition down to one saturated term, the text's form itself modeling the narrowing the listener enacts.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for cognitive-quieting when a willing listener will accept a direct, effortless emptying and thought-content simply DEPARTS. Choose it OVER its siblings: vs recruited/foreclosed-quieting (615) — that empties WITHOUT a refusable command (makes emptiness wanted, makes thinking costly, or oscillates the grammar so there is no directive to refuse); pick 615 when a direct 'let go' would invite resistance. vs capacity-saturation (173) — release vs LOAD: quieting empties by letting cognition go, saturation empties by giving the channel more than it can process (a listener kept BUSY is 173, not this). vs scope-restriction (24) — there the faculty stays ACTIVE and is merely gated on what it may range over; here the flow leaves. vs space-preallocation-staging (641) — there the empty space is a pre-built delivery SLOT for a named insertion; here emptiness is the absorptive end in itself. Absorbed decode-tells: departure-motion (thoughts leaving) vs arrived-state naming (already empty) vs personified shutdown (the mind given a reason to rest) vs form-collapse (many descriptors attrited to one) are all realizations of THIS entry.


**Realizations** (3): `catalogue-collapse-narrowing`, `mental-spaciousness`, `metaphoric-cognitive-shutdown`


**See also.** `faculty-preserving-scope-restriction` — both act on the critical/thinking faculty but in opposite ways: one confines what thinking may range over while leaving it active, the other lets the flow of thought depart entirely. The second entry already names the first as the contrast case, so a reader choosing between them benefits from the link.; `recruited-or-foreclosed-quieting` — same target state (an emptied mind) reached by opposite means: one issues a direct, refusable invitation to let thought depart; the other engineers the emptying so no refusable directive exists at all - thinking is made costly, emptiness made wanted, or the grammar oscillates so no instruction is locatable. A reader choosing between them needs the other in view, because the pick turns entirely on whether a direct request would meet resistance.; `validate-then-weaponize-disposal` — relation=contrasts_with; one-shot departure imagery vs installed cyclic disposal ritual; contested surface (bubbles/balloons)


### count-or-cue-sabotage-disorientation

*risk: low*

A familiar deepening structure the listener is tracking to orient — a countdown, or an established directional cue (down = deeper, a count toward a floor) — is deliberately broken so the tracking/monitoring faculty cannot resolve it, stays occupied and frustrated, then disengages, and the failure is pre-framed as depth ('lose track of the numbers', 'the numbers aren't important'). With no stable way to track position, direction/order ceases to signal state and the operator's voice becomes the sole reference for where the listener is; smuggled state-suggestions or triggers frequently ride the collapsing sequence downward. Two realizations of the one sabotage-the-tracking-device lever: (a) numeric-order corruption — numbers scrambled, repeated, reversed, non-monotonic, or dissolved into percussive syllables so the sequence cannot be followed; (b) directional-cue voiding — after a conventional cue is established, its meaning is reversed, negated, or dissolved while its imperative pull is retained (silent flip of an ascending catalogue into descent, both directions pre-bound to deepening, mid-count re-ruling of an up-count as still-deeper, polarity inversion with a self-applied multiplier, destination-less repeating numbers).


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when the goal is DISORIENTATION by breaking a tracking device the listener was handed — the count/cue form is the host, sabotage is the technique. Choose it OVER countdown-descent, whose orderly descent IS the mechanism; here the order/direction is destroyed on purpose so it cannot be tracked. Distinct from confusion built on irresolvable content (contradictory propositional content, not a broken sequence), from syntactic/grammar collapse, and from a re-ruled direction that installs a NEW stable rule (here orientation is simply denied, not re-ruled to a new order). Not fractionation either — no real wake interval; the direction words are re-ruled or scrambled, not actually alternated. The tell between the two realizations: numeric-order corruption scrambles the sequence itself; directional-cue voiding inverts an established cue's meaning while keeping its pull.


**Realizations** (1): `installed-cue-subversion`


**See also.** `engineered-failure-harvest` — forced real-time computation failure overlaps failure-harvest; count-vehicle keeps it here; `metacognitive-destabilization-drop` — both deepen by denying the listener a way to locate themselves, and both are separated from fractionation on the same grounds. The split is what gets broken: the tracking device the listener was handed, versus the criterion for judging whether trance occurred at all.


### countdown-descent

*risk: low*

A monotonic ordinal count (typically 10-to-1 or 5-to-1, occasionally an inverted 1-to-10) is run as the absorption/depth vehicle: each numbered step is bound to descent, relaxation, or accumulation imagery so the count itself drives the state change and the terminal number lands a declared trance. The count supplies punctual, one-directional structure the listener surrenders into — resistance must fight a sequence that only moves one way toward the floor. Variants realize the same descent through a persistent distinct surface (styling metaphor, inevitable proprioceptive milestone, prose camouflage, deliberate rhythm-breakage, lowered-consent framing, listener-set floor, per-number functional load) without changing the underlying counted-descent lever.


**When to reach for this.** The count is the descent vehicle and the state moves smoothly toward a floor under the assumption of cooperation. Reach for it OVER count/cue-sabotage — there the count is deliberately corrupted or its direction voided so tracking FAILS (disorientation is the goal); here the orderly descent IS the mechanism. It is not numerical depth-work on an ALREADY-tranced subject — here the count itself produces the descent — and it is not a no-fail count (there every branch is pre-coded success; here the count can fail if the subject stops cooperating). One realization interleaves a mantra loop BETWEEN the numbers so the count does double duty (deepen + deliver payload) — a composition on the same clean-descent lever.


**Realizations** (2): `body-to-mind-threshold-crossing`, `countdown-mantra-interleaving`


### environmental-dissociation

*risk: low*

Narrows the attention channel by fading external stimuli — room, sounds, body sensation, surroundings — so only the operator's voice remains as relevant input, deepening absorption and removing competing inputs that could provide reality-testing. Realized either by fading anchors out (they dissolve, recede, become unreal) or by keeping noticed stimuli in awareness and re-tasking them as relaxation fuel; the salience shift may be delivered as a request or as an already-true factual report.


**When to reach for this.** The lever is subtraction of competing input, not the voice's own pull — unlike voice absorption, where the voice fills mental space and causes the descent. Unlike consciousness-splitting work that targets an altered self-model, the narrowing of input is the goal here and dissociation only a side-effect. Distinct from emergence work, which reintroduces environmental anchors on the way back out.


**Realizations** (1): `sequential-sense-deactivation`


**See also.** `hostile-environment-channel-conversion` — sibling that keeps the environmental voice IN and weaponizes it; `voice-absorption` — both end with the operator's voice as the only relevant input and are routinely run together, but the lever is opposite in direction: one subtracts competing external stimuli until the voice is what remains, the other has the voice fill and replace mental space by its own pull.


### eye-closure

*risk: low*

Suggests eyelid heaviness ending in closure to establish the external-to-internal shift, realized through a range of surface rules: reattributing the heaviness to an identity-confirming prop, a self-reinforcing attention-equals-cause loop, reframing closure as a sensory upgrade rather than a loss, or deferring the eyelids to the terminal position after a full-body inventory so closing completes an already-established pattern.


**When to reach for this.** Unlike environmental dissociation, which fades the surroundings, the move here is the eyelid closure itself — the gateway to the internal shift. And unlike breath-locked eyelid fractionation, which binds eyelid state to an autonomic rhythm to fractionate, these are single closure-suggestion units with an articulable surface rule, not self-powered oscillation cycles.


**See also.** `breath-locked-eyelid-fractionation` — sibling ATTN-02 family; both terminate in closure


### faculty-preserving-scope-restriction

*risk: medium*

Leaves the act of thinking/evaluating intact but constrains what it may range over, so the listener still experiences themselves as thinking freely while their critical faculty has been pre-narrowed. Two surface forms of one lever: (a) narrowing the evaluative gatekeeper — the function that decides 'is this important, should I attend?' — to a small explicit allowlist ('all that is important is listening, relaxing, going deeper'), so anything outside it (noise, stray thought, itch) is preclassified as unimportant before it arises; and (b) bracketing behavioral suggestions with 'you don't want to think about anything BUT [looking/sucking]', handing the listener a restricted domain to think within so the object of thought is confined. Either way the evaluative channel is dampened while the felt sense of free thought is preserved, so later suggestions land without pushback and resistance is hard because the listener is still allowed to think — just told what about / what counts.


**When to reach for this.** Keeps the faculty active but restricts its scope (relevance-allowlist or object-confinement). Distinct from a blunt 'stop thinking' command (bypassable suppression) and from techniques that quiet or empty thought — thoughts drifting away, or an already-present blankness — which remove thinking rather than confine it. The tell is preservation of thinking plus preclassification/confinement of what it may range over — not emptiness.


**See also.** `audience-split-bypass` — both leave the evaluating faculty running while removing its purchase, one by narrowing what it may range over and the other by declaring the content not addressed to it. Very easy to conflate, since both let the listener feel they are still thinking freely; the pointer helps make the call.; `cognitive-quieting` — both act on the critical/thinking faculty but in opposite ways: one confines what thinking may range over while leaving it active, the other lets the flow of thought depart entirely. The second entry already names the first as the contrast case, so a reader choosing between them benefits from the link.; `faculty-removal-pass` — restriction versus excision of the same faculty. One keeps thinking intact but preclassifies what it may range over, the other claims the organ removed outright; a passage that narrows what matters can be misread as a removal claim.; `filter-shaping-pre-qualification` — same strategic stance from opposite sides. Both deliberately leave the evaluating faculty intact and work around it rather than suppressing it. One narrows what the faculty may range over so the felt sense of free thought survives; the other shapes each suggestion to pass an untouched filter. Useful pair when the writer wants selectivity preserved rather than bypassed.; `recruited-or-foreclosed-quieting` — two ways to disarm the thinking faculty without a refusable order. One leaves thinking intact but pre-narrows what it may range over; the other empties it while removing any locatable directive to refuse. Confinement vs. foreclosed emptying — the shared question is where the refusal juncture went.


### fixation

*risk: medium*

Narrows the subject's attention onto one operator-chosen focus so competing stimuli fall away and absorption/suggestibility climb — the receptive-substrate primitive other absorption moves depend on. The focus can be an external point, a voice, an imagined image, a person, a rhythmic body channel, or even the accessible word-space itself; delivery framing varies (misattribution to infatuation, aesthetic appraisal, focus asserted as already-accomplished fact, a geometric attention-rail, a narrated substitute for an absent visual).
