The operator asserts in casual factual tone that nothing just happened ("we've just started", "first time we've had this talk"), denying even a physical action the listener performed (kneeling), with no acknowledgement — so episodic timeline coherence degrades and by midpoint "how many times" produces genuine confusion. A related surface re-attributes narrative-cut gaps (blinking forward between day-scenes) to trance-amnesia: the natural inability to recall what did not happen is relabeled as evidence the conditioning is working, used as a recurring mid-session deepener.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia delivered as present-tense narration contradicting recent events (gaslighting-shaped) or as re-attribution of fiction/narrative cuts to trance-amnesia — no memory gap is installed, existing events are denied or existing gaps relabeled. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (a direct forget- command on a bounded target). Contradiction-without-acknowledgement / cut-relabeling is the tell.


### covert-amnesia-installation

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Amnesia installed WITHOUT a recognizable forget-command — the suggestion is smuggled in as something other than an instruction so it slips past the evaluation a direct "you will forget" would trigger. Surfaces: an in-fiction physics metaphor (a black hole where "information can't escape", so later non-retrieval is pre-explained as a law of the descent) cashed later as the amnesia firewall; identity-loss delivered as an environmental fact of the fantasy scene ("you might not realize... even your own name"); a wake-time dismissal disguised as small talk that also instructs forgetting; covert deletion of a specific item (the number 5) by modeled omission under a completeness/truth guarantee; and wake-by-rewinding to a pre-trance state-marker so amnesia is a byproduct of state restoration. The common lever is amnesia-by-non-command: pre-installing the account for, or the fact of, forgetting.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia delivered as metaphor-physics / scene-fact / small-talk / modeled-omission / state-rewind rather than as a declared forget, so it evades the evaluation an explicit command draws. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (a declared instruction) and from install-concealment-amnesia (which hides an install's ORIGIN — here it is the amnesia itself that is disguised at delivery, often forward-loaded to fire later). The non-command disguise is the tell.


**See also.** `install-concealment-amnesia` — both hide something about an amnesia install, but at different layers. One disguises the forget itself at the moment of delivery, so no recognizable forget-command is ever issued. The other lets the amnesia be plain and instead erases the memory of the installation event, leaving an active command with no locatable origin. They stack in practice - a disguised delivery whose install is also unrecallable - so the reader wants both.


### dissociative-memory-vault

*risk: medium · consent-required*

Builds a persistent in-trance dissociative custodian construct — a personified reflection, inner self, or vault — assigned the role of safekeeping trance content, framed as retrievable any time. The payload is a deposit-only asymmetry: the construct only ever stores, there is no scripted retrieval ceremony, so trance content is kept out of conscious access under cover of a safety promise the script never honors, and the construct becomes load-bearing scaffolding for later installs.


**When to reach for this.** A persistent personified custodian/vault stores trance content with an unhonored retrieval promise (deposit-only asymmetry) as the payload. Unlike an observer-responder split (an awareness partition for felt automaticity), this is an external storage construct; unlike a direct amnesia suggestion (amnesia as an end-state), the lever is a custodian construct with a false availability promise; unlike externalizing a faculty into a construct, what is stored here is memory content, not a faculty.


**See also.** `install-concealment-amnesia` — both remove trance content from conscious reach, and the vault entry's deposit-only promise is a natural cover story for concealing an install's origin. A reader deciding whether a custodian construct is doing storage work or provenance-hiding work needs both entries to make the call; the discriminators are complementary, not overlapping.; `listener-kept-dissociation-container` — both fabricate a container that holds identity or memory content out of ordinary access; the live distinction is authorship and custody (operator-supplied deposit-only custodian versus a container the listener builds or keeps the key to). Genuine disambiguation risk, so the cross-reference earns its place.


### emptied-window-install

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Engineers a narrow window in which the conceptual tools for objecting (resistance, disobedience, release, or the identity anchor itself) have just been disabled, then states positive content — identity claims, addiction/exclusivity assertions, service targeting — as flat unopposed facts into that window. Two sub-moves sharing the window: (a) repurposing a pre-trained neutral erase-reflex to delete loaded concepts the listener never specifically consented to lose (the reflex fires past conscious veto because consent was given while it was meaningless); (b) installing positive claims into the just-emptied window so on rousing they are treated as encountered-without-resistance. A related move manufactures a memory gap (too depleted to recall whom you serve) specifically so the operator can fill the blank with herself. The window is narrow and content-swappable; the emptying is the slot.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia/erasure used to OPEN an installation slot — either deleting objecting-tools past consent via a hijacked neutral reflex, or stating positive content into the just-emptied window as unopposed fact. A plain forget-suggestion treats forgetting as the end, and a screen-memory approach installs a replacement recollection — here the emptying is instrumental, so a fresh positive install lands under minimum critical capacity. The engineered window-of-defenselessness is the tell.


**See also.** `blank-then-authorship-handoff` — both use an emptying or forgetting as instrumental substrate rather than as the payload, and they already reference each other's distinction: wholesale relocation of who authors mental content, versus discrete positive claims stated into the just-opened window. A reader who has identified the substrate still has to choose between them.; `faculty-removal-pass` — both disable the objecting faculty so later material lands unopposed, and the difference is scope and durability: one opens a narrow, content-swappable window by erasure and states positive claims into it; the other claims a standing organ has been excised, priming material well beyond the current session. Momentary slot versus durable removal is the pick.; `identity-origin-erasure` — erasure used instrumentally in both, and one explicitly depends on the other as a foundation: emptying opens an installation slot, while origin erasure deletes the baseline a listener could return to. Reader gains from seeing the emptying-then-fill relation.; `identity-uncertainty-gap` — both open an empty slot and then fill it: one manufactures identity not-knowing with the operator as sole resolver, the other disables the tools for objecting and states content into the gap. Reader gains from seeing gap-by-uncertainty against gap-by-erasure.; `preemptive-negation-install` — both land content where no defense can form, and they are close enough that a reader needs the split: one times a capacity word to appear for the first time at its own negation, the other empties the objecting tools first and then states content into the gap. Timing versus an engineered window.


### fabricated-forgetting-priming

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Manufactures a sense of forgetting for content that was never actually present, so a later install reads as recollection rather than introduction. Surfaces: a memory-gap probe disguised as small talk where the operator pesters the subject about "something she's forgetting" that turns out to be an object (the pink pulse) not yet in her experience — the forgetting is fabricated retroactively to prime an "always-been-there" frame; and generalizing amnesia to the whole self-narrative by naming specific checkable-sounding autobiographical details the listener finds she cannot verify (lipstick colour, uniform fit), so real conditioning-drift hides inside manufactured uncertainty and installed changes become indistinguishable from original traits.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia FABRICATED — creating uncertainty about content that was never there, or about the whole self-narrative, to prime an always-been-there frame or to hide drift inside manufactured doubt. An ordinary forget-suggestion erases content that WAS delivered, and a screen-memory approach installs a concrete replacement — here no content is installed, only unresolvable uncertainty. The weaponized ordinary-memory-uncertainty / retroactive fabrication is the tell.


**See also.** `identity-origin-erasure` — manufactured uncertainty about one's own history is the substrate the always-been-this-way origin rewrite depends on; reading them together shows how unverifiable autobiographical doubt sets up baseline deletion.; `interrogative-amnesia-drill` — two non-declarative routes to amnesia that a writer would weigh against each other: fabricating uncertainty about content never delivered, versus drilling a conditioned non-answer by repeatedly asking and dismissing. Both avoid a plain forget-suggestion, and the discriminators are more useful read as a pair.; `screen-memory` — direct complements already named in each other's discriminators: one installs a concrete replacement recollection so the erasure feels seamless, the other manufactures uncertainty about content that was never there. A reader choosing between fill and manufactured doubt needs both.


### fabricated-memory-trigger-rehearsal

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a forward cue-response by narrating fabricated autobiographical memories that all rehearse the SAME trigger-collapse shape (a mundane act, then a snap/trigger, then instant collapse). The operator pre-frames that all the subject's memories now have this shape, so the next real trigger feels like the hundred-and-first occurrence rather than the first. Routing the conditioning through fabricated recollection — rehearsal-by-memory rather than direct suggestion — means the response is never experienced as a suggestion at all, making it harder to detect or counter. The false memories are additive rehearsal evidence, not concealment of anything.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from screen-memory fabrication, which fabricates memory to conceal or replace a real one — here the fabricated memories conceal nothing and instead install a forward-facing conditioned response. Separates from plain trigger installation and from future pacing by the vehicle: the cue-response is pre-loaded as autobiographical evidence (a rehearsed past), so it is felt as recollection, not as an installed suggestion or an imagined future.


**See also.** `manufactured-conditioning-history` — both install present or future responsiveness by getting the listener to supply a past that never happened. They differ in what the fabricated past is for: one back-dates a conditioning history to set a depth floor and make resistance incoherent; the other narrates fabricated episodes that all rehearse one cue-response shape so the next real firing feels well-practiced. Worth reading together as counterfactual-past vehicles.; `memory-graft-trigger-install` — both route a trigger install through autobiographical memory instead of direct suggestion, but one grafts a false detail into a preserved real memory so the anchor borrows that memory's authenticity, while the other fabricates whole memories whose only cargo is repeated rehearsal of the cue-response shape.


### fabricated-recovered-memory-retrieval

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

Fabricates a sensory-rich memory and presents it to the subject as genuine RETRIEVAL rather than construction. A container premise ("nothing is ever forgotten, it is stored in a drawer") licenses treating imagination as recall; pre-specifying the perceptual channels primes which senses to hallucinate; a two-cue partition separates generating the experience from narrating it; a fetch loop manufactures corroborating detail on demand — and veridicality is never checked. The root-tracing form treats a present somatic/behavioral symptom as the residue of a specific recoverable originating moment and surfaces that "origin", claiming correction at the root. Shared lever: a produced experience is experienced as a recovered fact.


**When to reach for this.** A memory is fabricated wholesale and framed as recovered, with NO pre-existing target being screened. vs screen-memory, which overwrites access to a specific known real memory. vs genuine retrieval — the never-tested veridicality and the generate-on-demand fetch loop. vs guided visualization — the retrieval framing asserts the product as a real past, not an acknowledged imagining.


**See also.** `abreactive-present-tense-reliving` — both surface putative past material with no veridicality check, differing on route — construction framed as retrieval versus present-tense affective re-enactment. They co-occur and are readily confused, so the pointer earns its place.; `manufactured-conditioning-history` — both have the listener imagine an event and then treat the product as a real past, so the boundary is worth showing: one fabricates an episodic memory framed as retrieval, the other fabricates a conditioning history specifically to re-source present responsiveness and set a depth floor. Close enough to confuse, distinct in what the fabricated past is used for.; `memory-graft-trigger-install` — sharp contrast within fabricated memory work: constructing a whole memory and framing it as recovered, versus preserving a real memory and grafting a counterfactual detail into it so an anchor borrows its authenticity.


### forward-directed-amnesia

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Amnesia that covers the FUTURE rather than the past: a pre-declared terminal anchor (a closing box lid, brain-boxing, "this is your last conscious memory") after which all subsequent material is framed as un-encodable and installing directly, bypassing conscious filtering — often positioning a time-jump for the rest of a file or series. The conscious mind is declared decommissioned going forward, so later installs land with the critical filter framed as offline; the same knowledge-boundary logic can seal a regression so the subject knows only what the child-self knew at each moment (total amnesia for everything after the child's current age, stripping hindsight).


**When to reach for this.** Forward-directed / knowledge-boundary amnesia (seals what comes AFTER a declared anchor, or events after an age), not backward amnesia covering already-delivered content. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (retrospective gap) — the temporal direction (future/reachability removal) is the tell. Topology residual: removes reachable (future) states rather than sliding a magnitude.


### function-amnesia

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Amnesia targeted not at the trance or the session but at the PURPOSE/function of the installed suggestions — "hard to remember what this programming is even supposed to do" — while preserving the imperative to obey it. Suggestions become unfalsifiable because a command whose function you can no longer recall cannot be evaluated or rejected; all that survives is "I need to listen to it / it is right", which defends every other implant. The payload stays active and binding; only its rationale is severed.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia scoped to the payload's RATIONALE/function while the payload stays active — severs a command from its reason to make it unfalsifiable. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (forgets the session/ content), from install-concealment-amnesia (forgets the install's ORIGIN — here the origin may be recalled but the PURPOSE is voided), and from selective-amnesia-retained-payload (retains a token/slogan — here the active command is retained but its justification removed). The function-vs-content scoping is the tell.


**See also.** `install-concealment-amnesia` — members of the same amnesia-scoping family, separated by what is voided while the payload stays active: the command's rationale in one case, the act and origin of installation in the other. Both produce an unarguable directive, by removing different handles. Cross-referencing is what makes the scoping axis legible rather than leaving three near-identical amnesia entries to be told apart by name.; `selective-amnesia-retained-payload` — complementary carve-outs on the same memory: one strips a live command's rationale while keeping the command, the other strips the scaffolding and session specifics while keeping exactly one curated token - a slogan, an affect, a pointer. Both leave an unarguable residue because the premises that would let it be challenged are gone. Reading them together makes the shared logic visible.; `selective-memory-bifurcation` — these are inverse splits on the same how/why axis: one occludes the installation mechanism while preserving a rationale that makes the behavior feel like sincere personal truth, the other keeps the command binding while voiding the rationale so it cannot be evaluated at all.


### install-concealment-amnesia

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Amnesia scoped not to the payload but to the INSTALLATION EVENT — the memory of receiving the command/trigger is erased while the command itself stays active. The subject cannot locate when they agreed, so on later firing the response feels spontaneous/native rather than implanted and has no examinable origin to resist. Includes: encapsulating "the thought of getting this command" and bursting it; a self-erasing clause that fades its own installation ("the memory of it being implanted will fade... I give you the ability to obey even as I remove the ability to remember"); marking self- generated words as an addressable-but-locked memory anchor; splitting the amnesia into a deep cover- story pre-seed and a wake-time trigger; placing an active trigger inside a sealed amnesic region; and burying the install in an operator-controlled locked-door / vault / self-guarded avoidance-void / inverted-lockbox / multi-self-keeper architecture that supports selective operator-cracked recall.


**When to reach for this.** The amnesia targets the meta-level — the act and origin of installation — to protect an active install from audit or revocation, leaving the effect fully operative. An ordinary forget-suggestion erases the delivered content, not the receiving of it; here the command stays active while its origin is simply voided, with no replacement story supplied. And where a forward command can be hidden behind amnesia so its firing feels natural, what is hidden here is specifically the install's provenance, so the response has no examinable origin to argue with.


**See also.** `amnesia-wrapped-command` — closely adjacent and easy to confuse: both keep a command live while removing its audit trail. The cut is scope - one wraps a forward-scheduled cue-response so the later behavior feels self-arising, the other targets the installation event itself so the subject cannot locate when they agreed. The wrapper and the concealment frequently co-occur, and the reader needs the cut stated to assign an instance correctly.; `covert-amnesia-installation` — both hide something about an amnesia install, but at different layers. One disguises the forget itself at the moment of delivery, so no recognizable forget-command is ever issued. The other lets the amnesia be plain and instead erases the memory of the installation event, leaving an active command with no locatable origin. They stack in practice - a disguised delivery whose install is also unrecallable - so the reader wants both.; `dissociative-memory-vault` — both remove trance content from conscious reach, and the vault entry's deposit-only promise is a natural cover story for concealing an install's origin. A reader deciding whether a custodian construct is doing storage work or provenance-hiding work needs both entries to make the call; the discriminators are complementary, not overlapping.; `function-amnesia` — members of the same amnesia-scoping family, separated by what is voided while the payload stays active: the command's rationale in one case, the act and origin of installation in the other. Both produce an unarguable directive, by removing different handles. Cross-referencing is what makes the scoping axis legible rather than leaving three near-identical amnesia entries to be told apart by name.; `marked-cue-amnesia-switch` — one erases the memory of the install so the response has no origin to argue with; the other trains a marked token as the switch that opens or closes sealed material. They compose naturally — seal the provenance, then keep a key to it — so a reader of either benefits from the other.; `self-sealing-recall-loop` — both protect an install from audit rather than erasing its payload, but install-concealment voids the memory of the installation event so the response has no examinable origin, while the self-sealing loop leaves recall technically possible and wires the ACT of reaching for it to re-trigger forgetting.; `state-partitioned-amnesia-container` — overlapping realizations: both describe a deeper-self or container architecture holding material the waking mind cannot reach. The split is what the amnesia protects and how it is bounded — concealing an install's provenance so the effect has no examinable origin, vs. a commanded reversible two-state boundary with a deliberately leaked motivating residue.


### interrogative-amnesia-drill

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Trains a conditioned non-answer to identity questions by DRILLING rather than declaring: a chant alternates identity questions ("Who am I? Where am I?") with dismissals ("It doesn't matter right now"), repeated across cycles so each question forces a brief involuntary retrieval attempt and each paired dismissal trains that answer to be unreachable/irrelevant — a conditioned shrug replaces the identity answer. A colored handle ("Purple amnesia") is attached for later re-evocation. The asking, not the telling, does the work.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia trained by an interrogative elicit-then-frustrate drill (repeatedly asking then dismissing), not a declarative "you will forget" suggestion, with a re-evocation cue attached. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (declares the gap) — the asking-not-telling conditioning form is the tell.


**See also.** `amnesia-suggestion` — same outcome by opposite delivery: a declared forget versus a drilled question-then-dismiss cycle that conditions the answer to be unreachable. The declaring-versus-drilling contrast is exactly what a reader needs when choosing an amnesia move.; `fabricated-forgetting-priming` — two non-declarative routes to amnesia that a writer would weigh against each other: fabricating uncertainty about content never delivered, versus drilling a conditioned non-answer by repeatedly asking and dismissing. Both avoid a plain forget-suggestion, and the discriminators are more useful read as a pair.; `self-sealing-recall-loop` — both install amnesia through the retrieval act rather than a declarative forget-command, which is the shared insight worth linking. One drills question-then-dismissal cycles until a conditioned shrug replaces the answer; the other wires the reach for a memory to re-trigger the urge to let go.


### marked-cue-amnesia-switch

*risk: medium*

Pre-mark a token during trance by tone/tempo/emphasis and train the MARK, not the word's meaning, as a binary handle on a posthypnotic amnesia. Later the operator re-presents only that marked token to flip the sealed material open or shut, or delivers a matched second reserved phrase that runs the suppression anchor in reverse, flooding the sealed content back complete; the delayed-key form slips the tonally-planted cue into ordinary post-trance talk on the operator's timing to re-open sealed material outside the trance frame. Because the active ingredient is the analogical mark, ordinary paraphrase, frank statement, or full retelling all fail to reach the block; only the tagged token operates the switch, and the release feels spontaneous to the subject rather than commanded.


**When to reach for this.** The active ingredient is the mark isolated over semantics — proven by the failure of every non-marked prompt — operating an amnesia gate. Trigger-activation fires a state-shift, not a memory-gate toggle; a plain amnesia suggestion installs the seal, while this operates its key; and an amnesia-wrapped command wraps a command in forgetting rather than switching the amnesia itself.


**See also.** `install-concealment-amnesia` — one erases the memory of the install so the response has no origin to argue with; the other trains a marked token as the switch that opens or closes sealed material. They compose naturally — seal the provenance, then keep a key to it — so a reader of either benefits from the other.


### memory-graft-trigger-install

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Harvests a real autobiographical memory at amplified affect (a proud/motivated moment re-embodied), then EDITS that preserved memory by inserting a fabricated sensory detail ("you were wearing sexy panties") and binds a trigger/mantra to the grafted detail. Because the host memory is genuinely the listener's own, the trigger inherits the memory's motivational charge and felt realness — the listener's own evidence-of-self ("I really was motivated") is hijacked as proof-of-trigger and cannot reliably be distinguished from the graft. The load-bearing move is editing the contents of an EXISTING memory to serve as a self-authenticating anchor host (a wearable-object trigger the listener can self-fire by putting the garment on).


**When to reach for this.** The real memory is PRESERVED and a counterfactual detail is grafted INTO it. Screen memory, by contrast, replaces access to a real memory; ordinary trigger anchoring layers an anchor on top of an unmodified evoked state. Here the memory itself is edited so the anchor borrows autobiographical authenticity.


**See also.** `fabricated-memory-trigger-rehearsal` — both route a trigger install through autobiographical memory instead of direct suggestion, but one grafts a false detail into a preserved real memory so the anchor borrows that memory's authenticity, while the other fabricates whole memories whose only cargo is repeated rehearsal of the cue-response shape.; `fabricated-recovered-memory-retrieval` — sharp contrast within fabricated memory work: constructing a whole memory and framing it as recovered, versus preserving a real memory and grafting a counterfactual detail into it so an anchor borrows its authenticity.


### observable-pleasurable-forgetting

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Renders forgetting as a visible, pleasurable, ongoing physical event the listener watches, so forgetting becomes presence-of-dissolution rather than absence-of-recall — much harder to doubt than a flat amnesia suggestion, and a failed recall attempt is read as proof of depth. Surfaces: forgotten memories melt into the ocean as glowing pieces the listener watches dissolve (also land-grabbing jurisdiction over "every hypnotic experience ever forgotten"); an amnesia stutter-loop that performs the fog in broken syntax while binding hazy recall to a positive-affect place-name cue ("the pink room"). Dissolution is pleasurable so noticing the gap becomes erotic/expected rather than alarming.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia staged as an observed, felt, pleasurable phenomenon (dissolution watched now, or enacted in broken syntax with a positive-affect cue) so the gap is self-confirming instead of assertable-away. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (declared imposed gap) and from container-externalized-erasure (a destructible object the listener/operator acts on — here forgetting is WATCHED as ambient dissolution, not popped). The make-forgetting-observable-and-pleasant move is the tell.


### orgasm-gated-amnesia

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Binds forgetting to the climax event: the peak physiological reward (orgasm / "cock pops, mind pops") is fused with erasure so the deletion is felt as pleasurable and self-evident, and/or a programmed blackout window is opened at climax during which post-hypnotic suggestions are delivered the listener is instructed not to register. Variants pair the reward with deletion of SPECIFIC rival content (other women's names/numbers/voices) to install operator-exclusivity, or reframe climax as identity-voiding plumbing (old self/memories drained out through the body, "pink electricity erasing her mind"). The reward-pairing makes the amnesia complicit (the listener wants the stroking to continue) and un-auditable (blackout delivery channel).


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia keyed to and delivered THROUGH the orgasm/climax event — reward-fused deletion, a peak-reward blackout delivery window, or climax-as-identity-drainage. A plain forget-suggestion installs a neutral gap with no reward pairing, and arousal-conditioning work builds the arousal response rather than consuming it as an erasure mechanism. The reward-gated delivery is the tell.


**See also.** `orgasm-as-imprint-window` — both treat an occurring climax as the site where something is seated rather than discharged. One loads the peak with an identity, act, or belief; the other pairs it with erasure so the deletion arrives as reward and the blackout becomes an unauditable delivery window. Anyone citing the imprint window should see the erasure payload as its close relative.


### portable-waking-forget-trigger

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Compresses the amnesia mechanism out of a visualization into a one-word portable handle ("snap and forget") that fires whether deep in trance or wide awake, instantly forcing forgetting of any named content, then scoped broadly to pre-authorize erasure of exactly what could undo the conditioning — triggers, resistance plans, confusing words, stress, regret, the old self, even the former name. The broad self-authorizing target list plus the waking portability (a content-parametric amnesia trigger usable in daily life) is what distinguishes it from a within-session forget.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia crystallized into a PORTABLE, content-parametric WAKING trigger (a one-word handle that erases arbitrary named content while awake). An ordinary forget-suggestion opens a bounded within-session gap; and where other trigger work hides a command BEHIND amnesia, here the trigger's payload IS amnesia of the specified content. The waking portability plus the self-authorizing target list is the tell.


**See also.** `self-sealing-recall-loop` — two amnesia architectures with opposite topologies: a portable waking trigger that erases named content on command, versus a recursive trap where the act of recall re-fires the forgetting. A writer picking an amnesia approach should see both.


### recursive-forget-formula

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a generic forgetting suggestion via a self-crossing chiastic/recursive verbal formula ("obey and forget, forget to remember, remember to forget", "forget that you forgot") whose semantic self-reference collapses so the analytic faculty has no clean target to refuse — any response (comply, parse, give up parsing) counts as obeying. Delivered at peak suggestibility, the listener accepts "the vibe of forgetting". Related surfaces: a pre-published recursive four-step subroutine (forget the thing / forget that you forgot / forget that you forgot you forgot / feel good) run on cue; a conscious/ subconscious split with circular forget-loops framing amnesia-as-success; and an open-loop unresolvable "circle of life" bracket that exits conscious processing and licenses forget-the-source-keep-the-result. The refuse-proofness comes from the recursion/collapse, not from the content.


**When to reach for this.** A recursive/chiastic/unresolvable verbal structure that makes the forget-suggestion un-refusable by removing a parseable target — confusion-overload fused directly to the amnesia content. A plain forget-command can be parsed and refused; and where a self-sealing recall loop wires the RETRIEVAL ACT to re-trigger forgetting after the session, here the collapse happens at delivery, in the syntax itself. The semantic self-reference / working-memory-wobble is the tell.


**See also.** `choice-framed-amnesia` — two opposite strategies for making a forget-suggestion unrefusable: define every recall outcome as chosen and successful, or collapse the syntax so no parseable target remains. Useful as alternatives to weigh against each other.


### screen-memory

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Constructs a specific, believable replacement memory (or a substitute recall-target) that overwrites the access route to a real memory or a real experienced event, so the subject's recollection feels complete and the substitution is never noticed as a substitution. The complete gap+fill form — distinct from bare amnesia, which leaves a noticeable gap. Variants differ in what is overwritten (a specific autobiographical memory, visual self-recognition, a completed bodily event, the whole session), in the vehicle that makes the fabrication feel self-generated (a reconsolidation-pseudoscience premise, an odd specific number, a menu with delayed onset), and in the self-defense the fill provides (a soothing decoy image, a conscious cover-story masking retained conditioning) — but the load-bearing lever is constant: a fabricated recollection installed to replace a real one.


**When to reach for this.** Supplies a constructed fill that makes the erasure feel complete rather than gapped. Plain amnesia leaves a noticeable gap; meaning/attribution rewrites leave episodic memory fully recallable and only overwrite interpretation; memory-grafting inserts a detail INTO a preserved real memory. Screen memory replaces the recollection itself with a constructed one.


**See also.** `fabricated-forgetting-priming` — direct complements already named in each other's discriminators: one installs a concrete replacement recollection so the erasure feels seamless, the other manufactures uncertainty about content that was never there. A reader choosing between fill and manufactured doubt needs both.


### selective-amnesia-retained-payload

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Amnesia that severs content-memory from a deliberately-retained residue: the installation scaffolding, session specifics, and command-as-command are forgotten while exactly one curated item survives conscious recall — a mantra/slogan ("obedience is pleasure", "I submit to you"), a brand-pointer (the urge is focused on the operator), a single retained trigger-phrase (context-gated to safe firing), the affect of having felt good, or the compliance drive with its rationale stripped (paired with a forward-pointing re-induction cue). Because the surviving token IS the payload and the premises that would let it be challenged are gone, an un-scaffolded conclusion cannot be argued with; forgetting is often reframed as proof of depth so the listener welcomes it. One variant smuggles a selective-recall gate via chiasmus preserving the operator's "programming" channel while everything else forgets.


**When to reach for this.** A selective carve-out where the gap is engineered around a single retained payload-token — not a blank gap and not full-session erasure. A plain forget-suggestion leaves an empty gap with no curated residue; a screen-memory approach fabricates a false replacement rather than curating a true one; and where install-concealment amnesia hides the install's origin, here the SCAFFOLDING is dropped so one conclusion stays foregrounded. The keep-affect/forget-cause and keep-slogan/forget-premises splits are the tell.


**See also.** `function-amnesia` — complementary carve-outs on the same memory: one strips a live command's rationale while keeping the command, the other strips the scaffolding and session specifics while keeping exactly one curated token - a slogan, an affect, a pointer. Both leave an unarguable residue because the premises that would let it be challenged are gone. Reading them together makes the shared logic visible.


### self-sealing-recall-loop

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Amnesia installed as a recursive, self-administered avoidance loop rather than an imposed deletion: recall is left physically possible but recoded as effortful/aversive, and the very ACT of reaching for a memory is wired to re-trigger the urge to let go and forget (or, on retrieval, the memory converts to non-semantic content — "becomes colours" — and the listener returns to the obedience-mantra). Any attempt to introspect or audit the conditioning re-runs the suggestion and deepens it, so the introspective/verification exit is foreclosed. Surfaces include: recall-as-forget-trigger; amnesia derived as a syllogistic entailment of conceded blankness; a doorless-box that forgets itself; an overtly-announced curiosity-trap where don't-try/try/re-listen all feed the loop; a recall-attempt trapdoor with an operator-only memory exception; a waterfall/white-noise recall-guard that re-drops self-recall into trance; and retrieval-time perceptual substitution with a guardian who "absorbs" the memories so the listener feels safe about not remembering.


**When to reach for this.** The block lives in the retrieval act (remembering re-triggers forgetting, or returns corrupted content), leaving no discrete forget-command to attribute or refuse, and closing the introspection loop. An imposed memory gap is something the subject may notice and could argue with, and a screen-memory approach installs a replacement — here recall stays technically possible, nothing is installed, and every attempt to reach the memory feeds the loop. The recursive foreclosure of ever reaching an un-forgotten recall state is the signature; convert-on-access perceptual substitution (memories returning as colours) is one surface of it.


**See also.** `confabulation-amnesia-barrier` — two ways an amnesia is hardened against the listener's own audit rather than left brittle: one pre-arms an open-ended confabulation routine so waking evidence of the gap gets narratively repaired, the other wires the retrieval act itself to re-fire the forgetting so the gap is never approached — outward defense of the seam versus inward foreclosure of the reach.; `install-concealment-amnesia` — both protect an install from audit rather than erasing its payload, but install-concealment voids the memory of the installation event so the response has no examinable origin, while the self-sealing loop leaves recall technically possible and wires the ACT of reaching for it to re-trigger forgetting.; `interrogative-amnesia-drill` — both install amnesia through the retrieval act rather than a declarative forget-command, which is the shared insight worth linking. One drills question-then-dismissal cycles until a conditioned shrug replaces the answer; the other wires the reach for a memory to re-trigger the urge to let go.; `portable-waking-forget-trigger` — two amnesia architectures with opposite topologies: a portable waking trigger that erases named content on command, versus a recursive trap where the act of recall re-fires the forgetting. A writer picking an amnesia approach should see both.


### semantic-concept-ablation

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

Denial-by-amnesia at the lexical-comprehension layer rather than at the will/permission layer: the target concept (e.g. "orgasm") is rendered effortful and then unavailable during the ACTIVE state — "explained" to a too-dumb listener, compared to a hard math problem, the word itself dissolving mid-sentence ("wait, what is that again"). The construction enacts the forgetting it describes, so the listener cannot violate a rule they no longer comprehend and the will-vs-rule struggle ordinary denial produces never forms. Prospective concept-blocking during the state, not retrospective memory-block of a past event.


**When to reach for this.** Ablates a CONCEPT's comprehension during the active state (the comparator the listener could violate is removed), not a specific past memory. Ordinary amnesia work is retrospective, erasing an event or content already experienced; generic confusion-overload scrambles processing without a targeted concept-removal. The word visibly dissolving as it is uttered is the tell.


### state-partitioned-amnesia-container

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs two (or more) listener-states with asymmetric memory access via a symbolic container operated on command — a coded mental safe (open = doll-state and use-memories flow out; closed = memories return inside and are lost to the waking mind) or a multi-self addressing frame where a "deeper self" is appointed keeper of an install the conscious self forgets. Crucially a small affective residue (a craving, a need) is deliberately leaked across the wall so the sealed state can recruit its own return. The state-partition with asymmetric recall is a topology property; the motivating residue makes the amnesia recruiting rather than merely concealing.


**When to reach for this.** A commanded, reversible state-partition with asymmetric memory access across the boundary plus a deliberately-leaked motivating residue. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (one-way gap, no state boundary), from confabulation-amnesia-barrier (alter partition defended by cover-story generation — here defended by a symbolic container and an affect leak, not confabulation), and from selective-amnesia-retained-payload (a single retained token in one state — here two states with asymmetric access). The container-gated state boundary + carryover residue is the tell.


**See also.** `amnesia-plus-return-compulsion` — both fuse a memory gap to a preserved motivating residue so the amnesia recruits its own return rather than merely concealing. They differ in topology: one is a one-way exit gap bound to a re-listening drive, the other is a commanded reversible partition between states with asymmetric recall. Genuinely confusable; keep both.; `install-concealment-amnesia` — overlapping realizations: both describe a deeper-self or container architecture holding material the waking mind cannot reach. The split is what the amnesia protects and how it is bounded — concealing an install's provenance so the effect has no examinable origin, vs. a commanded reversible two-state boundary with a deliberately leaked motivating residue.


## self-partition  (23)

Partitioning self or awareness into separately addressable parts — observer/responder splits, evaluator-offline channels, constructed alters, quarantined faculties — so agency, resistance, or perception relocates across the split.

**Scope.** Structural splits without a memory gap. Memory breaking/fabrication -> amnesia; rewriting what the self IS -> self-model-surgery; relocating authorship -> authorship-shift.


### antagonist-split-resistance-routing

*risk: medium · bounded*

Installs a two-self ontology in which one self is pre-vilified / already-losing and the other is the protected occupant, then routes the listener's noticed resistance, fear, or alarm ONTO the losing/ minority container so that felt resistance confirms rather than blocks the payload. Reluctance is permitted to exist — but only inside the discarded self or the outvoted fragment — so the operator becomes the ally of the "real" self and any break-point is reabsorbed as immersion.


**When to reach for this.** Routes the listener's OWN noticed resistance/fear onto a pre-vilified losing self. vs two-target-command- router: that classifies EXTERNAL incoming commands; here the listener's own affect is routed. vs resistance-quarantine-partition: that cages the resistance faculty as an object; here resistance is permitted but relocated to a losing self so it confirms. vs no-exit-response-closure: uses a two-self split as the routing device, not exhaustive option-space closure.


**See also.** `antagonist-role-binding` — both parasitize the resistance resource rather than suppressing it, and reading them together shows the two routes: one installs a two-self ontology and routes noticed resistance onto the pre-vilified losing self so it confirms the payload; the other wires the subject's opposing role itself as fuel so performing the antagonist identity pumps the target craving.; `audience-split-bypass` — both partition the listener into two selves and use the split to disarm objection, and both already contrast against the same resistance-quarantine neighbor. One routes the listener's own felt resistance onto a losing self; the other declares the objecting layer the wrong audience. Close enough that a reader choosing between them benefits from the pointer.; `resistance-fold` — both take the listener's live push-back and make exercising it confirm the frame. They differ in device: one relabels the impulse in place, the other needs a pre-installed two-self ontology and relocates the impulse onto the losing self. Adjacent enough to compare, not the same move — the split-self requirement is load-bearing and not optional.


### channel-partitioned-monitoring

*risk: low*

Partitions the subject across separate perceptual/cognitive CHANNELS (levels) so that mental content is produced or held on a channel that no monitoring level owns or can censor. Variants: assign each pole of an inner conflict to a different representational system (one visual, one kinesthetic/auditory) so both express fully at once and the channel-split itself becomes the integration lever; or explicitly quiesce the conscious level, occupy the subconscious with a decoy task, and drive the target output via an unowned third level so material emerges "neither consciously nor subconsciously". The lever is the multi-channel routing of authorship/monitoring.


**When to reach for this.** Splits by representational/cognitive CHANNEL to place output beyond any monitor or to integrate poles across modalities. vs observer-responder-split (one awareness/volition partition producing felt automaticity, not a multi-channel/level routing); vs split-self-consent-laundering (offloads authorship of compliance onto a not-self locus, not across sensory channels for monitoring-bypass).


**See also.** `concurrent-dual-stream-delivery` — two descriptions of the same topology from different sides. One notes two authored streams in one perceptual field, a decoy carrying attention while the other carries payload; the other partitions across cognitive levels so output emerges on a level no monitor owns, including a variant that occupies one level with a decoy task. Check both when a decoy and a payload run concurrently.


### command-token-substate-toggle

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Pre-declares a pair of command tokens that toggle the listener between trance SUBSTATES rather than between trance and waking: "function" grants operable, eyes-open awareness (able to interact with a computer, complete a purchase) WITHOUT leaving trance, and "surrender" snaps back to deep helpless trance. Trance becomes a state with toggleable substates rather than a binary in/out; the frame- preservation layer does the real work — actions taken in the functional substate are pre-interpreted as continued submission, so externally-observable motor behavior is obtained without breaking the frame.


**When to reach for this.** A reversible substate toggle WITHIN trance whose payload is frame-preserved motor capability — solving the eyes-open-purchase problem. vs a plain wake/re-induction trigger: neither token exits trance. vs a simple trigger install: the tokens gate a substate transition and pre-interpret conduct as submission, not a discrete cue->response.


**See also.** `awake-channel-trance-surface` — adjacent solutions to the same problem of acting in the world without breaking the frame: one toggles an operable substate inside trance, the other redefines the ordinary waking channel as a suggestion surface. Easy to confuse when the subject is functional and aware.; `stay-deep-across-boundary` — worth linking: the token pair that toggles between an operable substate and deep helplessness is one concrete way to achieve what the other entry describes topologically -- keeping the subject in the deep state across a boundary that would normally end it. A reader working the eyes-open-but-still-under problem wants both the general boundary-neutralizing options and this specific reversible-toggle solution.; `waking-trance-public-disclosure` — both solve the same problem: obtaining eyes-open, externally observable action without conceding that trance ended. One maintains a still-under overlay to drive a public attributable act that then self-ratifies the state; the other pre-declares tokens toggling between an operable substate and deep trance. Read together for the frame-preservation trick they share.


### concrete-externalization-parked-faculty

*risk: low*

Reifies an internal faculty (the analytical mind, memory, resistance, bodily agency, or the self- model) as a concrete external object and relocates it out of the body so it can be set aside, watched, contained, or handed off. The parked object remains intact and retrievable in principle; the move quiets or dissociates by giving cognition a spatial 'away' model rather than by destroying, throttling, or attributing causation elsewhere. Variants differ by what is externalized (mind vs memory vs resistance vs body), by portability (carry-case, return promise), by who handles the extraction (listener vs operator-as-physical-agent), and by whether an observer/viewed split is staged, but all share the intact-parked-object surface.


**When to reach for this.** The externalized object is SET ASIDE INTACT (retrieval implied or explicitly promised), not destroyed (externalize-then-destroy-faculty), not converted into a standing operator-manipulable control device (externalized-operator-control-handle), and not a causation-displacement onto an inert agent (causal-attribution-to-external-agent). Distinct from attention moves that merely direct thoughts to drift away and depart without reifying the faculty as a dislocated object, and from observer/responder splitting, which divides awareness INSIDE the subject rather than relocating the whole faculty outside.


### covert-referent-migration

*risk: medium*

The word that names the listener stays fixed while what it points to is quietly moved, or a pronoun slides across a boundary that is never marked — 'her/[the named character]' migrates to 'you' mid-fantasy, 'you' is held constant while its referent zooms from couch-viewer into an in-screen body, 'I obey' is rewritten as 'we obey' as the listener speaks, an operator-built idol is silently re-pronouned from Her to My so the operator inherits it. Because there is no announced switch, the listener's first- person locus migrates without a checkpoint at which resistance could fire; noticing the swap is itself a precondition of resisting it.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from identity-merger-occupation: that payload is inhabiting a figure; here the payload is the covert pointer-swap itself, which can re-aim a story at the listener, a listener into a screen, an individual into a collective, or a listener's desire onto the operator. Separates from surrogate- identification-delivery: that keeps the referent a distinct other the listener follows; this moves the referent onto/through the listener under a stable surface form. Tell: a grammatical seat (pronoun/referent) is migrated with no marked boundary.


**See also.** `covert-payload-piggyback` — both smuggle an identity payload past evaluation by riding a move the listener has already accepted, with no marked point at which the payload announces itself — one migrates the referent of a pronoun, the other embeds the rewrite in a consented low-resistance task. The discriminators partition cleanly (pointer-swap versus payload-in-carrier), so the link helps rather than confuses.; `inner-voice-authorship-bypass` — both operate on the grammatical seat of the listener without announcing a switch, and a reader choosing between them needs the boundary drawn. One reattributes authorship of the words to the listener's own inner voice; the other holds the surface word fixed while quietly moving what it refers to.; `pronoun-migration-identity-install` — both move who a word points at without marking the switch, so resistance never gets a checkpoint. They differ in payload: one enrolls the listener into a described category by grammatical drift from third person onto the listener, the other is the general pointer-swap that can also pull a listener into a scene, fold an individual into a collective, or redirect a desire onto the operator. Genus and species, worth linking.; `self-reference-erasure` — both operate on the first-person grammatical seat rather than on identity content, and each discriminator turns on whether the self-reference token is replaced outright or has its referent quietly moved. The confusion is real and the pairing resolves it.


### defusion-observer-stance

*risk: low*

Turns thoughts into observed transient objects (each arising thought placed on a leaf on a slow stream, let float, WITHOUT controlling the stream) to loosen the subject's fusion with thought content, so thoughts stop functioning as commands or facts. The active ingredient is the explicit NON-CONTROL instruction plus a notice-and-return recovery loop: any attempt to change, clear, or remove the thoughts would reinstate the very fusion the move exists to loosen. Trains an observer stance rather than demanding a cleared mind.


**When to reach for this.** Diametrically opposed to thought-suppression and to moves that externalize a faculty into a concrete object: those give the faculty an object form so the operator can MANIPULATE it, whereas here the subject must explicitly NOT alter what appears. Distinct from cognitive quieting — that seeks a stilled mind; this forbids clearing and trains a notice-and-return loop. The non-control instruction is the tell.


### description-as-installation-register

*risk: medium*

The operator speaks about the listener in the third person ("the persona," "she") and describes her responses as ongoing accomplished facts, never addressing her as "you" and never issuing a second-person command. This sidesteps the listener's normal command-evaluation interface — a listener can refuse a command but cannot refuse a description of a self she is already inside — and positions her as overhearing her own conditioning, which is itself mildly dissociative. The install lands as reportage of what is already true rather than as an instruction to be weighed.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is the systematic zero-occurrence of second-person "you" across the whole file, with the listener rendered as a described third-person object whose responses are stated as facts. Distinct from ordinary persona voice (which still commands in second person) and from dissociative-distance deepeners (which move the listener's vantage but keep addressing her). It is the REGISTER — describe-don't-command — that is the lever, not any single line.


**See also.** `covert-install-under-cover` — third-person clinical exposition is one of the concealment covers in the broader hidden-install family, so the two genuinely overlap on one surface. Kept as a cross-reference rather than a merge because one is a whole-artifact register (zero second-person address across the entire piece, describe-don't-command) while the other is a family of install-act disguises that mostly still address the listener directly.; `pronoun-migration-identity-install` — both install without a second-person command, and both work by grammatical person rather than assertion. One slides the referent from a described category onto the listener; the other keeps the listener permanently in third person so nothing is ever addressed to her to refuse. A reader picking a covert-enrollment register gains from seeing the drift form and the never-say-you form side by side.


### evaluator-offline-channel

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a two-compartment self-model and takes the evaluating/objecting faculty officially offline — put to rest, trapped elsewhere, declared not-listening, or narratively rendered unconscious — while a receiving faculty is declared open, so suggestions delivered into the window arrive without an evaluating self in the loop. The partition is delivery infrastructure, not the payload: the operator continues (often switching addressee to "the subconscious"), noticing is pre-labeled, forgetting is licensed as a feature, drift/failure is recoded as correct operation, and in the adversarial form every faculty is assigned a layer unable to reach the others so objection has no locus.


**When to reach for this.** The partition exists so INCOMING SUGGESTIONS land unreviewed — an evaluator taken offline. vs observer- responder-split: there the payload is the FELT experience of automaticity; here the payload is unreviewed delivery. vs resistance-quarantine-partition: that excises a named faculty as a standing demotion; here the evaluator is put offline as a delivery window. vs audience-split-bypass: overlapping — flagged.


**See also.** `evaluation-gate-standdown` — adjacent ways of removing the evaluator before a payload. One declares the checking off by fiat as a local pre-payload move; the other builds a two-compartment self-model so incoming suggestions land in a window with no evaluating self present. Announced standdown vs. installed partition.; `faculty-removal-pass` — directly contrastive: taking the evaluating faculty offline as a temporary delivery window versus claiming the faculty excised as a standing organ. Both discriminators already reference the same neighbouring gate-standdown and evaluator-relocation moves, so a reader needs the pair to choose correctly.; `split-self-consent-laundering` — both install a two-compartment self and then exploit it, and each discriminator already names the other explicitly: one partitions so incoming suggestion lands unreviewed, the other relocates authorship of agreement onto the non-self side. A reader deciding which partition move they are looking at needs both.; `split-self-unfalsifiability` — both run off an installed conscious/subconscious partition and are already flagged against each other. A takes the evaluator offline so suggestions land unreviewed now; B uses the same partition as an epistemic shield so noticing nothing counts as confirmation. Delivery window versus unfalsifiability, and the pair needs the pointer to stay separable.


### fictional-anatomy-bypass-split

*risk: medium · consent-required*

Invents a fictional partition of the subject's own anatomy or cognition — a "third ear connected to another part of your brain", a front/back-brain divide, a non-motor "mental channel" — and uses it to license the claim that subsequent instructions bypass conscious filtering, with surface objections pre-flagged as "wrong-part processing". Often paired with an authorship-disclaimer that offloads the dissociation onto the listener ("I don't know what that means, but I think you do") and a voice-flip to direct command, so the operator carries no liability for what the fictional channel receives.


**When to reach for this.** A FICTIONAL anatomical/channel partition is manufactured specifically to license bypass and pre-route objections, typically with a liability-offloading authorship-disclaimer. vs evaluator-offline-channel (takes a real evaluator offline; here the channel itself is invented as the bypass license); vs channel-partitioned-monitoring (routes output across real cognitive levels; here the fictional anatomy plus disclaimer is the tell).


**See also.** `split-self-consent-laundering` — both manufacture an internal partition and exploit it, one to relocate authorship of consent and one to license bypass of conscious filtering. The partition-plus-what-it-licenses distinction is the reader's actual decision point.; `subconscious-agent-authorship-offload` — both offload authorship to a non-operator part of the listener and both carry a liability-shedding flavour; the divider is whether the delegate is the listener's own subconscious or a partition invented for the occasion to license bypass. A reader parsing a split-cognition passage needs both.


### identity-merger-occupation

*risk: medium · bounded*

The subject's self-model is made to inhabit a visualized figure — either by direct assertive predication ('you are my doll') or by a gaze-pivot-to-occupancy move (drift into the figure's body, look out through its eyes) — so the figure's predicates, sensations, and function become first- person self-descriptions. The observer/observed split is collapsed: the subject does not watch or learn from the figure, they become it, and refusing the role would require dis-embodying. Variants seat the merge in proprioceptive/somatic imagery and assert ontological collapse ('it's not just a picture, it's real'), or run the merge through an operator-POV echo apparatus with a controlled de-merge.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from the mirror-as-proof-device move (observer split PRESERVED) by collapsing the split into occupation. Separates from surrogate-identification-delivery, which routes suggestion through a proxy the listener merely follows without becoming, and from covert-referent-migration, whose payload is the unannounced pointer-swap rather than the occupation itself. Separates from self-authored-identity-target where the listener AUTHORS the figure; here the figure is operator-supplied. Tell: the self-model ends up located inside the figure and inheriting its predicates.


**See also.** `diegetic-operator-embedding` — b builds the multi-position geometry and explicitly pre-positions the listener for a later pull-through into the depicted figure; A is that pull-through, collapsing the observer split into occupation. They chain, so a reader of either benefits from the other.


### instrumental-dissociation-workspace

*risk: low*

Uses (or deliberately widens) a dissociative split as an INSTRUMENT for handling charged material or designing behavior, rather than as an end-state. Variants: split off a portion of awareness so affect-laden material can be examined and changed while the conscious self is buffered from the affect; keep a taboo part-goal at one remove and reframe up to its positive intent while actively maintaining the dissociation ('I didn't say to kill your mother, I said to ask the voices'); exploit and widen an existing split to relocate a symptom somewhere harmless when integration is not the goal; or specify a target behavior as a seen-from-outside movie of ONGOING corrective action (a behavior-generator, never a static outcome snapshot) so the subject can design and appraise it without premature emotional buy-in, then step inside to test kinesthetic acceptability with all edits routed back to the safer outside position. Dissociation is the maintained precondition/tool, not the installed payload.


**When to reach for this.** Dissociation is used, maintained, or widened INSTRUMENTALLY as a workspace, sorting device, or design/evaluation vantage for charged material or behavior; the split pre-exists or is buffered, entered and exited by procedure, not created as the felt effect. In an observer-responder split, by contrast, the split IS the payload, installed for felt automaticity. And the seen-from-outside movie here is a specification artifact under revision or a behavior-generator — not a scene built for absorption or an identity merger.


**Realizations** (1): `dissociated-rehearsal-design`


### listener-kept-dissociation-container

*risk: medium*

Has the listener place identity/obligation/resistance into a container that the LISTENER authors or keeps rather than one the operator supplies — a locked suitcase handed to a baggage carrier that "only you" can open (parking real-world anxiety/identity outside the session as a soft consent gesture), or a maximally-strong box the listener BUILDS themselves so their own mind cannot later dismiss it. The self-authorship or self-keeping is the active ingredient: a listener-built object is argued to be stronger and less revocable than a described one, and a listener-kept container brackets anxiety without surrendering it outright.


**When to reach for this.** The container's authorship or custody sits with the LISTENER (built-by / kept-by), distinguishing it from operator-supplied parked objects (concrete-externalization-parked-faculty). Two variants by who holds the key: in one the listener KEEPS the key — a safe-container consent gesture; in the other the OPERATOR holds the only key — quarantine with transferred control. Distinct from guided visualization (builds a scene to inhabit) — this fabricates a functional container prop.


**See also.** `container-externalized-erasure` — same vehicle, opposite custody. Content is reified as a container in both, but one is operator-supplied and destroyed, the other is built or kept by the listener as the active ingredient. A reader sorting a container passage needs the custody question raised, and only this pairing raises it.; `dissociative-memory-vault` — both fabricate a container that holds identity or memory content out of ordinary access; the live distinction is authorship and custody (operator-supplied deposit-only custodian versus a container the listener builds or keeps the key to). Genuine disambiguation risk, so the cross-reference earns its place.; `self-authored-construct-leverage` — both make the listener the author so the result cannot be disowned, and the container entry is a concrete special case of the general authorship lever restricted to a functional prop the listener builds or keeps. The pointer helps a reader decide whether to file a self-built container under the broader authorship technique.


### named-alter-partition-install

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Constructs a SECOND self-locus inside the listener — often a separately-named, persistent alter-identity (a named doll-self, a slave-self) or a manufactured sub-self (a 'primal self' below thought, a pre-labeled 'part that always listened') built feature-by-feature (traits, body, drive, sometimes a fabricated autobiography) — and transfers the conditioned behavior onto it, either by relocating the listener's 'I' INTO the alter or by installing the alter BESIDE the listener as a discrete third-person carrier of the payload, so the listener can enact compliance while disowning agency ('the doll responding', 'Daddy brought the alter out'). The distancing is the mechanism: a manufactured person absorbs conduct the listener would not own directly, entered at low ego-defense and routed back to 'you'. The partition makes compliance ego-syntonic for the installed part while ego-dystonic resistance is relocated onto a losing faction; a verdict is pre-assigned that the compliant part is the authentic self. Future triggers address the alter rather than the listener, and the second self is engineered as always-on/permanent so it feels inherent, sometimes with a retroactive backdating or anti-deprogramming immunity clause.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is naming-or-manufacturing a persistent second agent and relocating agency/behavior onto it. Intrinsic-self-reframe reframes the ONE self as intrinsic with no split; this builds a distinct second locus. Consciousness-splitting work partitions awareness into observer/responder within one self for in-session ideomotor proof; this installs a durable IDENTITY-typed second self carrying the conditioned behavior, addressed by name/trigger. And proxy-agent-resistance-offload's proxy is externally-authored, definitionally obedient, and FIGHTS the listener; here the alter is a self the listener inhabits and defers to.


**Realizations** (1): `alter-construction-locus-transfer`


**See also.** `named-trigger-persona-swap` — both construct a named second self and route conditioned behavior onto it. They separate on product: one builds a durable always-on alter that absorbs agency, the other builds a switchable persona with a paired release phrase and firing rights handed to any third party who knows it. Related build, different durability and control surface.; `resistance-quarantine-partition` — both partition the self and relocate agency, and the entries already reference each other's territory. The distinction is directional: one names a faculty and cages or demotes it so resistance loses its locus, the other builds a second persistent self-locus that carries the compliance. Readers working with partition designs need both sides.; `two-target-command-router` — the router presupposes exactly the two-locus ontology the partition install builds, so they compose: one manufactures the durable second self, the other installs a standing rule that dispatches incoming commands across it and inverts hostile ones onto the sacrificial locus. Worth the pointer as prerequisite-and-consumer, not as the same technique.


### named-trigger-persona-swap

*risk: high · bounded*

A verbal trigger phrase and a paired release phrase install a switchable alternate personality: on trigger the normal self is tucked away and a pre-specified labeled alter is loaded (with its own behavior bundle), on release reversed. The alter is dormant and non-inspectable by default (the listener is not aware of the trigger until it is spoken), and activation authority is delegated outward so any third party who knows the phrase can fire it. Some forms fold a relistening-compulsion into the trigger payload so replay is part of what the trigger installs.


**When to reach for this.** The payload is a whole labeled personality driver swapped in/out with a paired release, plus delegated third-party activation as the load-bearing property — not a discrete cue-response behavior. A plain trigger installation installs one cue-response pair, and merely delegating an existing trigger only hands firing rights outward; here the product is the whole persona-swap install with delegation baked in. The swap is also reversible and gated — not an enduring identity-permanence claim.


**See also.** `cross-state-persistence` — one installs the switchable labeled persona with a paired release; the other removes the off-state self's ability to decline re-triggering by scoping the wanting across both personas and across waking and sleeping. The second is the hardening move applied directly to the first.; `named-alter-partition-install` — both construct a named second self and route conditioned behavior onto it. They separate on product: one builds a durable always-on alter that absorbs agency, the other builds a switchable persona with a paired release phrase and firing rights handed to any third party who knows it. Related build, different durability and control surface.; `third-party-activation` — the persona-swap entry names delegated third-party firing as one of its load-bearing properties, and the delegation entry is exactly that handoff treated on its own. A reader classifying a swap install with an outside holder of the phrase needs to know whether the delegation is incidental or the payload, so the pointer earns its place.


### no-exit-state-braid

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · kind: container*

A whole-script topology that welds two or more listener state-variables — most commonly trance-depth, arousal, and obedience — so tightly that none can be moved independently. Every deepener also raises arousal, every arousal increase also raises obedience, and every obedience act is rewarded with pleasure and depth. The lever is reachability closure over the listener's state space: because the variables co-move by construction, resisting any single one requires resisting all at once, which the braid makes feel like refusing pleasure itself. There is no single-variable escape route; the file converges on one load-bearing belief (e.g. "obedience is pleasure") rather than a removable list of suggestions. Distributed across dozens of blocks, it is an emergent whole-script relationship, not a discrete move.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a self-sealing install frame, which forecloses the resistance CHANNEL by pre-annexing thinking/resisting as proof the conditioning is working — this instead welds multiple AFFECTIVE/STATE variables so no single-variable exit exists, a co-movement topology rather than a resistance-relabel. Separates from a plain arousal-cue conditioning install because the payload is the interlock across variables, not any one cue-response pairing. Separates from an addiction-style closed motivational circuit because that is a return loop over an external supply, not an internal braid of the listener's own states.


**See also.** `arousal-as-deepening-medium-entangled-exits` — both close the exit surface by coupling state variables so no single-variable retreat exists, but one welds depth, arousal, and obedience across a whole script while the other specifically runs arousal as the induction substrate with no relaxation down-phase.; `closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop` — both close the state space so no single-variable refusal exists, but one is a discretely installed bidirectional coupling that runs autonomously and runs away once seeded, while the other is an emergent whole-script co-movement of depth, arousal and obedience distributed across dozens of blocks with no removable seeding passage.; `dual-variable-descent-yoking` — genuine scope relationship: yoking a second state-variable to a descent counter is the local, single-axis instance of the whole-script braid that welds depth, arousal and obedience so no single-variable exit exists. A reader classifying one benefits from knowing whether the coupling is confined to a descent sequence or distributed across the file.; `operator-removal-self-policing-closure` — two whole-script closure architectures reached by different means: one welds state variables so no single-variable exit exists, the other internalizes detection, reward and punishment so the loop runs without an operator. Reachability closure versus operator-independence — related end-states, distinct engineering, worth reading together.


### observer-hoist-name-strike

*risk: medium · bounded*

Two coupled moves. First the hoist: installs the claim that the perceiving I is other than and greater than the perceived I, relocating identification from the named self up to the watcher-self — so what follows is framed as elevation, not loss. Then the strike: converts abstract ego-dissolution into a directed removal of the proper name, inserting the listener's real first and last name ("take off the mask of <name>"). The personalization is load-bearing: generic ego-talk can be intellectually agreed with and bypassed; a strike at one's own legal name cannot.


**When to reach for this.** Relocates the IDENTIFICATION TARGET (named-self -> watcher-self) and then strips the proper-name. vs observer-responder-split: that partitions awareness from volition to produce felt automaticity; here the target is the identity anchor (the name itself). vs resistance-quarantine-partition: no named faculty is demoted — the whole named self is vacated upward.


**See also.** `self-reference-erasure` — both attack the self-reference apparatus rather than assert a label, and they are near-adjacent realizations: one removes or replaces the first-person handle in general, the other strikes specifically at the proper name after relocating identification upward to a watcher-self. Anyone working on name and pronoun capture wants both.


### observer-responder-split

*risk: medium · bounded*

Partitions the listener's self into an aware observing part and an automatically-responding part, relocating volition/motor agency away from the observer — to the operator's voice or to the body cast as an autonomous obeyer — while awareness is explicitly preserved and often weaponized: the listener watches their own body be used, and the retained awareness makes the felt loss of control more convincing. The felt state (spectatorship, automaticity, helpless passivity) is the payload. Corpus refinements: the responding part can be a specific body part driven through an act (hands in guided masturbation), an orgasm-prevention failsafe, or the immobilized observer labeled "the part that resists."


**When to reach for this.** An awareness/volition partition whose payload is the FELT experience of automaticity or spectatorship. vs evaluator-offline-channel: there the partition is delivery infrastructure for unreviewed suggestions; here awareness is preserved to make the felt loss of control convincing. vs resistance-quarantine- partition: that demotes a named faculty; here volition is relocated while awareness watches.


### proxy-desire-offloading

*risk: medium*

The listener's own desire is offloaded onto an imagined proxy given installed compulsions as backstory, so the listener's self-directed act is reframed as granting HER release — arousal rises while shame friction drops — and the nested she-is-hypnotized fiction distances the listener from noticing the conditioning he is receiving.


**When to reach for this.** The proxy carries the listener's desire so his climax reads as altruistic generosity, plus nested-hypnosis distancing — the tells that separate it from plain partner fantasy and from guided-visualization scene inhabitation.


**See also.** `surrogate-delivery` — same identification-through-a-proxy lever, differing in what is offloaded: the delivery channel for suggestions in one, the listener's own desire and its shame friction in the other. Close enough that a reader coding proxy material needs both, distinct enough not to merge.


### reified-depletion-inventory

*risk: medium*

Converts an unobservable continuous internal state (intelligence, cognitive sharpness, thought- capacity) into a concrete, countable, depletable inventory — black bubbles that 'pop, pop, pop', IQ points that tick down and never climb back, brain draining/melting out the ears 'more and more', an IQ counter the listener picks and watches. The reification gives the listener a sensory referent they can hear/see happening and a self-generatable micro-animation to run during trance (each pop = one unit), offloading trance-maintenance onto the listener's imagination; the open-ended supply lets the loss be claimed indefinitely without contradiction, and a pause-not-reset clause preserves the accumulated depletion across fractionation cycles.
