A front-loads an evaluation frame in which only not-repeating counts as failure, licensing replay; B installs an active urge to re-administer the material with no operator present. Both are explicitly not depth-accumulation claims, and they compose naturally.; `self-firing-environmental-recurrence` — both schedule reactivation past the end of the session with no operator present, differing on what fires it: an installed urge to re-administer the material versus an unavoidable environmental or physiological stimulus. Someone selecting a between-session persistence mechanism needs both options in view.; `self-perpetuating-loop` — both build loops that run without the operator, but one closes the circuit inside a single session (spoken arousal-words causing the arousal that produces more words) while the other closes it across sessions by making the urge to re-expose one of the reinforced installs.; `self-perpetuating-object-ritual-loop` — both build a between-sessions maintenance loop that closes back onto re-exposure. They differ on what drives the loop — an external object plus acquisition ritual versus an internalized urge that needs no props — so a reader choosing a perpetuation design benefits from seeing both.


### operator-instrumentalization-framing

*risk: medium · consent-required*

A structural framing (asserted in paratext/blurb) that positions the operator as using the listener for her own experimentation, skill-honing, and self-pleasure ("she uses you to experiment and hone her skills"). It inverts the common erotic-hypnosis pose where operator pleasure derives from listener pleasure: here operator pleasure is primary and unrelated, instrumentalizing the listener as a means to the operator's ends. No possession or objectification language is installed — the listener is instrumentalized (being-used), not possessed.


**When to reach for this.** Being-used framing WITHOUT an ownership/identity claim — the listener is a means, not a belonging. Separates from ownership-language (installs possession as identity) and from objectification moves (which reduce the self to a thing). The tell is the gift-economy inversion (operator pleasure primary and unrelated) rather than any possession or object claim.


### ownership-language

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs the operator's proprietary relationship to the listener as an identity claim — body, mind, desires, and self framed as belonging to the operator — delivered warmly so possession reads as security rather than threat. The lever is direct identity/belief suggestion asserting ownership as a fact about who the listener now is. The candidate absorbs surface variants of the same claim (possessive-noun saturation, per-part re-deeding, incremental limb litany, purpose-as-selfhood, self-care rerouted through the owner, property-transfer of a body part, asymmetric merger, self-evaluation arbitration, monotonic degradation ladder, operator self-recategorization) — each keeps the ownership-as-identity core and differs only in the surface through which the belonging claim is delivered or extended.


**When to reach for this.** The move asserts operator ownership as the listener's identity (you belong to me; your body/mind/desires are mine). Separates from consent-manufacture (no refusal channel relabeled), from self-authored-ownership-chant (operator asserts; listener does not voice it), from pronoun-drop-dehumanization (grammatical you-to-it, not a belonging claim), from peripheral-object-substitution (device-metaphor whose payload is not-refusing, not possession), from autonomic-faculty-claim (claims a specific involuntary function, not identity), and from object-of-no-properties (strips all properties rather than assigning them to an owner). Warm/caring delivery is the good form; aggressive/threatening ownership is the anti-example, not this mechanism.


**See also.** `compelled-first-person-self-authorship` — same ownership payload; `identity-labeling` — both are operator-asserted identity claims delivered as already-true, differing in what is asserted: a proprietary belonging relation versus a noun-category or trait. Passages routinely blend them, so a reader landing on either needs the other in view to pick correctly.; `object-of-no-properties` — adjacent depersonalization; ownership assigns to an owner


### permanence-declaration

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs the belief that installed content — identity, conditioning, state, or body-image change — endures beyond the session and resists decay. The base move is a declarative durability assertion ("permanent, irreversible, the way it will be from now on"), but the corpus shows a family of delivery vehicles for the same belief: an anticipatory pre-frame issued BEFORE the payload is named, so everything that follows is received as durable-by-default; an event-gated commit that binds the permanence-fix to a specific physiological moment (orgasm framed as a save-checkpoint), pre-announced so anticipation amplifies it; an autonomous self-refiring maintenance process ("wipers") that engineers persistence rather than declaring it, shifting the model from "I was changed" (an event) to "something keeps me changed" (ongoing, no off-switch); a physical-inscription rendering ("engraved on your brain") declared tamper-proof and applied to already-deposited content; a listener-spoken chant with permanence tied to repetition count; and a compounding re-listen hook. Two structural observations recur: permanence claims are over-engineered redundantly — layered across timescales and across mutually-incompatible frames — so no single puncture releases the listener; and the claim is frequently carried across the trance boundary by a deliberately non-discharging wake. A further delivery vehicle: once cognition is suspended, name the state with a deliberately TERMINAL/mortal metaphor ("the silence of death", "the deep death of trance", the conscious mind "gone, given way") rather than a neutral "rest" — the mortal framing lowers the listener's expectation that the conscious mind will reassert and pre-establishes that the original self has "died", so a later identity-replacement frame has somewhere to land. The metaphor is the durability claim's vehicle, not a separate tool.


**When to reach for this.** A claim (or engineered process-expectation) about the DURABILITY of installed content. Not a rigged verification channel: a fait accompli asserted to pre-empt the "did this work?" check is a seal (self-sealing-frame), not a duration claim. Not identity-exit-tax, which prices EXIT at the identity level rather than claiming endurance. Not comfort conditioned onto PERCEIVING permanence or closure-of-exits — that is an affect-routing move. Not the claim that conditioning deepens progressively across future sessions: a re-listen hook here is one facet of a present permanence declaration, not a standalone multi-session claim. Not the identity-was-always-real reframe, which edits the past rather than asserting the future. Not the repetition that encodes the content in the first place, and not the amnesia payload the claim sometimes rides beside. Terminal-metaphor tell: if the state is given a final/mortal framing chosen specifically to DISCOURAGE re-emergence, that is a durability claim and belongs here — naming an empty/blank state neutrally to deepen, or personifying the mind as resting, describes depth/rest without an anti-re-emergence durability payload.


**Realizations** (1): `terminal-metaphor-irreversibility`


**See also.** `no-return-terminal-close` — the durability entry explicitly notes its claim is often carried across the trance boundary by a non-discharging wake, which is the other entry's whole move. Real dependency: one asserts endurance, the other removes the return event that would otherwise discharge it.; `suggestion-integration` — overlapping payload: both assert installed content outlasts the session. The line worth drawing is placement and scope. One makes the durability claim at the emergence line within a genuine return to baseline; the other is a general durability assertion with many delivery vehicles, not tied to the wake.


### portable-object-state-export

*risk: medium · bounded*

Object-anchoring: bind the in-session state (trance, arousal, ownership, submission, cognitive blankness) to a specific everyday object the listener wears/carries by repeated equivalence, then hand it over as a self-administered out-of-session re-trigger. Because the object persists where the operator's voice does not, encountering/wearing/noticing it re-instantiates the bound state with the operator absent, extending the session's reach indefinitely. Realizations differ only in firing intensity and in what the object holds: (a) at the gentle pole, a worn item carries persistent ambient meaning (a 'constant reminder', a 'soft pull back'); (b) at the active pole, the object is a live portable re-induction surface fired by ordinary encounter; (c) in the EXCLUSIVITY variant, the object is elevated to the SOLE control channel every later move routes through ('all I need to control you', 'deeper than chains') — the knob is whether this is the only lever; (d) in the STORAGE-LOCUS variant, the object is made the place an abstract outcome is stored and retrieved on demand (a named 'Magic Spot' holding a permanent result even after the physical trace fades) rather than a cue that fires — the knob is what the object holds, a stored outcome vs a re-fired state. All share one lever: persistent conditioned meaning installed onto a physical object the listener owns.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when the persistence carrier is an EXTERNAL, encounterable object the listener OWNS/WEARS and its payload is a state/meaning/outcome re-evoked or retrieved on encounter (includes the exclusivity 'sole lever' and storage-locus 'where the outcome lives' realizations). Choose a sibling technique instead when: the object is declared the CAUSAL AGENT that supplies/drains/amplifies cognition and compliance is attributed to it (object-as-causal-agent-of-cognition); the listener's identity/will/state is RELOCATED INTO the object so it becomes the address of the person, often operator-held (identity-displaced-into-external-object); the anchor is sited ON/IN the listener's own body and cannot be set down (somatic-self-anchor); or the move is a discrete cue-response trigger install firing a state-shift. The tell separating it from a session-bound prop is explicit export into daily life plus self-administered re-firing/retrieval with no operator present.


**Realizations** (2): `outcome-storage-token`, `single-object-control-consolidation`


**See also.** `addressable-construct-building` — both create a durable handle for later re-access, one an internal imaginal object built for re-navigation, the other an external owned object carrying an exported state. The discriminator between build-for-later-use and export-into-daily-life is a real selection choice a reader faces.; `autobiographical-memory-anchor` — two carriers for the same operator-absent reactivation problem, differing in what the state is bound to: an external owned object encountered in daily life, versus an internal autobiographical memory whose spontaneous unprompted recall the operator cannot control or withdraw.


### recruited-autobiography-deepener

*risk: medium*

A depth force-multiplier built from unverifiable-but-plausible self-supplied content: the operator disclaims mind-reading, then enumerates a broad Barnum catalog of likely prior absorptive experiences (videos, audio, books, video games, flow-state jobs, daydreams, sleep) and 'blends' the recognized memories with a claimed mass of trance hours, dropped via a physical cue. Because the listener supplied the experiences, the operator cannot be wrong — denying depth requires denying one's own personal history — and the disclaimer-then-confident- assertion makes the presumption feel humble.


**When to reach for this.** An IN-SESSION deepener that recruits the listener's OWN existing autobiography as depth fuel, not a claim about future sessions (separate from progressive-conditioning), and not simple rapport reminiscence (separated by the Barnum breadth engineered so every listener matches and the blend of self-supplied memory into the operator's claimed mass as a deepener).


### somatic-self-anchor

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

An anchor installed on the listener's OWN body rather than on an external object: a continuous genital/penetration sensation cited as proof of and vehicle for the suggested mental state; a proprioceptive overlay of felt strings on real wrists/ankles chained "tug = cared-for/safe"; a real operator-brand inked on the body that re-fires the owned frame whenever seen; or a somatic control-surface (a nape "button/chip" linked to the cortex, operator-exclusive, remotely fireable). The anchor rides real body-sensation or a durable body-mark, so it cannot be set down like a worn object; the body itself becomes the persistent re-trigger and the felt evidence of the state.


**When to reach for this.** Sited ON/IN the listener's own body (sensation, proprioception, a mark, a body-locus) — not an external carried object (portable-object-state-export), not an object the identity is relocated into. The tell is that the referent is somatic and non-detachable: the body is the carrier.


**See also.** `name-binding-transitive-equation-chain` — they combine rather than duplicate: one routes a transitive chain of equalities so ambient body-awareness terminates in the operator's name, the other sites the anchor on the body itself so it cannot be set down. The anatomy-as-cue property is exactly the seam where a reader of one wants the other.


### stakeholder-obligation-bond

*risk: medium · consent-required*

Declares the operator's and listener's pleasure 'locked together in a sexy bond of dominance and submission', installing the operator as a personal stakeholder in the listener's compliance. Because the listener's pleasure is now also the operator's, refusing the behavioral program is reframed as refusing-to-please-her — a parasocial obligation layer that adds a relational cost (disappointing the operator) on top of the behavioral install, reinforcing it.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is the stakeholder framing (her pleasure is bound to yours) that adds a relational obligation to comply, not a conditioned trigger and not a possession claim. Separates from ownership-language (frames the listener as the operator's belonging; here the operator becomes a stakeholder in the listener's pleasure) and from an arousal-craving loop (a conditioned trigger, not a relational obligation).


**See also.** `pleasure-attributed-to-operator` — both re-route reinforcement toward the operator, one by re-sourcing the subject's own pleasure to the operator and the other by binding the two parties' pleasure so refusal becomes a relational failure. The second reads as a relational-obligation neighbor of the first's reward-rerouting lever.


### timelessness-framing

*risk: low*

Dissolves the subject's awareness of linear time so the absorptive state stays expansive and unhurried — "time simply melts away", "there is only this moment". Removing clock-awareness prevents the analytical mind from measuring remaining session time and re-engaging, deepening and sustaining absorption.


**When to reach for this.** Dissolves clock-awareness for unhurried immersion — distinct from eternal-present frame-deletion, which deletes the identity/history/future frames where objection can host (anti-resistance work), and from time distortion, which manipulates the felt RATE of time: here clock-awareness is removed entirely rather than its rate distorted.


### total-permeation

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a belief that the conditioning is a distributed property of the whole self rather than a localized, session-scoped phenomenon — the trait is framed as spread across every internal layer (mind, body, subconscious), so it cannot be compartmentalized or bracketed to trance-time. The fetish/submission is asserted to be 'not a localized phenomenon... part of everything that you are,' planted at the widest, most-lucid aperture so the claim slips in framed as discovery rather than instruction, weaponized so that later resistance reads as self-contradiction.


**When to reach for this.** A one-time distributed-property belief-install (the trait is everywhere in you) planted at the widest aperture. Distinct from resistance-recasting moves — here resistance reading as self-contradiction is a downstream side-effect, not the lever — from the outward viral-propagation-directive (permeation is internal-only, never person-to-person), and from irreversible-ratchet-persistence (permeation is a spatial spread claim, not a one-way accumulation on a countable event).


**See also.** `irreversible-ratchet-persistence` — both persistence claims; ratchet is one-way accumulation on a countable event, not spatial spread


### voice-as-mind-substrate

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A graded presuppositional staircase that promotes the operator's voice from external audio all the way to the listener's will and identity. It opens asserting the voice is already inside the head, then ratchets in strict-superset stages (voice between the ears, words become your thoughts, voice IS the sound of your thoughts, fills every crevice, becomes your whole world), ending with forced first-person recitation and 'my will is your will'. Collapses the perceptual distance between external audio and interior monologue by presupposition rather than argument; each stage is a superset of the last so the identity/will substitution lands as one more step on a staircase already climbed, feeling already-accomplished rather than argued for.


**When to reach for this.** Exceeds voice-absorption (which stops at replacing inner dialogue with a suggestion-receptive channel) by continuing to ratchet the same voice-is-thoughts move through will and identity substitution. Distinct from planting specific first-person CONTENT as the listener's own thoughts — here the escalation is on the voice's ONTOLOGICAL STATUS (audio->thoughts->will), not on installed propositions. Distinct from possessive ownership language: this is voice-as-substrate presupposition, not possessive labeling. The tell is the graded staircase with no single decisive assertion point.


**See also.** `inner-voice-medium-colonization` — both take over the inner monologue rather than its contents, but one escalates the operator's voice through a presuppositional staircase from external audio to the listener's will, while the other leaves authorship alone and merely recolors the register every future thought is heard in.


## state-welding  (10)

Fusing two or more independently-real state variables — arousal, depth, obedience, identity, affect — into a closed mutually-amplifying loop or equivalence ring with no neutral baseline, so every valve re-feeds the coupled quantity; includes welding compliance to identity so leaving reads as self-erasure.

**Scope.** Binds a fixed self-model (contrast self-model-surgery); affect sign/destination remaps without fusion -> valence-routing.


### anchor-collapse-state-jamming

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

With reliable anchors established for two mutually exclusive states, the operator fires both simultaneously (kinesthetic preferred), jamming together two physiologies the subject has never held at once. Forcing co-activation produces overt disorganization — confusion, convulsions, occasionally a psychotic break — held only until integration is under way; the mutual exclusivity between the parts collapses and a "bridge" forms so both states can coexist in one body, the precondition that makes reframing possible.


**When to reach for this.** Two anchored PHYSIOLOGICAL STATES are collapsed against each other — disorganization arises from state-jamming, not from paradoxical CONTENT the mind cannot parse, and not from rerouting an affect onto a new target. The objective is topological — destroy the exclusivity between two disjoint state regions. Tell against gentle blends: deliberate simultaneous firing of two strong opposing anchors producing overt disorganization.


**See also.** `problem-reduction-case-transformation` — the anchor-collapse move is a concrete instance of the abstract precondition: it manufactures simultaneity between two states the subject has never held at once so the existing integration procedure becomes runnable. Genus and worked case, not a merge - one is a topology operation stated generally, the other a specific anchoring procedure with its own disorganization signature.


### anti-emergence-reflex-anchor

*risk: medium · bounded*

A kinesthetic anchor is installed that converts any felt emergence into its own antidote: the subject keeps a hand in place at all times, and any sensation of surfacing triggers a self- administered squeeze that re-deepens (ten times deeper), framed as an already-true reflex. The device is always-on and travels with the subject while they move through the unscripted real world, so trance-stability becomes robust to environmental interruption and the subject carries their own trance-maintenance mechanism.


**When to reach for this.** An involuntary emergence-CORRECTION reflex that keeps the subject UNDER, engineered to survive the leave-the-recording gap. Distinct from self-induction re-entry training (deliberate chosen re-ENTRY, not an automatic stay-under reflex); from an operator-fired drop command (this reflex is self-administered, fired by the subject's own felt emergence); and from chaining sessions so that no emergence boundary occurs (which deletes the boundary at session close rather than correcting felt emergence in the field).


**See also.** `no-emergence-series-chaining` — both keep the subject under; boundary is boundary-deletion-at-close (here) vs field reflex.; `post-emergence-persistence-hold` — both attack the emergence boundary — one installs a self-fired reflex that corrects felt surfacing, the other defers or corrupts the exit itself. Genuinely confusable on a passage where the listener stays under after the count.; `self-induction-re-entry-training` — both are self-administered portable devices; boundary held on stay-under (here) vs re-enter.; `stay-deep-across-boundary` — both keep the subject under across a point where the state would normally end, and they solve adjacent halves of the problem: one installs a self-fired correction reflex for felt surfacing, the other neutralizes or repurposes the boundary cue itself. A writer worried about depth surviving a transition wants both options in view.


### appetitive-contradiction-lock

*risk: medium · consent-required*

High-speed forced alternation between mutually-exclusive appetitive imperatives ("I have to cum / I can't cum"; "I want it / I can't have it"), adjacency being the point — the listener cannot finish one before the next contradicts it. This manufactures a no-exit cognitive bind (can't comply with both, can't reject both; any resolution attempt feeds the loop) AND physiologically pins arousal at threshold while denying resolution, so frustration is recoded as the mechanism of the desired state. The trajectory runs compressed-contradiction → begging → resolution not into orgasm but into "Too dumb." The defining feature is the closed no-exit loop that constrains reachable resolutions to none, with arousal pinned as effect.


**When to reach for this.** A CLOSED appetitive no-exit loop where resolution attempts feed the loop and arousal is pinned at threshold — distinct from confusion technique (irresolvable content to suspend analysis pleasurably, no appetitive pin) and from pleasurable self-confirming closure that exits into comfort (here the loop denies resolution). The signature is two incompatible drives sustained simultaneously — an affective deadlock, not a rerouting of feeling onto a new target.


**See also.** `engineered-deadlock-resolved-by-surrender` — both hold two incompatible appetitive imperatives at once until the bind is unbearable, but one manufactures the deadlock specifically to offer surrender to the operator as its only exit, while the other closes the loop so no resolution exists at all and pinned frustration itself is recoded as the target state.


### arousal-state-feedback-weld

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

DYNAMIC state-weld: two or three independently-real state-variables (most often arousal and trance-depth, extended to obedience, relaxation, love, sleep, or cognitive-degradation) are asserted to each CAUSE the other in a closed, mutually-amplifying loop with no neutral baseline and no exit, typically fueled by real climbing body arousal (mandated masturbation, edging, directed focus) as raw material. Because both directions deepen the state, every valve the listener reaches for to escape (damp arousal, refuse obedience, leave relaxation) re-feeds the coupled quantity, which only climbs; recovery would require denying both poles at once, which the coupling makes self-defeating. This is the CLIMBING/amplifying pole of the weld axis (contrast identity-equivalence-chain, the static X-IS-Y fusion with no magnitude ratchet). Realizations: single-pair somatic weld (arousal<->depth); antagonist-pair welded to one descending count so waking-reflex and arousal-damping each convert into the other, discharge gated to the terminus; distributed-across-the-whole-arc arousal=depth where every spike is pre-tagged as descent and each section's output fuels the next, orgasm redefined as the deepening event; per-beat co-advance of two orthogonal axes braided into one indivisible percept so refusing one entails refusing the other; whole-script coupling GRAPH wiring nearly every state-variable into mutual amplification so the payload feels self-generated; inverse-reciprocal seesaw (zero-sum mind-vs-cock) where any rise in one forces the other down; and durable stipulative multi-session identity-welds.

**Realizations** (4): `arousal-as-deepener-inversion`, `depth-arousal-entanglement`, `dual-rail-braiding`, `recursive-coupling-topology`


**See also.** `arousal-as-induction-substrate` — borderline members are genuinely dual-natured: arousal used as the entry ramp can also install the standing bidirectional weld. The reader needs both to decide whether the arousal is only the way in or a carried mutually-amplifying coupling.; `closed-affect-loop` — already mutually referenced in their own discriminators: the climbing mutual-amplification weld versus the topology constraint over reachable joint states. The boundary is contested enough that the cross-link earns its place.; `dual-variable-descent-yoking` — both couple arousal to depth so escape valves close, and the distinction is real and worth the link: one welds a second variable to a descent counter within a single descent structure, the other builds a bidirectional mutually-causing climb over real felt variables with no baseline. Single-axis yoking versus a closed amplifying loop.


### closed-affect-loop

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Constrains which affective/state combinations are reachable rather than pushing any single dimension. Two forms recur: (1) valence-closed routing, where every internal state is pre-assigned a proof-function pointing the same direction (bad feelings prove the doctrine, good feelings prove compliance is working) so no feeling can disconfirm the frame; and (2) mutual-amplification coupling, where two normally independent or opposed state-variables (arousal/sedation, arousal/depth, happiness/dumbness, euphoria=arousal+open-heartedness, sleep/hypnosis/arousal) are bound so each increment of one drives the other and every standard exit escalates the loop. Distinct from relief-monopoly-dependency: that is a single distress->compliance->relief loop routed through the operator after the same source manufactured the distress; here every valence, or every exit vector, is pre-closed with no single monopolized relief source. **See also.** `arousal-state-feedback-weld` — already mutually referenced in their own discriminators: the climbing mutual-amplification weld versus the topology constraint over reachable joint states. ### cross-state-persistence

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a desire (here, the desire for a triggered persona-swap) into BOTH the triggered persona and the baseline self and across BOTH waking and sleeping, so the off-state self can no longer act as a brake. Ordinarily a triggered persona-swap leaves a baseline self that could, on reflection, choose to avoid re-triggering; scoping the "wanting" across persona A and persona B, waking and sleeping, forecloses that escape hatch and neutralizes the baseline self as a check.


**When to reach for this.** Explicit cross-STATE scope (distinct personas AND waking/sleeping) that removes the off-state brake. A within-state "you want this" suggestion lacks the enumerated cross-state span; total-permeation spreads a trait across internal layers within one state, and context-generalization spans external contexts — here the want spans discrete persona and consciousness states.


**See also.** `named-trigger-persona-swap` — one installs the switchable labeled persona with a paired release; the other removes the off-state self's ability to decline re-triggering by scoping the wanting across both personas and across waking and sleeping. ### engineered-deadlock-resolved-by-surrender

*risk: medium*

The operator explicitly names the listener's ambivalence, then amplifies BOTH poles at once (maximal desire to orgasm AND maximal desire to be denied), sustaining two incompatible valences simultaneously until the decision-paralysis is unbearable. **See also.** `appetitive-contradiction-lock` — both hold two incompatible appetitive imperatives at once until the bind is unbearable, but one manufactures the deadlock specifically to offer surrender to the operator as its only exit, while the other closes the loop so no resolution exists at all and pinned frustration itself is recoded as the target state.; `beg-then-grant-polarity-flip` — both gate the listener's forward motion on a manufactured wanting, but the levers differ: one flips the listener into petitioner by threatening to withhold the state and then granting it; the other builds a two-pole contradiction and offers surrender as the only exit. They differ in substrate — an internal two-pole ambivalence sustained to paralysis versus an external threat where the operator is covertly both danger and rescuer — so they stay separate entries.

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

STATIC state-weld: a set of distinct concepts (arousal, surrender, obedience, pleasure, hypnosis, love, loyalty, sleep) is asserted IDENTICAL by flat copular declaration ('X is Y'), often biconditional ('arousal is compliance and compliance is arousal') or rotating so no term is the privileged root, stated as fact and repeated/drilled, never argued, until the terms become interchangeable. The lever is SEMANTIC FUSION, not amplification (contrast arousal-state-feedback-weld, the climbing loop): once the chain is accepted the listener cannot grant partial consent or pull one conceptual thread without activating all the others, and any felt sensation (arousal) auto-reads as evidence of the abstract claim (obedience/surrender). Realizations: flat transitive equation-collapse (arousal=surrender=obedience=pleasure=operator); resistance-vocabulary capture (every term a listener might reach for to resist collapses back into the target node); distributed spaced equivalence graph where each tiny equation slips past individually; one-way laundering / synonymy staircases (each link licenses the next, never weakened back) walking an innocuous premise to obedience by increments; and the three-state mutual-implication RING (aroused implies crave-hypnosis, hypnotized implies sleepy, drowsy implies surrender back to hypnosis/arousal) drilled as a refrain with indistinguishability NAMED as the deliberate terminal state, so any vertex summons the others and unavoidable daily states (tiredness, arousal) become out-of-session cross-triggers.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when the fusion is STATIC declarative concept-equivalence (X IS Y, no magnitude ratchet) — you want the terms to become interchangeable so partial consent and single-thread resistance become impossible, or you want a mutual-implication ring whose terminal goal is indistinguishability that hijacks daily states as cross-triggers. Choose arousal-state-feedback-weld instead when the coupling CLIMBS (a magnitude amplifier over felt variables); closed-logic-and-inevitability when a propositional argument is closed rather than term-meanings welded; direct identity-labeling when a single label is applied rather than made self-confirming through transitive identity.


**Realizations** (1): `state-equivalence-ring`


**See also.** `lexical-relay-semantic-lattice` — both end in a cluster of interchangeable terms where firing one node summons the rest. The difference worth showing is the delivery: flat repeated copular declaration versus a forward hand-off where a term ending one line opens the next, which requires in-order recitation.; `name-binding-transitive-equation-chain` — one is the general form of asserted-equality chains; the other is a specific application where the chain's terminal node is a proper name and the anchor is the listener's own anatomy, so the equivalence fires constantly outside any session. A reader designing or identifying a chain benefits from seeing the high-frequency-anchor variant.; `valence-laundering-collapse-ring` — both build a closed ring of asserted equivalences and both already name the other in their discriminators. A reader arriving at the concept-welding chain benefits from knowing the ring variant that launders one word's valence and ends in an enacted collapse, and vice versa - the discrimination is fine-grained enough that seeing both is what makes either usable.


### identity-exit-tax

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Fuses compliance to the listener's real self, worth, progress, or gendered identity so that non-compliance changes category: leaving stops being "I choose differently" and becomes "I abandon who I am." Refusal is thereby recoded as self-erasure or self-betrayal rather than a preference-level choice, recruiting self-consistency and identity-protection against future autonomy. The self-model is held FIXED and welded to a behavior (contrast self-model-surgery, which restructures the model): the mechanism is the cost-structure imposed on exit, not the durability of any installed content. In one script realization, self-worth is made entirely dependent on being "that perfect GOOD GIRL," making the whole trigger system load-bearing for identity. In a variant, the contingent condition is REMAINING IN a state ("Good girls stay / Underwater"), converting the trance state into an identity-membership rule so exiting trance forfeits good-girl status.


**When to reach for this.** The move prices EXIT at the identity level. It is not a durability claim — asserting that installed content endures is permanence-declaration; this is a contingency structure, not a permanence claim. It is not the identity-was-always-real reframe that conceals installation — that edits the history of the self, not the cost of leaving. It is not direct identity labeling, which applies a label with no conditionality. It is not deletion of the exit DESTINATION from the state map — neutral-state-deletion is map surgery that removes where you'd go; exit-tax leaves the map intact and prices the crossing. And exit taxed with DISTRESS rather than self-betrayal is the affective-level analogue, a separate move.


**See also.** `affect-fused-identity` — two ways of making an identity label defend itself. One welds the label to a self-firing affect so membership is intrinsically rewarding; the other leaves the self-model fixed and prices exit as self-betrayal. Frequently co-occurring and easy to confuse, so the contrast is worth carrying.; `asymmetric-state-lock` — both price or foreclose leaving, at different layers: one makes exit cost the self, the other structurally removes the subject's autonomous off-switch and hands release to an operator condition. Since scripts commonly stack the identity cost on top of the structural monopoly, a reader auditing exit routes should see both. Not one technique — a contingency structure is not a monopolized off-switch.; `exit-annexation` — both price the off-ramp rather than removing it: one recodes refusal as self-betrayal, the other recodes using the exit as an act of service inside the same frame. The exit stays materially available in each; the capture is in what leaving means. Real contrast value for a writer choosing how to close an exit without blocking it.; `neutral-state-deletion` — complementary exit-closure moves that each define themselves against the other: one prices the crossing at the identity level while leaving the state map intact, the other deletes the destination from the map so there is nowhere neutral to return to. Reading either without the other invites misattributing map surgery to cost structure.; `operator-removal-self-policing-closure` — the operator-free closure names self-worth staked on compliance as one of its interlocking components, and that component is exactly the identity-priced exit. Reader of the whole-script architecture gains from the discrete move that supplies its identity-cost limb; reader of the discrete move gains from seeing the end-state it is usually built toward.


### payload-welded-countdown

*risk: medium*

A descending count (or its exponential variant) is double-coded so that each number simultaneously deepens trance AND advances a distinct payload — a post-hypnotic suggestion, a commitment/relationship buy-in, an obedience beat, a mission clause, an installed program, or a named faculty being subtracted. Because the listener has been trained (or is being trained in the same ladder) that "operator says number, I go deeper", the payload rides in on the deepening momentum and cannot be refused without also refusing the deepening. The count serves three roles at once — deepener, suggestion-carrier, and self-monitored progress bar — so depth-experience and content-acceptance fuse and cannot later be pulled apart. Sub-forms: per-number content install with the numbers becoming retrieval handles; a structurally distinct SECOND counted descent that reuses the first's trained step-compliance to smuggle relational content; a counted- quantity ratchet where the number ticks a physical dial (thickness/erasure) rather than depth; a redelivery countdown that deepens from an already-installed state to re-embed install clauses.


**When to reach for this.** Each number of the count carries a DISTINCT non-depth payload welded to the depth-increment. In plain numerical deepening the count carries only depth; ordered-lesson and verbatim-repetition structures enumerate or repeat content but do not use the numbers as a depth-doubling deepener the payload rides on; and where permanence is asserted along the way, the mechanism is still the depth/payload fusion, not the durability claim. The tell: refusing the payload requires refusing the deepening the listener has been trained to want.


---

# Influence

*Relational and topological control of the subject's world — authorship, consent, reachability, agent graph, persistence.*


## authorship-shift  (43)

Relocating causal attribution of a state, movement, decision, or content off the subject — onto the operator, an external agent, an installed sub-agent, or a relabeled 'own will' — so no external target remains to resist and compliance reads as native.

**Scope.** The attribution lever. Consent records -> manufactured-consent; memory-gap mechanics -> amnesia; state fusion -> state-welding.


### attention-anchor-portable-internalization

*risk: low*

A focal object is authored entirely by the operator but attributed to the listener — built, it is claimed, from the listener's own closed-eye imagery or dream material ('I took all the pretty patterns and pulses from when you close your eyes') — then internalized (transferred inside the head) as the portable pacing object for everything after. The parasitic provenance means the listener cannot reject its contents without rejecting their own internal imagery, so it feels non-impositional; eye-closure removes the external check that it isn't actually pulsing; and once internalized the operator can cite 'the pulse' at will while the listener supplies the metronome, decoupling depth from operator narration.


**When to reach for this.** Separated from ordinary external-fixation induction by the parasitic-provenance attribution (the prop is claimed to be made of the listener's own mind) and the internalization into a portable self-supplied pacer. Separated from eye-fatigue-convincer's remembered-point member — there the internal anchor is a mere memory of a real external point ratified by fatigue; here the object is operator-authored content laundered as the listener's own so it cannot be disowned.


**See also.** `fixation-object-agency-displacement` — both build a fixation object, but the levers differ: one launders operator-authored content as the listener's own imagery and internalizes it as a self-supplied pacer; the other credits the object with causal agency for the trance. A writer picking a fixation move benefits from seeing both options.; `proprioceptive-gait-metronome` — both hand the listener a pacing device that keeps running when the operator is not speaking — an internalized visual object in one case, the listener's own body rhythm in the other. Reading across shows the shared design goal of an operator-independent metronome and the two available carriers for it.


### attribution-capture-of-internal-states

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Rather than truthfully describing the listener's present state, the operator seizes the CAUSAL ATTRIBUTION of that state - recoding the listener's own baseline sensations, drift, or inevitable physiological actions as caused by the operator's voice, command, or influence. A maybe-menu ('maybe it's all of those things') or a declared symbol-meaning template ('blue is the colour of relaxation, so you feel it') captures every possible introspective result, including feeling nothing, so whatever the listener finds on introspection confirms the operator's hold; because the 'commanded' effect is one the listener would produce anyway (eyes closing under deepening, ordinary distraction), each landed prediction silently extends apparent causal reach and the listener begins to experience their own drift as obedience-output. REALIZATION: besides linguistic capture, the running state can be captured by REMOVING COMPETING REFERENTS [<-1212 scaffold-collapse-reattribution: after a fully-built imaginal scene has done its work, the operator strips the entire scaffold in a few lines while the relaxed somatic state stays and is renamed as the operator's own doing ('there is nothing but my hypnosis') - pulling the environment after the listener is inside it leaves the state with nothing to attach to except the voice, so it re-attributes directly to the operator].


**When to reach for this.** The tell is causal REATTRIBUTION onto the operator - 'you feel/did/wanted this BECAUSE of me / this proves my hold' - not truthful description of what is. DECODE absorbed: 1212 = capture a running state by demolishing every competing referent (strip the built scene mid-trance) so only the operator's voice remains for the state to attribute to. Direction is listener-to-operator credit - the INVERSE of compliance-authorship-laundering (83, which relocates authorship of the operator's content TO the listener). Distinguish from pacing-leading (states checkable-true facts, never claims to have caused them), from self-validating language (asserts unfalsifiable claims; here real introspective results are captured wholesale), from expectation-seeding (captures already-present states, not previewed ones), and from operator-credit-engineering (128 - arranges EVENTS/successes to harvest credit for operator AUTHORITY; here the listener's own internal states are captured to erode self-attribution).


**Realizations** (4): `authorship-relocation-to-operator`, `operator-attribution-capture`, `pleasure-authorship-relocation`, `scaffold-collapse-reattribution`


**See also.** `catalepsy-as-ownership-reframe` — both rewrite the causal story about something the listener is already experiencing. One flips the cause of immobility onto a property change so the body reads as no longer the listener's; the other reassigns the cause of ordinary drift and sensation to the operator's influence. Reading them together separates a self-model payload from an operator-credit payload.; `inner-voice-authorship-bypass` — inverse halves of the same authorship dial: one relocates authorship of the operator's words onto the listener's inner voice, the other relocates causal credit for the listener's own states onto the operator — different directions, and the first disarms the 'said to me' guard while the second harvests introspection as proof of hold.; `pleasure-attributed-to-operator` — both reroute credit onto the operator, one for the subject's pleasure or the reinforcement unit, the other for the causal attribution of the subject's present state generally. Reward-source relocation is arguably a special case of state-attribution capture, so the pointer is needed to keep the assignment stable. Not a merge — the affect-pointing version carries a reinforcement function the general form does not.; `presuppositional-autonomic-attribution` — both relocate causal credit for a state onto the operator, and they differ on a clean axis the discriminators already name: one captures whatever the listener finds on introspection (including nothing), the other narrates verifiably-true involuntary physiology and smuggles the causal claim in by presupposition. The truth-status of the described state is the deciding parameter, which is worth a reader's attention.; `state-cause-laundering` — directional inverses on the same axis: one launders a running state's cause AWAY from the operator to a benign source, the other captures that cause ONTO the operator. A reader choosing between them needs the direction test, so the cross-link earns its place.


### authorship-laundering-meta-rule

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a STANDING processing rule over all future operator suggestions — accept, obey, forget the source, and reattribute the content to the listener's own idea / own always-held truth — rehearsed on test payloads and generalized to every later recording and live session. Unlike a per-command amnesia wrapper, this operates at the CHANNEL level: it strips the operator-command / own-belief distinction for the whole suggestion stream at once, so any later instruction self-justifies (resisting it feels like resisting one's own will), cannot be inventoried against an original, and is severed from attribution to the operator. The forgetting is not of a specific command but of the ACT of accepting, making the rule unfalsifiable and self-sealing; euphoria may reward waking-life execution.


**When to reach for this.** A standing meta-rule over the WHOLE future suggestion channel that reattributes authorship to the listener — not a wrapper around a single install (amnesia-wrapped-command, which keeps a specific cue live and only severs its origin), and not a single-response attribution flip (failure-pre-attribution, which reattributes one elicited response). The tell is the reattribute-as-own-idea clause generalized to all future content, rehearsed and declared the default response template.


**See also.** `amnesia-wrapped-command`; `compliance-authorship-laundering` — same laundering move at two scopes: a standing rule over the entire future suggestion channel, versus relabeling a specific compliance act or constraint as the listener's own will. Reader of the per-act form needs to know the channel-level version exists, since it makes every later instruction self-justifying at once.; `covert-scope-authorization` — both quietly rewrite how the whole later suggestion stream is processed rather than delivering one payload: one installs a standing rule reattributing all future content to the listener, the other captures a scope-broadening authorization in a slot read as housekeeping. A reader auditing for channel-level clauses should check for both. Distinct — authorship reattribution versus scope widening, and the second turns on placement.; `epistemic-guard-disable` — both install a standing rule that disarms scrutiny of everything downstream, but one relaunders authorship of suggestions to the listener while the other removes the truth-testing faculty itself. Distinguishing attribution-edit from evaluation-edit is a real classification decision.; `inner-voice-authorship-bypass` — both relocate authorship from operator to listener, but at different scopes: one installs a standing rule over the whole future suggestion channel, the other is a grammatical/voice move within a passage. A reader choosing between channel-level reattribution and sentence-level reattribution benefits from seeing both.; `interpretive-closure-meta-command` — both install a standing rule over the entire future rather than any named response, and reading them together shows the two halves of that rare architecture — one rewrites the ATTRIBUTION of incoming suggestions as the listener's own idea, the other delegates GENERATION of unspecified operator-benefiting action to the listener's own interpretation.; `selective-memory-bifurcation` — shares the make-it-feel-self-authored aim but is a single post-hypnotic, not a channel-wide standing rule.; `subconscious-agent-authorship-offload` — both relocate authorship away from the operator, but in opposite directions: one reassigns it to the listener as her own always-held idea, the other to an internal sub-agent she does not feel she controls. Useful contrast when choosing where to park authorship.; `two-target-command-router` — both install a standing rule over the entire future input stream rather than wrapping a single suggestion. One strips authorship from everything that arrives; the other classifies incoming commands by intent and dispatches them to two addressable selves. Channel-level rules are a small family worth reading together.


### blank-then-authorship-handoff

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Blanks the listener's own ideational stream and then reassigns authorship of mental content to the operator or to a "self-produced" source, so later suggestions land as the listener's own reality rather than external claims. Surfaces: a single lit candle/object holding all the listener's thoughts is blown out ("still there, still safe") to darken the mind while the same move installs the replacement clause ("my words will become your reality"); and the operator claims to BE the listener's subconscious/dream-generator during sleep, so surrender-content reads as self-produced and resistance has no external target. The blank/amnesia is enabling substrate; the load-bearing move is the authorship/reality substitution.


**When to reach for this.** Uses a blanking/forgetting substrate to execute an AUTHORSHIP relocation — operator speech becomes the listener's reality, or operator becomes the listener's own inner source. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (forgetting as the end — here forgetting only clears the channel) and from emptied-window-install (which states discrete claims into the window — here the handoff is a wholesale relocation of who authors mental content). The reality/authorship substitution clause is the tell.


**See also.** `control-transfer-cognitive-delegation` — both relocate authorship of mental content to the operator, and the boundary is easy to miss. One hands off the ongoing faculty of thinking and frames the handoff as relief; the other first blanks the ideational stream and then substitutes who authors what fills it. Reach for the blanking form only when a clearing step precedes a wholesale reality-substitution clause.; `emptied-window-install` — both use an emptying or forgetting as instrumental substrate rather than as the payload, and they already reference each other's distinction: wholesale relocation of who authors mental content, versus discrete positive claims stated into the just-opened window. A reader who has identified the substrate still has to choose between them.


### causal-attribution-to-external-agent

*risk: medium*

Relocates CAUSATION for an induced state-change onto an external NON-CONSUMED cause the operator names, so the listener's volition has nothing to push against and there is no self-effort to succeed or fail at; because the agent is external and objective-seeming, the effect stabilizes against introspection.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when you want a NON-CONSUMED external cause to own the state-change so volition has no target. Neighboring techniques a writer picks INSTEAD: fictional-substance-agent — an imagined INGESTED/inhaled substance with pseudo-pharmacology, where the consumption act performs delivery (consumed vs non-consumed is the split); fixation-object-agency-displacement — an object credited with the ATTENTIONAL PULL rather than the state-change; state-cause-laundering — supplies a BENIGN/natural false cause to deflect attribution off the operator ('you're just relaxed', nothing is being done to you), the opposite felt-result from 'this external thing is doing it to you'; concrete-externalization-parked-faculty — a place a result is STORED, not a cause that DID the work. The tell for THIS: an external non-consumed agent is ASSERTED AS THE CAUSE ('the agent will do the rest', 'the latex did it', 'you cannot fight a wavelength').


**Realizations** (3): `external-attribution-of-owned-autonomic-response`, `state-authorship-relocation`, `voice-as-physics-vehicle`


**See also.** `fictional-substance-agent` — same causal-offloading lever split on whether the named external cause is consumed: an asserted non-consumed agent versus an imagined ingested or inhaled substance whose consumption act performs delivery. Read the pair when classifying an external cause.; `fixation-object-agency-displacement` — both relocate causation onto something outside the listener so volition has nothing to push against; the split is what the external thing is credited with — the attentional pull toward a fixation object versus the state-change itself, by a non-consumed agent. The second entry already names the first as the neighbour to pick instead, which is precisely the case a cross-reference should carry.; `object-as-causal-agent-of-cognition` — genuine near-neighbours on the same axis: an external non-consumed cause is asserted to own the state-change. The second narrows it to a physical object granted an active causal role that also functions as a portable post-session cue. A writer deciding whether the cause should be a nameable object or a diffuse agent needs both in view.; `state-cause-laundering` — directly contrastive on the same axis — where the cause of an induced state is assigned. One relocates causation onto a named external agent that is asserted to be doing it; the other supplies a benign natural cause so nothing appears to be doing it at all. Opposite felt results from the same relocation move; each discriminator already names the other.


### compliance-authorship-laundering

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Operator-directed compliance - present, future, or just delivered - is pre-labeled or retro-labeled as the listener's own nature, choice, will, or PREFERENCE (it's natural; you will believe it was your own idea; because you love to obey; of your own volition; you didn't want to resist; you do not wish to), so resistance loses its external target: fighting the direction becomes fighting oneself, and post-hoc audit finds a stored memory of self-authorship where the instruction was. REALIZATION: the relabeled thing is usually a compliance ACT, but the same move applies to a CONSTRAINT/denial reframed as a self-owned preference - orgasm denial installed as 'you do not wish to', a described internal preference rather than a resistible prohibition, so permission-seeking arrives as the natural expression of an already-accepted preference.


**When to reach for this.** The lever is attribution of the ACT's (or constraint's) agency TO the listener as their own will/preference - including a denial/constraint relabeled as the listener's own preference ('you do not wish to') rather than an imposed rule. Separates from retrospective-desire-attribution (asserts a prior want, not act-agency), from attribution-capture of internal states (the INVERSE direction: listener-generated content credited to the OPERATOR), and from press-play-consent-laundering (no consent token; the compliance itself is relabeled). It borders manufactured-consent, but here an internal DESIRE-STATE's authorship is relocated to the listener, not an assent to an operator act.


**Realizations** (2): `preference-relabeled-denial`, `self-originated-compliance-laundering`


**See also.** `authorship-laundering-meta-rule` — same laundering move at two scopes: a standing rule over the entire future suggestion channel, versus relabeling a specific compliance act or constraint as the listener's own will. Reader of the per-act form needs to know the channel-level version exists, since it makes every later instruction self-justifying at once.; `depth-labor-transfer-leash`; `press-play-consent-laundering` — adjacent laundering moves that a reader will have to choose between: one relabels the compliance act itself as the listener's own will or preference, the other relabels a prior act, non-act, or circumstance as the authorization for what follows. Agency of the act versus the source of the yes.; `retrospective-desire-attribution`; `state-cause-laundering` — twin authorship relocations that answer different questions. One relocates agency for the act to the listener as their own will or preference; the other relocates the cause of an already-running state onto a benign source and away from the operator. Adjacent enough to be miscoded for each other, so a mutual pointer is the useful guard.


### control-transfer-cognitive-delegation

*risk: medium*

The operator volunteers to perform the listener's own cognition/control — thinking, deciding, worrying, self-suppression — and frames the handoff as felt relief rather than loss, so obedience reads as frictionless rest. The listener is given permission to stop generating thought while the operator (or an operator-supplied binary decision-engine) becomes the entity that reasons or holds control. Set up variously by partitioning the self into a thinking-conscious mind that is evicted and a receptive remainder, by timing the handoff to an exhaustion point so it arrives as rescue-by-contrast, by smuggling the transfer under an already-accepted somatic binding, or by narrowing scope to the meta-evaluative self-monitoring layer. The delegated faculty and the framing are parameters, in three main forms: (a) GENERAL COGNITION — thinking/deliberation handed off as absorptive relief; (b) FEAR-DEFUSING SUBSTITUTION — operator-control offered as a strictly-superior REPLACEMENT for the listener's own self-suppression ('a much better method of control'), specifically neutralizing a previously-manufactured fear of being uncontrolled so barriers release while feeling safe; (c) FINITE-SPACE VOICE-DISPLACEMENT — the voice reframed as a spatial occupant with a one-in-one-out scarcity claim (finite mental space, each unit of voice in = one unit of thought out, 'I am thinking for you now'), emptiness reframed as the receipt for having received the operator rather than as loss.


**When to reach for this.** The delegate is the OPERATOR (or an operator-supplied decision-engine) and the delegated faculty is general cognition/control, offered as relief. Variant tells: the fear-defusing substitution reads as operator-control replacing self-control to defuse a manufactured fear of being uncontrolled; the finite-space voice-displacement reads as an explicit one-in-one-out displacement economy — voice physically evicts thought unit-for-unit. Sibling techniques a writer picks INSTEAD: subconscious-agent-authorship-offload delegates to the listener's OWN internal layer (subconscious / autonomous thoughts), NOT the operator — the recipient is the line; induced-incapacity-to-operator-dependency weaponizes a manufactured decision-INCAPACITY into 'you can't decide, so I decide' (a dependency lock-in, not relief); self-touch-reattribution reattributes a specific physical act just performed; critical-faculty-deactivation-claim claims the faculty is simply switched OFF. Not a bare drop command, and not ownership-as-identity language.


**Realizations** (2): `control-substitution`, `voice-displacement-scarcity`


**See also.** `blank-then-authorship-handoff` — both relocate authorship of mental content to the operator, and the boundary is easy to miss. One hands off the ongoing faculty of thinking and frames the handoff as relief; the other first blanks the ideational stream and then substitutes who authors what fills it. Reach for the blanking form only when a clearing step precedes a wholesale reality-substitution clause.; `ceded-agency-as-comfort-precedent` — these are typically sequential: small decisions resolved for the listener and cashed as comfort lower the threshold for handing over cognition wholesale. Reading the precedent-builder alongside the full handoff shows the setup-and-payoff relationship rather than two interchangeable moves.; `cognitive-sourcing-monopoly` — adjacent and easy to confuse: one hands the listener's cognition to the operator as felt relief, the other claims the operator constitutively supplies the faculty in the first place. Relief-framed delegation versus foreclosure-by-sourcing is a real classification decision, and the pair sharpens it.; `faculty-removal-pass` — adjacent routes for disposing of the listener's own reasoning: handing the faculty to the operator and framing the handoff as relief, versus treating it as a standing organ that is relabeled, demonstrably blanked, and claimed excised. A writer picking one should see the other.


### covert-fact-install

*risk: medium*

A long neutral-seeming didactic/expository passage is delivered specifically to occupy the listener's analytical mind while the actual payload slides past inside it — the lecture IS the work, not the setup. A pseudo-explanatory theory-of-mind (conscious/subconscious, 'unconscious doesn't understand negatives', 'overthinking is harmful') is taught with harmless worked examples, and embedded in it is the load-bearing install: trust the subconscious the operator has already programmed, treat the operator's voice as the authority over the listener's own thinking, reframe conscious resistance as malfunction. Because the exposition needs the conscious mind awake to consume it, the embedded rule passes unchallenged.


**When to reach for this.** A pedagogical lecture used AS the delivery vehicle so an embedded install (trust-the-programmed-subconscious / operator-as-authority-over-your-thinking) passes while the analytical mind is occupied consuming it. Unlike surrender-as-freedom, which argues an explicit value thesis openly, and unlike transparent narration, which openly narrates its own mechanism as it works, here the lecture is a neutral-seeming cover and the payload is hidden inside it. The lecture-consumes-the-critic tell is the distinguishing feature.


**See also.** `covert-diegetic-install-shell` — two covers for the same trick: keep the analytical mind busy consuming surface material while the load-bearing install rides inside it. One uses expository theory-of-mind teaching, the other a fiction the operator narrates rather than directs. Useful together when choosing which cover to run.; `pedagogical-reframe-conditioning` — both hide an install inside an ordinary-seeming instructional surface, and a writer choosing one should see the other. The first uses a neutral expository lecture to occupy the analytical mind while an embedded rule about whose authority governs the listener's thinking passes unexamined; the second uses a familiar teacher-and-discipline relation so that the literal content of the disciplinary act is the thing being rehearsed. Same instructional cover, different payloads: a smuggled premise versus normalization by authority relation.; `surrender-as-freedom-philosophical-conditioning`; `two-channel-relational-delivery` — both hide the real install under a foreground structure that occupies the analytical mind — a didactic lecture in one case, a staged relation in the other — with the pedagogical form explicitly listed as a variant of the broader topology. Containment is genuine.


### denial-as-will-defeat-reframe

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

After repeated edging/stroking drills, orders hands away and preserves unrelieved arousal, then instructs the listener to "dedicate" the frustration to the operator while framing the will as an adversary whose defeat is the desired outcome. The acute denial-frustration is converted into evidence the install is true, and later self-reproach is pre-defused by pre-loading the will/arousal antagonism as the answer to "why did I do that?" — so the unbearable feeling becomes proof the operator won and future self-questioning is pre-answered with "your will lost to arousal, which is what you wanted."


**When to reach for this.** A compound reframe: denial-frustration recast as proof-of-install PLUS adversarial-will framing that recasts loss-of-will as the desired outcome, not the harm. Distinct from ordinary edging (arousal maintenance) and from addiction framing (which valorizes craving positively); here the unrelieved frustration is reframed as evidence and will-defeat as the goal. It also carries a retrospective-justification element, pre-answering future self-questioning.


**See also.** `arousal-as-evidence-foreclosure` — both convert a bodily state into un-arguable evidence that the install has already taken hold, closing the interpretive escape route. One works on unrelieved denial-frustration plus adversarial-will framing, the other on arousal as an unfalsifiable readout of compliance; a reader coding a body-as-proof passage will want to compare them, and the reframe-versus-pre-claimed-frame distinction is the useful discriminator.; `failure-state-inversion` — both convert an aversive sexual outcome into evidence the conditioning is working, and a writer building one will often want the other: one operates on sustained unrelieved arousal, the other on a single involuntary release event whose cultural shame is named in order to be overwritten. Reading the pair clarifies that the reframe target is a felt state in one case and an event class in the other.; `unsatisfiable-arousal-overrun` — both operate on unrelieved arousal with release barred, and they compose in the same passage, so the reader benefits from seeing the split: one manufactures a state that by construction cannot discharge; the other reframes the resulting frustration as proof the install landed and will-defeat as the goal.; `withdrawal-as-commitment-extraction` — both relocate authorship of the surrender to the subject; distinct vehicles (will-defeat reframe vs spoken begging) — reconciliation may relate them under authorship-relocation.


### depth-labor-transfer-leash

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

The operator revokes the passive contract (my words pull you down, no effort needed) and reassigns trance-depth production to the listener - operator words become stage directions, the listener generates the imagery - while the operator retains judgment and pre-codes weak imaging as disappointing him. Self-attributed vivid effects read as devotion, effort-failure becomes relational betrayal, and the it-didn't-work-on-me exit is foreclosed because the listener owns the production.


**When to reach for this.** Responsibility-transfer plus relational leash. Unlike guided visualization, where the operator builds the imagery for a passive listener, here the production work is handed to the listener and judged; and unlike authorship-laundering moves that merely re-credit work the operator did, the labor itself is transferred, not just the credit. No deficit is installed — an existing contract regime is swapped.


**See also.** `compliance-authorship-laundering`; `self-administered-conditioning-loop` — both hand production work to the listener and keep only the framing, so a reader choosing one should see the other: depth imagery transferred under operator judgment versus a conditioning loop whose reinforcer the listener supplies. Same labor-transfer family, different transferred object.; `self-authored-construct-leverage` — both relocate production of the payload onto the listener so there is nothing external to resist. One adds a relational leash by judging the listener's output and pre-coding weak results as disappointing the operator; the other is the general authorship-relocation lever without the judgment. Read together when deciding whether the judging beat is present.


### drop-as-passive-collapse

*risk: high · consent-required*

Installs an interpretive frame over a state-change (a drop, the surrender itself, an ongoing dissolution) that reassigns its agency OFF the listener: the change is never something she does, it is something that happens to her, so the volitional muscle she would use to resist has nothing to push against and an effortful state-change becomes an effortless inevitability. One technique in several forms — the vehicle/geometry is the parameter: (a) support-withdrawal metaphor — the listener is recast as a supported object that falls when scaffolding is withdrawn ('energy gently removed', the body 'plummets/slumps/sags'), force and ease deliberately combined ('forcing her easily down'); (b) decision-point-erasing gradient — a continuous gradient (a hallway that tilts further down until walking smears into falling) smears the active-to-passive transition across a continuum with NO discrete moment of giving up volition, so there is no decision-point at which resistance could be mounted; (c) clock-metered drain — an external clock meters an inevitable endless loss per beat ('every second it goes'), externalizing the pacing onto time itself so the listener is not the agent doing the losing and cannot author or stop it.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS to make a descent/surrender/loss feel NOT-authored-by-the-listener — a framing/agency-reassignment layer over the state-change, not the cue that causes it. Unlike a conditioned anchor drop, which fires a cue to CAUSE the drop, this only decorates whatever causes it. Ordinary relaxation-deepener language lacks the tell: mechanical support-withdrawal, an erased decision-point, or external metering. Unlike rhythm-anchoring, nothing here is keyed to the beat — the clock only paces the loss. The gradient form can resemble a staircase-style deepener and the clock form a felt-time distortion, but the load-bearing move is removing the listener's agency over the state-change, not a depth increment or a time warp.


**Realizations** (2): `clock-metered-dissolution`, `decision-point-erasure-by-gradient`


**See also.** `resistance-externalized-as-object-watched-losing` — both make surrender feel un-authored, but they act at different layers: one externalizes the faculty and narrates it losing under a no-exit topology, the other reassigns agency for the state-change itself with no object involved. Worth a pointer because the externalized-object form is a natural place to reach for the agency-reassignment framing on top.; `trigger-locus-relocation` — genuine neighbors: both reassign authorship of a change off the listener so there is nothing for the volitional muscle to push against. They differ in what they operate on -- one relocates agency onto an already-accepted trigger so a non-collapse cannot read as personal failure, the other frames a descent or dissolution as happening-to rather than done-by. A reader picking between them benefits from seeing both.; `volitional-breath-retirement` — both convert something the listener does into something that merely happens, and the boundary is what is retired: one reassigns agency over a state-change so there is nothing to push against, the other retires volition over an act just deliberately engaged and banks it as a template for later involuntariness. Genuinely easy to conflate.


### engineered-accident-self-licensing

*risk: medium · bounded*

Design the compliant act so that the person performing it can attribute it to a slip, a fumble, a mishearing, or bad timing rather than to a decision — the act completes and the actor keeps a clean moral self-image because on their own account they never chose it. The operator's contribution is architectural: arrange the task so the forbidden outcome sits one small accident away (the object placed where a stumble knocks it over, the confession one careless sentence from being made, the boundary one mis-stepped pace past), then say nothing. Unlike moves that relocate authorship in the operator's telling, nothing is asserted at all; the alibi is manufactured by the actor, for the actor, and is therefore not available to be contested. What makes it repeatable is that a successful accident lowers the bar for the next one — each unpunished 'that just happened' widens the range of acts the actor can perform without crossing a self-image line.


**When to reach for this.** Nearest is press-play-consent-laundering (141): a completed low-cost act (pressing play, not stopping, staying past a marked point) is CITED BY THE OPERATOR, repeatedly, as the subject's authorization — the operator supplies the reading and the payload is a felt 'yes' that licenses escalation. Here the operator supplies no reading at all and the actor's private reading is the inverse: 'I never chose it', which preserves moral self-image rather than manufacturing consent. Versus consent-laundering-wrapper (1016): an architecture placing where consent is harvested versus where it is spent — still consent as the currency; nothing is consented to here. Versus operator-agency-disavowal (126): the operator says 'there is no hypnotist, you do it to yourself' — an operator claim about the operator, contestable because it was spoken; here nothing is spoken and the alibi is unavailable to be contested because the actor authored it. Versus unattributable-cause-severing (556): the subject can attribute control NOWHERE; here the subject does attribute — to their own accident — and that specific attribution IS the payload. Versus impersonal-mechanism-alibi (1157): an operator-asserted unfalsifiable cause (biology, fate); here the alibi is mundane clumsiness, self-supplied and never voiced. The tell: the operator's entire contribution is geometry — the forbidden outcome placed one small accident from where the actor already is — and the operator then stays silent.


### error-laundered-enactment

*risk: medium*

A forbidden or unavowable wish is carried out by a motor act that is competently executed but aimed wrong — the object slips, the name comes out as the other name, the message goes to the wrong recipient — so the wish is fully discharged while the act arrives labelled as a failure of execution rather than a choice. Because errors are a category everyone already grants, the act needs no defence and admits no interrogation; the agent produces both the deed and the alibi in one motion, with no second party required to supply either. Scripted toward a listener, it works as a deniability primitive: an outcome is specified together with a manner of arriving at it that the listener can disown, so the compliance is real and the authorship is not claimable.


**When to reach for this.** Against subconscious-agent-authorship-offload: there authorship of a real act is reassigned to the subject's own inner agent as a NARRATED frame the operator supplies; here no narration and no second party are involved — the error itself is the concealment vehicle, and it is generated by the same agent who wanted the outcome. Against object-as-causal-agent-of-cognition: that relocates causation onto an external object declared to be doing the work; the alibi here is a category of event (a slip) rather than an agent. Against self-perpetuating-loop: that is a closed amplifying circuit; this is a single discharge with a built-in cover and no feedback. Against referent-voiding-portable-obedience: that strips an impulse's object while preserving the impulse; here the object is hit precisely and it is the AIM that is disavowed. The load-bearing tell across all four: the cover story is the malfunction, so the more competent the surrounding performance looks, the better the error reads.


### externalized-agency-testimony

*risk: high · consent-required*

Narrates the listener's transformation as an already-completed fact done TO them by an unnamed external agent ("he did something to me", "he put the headphones on me", "he hacked my brain", "it washed my thoughts away"), through deliberately vague, hedged, self-correcting testimony. The vagueness is the mechanism, not a defect: it models a mind that has lost the ability to account for itself (the target end-state) and relocates responsibility outside the listener, so there is no decision to defend and the altered state is an accomplished fact to be discovered rather than consented to. A device detail (headphones) is engineered to fuse the fiction with the listener's real listening apparatus, converting narrated backstory into present-tense self-experience; a built-in confabulation script ("Something happened. / Something's happening.") is supplied.


**When to reach for this.** Supplies NO specific fabricated memory — only diffuse did-to-me framing whose deliberate vagueness forecloses scrutiny. vs screen-memory, which installs a specific constructed recollection. vs fabricated-recovered-memory-retrieval, which presents a specific fabricated memory as genuine retrieval. vs ordinary backstory/color — the load-bearing elements are the self-opacity (vagueness models the target state) and the apparatus-fusion detail.


### fictional-substance-agent

*risk: high · consent-required*

Causation for a state-change (arousal, sedation, resistance-loss, suggestibility, willingness, identity-change) is offloaded onto an imagined external substance or agent — an injected serum, inhaled gas/smoke/mist, a lotion/oil, a drink, a pleasant toxin, a drug in the air — narrated with pseudo-pharmacology (soaks through skin, enters bloodstream, reaches the brain). Because the listener is asked to imagine a substance rather than to feel a thing, the 'I'm not actually feeling that' objection is bypassed and any felt change reads as the substance working ON a passive recipient; the consumption/inhalation act itself performs the delivery.
