**When to reach for this.** Reach for this to deliver a WHOLE payload deniably by staging a foreground relation (two-voice dialogue, pedagogy, or a watched surrogate) that absorbs the heavy claims while the real install rides underneath via identification — a topology of who-is-addressed-vs-who-absorbs spanning the whole artifact. NOT a mere two-character narrative device (the tell is the two-TRACK architecture and the single fold-in seam), NOT observational-modeling-contagion (a bare modeled behavior raises rate; here a constructed relation is the deniable carrier of the entire script), and NOT a discrete framing move.


**Realizations** (1): `surrogate-demonstration-frame`


**See also.** `concurrent-dual-stream-delivery` — both run two simultaneous authored tracks with the real install underneath, but one splits by perceptual channel with a decoy occupying attention, while the other splits by dramatized relation (dialogue, teacher, watched surrogate) so identification rather than distraction licenses the payload.; `covert-fact-install` — both hide the real install under a foreground structure that occupies the analytical mind — a didactic lecture in one case, a staged relation in the other — with the pedagogical form explicitly listed as a variant of the broader topology. Containment is genuine.; `register-camouflaged-delivery` — both land a payload underneath something the listener is attending to instead of announcing it, and the pair covers two scales. One conceals the content in a channel or register that is not consciously monitored, dying if the camouflage is removed; the other stages a foreground relation across the whole artifact that absorbs the heavy claims while the install rides underneath via identification.


### vicarious-modeling-installation

*risk: high · bounded*

Showing the target others performing (or NOT performing) an act — even on film, with no instruction to imitate — silently re-weights what the viewer treats as available and appropriate and shifts their own subsequent rate of that act; valence is set entirely by what is modeled (the same channel cures phobia or transmits aggression). VARIANTS by carrier/direction: (a) in-person/film depiction [vicarious-modeling] — mere observation of a model raises the behavior, no live plurality/instruction/prohibition; (b) media-scale one-way [publicized-modeling-contagion] — wide broadcast of a similar other's act (e.g. publicized suicides) raises the base rate population-wide among identifiers, differing from (a) only by scale and carrier; (c) inaction/mutual-visibility [pluralistic-ignorance-freeze] — among co-present strangers each reads the others' calm non-response as evidence nothing is wrong and suppresses their own, a recursive freeze that yields less help than a lone witness (broken by singling one person out).


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when mere OBSERVATION of a model shifts the viewer's own rate — no belonging is offered, no operator required, nothing suggested/triggered/scheduled. Pick the variant by carrier (in-person/film vs media-scale) and direction (action-raising vs inaction-freeze). NOT social-proof-belonging-enrollment (membership/conformity is the lever, not rate-shift-by-exposure) and NOT two-track-relational-delivery (a foreground RELATION carries the payload via identification, not a bare modeled behavior).


**Realizations** (2): `pluralistic-ignorance-freeze`, `publicized-modeling-contagion`


**See also.** `manufactured-consensus` — same-chapter social-proof genus, different lever (live headcount certification vs observational installation); reconciliation may raise a shared principle.


## contingency-engineering  (39)

Arranging antecedents and consequences in the subject's environment so behavior is built, transferred, maintained, or suppressed — shaping, chaining, stimulus control and prompt-fading, differential reinforcement, extinction, motivating operations, response-cost economies, rule-governed stakes.

**Scope.** The unit is a contingency arrangement in the world. Live in-trance affective pairing -> conditioning; pure measurement -> measurement.


### antecedent-manipulation

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Change a response by editing the ANTECEDENT rather than manipulating consequences, with the behavior's function already known — edit the situation upstream so there is nothing to escape / nothing to want / no cue / no way to respond, with NO consequence ever applied (requires operator control of the antecedent variable). CORE LEVERS: (1) neutralize an aversive task antecedent (add a manipulable strategy, reduce difficulty, fade demands, errorless procedures) so the task stops carrying aversive value and escape-maintained behavior abates; (2) dissolve the motivating operation directly (make the avoided thing non-aversive) so the behavior's value drops; (3) remove the discriminative stimulus that cues the behavior so its occasion stops arising; (4) remove the stimuli/materials a competing behavior requires (discard cigarettes, clear all food) during a low-urge window. ABSORBED FACETS: (initiating-cue-substitution) don't just remove the SD — SWAP it for a different initiating cue that sets a PREFERRED chain in motion (ashtray -> TV remote), so the same context triggers an alternative sequence; (competing-reinforcer-removal) reduce/eliminate RIVAL reinforcers in the setting beforehand (cartoons) so the operator's reinforcer gains relative value and the target's salience rises for uncontested differential reinforcement; (antecedent-summation-competition) do ARITHMETIC on controlling variables — combine individually-insufficient antecedents so their additive effect crosses the evocation threshold to EVOKE a response no single antecedent could, or introduce a competing rival MO/SD to SUPPRESS by disrupting the controlling variable; (physical-topography-preclusion) make the response topography MECHANICALLY unavailable before it can occur (pre-emptive hold / antecedent restraint, noncontingent protective equipment, self-restraint) so rate drops to near zero with motivation and the maintaining contingency left intact — that noncontingent equipment works shows prevention, not punishment, carries it.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for ANTECEDENT MANIPULATION when you can change behavior by EDITING THE SITUATION UPSTREAM (remove/swap the cue, dissolve the MO, remove enabling materials, mechanically preclude the motor act, or do arithmetic on controlling variables) with NO consequence applied. Choose it over: extinction / punishment (which act on CONSEQUENCES after the response — this leaves nothing to consequate); DRI / initiating a competitor via reinforcement (consequence-side — the cue-substitution facet swaps the ANTECEDENT instead). Direction note: most facets SUPPRESS by removing an evoking condition, but antecedent-summation can also EVOKE (combine sub-threshold antecedents to cross threshold); mechanical-preclusion removes the motor possibility itself (vs suggested inability, which is a present-state move, not an antecedent edit).


**Realizations** (5): `antecedent-environment-editing`, `antecedent-summation-competition`, `competing-reinforcer-removal`, `initiating-cue-substitution`, `physical-topography-preclusion`


**See also.** `counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening` — genuine selection pair: both weaken an unwanted response without consequences, one by training an incompatible state against the eliciting stimulus, the other by editing the upstream situation so the occasion never arises. A reader deciding which lever applies benefits from the pointer.; `motivating-operation-engineering` — both are antecedent-side operations applied before any consequence, and the boundary genuinely needs stating: one changes only the momentary worth of a consequence to raise or lower the rate of everything it maintains, the other edits the situation so the cue, the materials, or the motor possibility is gone. The second explicitly lists dissolving the value as one of its levers, so the overlap is real and a reader must be told which lever they are reaching for.; `reinforcement-extinction` — both reduce a behavior once its maintaining function is known, but extinction acts on the CONSEQUENCE side (withhold the reinforcer the response already produces) while antecedent editing acts upstream so the occasion, motivation, or motor possibility never arises and there is nothing left to consequate.; `self-instruction-antecedent-training` — both edit the antecedent rather than the consequence, and the only thing separating them is who supplies it -- the subject manufacturing their own carried cue versus the operator editing the situation upstream. Without the pointer a reader will file self-cueing under situational editing and lose the control-locus distinction.


### autoclitic-training

*risk: low*

Install or strengthen an AUTOCLITIC — a secondary verbal form that comments on, modifies, or regulates the speaker's own primary verbal behavior (self-editing, self-qualifying, or telling the listener HOW to attend). Because the controlling stimulus is the learner's own transient, private verbal output, timing/access is the core difficulty. In one realization, to teach an autoclitic MAND (a louder voice / stock phrase regulating the listener's response to the learner's primary utterance), capture or contrive the listener-regulation MO, model/role-play the form, and if the MO alone fails layer a contingency-specifying prompt (CSS) atop it, then fade the prompt leaving the MO in control. In another, bring the learner's utterance under control of a feature of what they THEMSELVES just said, installing a comment-on-own-output / self-awareness layer. In a third, monitor ongoing natural speech for a self-modifier already slipping out at baseline ('that was SO big') and immediately reinforce the modifier COMPONENT specifically, not the whole utterance.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for AUTOCLITIC TRAINING when the target is a SECONDARY verbal form operating on the speaker's OWN primary utterance (a modifier/qualifier, or a mand regulating how the listener takes the utterance) — the controlling stimulus is the learner's own transient private speech, which is what makes it hard. Choose it over general verbal-operant teaching (tact/mand for external objects/states): here the acquired form regulates or comments on the learner's existing utterance rather than naming a new referent, and it presupposes the primary verbal repertoire already exists. The three facets differ only by which autoclitic and by contrived-MO vs self-referential vs in-vivo capture.


**Realizations** (2): `autoclitic-self-referential-control`, `in-vivo-autoclitic-capture`


### aversive-suppression-without-reserve-depletion

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

Deliver a mild aversive consequence contingent on a well-established response and the rate drops immediately — but only for as long as the aversive keeps arriving and the emotional reaction it provokes stays fresh. The suppression rides on an adapting emotional state, not on any change to the underlying disposition, so as the emotional reaction habituates the rate creeps back. The tell is conserved reserve: run the response to extinction afterward and the total number of responses emitted is unchanged from an unpunished control, proving the punished responses were masked and banked rather than spent. Operationally this makes positive punishment a rental, not a purchase — it buys quiet while it is being paid for and leaves the disposition intact underneath.


**When to reach for this.** The nearest shipped entries are all removal-based or competition-based, and none of them delivers an aversive. reinforcement-extinction (432) breaks the response-reinforcer relation and genuinely drains the disposition — its extinction curve is the thing being consumed, whereas here the extinction curve is what survives untouched. massed-practice-rate-suppression (1076) also attaches an effortful cost, but the subject over-emits voluntarily and the reduction is satiation/response-cost on the subject's own repetitions, not an operator-delivered consequence on a normal-rate response. counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening (1032) trains an incompatible state against an eliciting stimulus — a competing response is installed; here nothing competes and nothing is installed, the response is simply held down. disconfirmation-suppression (982) suppresses an item of information to protect a belief-dependent effect; this suppresses a behavior and makes no claim about belief. The load-bearing separator against all four is the reserve-conservation signature: only this entry predicts that the post-treatment extinction curve is identical to an untreated control.


### behavior-chaining

*risk: medium*

ASSEMBLE a multi-step behavior sequence by reinforcement, exploiting that each link's stimulus is both conditioned reinforcer for the prior response and SD for the next. Forward chaining reinforces step 1 to criterion, then withholds until 1+2, then 1+2+3 (total-task is the every-step-every-session variant); backward chaining pre-completes all but the last step, reinforces only the final step, then rolls backward, so every trial ends contacting the terminal natural reinforcer; a probe-and-skip/leap-ahead variant skips already-owned links while reinforcement still demands the whole sequence in order. Assembly DIRECTION (forward vs backward) is a structural/binding-time difference. FACETS absorbed: (chain-junction-fusion) deliberately engineers a junction so one cluster's terminal response becomes the SD for the next cluster's first response, fusing unit boundaries into one fluent sequence; (facilitative-chain-reinforcement) the intra-chain maintenance contingency where each completed step is reinforced by making the NEXT step available, so long self-guided chains hold together without external reward per link; (maintenance-probe-silent-extinction) periodically probes the ENTIRE chain to detect silent decay of mastered early links (which forward chaining stops actively reinforcing) before it collapses the chain, converting an open-loop 'mastered=stays mastered' assumption into a closed loop.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for BEHAVIOR-CHAINING to build or maintain a multi-step SEQUENCE (vs shaping, which refines a single response). Forward tell: a reinforced prefix grows front-to-back; backward tell: links added in reverse, terminal reinforcer contacted every trial; probe-and-skip tell: skipped steps still must be performed for reinforcement. The junction-fusion, facilitative-maintenance, and whole-chain-probe facets are build/maintenance parameters of one chaining program. Its OPPOSITE-direction moves — surgically severing one link, or collapsing a chain by removing the terminal payoff so decline cascades backward — are behavior-REDUCTION and live under reinforcement-extinction (chain-structured suppression), not here.


**Realizations** (4): `behavior-chain-assembly`, `chain-junction-fusion`, `facilitative-chain-reinforcement`, `maintenance-probe-silent-extinction`


### chance-pairing-self-maintaining-ritual

*risk: low*

When a reinforcer arrives on a schedule uncorrelated with anything the subject does, whatever the subject happened to be doing just beforehand gets strengthened — and because the strengthened behavior now occurs more often, it is more likely to precede the next delivery, which strengthens it again. The loop is closed by the statistics alone: the residual rate manufactures its own reinforcing coincidences, so the behavior props itself at a nonzero floor with nobody designing or maintaining it. The operator-relevant consequence is that a ritual can become durable without ever having been functional, and there is no contingency to break because there was never one to begin with. Practically this is why useless compliance rituals accrete around any procedure that dispenses reward on its own clock, and why removing 'the reason' for such a ritual does nothing.


**When to reach for this.** Every nearby closed loop in the shipped taxonomy is operator-AUTHORED; this one has no author. compounding-dependency-loop (536) is a deliberately constructed cure-feeds-disease circuit where the operator installs both the escalating state and its designated relief route. bidirectional-reentry-loop (1332) is two cues deliberately installed to fire each other, with both legs over-broadened on purpose. perpetual-obligation-ledger (506) is an operator structurally over-repaying to keep a debt open — an intentional accounting move on an inter-agent quantity, not an emergent one on a rate. failure-pre-attribution (862) pre-assigns the meaning of a null outcome; that is an interpretive frame supplied by the operator, whereas nothing here is interpreted or supplied at all. It is also distinct from the one-clause reinforcement-leak guards that tell an operator to avoid accidental pairings: those name it as a hazard to prevent, this specifies the positive-feedback structure that makes it self-sustaining, which is what an operator needs in order to recognize or deliberately seed one.


### class-collision-humor

*risk: low*

A stimulus with genuine dual equivalence-class membership is set up so the context first cues one class membership, then abruptly reverses to the other (Groucho primes 'flies' as a verb — 'time flies like an arrow' — then forces the noun reading — 'fruit flies like a banana'), steering the listener's match-to-sample response in opposing directions in quick succession. The whiplash between the two conflicting readings is what produces the humor/groan response — the operator move is the context priming-then-reversal across dual class membership, not the joke's semantic content.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from 'tell a joke' (that is content) — the tell is that the operator move is context priming-then-reversal across a genuinely multi-class stimulus. Separates from semantic reversal (which flips a term's meaning to destabilize the critical faculty in trance) — this exploits pre-existing multi-class membership and lands as humor, not absorption or bypass. Requires a stimulus with real dual class membership plus a reversible context.


### conditioned-reinforcer-manufacture

*risk: low*

Transfer reinforcing VALUE to a neutral or natural stimulus by repeated tight-contiguity pairing with an already-effective reinforcer, so the paired stimulus can then maintain or select behavior on its own AS A CONSEQUENCE. FORMS: an automatic self-reinforcer (a word emitted just before an existing reinforcer, so the subject's own production becomes self-reinforced); a precision event-marker bridging the response-to-reward delay (an invariant conditioned clicker fired at the instant of a correct approximation, enthusiasm expressed by enlarging the treat, never the marker — marker-invariance preserves its information value); a natural social reinforcer strengthened to carry behavior after artificial tokens are withdrawn (praise yoked to token delivery). GENERALIZED facet (generalized-conditioned-reinforcer): back a token with a WIDE, varied menu of currently-effective backups so it retains value across shifting satiation/deprivation states and across individuals with different preferences (motivation-independence), and protect that value by monopolizing the physical means of token production (a special pen/hole-punch/card available only to the operator) so no unearned token dilutes the supply.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for CONDITIONED-REINFORCER MANUFACTURE when you need a stimulus to acquire reinforcing FUNCTION and fire as a CONSEQUENCE that selects or maintains behavior (a marker, a token, a self-reinforcing word). Choose it over: respondent/evaluative pairing (which elicits an involuntary reflex or transfers a biasing VALENCE onto a choice target — here reinforcing function is delivered as a consequence, not affect elicited); an antecedent cue evoking a state (a covert anchor — this is consequence-side). The generalized facet's tell is BREADTH of the backup array as the source of motivation-independence plus supply-channel control as the value-integrity move; marker-invariance (scale the treat, never the marker) preserves information value.


**Realizations** (1): `generalized-conditioned-reinforcer`


**See also.** `motivating-operation-engineering` — consequence-side versus antecedent-side of the same behavioral economy: one gives a stimulus reinforcing function so it can select behavior after the fact, the other changes how much a consequence is worth before the response is evoked without delivering anything. Frequently confused in practice.


### contingency-discriminability-design

*risk: medium*

Set how DETECTABLE a behavior-consequence contingency is to the subject — a single design variable the operator drives to either pole. INDISCRIMINABLE POLE (make the contingency undetectable to force steady responding / prevent gaming): (indiscriminable-contingency) reinforce on a schedule the subject cannot discriminate — randomized delivery (spinners, dice, raffles) spread across many forms of the behavior, many settings, many rewards, so no instance is reliably non-reinforced and the exit ('the game's off, no need to respond') is removed, making the reward-optimizing policy 'act the targeted way across every domain'; (indiscriminable-reinforcement-schedule) a variable (VR) schedule the subject cannot COUNT, eliminating post-reinforcement pauses; (contingency-target-concealment) in a GROUP contingency, randomize/conceal which student/behavior/reinforcer counts (often drawn after performance) to defeat scapegoating and strategic under-responding; (reinforcement-thinning-boundary-erasure) step the schedule down before probes so the learner cannot discriminate training from test by reinforcer presence — an indiscriminability move for MEASUREMENT validity (keeps probe responding from differential extinction). TRANSPARENT POLE (make the contingency maximally discriminable so behavior attaches to the act, not confusion): (contingency-transparency-arrangement) pre-define the response class in observable terms with positive examples AND nonexamples, post the standing rules (duration, exit criteria, escalation) as a continuously-visible discriminative stimulus, and give a terminal transition prompt near the interval's end.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for CONTINGENCY-DISCRIMINABILITY DESIGN when the lever is the subject's ability to DETECT the contingency — set it opaque (VR/randomized/concealed-target/erased-boundary) to force steady responding, prevent counting or gaming, or protect probe validity; set it transparent (defined class + posted rules + transition prompt) so behavior attaches to the act rather than confusion. Choose it over: reward-magnitude moves / multiplier-stacking (which amplify a reward — here the manipulated variable is detectability, not size); a fixed cue-response pairing (a randomizer/visibility choice, not a set pairing). The two poles are the same design variable driven opposite directions; the group-target-concealment variant is the social/anti-scapegoating case, distinct from schedule-level indiscriminability.


**Realizations** (4): `contingency-target-concealment`, `contingency-transparency-arrangement`, `indiscriminable-reinforcement-schedule`, `reinforcement-thinning-boundary-erasure`


**See also.** `discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement` — both are about how a cue or contingency becomes detectable to the subject, and one explicitly manipulates discriminability of the reinforcement schedule while the other builds control by a reinforcement history. A reader designing stimulus control genuinely needs to know that detectability of the contingency is a separate lever they can set opaque or transparent.; `reinforcement-leak-proofing` — both are design levers on the same arranged contingency and are explicitly disjoint: one closes off every path by which reinforcement can arrive outside the arrangement, the other sets how detectable the arrangement is to the subject. Readers arranging a contingency routinely need to place a move on the correct axis.


### contingency-function-substrate-principles

*risk: medium*

Design principles about how behavioral FUNCTION is determined by the contingency arrangement itself — not deployable moves so much as constraints that govern every other contingency-engineering technique. (function-by-contingency-arrangement) a stimulus's behavioral function is a property of the ARRANGEMENT, not of the stimulus, so ONE identical stimulus can be scheduled into multiple functions by changing its relations rather than introducing new stimuli — a single aversive stimulus serves as negative reinforcer (termination), punisher (presentation), or motivating operation (presentation-as-MO) by onset/offset/timing; a single conditioned token reinforces, punishes (response cost), signals, or evokes by how its relations are arranged (function is REASSIGNED, not created). (stimulus-delta-leverage) behavioral leverage lives in stimulus CHANGE — the operative event is the transition (absence-of-tone -> tone); onsets, offsets, and contrasts against a baseline carry control while a maintained ambient condition is near-inert, so manipulate deltas, not standing states. (consequence-onset-detectability-bound) a function-altering (consequence) effect requires a detectable ONSET edge — a state whose onset is too gradual to read as a discrete event-following-a-response acts only as an antecedent motivator and cannot punish or reinforce what it follows, even when the same event with a sharp onset could.


**When to reach for this.** This entry collects cross-cutting DESIGN PRINCIPLES that constrain how any contingency-engineering technique works — reach for it as reference when deciding how to schedule a stimulus's function, where to place leverage (transitions vs standing states), or whether an event's onset is sharp enough to function as a consequence. Distinct from the deployable techniques (pairing CREATES a reinforcer; these principles say function is REASSIGNED by arrangement, leverage lives in the delta, and consequences need a detectable onset). Not itself a cue install, a contingency arrangement, or a subject-facing move — it is the substrate the others are built on.


**Realizations** (2): `consequence-onset-detectability-bound`, `stimulus-delta-leverage`


### counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening

*risk: medium*

Weaken an aversive or interfering stimulus's control over a response by pairing/training an INCOMPATIBLE state or response against it, or by severing the cue-to-response link — so a stimulus that used to evoke fear/refusal/an unwanted behavior stops doing so.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for COUNTERCONDITIONING / CUE-RESPONSE WEAKENING when a specific stimulus reliably evokes an aversive or interfering RESPONSE (fear, refusal reflex, an automatic behavior) and you want that stimulus to stop evoking it — by graded approach under an incompatible state, a competing response rehearsed under arousal, or decoupling the cue from the response. Choose it over: extinction (removes a reinforcer maintaining an OPERANT — here the target is an elicited/occasion-set response, and the cue's own charge may be left intact); DRI (reinforces an incompatible competitor via consequences — here the lever is a paired incompatible STATE or a trained noticing, graded to the eliciting stimulus); relaxation/absorption inductions (which ride a calm state to build absorption from baseline — here the aversive state is deliberately contacted/raised and displaced). Facets differ by graded-exposure vs sub-threshold-property-fade vs evoke-then-compete vs notice-and-let-pass.


**Realizations** (3): `evoke-then-somatic-redirect`, `private-event-response-decoupling`, `sub-threshold-aversion-fade`


**See also.** `antecedent-manipulation` — genuine selection pair: both weaken an unwanted response without consequences, one by training an incompatible state against the eliciting stimulus, the other by editing the upstream situation so the occasion never arises. A reader deciding which lever applies benefits from the pointer.; `discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement` — both are cue-and-response procedures that a reader can easily mis-select between. One builds a cue's evocative control over an already-emittable voluntary response through reinforcement history. The other tears down a stimulus's control over an aversive or interfering response by pairing an incompatible state against it or severing the link. Building antecedent control and dismantling it are the two directions of the same axis, and the entries' own boundary notes lean on each other.; `reinforcement-extinction` — adjacent behavior-reduction procedures that each name the other as the alternative to choose against - removing the reinforcer that maintains an operant versus pairing an incompatible state against an eliciting cue. Practitioner-facing selection depends on reading both.


### covert-provocation-confederate-rescue

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Instead of announced role-play, the operator behaves so as to actually drive the subject into the genuine problem state without revealing the frame (throwing the timid client out of the office); a pre-arranged confederate happens to be present, gains total rapport on the rebound, and programs the coping response. Because the new learning attaches to the genuinely evoked state rather than a pretend rehearsal state, it transfers when future-paced instead of staying a rehearsal.


**When to reach for this.** The frame is never announced (the provocation is made to feel real) AND a staged confederate supplies the rescue-and-program on the rebound; not overt role-play, announced practice, or in-session future-pacing of an imagined scene.


### data-extraction-objective

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

An objective-level whole-script property in which the terminal payload EXTRACTS information out of the listener (a confession email framed as 'the most effective methods of controlling and manipulating you') for the operator to reuse in designing future trance — rather than installing a trigger/identity/loop INTO the listener. Compliance is framed as feedstock for a recursive external loop (trance yields data, data designs the next trance), and the manipulation is named openly as something the listener wants, which may itself be harder to resist than concealment. The lever is reversing the direction of the payload: harvest, not install.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from every install-type payload (trigger, identity, loop) because the terminal move takes data OUT rather than putting a mechanism IN — the tell is the explicit recursive external loop (harvested data used to design future sessions) and the open naming of the manipulation as desired. Distinct from in-session information-gathering that serves the current session; here the data outlives the recording.


### derived-relations-installation

*risk: medium*

For a verbally/relationally capable learner, arrange a training history so that teaching a proper SUBSET of a repertoire causes an untaught, larger repertoire to EMERGE with no direct instruction — the target function/class/relation is never itself taught, paired, or labeled; it falls out for free from a relational structure the learner already runs. The lever is generative leverage (a small trained core multiplies into responses never directly reinforced), and emergence is typically certified by an EXTINCTION PROBE (novel never-reinforced combinations presented with no consequences). Forms (differing in which generative structure carries the emergence): (derived-relations-installation) state overlapping base relations declaratively, or train two links of a chain so the third collapses out, or order probes by nodal distance; (emergent-relations-harvest) teach a minimal spanning subset of conditional discriminations, harvest reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity closure under extinction probe; (derived-relation-training-protocol) hold a relation-TYPE constant across trials so untrained relations of that type derive, or factor-train-recombine a composite; (derived-relations-recombination) AB+BC yields symmetry/transitivity and matrix recombinations; (generative-instruction-emergent-repertoire) teach a subset to FLUENCY (contingency adduction) or exploit a naming cusp; (generative-substrate-training) install a component-repertoire SET (echoic/tact/listener/self-listener) so novel mands/tacts emerge once the substrate is jointly present, plus superimposition transfer; (class-expansion-node-grafting) teach ONE link touching an existing equivalence class so it grows/fuses combinatorially (80 relations from 16 trained); (compound-sample-class-expansion) a compound sample DECOMPOSES into independently matchable members; (matrix-recombinative-training) a crossed matrix yields untaught cells; (recombinant-carrier-frame) a carrier frame + swappable slot recombine into never-trained utterances; (bidirectional-naming-via-self-echoic-repetition) train one direction, self-chant supplies the reverse via contiguity; (interleaved-repertoire-training) interleave listener/speaker on a shared referent set to force bidirectional generativity; (emergent-relation-bootstrapping) substitute a cheaper base (exclusion / simple-discrimination) then harvest emergent classes; (class-wide-function-transfer) teach one evaluative relation to a category name so every member and derived-equivalent class inherits the function; (perspective-taking-training-repertoire) a graded deictic single/double-reversal curriculum builds perspective-taking as a durable RFT skill.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for DERIVED / GENERATIVE-RELATIONS TRAINING when you want a LARGE relational/verbal repertoire but will directly teach only a small spanning subset and let emergence supply the rest — the payload is emergence-without-training (untaught relations appearing), certified under extinction probe. Choose it over: discrimination / stimulus-control training, which trains each discrimination DIRECTLY trial by trial (its four-term match-to-sample trial is the atomic unit THIS design is built from — the line is trial-level direct training vs design-level harvest of untaught closure); direct pairing/association (the stimulus contacts a reinforcer — here the target is never contacted or labeled); ordered lesson-structure encoding (delivers taught content for retention — here new relations are DERIVED, not exposited). The forms differ only in which generative structure carries the emergence (equivalence closure / fluency / naming cusp / matrix / carrier-frame / node-graft / cheaper-base / deictic reversals).


**Realizations** (14): `bidirectional-naming-via-self-echoic-repetition`, `class-expansion-node-grafting`, `class-wide-function-transfer`, `compound-sample-class-expansion`, `derived-relation-training-protocol`, `derived-relations-recombination`, `emergent-relation-bootstrapping`, `emergent-relations-harvest`, `generative-instruction-emergent-repertoire`, `generative-substrate-training`, `interleaved-repertoire-training`, `matrix-recombinative-training`, `perspective-taking-training-repertoire`, `recombinant-carrier-frame`


**See also.** `discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement` — a deliberate design-level contrast that both discriminators already carry: one trains each discrimination directly, trial by trial, and its four-term trial is the atomic unit the other is built from; the other teaches only a spanning subset and harvests untaught relations, certified under extinction probe. The link is close to mandatory for correct selection.; `relational-emergence-probe` — one is the measurement arrangement that certifies untaught responses under extinction; the other is the training design whose payload is exactly those untaught responses. The probe is how the installation is verified, so each entry is incomplete without pointing at the other.


### differential-reinforcement

*risk: medium*

Change a behavior's rate by reinforcing SOMETHING OTHER than the target behavior in its problem form — its own absence/low-rate, an incompatible or alternative response, or a richer concurrent option — rather than removing all reinforcement (extinction) or delivering it free (NCR). One parametric technique across schedules (DRO/DRL/DRI/DRA + concurrent-choice); the schedule chosen sets which 'other' behavior earns reinforcement. Realizations: (DRO) reinforce the target's ABSENCE — momentary DRO samples only at an interval's end (trades suppression strength for monitoring cost), VI-DRO uses an unpredictable window, finite-license/coupon forms convert an unspent budget to bonus; a leak-guard form conditions delivery on absence of the WHOLE undesirable set and/or shortens the interval so a co-occurring substitute is not adventitiously reinforced; (DRL) reinforce the behavior's own occurrence only when its count stays at/under a criterion (spaced-responding DRL gives per-response reset feedback; interval DRL is a weaker two-stage form), keeping a desirable-in-small-doses behavior alive, optionally with a depleting token board; (DRI — differential reinforcement of incompatible behavior) reinforce a topographically INCOMPATIBLE competitor (silence vs noise, slack vs taut leash) that cannot co-occur; (DRA/FCT — functional reinforcer rerouting) a distinct deployment: a functional assessment identifies the maintaining reinforcer, then an alternative behavior is engineered to produce the SAME reinforcer more efficiently (teach a sign/card/'break' request; DNRA delivers escape for the alternative while the problem behavior gets escape extinction; an effort-undercut form makes the alternative cost less response effort); (graded concurrent choice) stage several concurrently-signaled options with graded payoffs (problem behavior pays worst but still works, task pays best) and raise the demand for the best over time; (rate-differential allocation) two concurrent schedules where the alternative pays richer/faster/more reliably so allocation shifts per the matching law, out-competing rather than blocking the problem behavior.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for DIFFERENTIAL REINFORCEMENT when you want to reduce (or replace) a behavior by paying SOMETHING ELSE — its absence/low-rate (DRO/DRL), an incompatible competitor (DRI), a same-reinforcer alternative (DRA/FCT), or a richer concurrent option — while keeping some reinforcement flowing. Choose it over: extinction (removes the reinforcer entirely, no alternative paid); NCR (delivers the reinforcer free on a time schedule with no behavioral contingency). Internal deployment fork: DRO/DRL reinforce the TARGET's own absence/low-rate; DRI/DRA reinforce a SEPARATE response class (DRA additionally requires a functional assessment and preserves the identified reinforcer, rerouting it — the one facet with a meaningfully distinct precondition); concurrent-choice/matching arms retain a degraded payoff for the problem behavior and win by relative payoff, not withholding.


**Realizations** (6): `differential-reinforcement-of-incompatible-behavior`, `functional-reinforcer-rerouting`, `graded-concurrent-choice-architecture`, `omission-contingency-leak-guard`, `omission-reinforcement-dro`, `rate-differential-allocation`


**See also.** `noncontingent-reinforcement` — sibling behavioral-schedule techniques that each name the other as the choice to rule out: one reinforces something other than the target behavior, the other delivers the maintaining reinforcer on a time schedule with no contingency at all. The contingency-versus-no-contingency fork is exactly the decision a reader needs.; `reinforcement-leak-proofing` — disjoint levers on the same arranged contingency: one decides that nothing outside the contingency pays, the other decides which other behaviour earns reinforcement. Both are commonly needed together and each entry already gestures at the other's territory.


### discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement

*risk: low*

Build ANTECEDENT (stimulus) control by differential reinforcement: reinforce the target response in the presence of a discriminative stimulus and withhold/degrade it in the SD's absence until responding concentrates under the SD and drops under S-delta. The cue's control is a product of the reinforcement HISTORY, not any intrinsic property; the SD is permissive (raises rate) not coercive. Realizations: (discriminative-stimulus-occasion-setting) the plain single-cue product — a cue signalling responding will now pay off; (audience-as-discriminative-stimulus) audience identity as an SD via a differential history across audiences, selecting emitted verbal content; (match-to-sample-contingency / matching-to-sample-relational-training) four-term MTS with a mandatory observing response + anti-recency rotation, so the correct comparison is conditional on the sample (a RELATION, not a fixed mapping) — the atomic trial the derived-relations harvest design is built from; (conditional-discrimination-four-term-contingency) the contingency-structure statement of that same four-term unit (sample selects which three-term unit is live); (contextual-function-selection) the five-term extension where a higher-order context cue gates WHICH conditional relation is reinforced while every relation stays live; (multiple-exemplar-concept-training) trains a concept/class boundary by reinforcing responding across varied nondefining features with non-exemplar contrast; (precursor-discrimination-training) trains discrimination of a target behavior and its ONSET to an accuracy criterion (product = a detection repertoire); (prerequisite-discrimination-gate) installs the observer's discrimination of a model's consequence first, as the bottleneck for observational learning. COMPOUND/CONVERGENT CONTROL facets (control the parts lack until they coincide): (convergent-multi-cue-control) conjunctive LRFFC control across function/feature/class; (convergent-multiple-control) a verbal antecedent stacked on a nonverbal one to DISAMBIGUATE among latent answers; (converging-cue-recall-lift) correlated cues added to LIFT a sub-threshold response a weak SD alone cannot pull; (joint-compound-stimulus-control) two already-controlling antecedents converge and the match itself becomes a new SD.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for DISCRIMINATION / STIMULUS CONTROL when you want a cue to GAIN evocative control over an already-emittable voluntary response through a reinforcement HISTORY (reinforce-in-presence / extinguish-in-absence is load-bearing). Choose it over: respondent/evaluative pairing (Pavlovian NS+US eliciting an INVOLUNTARY response — here voluntary responding is consequated); motivating-operation engineering (produces an MO / value shift, not a discriminated operant); a declared/verbal trigger install (installs a cue-response pair by declaration, no schedule); derived/generative-relations training (teaches a subset and HARVESTS untaught closure — this trains the discriminations directly, trial by trial). The compound-control facets differ only in WHY multiple antecedents are stacked: conjunctive (all must be satisfied), disambiguation (select among rival answers), weak-cue lift (pull a sub-threshold response), or convergence-as-new-SD.


**Realizations** (13): `audience-as-discriminative-stimulus`, `conditional-discrimination-four-term-contingency`, `contextual-function-selection`, `convergent-multi-cue-control`, `convergent-multiple-control`, `converging-cue-recall-lift`, `discriminative-stimulus-occasion-setting`, `joint-compound-stimulus-control`, `match-to-sample-contingency`, `matching-to-sample-relational-training`, `multiple-exemplar-concept-training`, `precursor-discrimination-training`, `prerequisite-discrimination-gate`


**See also.** `contingency-discriminability-design` — both are about how a cue or contingency becomes detectable to the subject, and one explicitly manipulates discriminability of the reinforcement schedule while the other builds control by a reinforcement history. A reader designing stimulus control genuinely needs to know that detectability of the contingency is a separate lever they can set opaque or transparent.; `counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening` — both are cue-and-response procedures that a reader can easily mis-select between. One builds a cue's evocative control over an already-emittable voluntary response through reinforcement history. The other tears down a stimulus's control over an aversive or interfering response by pairing an incompatible state against it or severing the link. Building antecedent control and dismantling it are the two directions of the same axis, and the entries' own boundary notes lean on each other.; `derived-relations-installation` — a deliberate design-level contrast that both discriminators already carry: one trains each discrimination directly, trial by trial, and its four-term trial is the atomic unit the other is built from; the other teaches only a spanning subset and harvests untaught relations, certified under extinction probe. The link is close to mandatory for correct selection.; `reinforcement-leak-proofing` — complementary levers on one contingency: one builds a cue's control by reinforcing in its presence and withholding in its absence, the other closes every path by which reinforcement reaches the behavior outside the arranged contingency. Discrimination training fails outright if the leaks are open, so a reader working on either needs the other.; `scaffold-fade-control-transfer` — adjacent halves of stimulus control: one builds cue control through a reinforce-in-presence, withhold-in-absence history; the other moves existing control to the natural cue by fading an added support. Anyone selecting between them needs the pair.; `shaping-successive-approximation` — complementary halves of the same differential-reinforcement engine, and the boundary is easy to get wrong: one differentiates the ANTECEDENT (a cue gains control through reinforce-in-presence / withhold-in-absence), the other differentiates the RESPONSE (a moving reinforced window builds a behavior that does not yet exist). A reader reaching for either should confirm which side of that line their case falls on.


### massed-practice-rate-suppression

*risk: low*

The subject deliberately over-emits the undesired behavior far beyond any functional occasion (a compulsive checker performs the full 13-step ritual five times for every real check), attaching an effortful or aversive cost — satiation or response-cost, left unstated — so its future rate declines. A counterintuitive increase-emission-to-reduce-rate move.


**When to reach for this.** Versus incompatible-response substitution, this repeats the SAME behavior on purpose, too much, rather than replacing it with an alternative. And versus repetition used to strengthen — verbatim looping that drives material deeper into encoding, or sustained endurance compliance that deepens the trance state — massed practice repeats the behavior specifically to REDUCE its future rate.


### motivating-operation-engineering

*risk: medium*

Bring a response under MOTIVATIONAL rather than prompt control by shifting the momentary VALUE of a consequence BEFORE the response is evoked, then evoking the response that obtains it. Value moves UP by an establishing operation or DOWN by an abolishing operation (satiation); nothing is delivered — only the momentary value is engineered, raising or lowering the rate of every behavior that reinforcer maintains. The primary fork is CAPTURE (exploit a value change the environment already supplied) vs CONTRIVE (produce one on demand). Realizations: (captured motivating operation) watch for collateral behavior signalling an object's value spontaneously rose and insert a teaching trial at that potent moment; (transitive mand gate-block) present item A that makes item B instrumentally valuable, then block access to B and teach the unblock response — a transitive conditioned MO via a standing means-end relation plus operator-controlled access; (chain-interruption evocation) interrupt a running chain at the point a needed element is missing so the incompletion spikes motivation for the repair mand (the interrupt-the-chain transitive-CMO route); (MO-override of stimulus control) push an MO high enough that an in-repertoire behavior generalizes beyond its trained SD, broadening the range of evoking stimuli with no new training; (conditioned motivation by pairing) pair a neutral cue with a motivating state / reinforcer / aversive until the cue alone reproduces the value-altering effect — a SURROGATE CMO manufacturing wanting (appetitive) or avoidance (aversive), the operator selecting valence by the correlation history. Satiation/aversion overshoot is the failure mode.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for MOTIVATING-OPERATION ENGINEERING when you want to change how MUCH a consequence is worth right now (raising or lowering the rate of all behavior it maintains) WITHOUT delivering anything — an antecedent value move, decided via the capture-vs-contrive fork. Choose it over: direct reward conditioning (which DELIVERS a reinforcer contingent on an act — this pre-sets its worth); chain-collapse's satiation route (the abolishing-operation twin used to DEVALUE-and-suppress — MO engineering here establishes value to EVOKE); respondent/evaluative pairing (which elicits an involuntary reflex/affect — the surrogate-CMO pairing facet here produces a value-altering MO, i.e. manufactured wanting/avoidance, not a triggered response). The mand facets of verbal-operant teaching TEACH the ask; this engineers the value the ask rides on.


**Realizations** (7): `captured-motivating-operation`, `chain-interruption-evocation`, `conditioned-motivation-by-pairing`, `mo-override-stimulus-control`, `motivating-operation-value-shift`, `staged-motivation-engineering`, `transitive-mand-gate-block`


**See also.** `antecedent-manipulation` — both are antecedent-side operations applied before any consequence, and the boundary genuinely needs stating: one changes only the momentary worth of a consequence to raise or lower the rate of everything it maintains, the other edits the situation so the cue, the materials, or the motor possibility is gone. The second explicitly lists dissolving the value as one of its levers, so the overlap is real and a reader must be told which lever they are reaching for.; `conditioned-reinforcer-manufacture` — consequence-side versus antecedent-side of the same behavioral economy: one gives a stimulus reinforcing function so it can select behavior after the fact, the other changes how much a consequence is worth before the response is evoked without delivering anything. Frequently confused in practice.


### negative-punishment-timeout

*risk: medium · bounded*

Immediately contingent on the target behavior, the operator withdraws the subject's opportunity to earn positive reinforcers or removes access to currently-available ones for a bounded interval; the subject ends the interval only by waiting it out or meeting exit criteria. Future frequency of the producing behavior drops because the moment of misbehavior reliably costs a window of good things. No new skill is taught — the lever is pure suppression, and it works only when the time-in environment is already reinforcing and the withdrawal is immediate and contingent. Defined by its suppressive effect, not by any topology.


**When to reach for this.** Withdraws the opportunity to earn or access reinforcers for an interval, distinct from response cost which levies a fine against already-held reinforcers. If the producing behavior's future frequency does not drop, it is not punishment at all — that effect-defined suppression is the tell versus any surface-similar removal.


**See also.** `response-cost-token-economy` — textbook siblings inside subtractive suppression, separated by whether a not-yet-earned opportunity is withheld for an interval or a reinforcer the subject already holds is debited per instance. Each already defines itself against the other, so the cross-link is load-bearing.


### negative-reinforcement-escape-compliance

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Make TERMINATION (escape) or prevention (avoidance) of an already-present aversive condition contingent on a target response: the subject raises the response to turn the aversive off or keep it from onset, and the reinforcer is the RELIEF itself, not an added reward. Severity scales effort (relief from a strong aversive can outweigh a comparable positive reward). The operator selects WHAT aversive the response escapes. REALIZATIONS by aversive source: (escape-from-aversive-reinforcement) the base case — a pre-existing aversive the response terminates/prevents; (escape-based-compliance) make the INSTRUCTION itself aversive by escalating instructional pressure (prompts, re-issue, error-correction) on non-response, so complying brings relief (the operator may run this without recognizing it); (aversive-antecedent-contingency) open a mild social-aversive interval (awkwardness, a pending obligation to respond) that responding terminates and not-responding worsens, compliance experienced as escape; (coercive-demand-form-selection) cast the want as a COMMAND supplemented with an added aversive whose removal negatively reinforces compliance — the coercive pole of demand-form selection (defined by the backing contingency, not the imperative grammar; the willing-listener pole is a praise-reinforced request with no aversive).


**When to reach for this.** Reach for NEGATIVE REINFORCEMENT / ESCAPE COMPLIANCE when the response is maintained by RELIEF from an already-present aversive (the response turns it off or prevents it), not by an added reward. Choose it over: positive reinforcement (adds a reward — here nothing is added, an aversive is removed); punishment (reduces a behavior — this INCREASES the target response by relieving an aversive); response-cost / time-out (subtract or withhold a positive — here an aversive is added-then-escaped). The realizations differ only by the aversive SOURCE (a pre-existing aversive / escalating instructional pressure / a social-awkwardness interval / an aversive backing a command). Often unrecognized — the operator may believe they are reinforcing positively while running an escape contingency.


**Realizations** (3): `aversive-antecedent-contingency`, `coercive-demand-form-selection`, `escape-based-compliance`


**See also.** `relief-monopoly-dependency` — the relief-monopoly entry is an applied case of the escape contingency: distress is manufactured or intensified, then compliance is made the unique route to relief, so the response is maintained by relief rather than an added reward. Naming the underlying schedule helps a reader see why the monopoly form is so durable.


### negotiation-frame-forfeit-challenge

*risk: low*

An operator-side, inter-agent move: when parties claim no alternatives exist and the process stalls, the operator puts the continuation of the process ITSELF on the line — making further participation explicitly conditional ("is there any basis to continue? I won't waste my time") rather than setting a consequence inside the negotiation. The threatened forfeit of the whole frame forces each party to either reveal a genuine positive intention (re-motivating the invested) or expose a concealed agenda (so the work can honestly stop). Both branches are useful; the lever is the credible willingness to end the engagement, not a deadline or penalty within it.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from ordinary consequence-setting / deadline pressure (those raise the cost of a move INSIDE the frame; this threatens the frame's existence) and from consent-manufacture (nobody's refusal channel is eroded — the constraint lands on the operator's own continued participation and on the parties' honesty about intent). The tell is challenging the very basis for continuing, specifically to smoke out whether real intention exists.


### noncontingent-reinforcement

*risk: low*

Deliver the maintaining reinforcer on a fixed-time schedule INDEPENDENT of the behavior, so the reinforcer the problem behavior used to produce is now free on the clock and the behavior loses the motivation to produce it. In the escape variant, breaks from a demand are handed out pre-emptively on a fixed-time schedule before the subject acts out, decoupling escape from misbehavior so the task is experienced as interruptible-by-default (compliance rises, disruptive escape falls). ABSORBED GUARD (ncr-competition-discrepancy): for NCR to actually suppress, the free source must OUT-COMPETE the earned one — increase amount/quality and densify the schedule so it exceeds baseline rate, and typically pair with extinction; if free and earned reinforcement merely MATCH, the subject keeps working for the earned one and NCR does nothing (the named failure mode).


**When to reach for this.** Versus extinction (removes the reinforcer) and DRO (reinforces omission); the tell is the maintaining reinforcer is still DELIVERED but on a time schedule with no behavioral contingency. The escape variant's tell is that the free reinforcer is scheduled task-removal, not an appetitive item.


**Realizations** (1): `ncr-competition-discrepancy`


**See also.** `differential-reinforcement` — sibling behavioral-schedule techniques that each name the other as the choice to rule out: one reinforces something other than the target behavior, the other delivers the maintaining reinforcer on a time schedule with no contingency at all. The contingency-versus-no-contingency fork is exactly the decision a reader needs.; `reinforcement-leak-proofing` — two disjoint levers on the same arranged contingency that are routinely deployed together: closing every unintended path by which the maintaining reinforcer can still be obtained, and delivering that same reinforcer freely on a time schedule. The second is explicitly noted to need the first to work.


### operator-gated-release-and-state-access

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Transfer control of a wanted somatic resource (orgasm, genital touch) or a wanted internal STATE to the operator by installing an access contingency whose only key is operator-defined — the listener keeps motor ability but cannot LEGITIMATELY release or re-enter, so every moment of compliance is renewed obedience and the locus of control over the resource moves to the operator. REALIZATIONS: (operator-gated-release-lock) gate orgasm/touch behind an operator command or reframe it as the listener's own incapacity (conditional grammar 'unless/until given the command', a 'psychological chastity device' positional reframe, a 'too blank to decide' self-state justification), and where the opening command is deliberately withheld the loop seals shut; (operator-gated-release-with-personal-best-ratchet) enumerate exit-conditions all routing back to the operator's ecosystem (a new personal-best chastity duration, completing another of the operator's recordings, explicit blessing), with a MONOTONIC personal-best ratchet raising the bar each successful release plus a forward consumption obligation — a permission interlock engineering a self-lengthening compliance trajectory; (withheld-faculty-debt-leash) declare the faculty already SEIZED and operator-held (fait-accompli / dropped-keys framing that removes any opt-in moment), returnable only on full compliance and completion — confiscation-and-conditional-return, often riding a safety-clause subversion; (asymmetric-state-ratchet) install a one-way rule on a pleasure MAGNITUDE (down=build, up=pause-not-reverse) so it ratchets monotonically and the listener cannot return to baseline by any action of their own; (re-access-gate) gate RE-ENTRY into a previously-installed desirable state on the subject first performing an out-of-session compliance task (purchase + ritual + obeying), harnessing the wish to return as homework enforcement.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for OPERATOR-GATED RELEASE / STATE-ACCESS when control over a wanted somatic resource (orgasm/touch) or a wanted state is TRANSFERRED to the operator via an access contingency whose key is operator-defined, motor ability left intact — so not-releasing/not-re-entering is renewed obedience. Choose it over: motor-inhibition convincers (which install an actual INABILITY to move — here the ability remains, only legitimacy is gated); trance-exit gating (which gates leaving trance, not a somatic release or state re-entry); a flat orgasm PROHIBITION (a rule to obey — these transfer the DECISION/access via lock, enumerated interlock, confiscation-debt, a one-way magnitude ratchet, or a homework-gated re-access). SAFETY: high risk, requires explicit consent and bounding — these erode the subject's own release/refusal channel and several reach out of session.


**Realizations** (4): `asymmetric-state-ratchet`, `operator-gated-release-with-personal-best-ratchet`, `re-access-gate`, `withheld-faculty-debt-leash`


**See also.** `asymmetric-state-lock` — both hand a key to the operator, but the gated-access lever monopolizes a wanted somatic release or a state's re-entry while the state-lock monopolizes the state's exit, so one withholds getting in and the other withholds getting out.; `cross-media-forced-continuation` — b is a narrow special case of A's confiscation-and-conditional-return form: the withheld faculty's unlock key is relocated onto consuming another operator's recording. Worth linking as the external-product variant of operator-gated access, not merged, because A's key stays inside the operator's own ecosystem while B's whole point is the hand-off outward.; `induced-incapacity-to-operator-dependency` — both move the decision about release from the listener to the operator, one by installing an access contingency whose key is operator-defined while motor ability remains, the other by manufacturing a decision-incapable state so an external decider is structurally required. Closely related routes to the same dependency.; `operator-gated-persistence` — genuinely useful adjacency: both hand the operator the key to something the listener wants back, and the practical question a reader faces is what is gated. One gates a somatic resource or a wanted state that never fully arrives without operator permission; the other gates the teardown of an already-installed persistent state. A script that locks release and then makes clearance contingent on further listening runs both, so the pointer helps.


### peripheral-first-inhibition-spread

*risk: medium · bounded*

An unwanted response is removed by never working on it directly. The operator trains non-reinforced discrimination at cues maximally distant from the target along a similarity or spatial dimension, then moves stepwise inward — nearer neighbours, then nearer still — and lets the accumulated inhibition spread to the target, which is treated last or not at all. The ordering is the whole technique: because the defended cue is never contacted while it is still defended, the subject has no occasion to mount the protection that direct extinction work would trigger, and by the time the sequence arrives the target sits inside a field of neighbours that already fail to produce the response.


**When to reach for this.** The operator's activity is concentrated on the target cue's NEIGHBOURS and the target is worked last or never, with suppression arriving by generalization along the similarity dimension. Against counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening (1032), which is the same dimension traversed the other way: its graded-exposure facet APPROACHES the eliciting stimulus under an incompatible state and its sub-threshold-property-fade works a property of the target cue itself — both contact the target, this retreats from it. Against reinforcement-extinction (432), which requires every maintaining source to be enumerated and cut AT the target: here the target's contingency is never touched. Against antecedent-manipulation (1052), which removes the cue so the occasion stops arising: here the target cue remains fully available throughout. The falsifying test is the tell — stop the sequence before reaching the target and probe it; if responding is unchanged, no spread occurred and there is no technique.


### positive-punishment-aversive-presentation

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Make the target behaviour PRODUCE a strong aversive consequence, delivered contingent on the response, so emission rate falls and the behaviour is held at or near zero. Nothing is withheld and nothing is debited — something bad is added, and the suppression is sustained by the aversive contingency's continued presence rather than by any depletion. This is what makes the move parametrically different from every subtractive neighbour: lift the contingency and responding returns, because the underlying strength was never spent, only held down. The operator therefore owns an on/off switch on the response with no accumulating progress, and the reserve that would have to be drained for durable change stays full underneath.


**When to reach for this.** This fills the empty cell in the contingency 2x2 — ADD an aversive to suppress — that reinforcement-extinction's own discriminator already points at when it says to choose extinction over 'punishment (delivers an aversive)'. vs reinforcement-extinction: extinction breaks the response-reinforcer link and lets rate decline toward baseline by depleting the reserve, with nothing aversive delivered; here the reserve is untouched and suppression lasts exactly as long as the aversive contingency is in force. vs negative-punishment-timeout: that WITHDRAWS the opportunity to earn reinforcers for a bounded interval — subtractive, and the subject waits it out; this presents an aversive per response with no interval to serve. vs removal-from-reinforcement-timeout: also removal-based, distinguished on the same axis, and its bounded-interval and exit-gating parameters have no analogue here. vs response-cost-token-economy: that debits an already-held reserve of positive reinforcers, which requires a stockpile to fine against — this needs no reserve and works on a subject who holds nothing. vs resistance-penalty-contingency: that attaches an aversive specifically to RESISTING, thinking, or waiting, poisoning the exit path — here the aversive attaches to the target operant itself, whatever it is, with no resistance framing.


### precommitment-rule-governed-stakes

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Bind the FUTURE self in advance, during a low-temptation window, by restructuring the contingency so the later self cannot easily defect — pre-committing an irreversible act or a pre-set stake whose anticipated outcome (a rule-governed analog) controls present behavior across the delay a literal operant contingency could not bridge. FORMS: (future-self-precommitment) perform an IRREVERSIBLE or costly-to-reverse act while a tempting smaller-sooner reward is still temporally distant and discounted below the larger-later outcome (locking the cigarette case, early-month payroll savings, Odysseus at the mast), removing or penalizing the future impulsive choice before temptation peaks; soft pattern-over-days commitments are the same mechanism at a longer horizon; (self-imposed-penalty-commitment) pre-arrange a fixed penalty ( to a friend) on any day the target behavior fails a criterion, with a TRUSTWORTHY THIRD PARTY holding the stakes so it is non-self-waivable; (rule-governed-delayed-stakes) pre-commit a sizable, somewhat-delayed aversive tied to a behavioral limit (forfeit money to a despised cause for exceeding a cap; avoid a fine by exercising by midnight), a despised recipient sharpening the stake.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for PRECOMMITMENT / RULE-GOVERNED STAKES when you want to control a LATER behavior by binding the future self NOW — an irreversible act or a pre-set non-waivable stake set before temptation peaks, working across a delay. Choose it over: self-instruction/self-cueing (which supplies an antecedent that EVOKES the next response — precommitment FORECLOSES or penalizes the choice, foreclosure vs evocation being the structural line); self-administered contingency (which relocates the ongoing measurement-consequence ADMINISTRATOR role into the subject — precommitment arranges ONE future contingency, not an ongoing loop); an in-the-moment refusal / willpower act (precommitment is a separate act done in advance on the contingency structure). Facets differ by irreversible-act vs external-stakeholder-penalty vs delayed-aversive-stake.


**Realizations** (2): `rule-governed-delayed-stakes`, `self-imposed-penalty-commitment`


**See also.** `rehearsed-pre-commitment` — both bind a future self by acting upstream of the moment of execution. One does it with an irreversible act or non-waivable stake that forecloses the later choice; the other by obtaining genuine consent and rehearsal while judgment is intact. Foreclosure versus pre-made decision.


### reinforcement-extinction

*risk: medium · bounded*

Reduce a behavior by breaking the response-reinforcer contingency: once the maintaining reinforcer is identified, arrange the environment so the behavior no longer produces it, so with no payoff the rate declines toward its pre-reinforcement baseline. Nothing aversive is delivered — the lever is removal (not punishment), and partial reinforcement undermines it. The move spans every reinforcer channel and carries its own integrity rules: withhold a positive reinforcer with no alternative; enumerate and withhold ALL maintaining sources at once (one live source only thins the schedule and can leave the behavior intact); block escape so a negatively-reinforced response no longer terminates the aversive (escape extinction); restate the contingency flatly and disengage to deny an attention/conflict payoff; break the contingency at the sensory channel when the reinforcer is the behavior's own self-produced sensation (sensory masking). Route targeting through a functional assessment ('just ignore it' is the named anti-pattern) so the identified reinforcer is the one cut. Anticipate the extinction burst and hold the line consistently through it (relenting reinforces an intensified response); optional accelerants engineer extra evoking occasions to raise non-reinforced trial density, titrate a caregiver's tolerated ignoring duration upward so the procedure is actually sustained, and guard NCR delivery timing so a scheduled free reinforcer never coincides with a just-emitted problem behavior. PROCEDURAL FIDELITY: hold the contingency steady through the predictable side-effect cascade (burst, response variation, spontaneous recovery, resurgence, emotional/aggressive outbursts) treating these as expected, and critically do NOT let an emergent burst topography contact reinforcement — caving to an escalation trains a new, worse behavior to do the old job (topography substitution is itself the consistency failure). CHAIN-STRUCTURED SUPPRESSION (breaking a chain via its reinforcer structure): (chain-link severing) pay the LATE response of a two-response chain unconditionally so the intermediate stimulus stops predicting reinforcement and loses SD/conditioned-reinforcer value — only the EARLY link decays, surgical vs broad suppression; (chain collapse) strip the value of the chain's TERMINAL payoff so decline cascades BACKWARD through every upstream link — an extinction route (withhold the terminal consequence, the most immediate breaker) or a satiation route (an abolishing operation devalues it — the same abolishing-operation move as motivating-operation engineering).


**When to reach for this.** Reach for EXTINCTION to reduce a behavior by REMOVING its maintaining reinforcer so the rate declines to baseline (no aversive delivered). Choose it over: punishment (delivers an aversive); noncontingent reinforcement (still delivers the reinforcer, free on a schedule); differential-reinforcement rerouting/DRA (preserves the reinforcer and redirects it to a sanctioned channel); differential reinforcement of absence/low-rate (reinforces omission, not full removal); graded-support-withdrawal / transfer-of-control (there withdrawal is engineered so the GAIN persists; extinction removes support so the response dies); motivating-operation engineering (the chain-collapse SATIATION route here is its twin — extinction WITHHOLDS the payoff, satiation DEVALUES it). The chain-structured facets split by whether one link is surgically severed (unconditional late-response payment) or the terminal payoff is removed so the whole chain cascades backward. Variants also split by reinforcer channel (positive / escape / attention / automatic-sensory) and by integrity/acceleration rule (complete-enumeration, burst-integrity, trial-density, graduated-ignoring, NCR timing-guard).


**Realizations** (6): `behavioral-extinction-of-refusal`, `chain-collapse-terminal-payoff-removal`, `chain-link-severing`, `extinction-procedure-fidelity`, `function-based-extinction`, `sensory-extinction`


**See also.** `antecedent-manipulation` — both reduce a behavior once its maintaining function is known, but extinction acts on the CONSEQUENCE side (withhold the reinforcer the response already produces) while antecedent editing acts upstream so the occasion, motivation, or motor possibility never arises and there is nothing left to consequate.; `counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening` — adjacent behavior-reduction procedures that each name the other as the alternative to choose against - removing the reinforcer that maintains an operant versus pairing an incompatible state against an eliciting cue. Practitioner-facing selection depends on reading both.


### reinforcement-leak-proofing

*risk: low*

Closes every path by which reinforcement can reach behavior outside the arranged contingency, so the contingency keeps exclusive control of delivery. Withhold all maintaining reinforcers consistently across every agent and occasion — a single lapse installs an intermittent schedule and makes the behavior MORE resistant, inverting the intended change; bundle instructions, alternative reinforcement, and recruitment of significant others to close multi-agent leaks; widen the delivery rule so the reinforcer is withheld when any significant inappropriate behavior is concurrent (blocking adventitious strengthening of a substitute); and design reward access so baseline pleasures stay free while only a cut-above upgrade is contingent (removing the incentive to bootleg without demanding deprivation).


**When to reach for this.** Aimed at closing unintended reinforcement paths (lapses, other agents, concurrent behaviors, self-smuggled access), not at the contingency's content. The trap tell separates it from slow-but-progressing extinction: inconsistency reverses the direction of change, making the behavior tougher, not merely slower. Separate from performance-band-criterion-setting: that decides what earns reinforcement, this decides that nothing else pays — disjoint levers on the same contingency.


**See also.** `contingency-discriminability-design` — both are design levers on the same arranged contingency and are explicitly disjoint: one closes off every path by which reinforcement can arrive outside the arrangement, the other sets how detectable the arrangement is to the subject. Readers arranging a contingency routinely need to place a move on the correct axis.; `differential-reinforcement` — disjoint levers on the same arranged contingency: one decides that nothing outside the contingency pays, the other decides which other behaviour earns reinforcement. Both are commonly needed together and each entry already gestures at the other's territory.; `discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement` — complementary levers on one contingency: one builds a cue's control by reinforcing in its presence and withholding in its absence, the other closes every path by which reinforcement reaches the behavior outside the arranged contingency. Discrimination training fails outright if the leaks are open, so a reader working on either needs the other.; `noncontingent-reinforcement` — two disjoint levers on the same arranged contingency that are routinely deployed together: closing every unintended path by which the maintaining reinforcer can still be obtained, and delivering that same reinforcer freely on a time schedule. The second is explicitly noted to need the first to work.; `removal-from-reinforcement-timeout` — both are design constraints on the same contingency and typically co-occur. One closes every unintended path by which reinforcement could still reach the behavior; the other suppresses by withholding access for a contingent period. Both name the same trap — applying the procedure inconsistently makes the behavior tougher rather than merely slower.


### removal-from-reinforcement-timeout

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

Suppress a behavior by REMOVING or withholding access to reinforcement for a period contingent on it (time-out from reinforcement / negative punishment by removal of opportunity), rather than debiting a held reserve (response-cost) or delivering an aversive. CORE (environmental-contingency-nonexclusion): keep the subject physically present but strip the reinforcing elements from the surrounding environment (planned ignoring, terminating a specific reinforcer, contingent observation where the subject watches others earn but cannot, partitioning within the room) — same suppressive effect as exclusionary time-out but milder/least-restrictive; the contingent-observation form sharpens it by making the deprivation vivid. FORM FACETS: (recoverable-contingent-withdrawal) remove a preferred item for a brief fixed interval, restored next trial contingent on the desired response (combined negative punishment + DRA — access gated by the alternative, not merely forfeited); (impoverished-context-permission) counterintuitively PERMIT the behavior only in a reward-stripped inconvenient setting, stripping the incidental co-reinforcers that rode along and raising response cost. PRECONDITION (reinforcement-discrepancy-engine): enrich the time-in baseline FIRST so every withdrawal has bite — an impoverished time-in nullifies the whole procedure. PARAMETERS of time-out design: (absence-gated-punishment-exit) gate release on the subject going a set interval WITHOUT the target behavior, not on the clock, so leaving does not reinforce the punished behavior; (aversive-interval-tolerance-ceiling) cap the interval short (2-5 min, never beyond ~15) so the subject cannot obtain reinforcers inside it or build tolerance (anti-inversion, requires time-in richer than time-out); (dense-every-instance-consequence-schedule) consequate EVERY occurrence and abandon the procedure rather than apply it intermittently, since occasional use manufactures the ambiguity that dense scheduling prevents. LIFECYCLE (aversive-procedure-sunset-design): at the moment the aversive procedure is introduced, AUTHOR its elimination — pre-plan the switch toward reinforcement-based reductive methods (DRA/DRI) or reduced intrusiveness once the target behavior drops, rather than running the punisher indefinitely, limiting exposure and migrating control onto positive contingencies.
