**When to reach for this.** Reach for REMOVAL-FROM-REINFORCEMENT / TIME-OUT when suppression should work by WITHHOLDING access to reinforcement (removing a not-yet-earned reward or stripping the reinforcing environment) for a contingent period. Choose it over: response-cost / token economy (which SUBTRACTS a reinforcer the subject already HOLDS, per instance — this removes access/opportunity instead); extinction (which removes the SPECIFIC maintaining reinforcer of the target response so it decays to baseline — time-out removes reinforcement broadly for an interval regardless of the maintaining source); aversive-antecedent contingencies (which ADD a bad state escaped by compliance). The absorbed facets are the forms (non-exclusion / recoverable / impoverished-permission), the enrich-time-in precondition, and the exit/duration/schedule parameters of one time-out design.


**Realizations** (7): `absence-gated-punishment-exit`, `aversive-interval-tolerance-ceiling`, `aversive-procedure-sunset-design`, `dense-every-instance-consequence-schedule`, `impoverished-context-permission`, `recoverable-contingent-withdrawal`, `reinforcement-discrepancy-engine`


**See also.** `reinforcement-leak-proofing` — both are design constraints on the same contingency and typically co-occur. One closes every unintended path by which reinforcement could still reach the behavior; the other suppresses by withholding access for a contingent period. Both name the same trap — applying the procedure inconsistently makes the behavior tougher rather than merely slower.; `response-cost-token-economy` — adjacent negative-punishment contingencies a practitioner picks between: one debits a reinforcer the subject already holds per instance, the other withholds access to reinforcement for a contingent interval, and the design parameters that keep each intact (reserve provisioning versus enriched time-in) do not transfer.


### respondent-stimulus-pairing

*risk: medium · kind: principle*

Operate on the RESPONDENT (reflex) arc via stimulus presentation, not consequences on voluntary behavior. BUILD direction (respondent-stimulus-pairing): present a neutral stimulus just before or simultaneous with an unconditioned stimulus that already elicits a response; after repeated pairings the formerly neutral stimulus alone elicits a conditioned response — an automatic, involuntary reaction the subject did not have and did not choose, transferring by temporal contiguity (forward/simultaneous strongest, backward/delayed weaker). EVALUATIVE facet (valence-transfer-pairing): pair a stimulus that already reliably evokes a positive emotional response (liked music) with a neutral target (a product, an ad), contiguously and repeatedly, until the target itself elicits the affect and biases downstream choice toward it — affect installed with no argument about the target's merits. DECAY direction facet (respondent-habituation): present an eliciting stimulus repeatedly within a short span with no consequence or pairing, and the elicited response's magnitude decays and may vanish (massed re-exposure blunts reactivity on an intact unconditioned reflex arc); SPACING the same exposures preserves the response — presentation TIMING is the lever.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for RESPONDENT CONDITIONING when the target is an INVOLUNTARY (reflex/affective) response and the lever is stimulus PRESENTATION, not consequation of voluntary behavior. To install an elicited response or affect, pair NS+US by contiguity (order-sensitivity forward > backward is the procedural marker); to install a biasing VALENCE onto a choice target, use an already-evocative affective stimulus; to DECAY an existing reflex, re-present the eliciting stimulus massed (no pairing). Choose it over: discrimination/stimulus-control and any declared-trigger install (which consequate/instruct VOLUNTARY responding — no reflex elicited); motivating-operation engineering (which shifts a reinforcer's VALUE, not a reflex); conditioned-reinforcer manufacture (pairing that transfers reinforcing FUNCTION delivered as a consequence, not elicited affect).


**Realizations** (2): `respondent-habituation`, `valence-transfer-pairing`


**See also.** `within-session-conditioning-loop` — both build an automatic response by repeated pairing, but one presents a stimulus to elicit an involuntary reflex while the other fires an installed cue and rewards the response inside the session. The elicit-versus-consequate distinction is the classic confusion these two need each other to resolve.


### response-cost-token-economy

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Suppress a behavior by SUBTRACTING, contingent on it, a quantum of a reinforcer the subject ALREADY possesses (tokens, slips, earned minutes) — a negative-punishment (subtractive) economy. The atomic move plus the preconditions and parameters that keep it operating and motivationally intact. CORE EVENT (response-cost-fine): a per-response debit of an already-held, genuinely-valued reinforcer; immediacy is load-bearing (delay degrades it); it suppresses without building any replacement. PRECONDITIONS/PARAMETERS (bounded-response-cost-contingency-design): first STOCKPILE a withdrawable reserve (you cannot fine someone with nothing to lose); scale each fine to infraction magnitude and announce the schedule in ADVANCE; prohibit debt / keep earnings net-positive so the token never acquires net-aversive value; provision the reserve above baseline occurrence (~baseline-mean+25%) so it cannot be exhausted mid-session; thin reinforcement density gradually across multiple axes; a self-directed form pre-commits a concrete penalty per future failure. PARAMETER FACETS: (fine-magnitude-calibration) size each fine inside a two-sided window whose non-obvious constraint is the UPPER bound — a reserve-depletion ceiling, since over-fining inverts the effect (a drained subject gives up); (bonus-pool-loss-substrate) drain a pre-loaded noncontingent WINDFALL pool while walling off earned holdings, softening emotional fallout; (pre-stated-refusal-penalty) pre-announce an escalating penalty on NON-SURRENDER to close the 'I won't give it back' counter-move; (operator-custodied-enforcement-medium) keep the enforcement medium (ledger/tokens) outside the subject's control so the penalty is enacted by operator bookkeeping, removing the refuse-to-pay option; (attention-leakage-ratio-neutralization) keep reinforcer DELIVERIES well above loss-notifications so the loss-mark does not itself function as reinforcing attention.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for RESPONSE-COST / TOKEN ECONOMY when suppression should work by SUBTRACTING a reinforcer the subject ALREADY HOLDS, per instance. Choose it over: removal-from-reinforcement / time-out (which WITHHOLDS a not-yet-earned reward or removes access to reinforcement, rather than debiting held property); differential reinforcement (which pays an alternative/absence, not debits the target); aversive-antecedent contingencies (which ADD a bad state escaped by compliance — this builds and depletes a POSITIVE reserve as the suppression currency). The absorbed facets are the parameters of one economy: reserve-first precondition, magnitude upper-bound, loss-substrate, refusal-penalty, operator custody, and loss-notification-ratio guard.


**Realizations** (7): `attention-leakage-ratio-neutralization`, `bonus-pool-loss-substrate`, `bonus-response-cost`, `fine-magnitude-calibration`, `operator-custodied-enforcement-medium`, `pre-stated-refusal-penalty`, `response-cost-fine`


**See also.** `negative-punishment-timeout` — textbook siblings inside subtractive suppression, separated by whether a not-yet-earned opportunity is withheld for an interval or a reinforcer the subject already holds is debited per instance. Each already defines itself against the other, so the cross-link is load-bearing.; `removal-from-reinforcement-timeout` — adjacent negative-punishment contingencies a practitioner picks between: one debits a reinforcer the subject already holds per instance, the other withholds access to reinforcement for a contingent interval, and the design parameters that keep each intact (reserve provisioning versus enriched time-in) do not transfer.


### scaffold-fade-control-transfer

*risk: medium*

Establish or MOVE stimulus control by installing a temporary support that reliably produces the target response, then removing that support GRADUALLY so control transfers to the natural cue with few or no errors and no lasting dependence. The common lever is graded withdrawal of ONE assistive dimension rather than a cold handoff; the non-negotiable second half is that the support must be faded or the gain becomes prompt/dimension dependence (the named failure mode). The realizations differ by which dimension is attenuated. Response-prompt strength: an added antecedent — verbal instruction, demonstration/model given a prior imitative repertoire, or graded assistance hierarchies (most-to-least, graduated guidance, least-to-most) — is reinforced while present, then faded. Stimulus-side errorless fading: the antecedent STIMULUS's own form is exaggerated-then-faded, or an artificial shape is morphed into the natural target, so at completion no separable prompt remains. Time-delay transfer: only the TIMING gap between an unchanged prompt and the cue is stretched, so the learner responds in anticipation and beats the prompt. Graded support withdrawal: an artificial support (token system, chemical dose, dense free-reinforcer schedule) is withdrawn along a planned graded schedule, each step subthreshold for relapse — the gain-preserving/maintenance facet, optionally migrating the function to a portable substitute first. Model-reinforce-fade teaching: present the object, model the response, reinforce the echo, then fade the model so the object alone evokes the tact. Errorless superimposition-plus-fading (superimpose a new dimension on an already-controlling one, then fade the old) is the shared errorless craft.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for TRANSFER-OF-STIMULUS-CONTROL (prompt/errorless fading) when a support currently produces the response and you must hand control to the natural cue WITHOUT errors or dependence — the defining act is the engineered FADE of that support. Choose it over: shaping (grades successive approximations of the RESPONSE with no external support carrying it); discrimination training (builds cue control by a reinforce/extinguish history, not by fading an added support). The realizations differ only in WHICH dimension fades — response-prompt strength, stimulus form, prompt timing, or an artificial support schedule; all share the one transfer-by-attenuation lever and the 'leaving the support in = dependence' failure mode.


**Realizations** (8): `differential-reinforcement-teaching`, `graded-fade-stimulus-control-transfer`, `graded-prompt-fading-transfer`, `graded-support-withdrawal`, `prompt-fade-scaffolding`, `prompt-then-fade-to-natural-antecedent`, `stimulus-side-errorless-fading`, `time-delay-prompt-transfer`


**See also.** `contingency-authorship-transfer` — the same graded-fade lever applied to different objects: withdrawing an added support so the natural cue takes control, versus handing over authorship of the contingency itself until the subject is both parties. The first is the general craft the second specializes.; `discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement` — adjacent halves of stimulus control: one builds cue control through a reinforce-in-presence, withhold-in-absence history; the other moves existing control to the natural cue by fading an added support. Anyone selecting between them needs the pair.; `shaping-successive-approximation` — an explicitly paired design contrast already stated on both pages: one differentiates the response while holding the antecedent fixed, the other holds the response fixed and fades an added support. Practitioners routinely confuse the two, and each entry's discriminator names the other as the thing to choose against.


### self-administered-conditioning-loop

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The operator transfers the labor and the reinforcer of a conditioning loop into the listener, keeping only the framing. The listener supplies the reward (self-generated arousal, self-recited mantra, a self-voiced first-person declaration, a competence appraisal on each repetition, an instructed motor act) while the operator merely labels it as caused-by and owned-by the operator's words. Because the reward is the listener's own and the act of producing it is defined as the compliance, the loop becomes self-driving: stopping costs the pleasure, continuing costs autonomy; progressive transfer of the operator role into the listener's own drive is the point, so the loop rides the listener's ordinary daily behavior (masturbation, self-talk, re-listening) as its substrate and can continue operator-absent. A staged sub-form keeps the operator present only to install a CUTOFF: a voluntary motor act (nodding) is coupled to involuntary sensation, acceleration is instructed so sensation rises as a function of the listener's OWN action, the escalation is re-credited to operator control, and an anti-saturation hard-stop both hides the listener-driven nature and installs operator stop-authority before a later gate.


**When to reach for this.** The reattribution move: the operator OWNS the reward-framing but never GENERATES the reward, and the loop is engineered to self-sustain (or to install stop-authority) rather than being operator-driven. In a within-session conditioning loop the operator both drives and delivers the reinforcing cycle in-session; here the listener supplies it. Where arousal is conditioned to operator cues as the goal, arousal/pleasure here is the outsourced FUEL, not the payload. A self-directed mantra is absorptive chanting for its own sake; here recitation is tied to escalating pleasure and autonomy-cost. And unlike ideomotor proof, where subtle AUTOMATIC movement serves as evidence of trance, the motor act here is VOLUNTARY, instructed, then reattributed. The self-driven-motor-with-cutoff form — operator present only for the cutoff — is a variant of the same listener-drives-it-then-reattribution logic.


**See also.** `closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop` — both produce a loop that keeps running with no operator present, but the closed loop achieves it by topology (every direction of resistance re-enters), while the self-administered loop achieves it by transferring the reward-generating labor to the listener and merely relabeling the credit.; `depth-labor-transfer-leash` — both hand production work to the listener and keep only the framing, so a reader choosing one should see the other: depth imagery transferred under operator judgment versus a conditioning loop whose reinforcer the listener supplies. Same labor-transfer family, different transferred object.; `obedience-to-blankness-coupling` — both build compliance loops that stop needing the operator to deliver the reward. One contractually couples every obeyed command to increasing blankness, making the state itself the reinforcer; the other transfers reward-generation to the listener while the operator keeps only the framing. Useful to compare when deciding who supplies the reinforcement.; `pleasure-attributed-to-operator` — both reroute credit for a good feeling onto the operator without the operator producing it. One re-sources the listener's baseline pleasure to the operator's presence; the other has the listener generate the reward while the operator keeps only the framing — the second is close to the first run at loop scale.; `recited-feedback-loop-formula` — both build a self-reinforcing compliance cycle, and the useful distinction is who supplies the fuel: an operator-recited closed formula with an explicit no-ceiling clause, versus a loop whose reward the listener generates while the operator only claims ownership of it. Directly contrastive on the generation question.; `self-authored-compliance-content` — both hand production to the listener, but the thing produced differs: compliance content invented or narrated by the listener, versus the reinforcer of a conditioning loop supplied by the listener while the operator keeps only the framing. Worth cross-reading; not one technique.; `self-management-self-administered-contingency` — both relocate part of a conditioning loop into the subject so it runs without the operator present, and they differ on exactly the point a reader needs: in one the subject genuinely owns the administrator role with autonomy intact, in the other the operator retains the framing and re-credits the subject's self-generated reward to themselves. The second's discriminator already names that contrast.


### self-instruction-antecedent-training

*risk: low*

Teach the subject to emit their OWN stimuli — verbal self-directives, covert intraverbals/imagery, self-textual reads of stable landmarks, or a self-arranged environmental mark — that then function as antecedent discriminative cues for the subject's OWN subsequent behavior, transferring control of performance from an external prompter to a self-generated stimulus the subject carries everywhere. Installation proceeds by teaching each component across exemplars, optionally driving the verbal mediator covert via an audibility-fading ladder (aloud -> whisper -> lip -> silent). REALIZATIONS: (self-instruction-antecedent-training) directly teach self-directives/step-prompts/produced intraverbals as antecedent cues, faded to covert, yielding self-paced/emergent responding; (self-generated-antecedent-cueing) the subject manufactures covert SDs (self-echoics, self-textual reads of landmarks) and feeds them in sequence to prompt a multi-step action the environment alone would not evoke; (covert-self-priming) a self-directed priming sequence where a topic-SD covertly evokes self-intraverbals/imagery that pre-strengthen content for a later turn; (self-supplied-covert-cue) trains deliberate on-cue emission of covert imagery whose response-product overlaps the target and acts as an added private SD, expanding output; (chain-priming-future-cue) execute the first physical link of a chain NOW so the partial completion is a self-arranged environmental SD that confronts the future self and EVOKES the next link.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for SELF-INSTRUCTION / SELF-CUEING when the subject supplies their OWN antecedent (a self-generated SD, self-directive, covert image, or self-arranged mark) to steer their OWN behavior — control is subject-manufactured, not operator-issued. Choose it over: operator-delivered cueing / discrimination training (the SD is issued by the operator there); self-administered CONTINGENCY (which relocates the measurement-and-CONSEQUENCE loop into the subject — this relocates the ANTECEDENT/cue, not the reinforcer); rule-governed precommitment (which binds the future self by a STAKE/foreclosure — the partial-completion facet here EVOKES the next response rather than foreclosing a choice). The facets differ only by which self-generated antecedent (verbal directive / covert intraverbal / covert image / physical partial-completion).


**Realizations** (4): `chain-priming-future-cue`, `covert-self-priming`, `self-generated-antecedent-cueing`, `self-supplied-covert-cue`


**See also.** `antecedent-manipulation` — both edit the antecedent rather than the consequence, and the only thing separating them is who supplies it -- the subject manufacturing their own carried cue versus the operator editing the situation upstream. Without the pointer a reader will file self-cueing under situational editing and lose the control-locus distinction.; `self-induction-re-entry-training` — both make the subject supply their own antecedent. One is a portable cue for deliberate re-entry into a conditioned state; the other trains self-generated cues that steer ordinary subsequent behavior. Same lever, different target.; `self-management-self-administered-contingency` — complementary halves of relocating behavioral control into the subject: one moves the measurement-and-consequence loop inside, the other moves the antecedent cue inside. Each is defined partly by not being the other, so the cross-reference is load-bearing.


### self-management-self-administered-contingency

*risk: medium*

Relocate the measurement-and-consequence machinery of a contingency INTO the subject, on the premise that the self is the one agent guaranteed present everywhere — extending contingency management into private events and settings no external agent can follow. Spans from bare self-observation (which changes behavior by reactivity alone) to a full self-run consequence loop. REALIZATIONS: (self-administered-contingency) the subject self-selects task and reward, self-monitors completion, and self-delivers the reward — a self-contract collapsing all four roles (integrity resting on honest self-monitoring), an accuracy-matching contingency (reinforcement for MATCHING an independent observer's record — reinforcing correct self-observation), or a self-scoring loop against an answer key with a self-delivered consequence; (two-response-self-management-split) the genus framing — emit a SEPARATE controlling response that manipulates a variable of the target function at a PRIOR time-point when the competing reinforcer is weak, converting an intractable in-the-moment impulse into a tractable earlier engineering problem; (self-monitoring-reactivity) bare observe-and-record with NO added consequence, where the act of measurement alone shifts the rate (and yields an ABC baseline); (self-recording) install a recording act contemporaneous with the target (tally, chart on the mirror) so the mark itself becomes an immediate discriminative/consequating event, with an accuracy-matched-to-observer training variant that thins the external check until the subject records accurately unsupervised.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for SELF-MANAGEMENT / SELF-ADMINISTERED CONTINGENCY when the CONTINGENCY-ADMINISTRATOR role (measure, and consequate or just observe) relocates into the subject, running as an ongoing loop the subject drives. Choose it over: precommitment / rule-governed stakes (which arranges ONE future contingency / binds the future self by a stake — this transfers the ongoing administrator role); self-instruction/self-cueing (which relocates the ANTECEDENT/cue, not the measurement-consequence loop); operator-outsourced conditioning loop (where the operator OWNS the framing and reattributes the subject's self-generated reward to themselves — here the subject genuinely self-administers, autonomy intact). Facets span reactivity-only (observe/record, no consequence) through full self-contract; the accuracy-matching variant trains correct self-observation rather than the behavior itself.


**Realizations** (4): `self-managed-contingency`, `self-monitoring-reactivity`, `self-recording`, `two-response-self-management-split`


**See also.** `contingency-authorship-transfer` — process and end-state: the gradual handover of task, standard, monitoring and delivery from operator to subject terminates in exactly the self-run contingency loop the other entry describes. Not a merge - one names the fading schedule applied to authorship, the other the standing arrangement once the handover is complete.; `self-administered-conditioning-loop` — both relocate part of a conditioning loop into the subject so it runs without the operator present, and they differ on exactly the point a reader needs: in one the subject genuinely owns the administrator role with autonomy intact, in the other the operator retains the framing and re-credits the subject's self-generated reward to themselves. The second's discriminator already names that contrast.; `self-instruction-antecedent-training` — complementary halves of relocating behavioral control into the subject: one moves the measurement-and-consequence loop inside, the other moves the antecedent cue inside. Each is defined partly by not being the other, so the cross-reference is load-bearing.


### shaping-successive-approximation

*risk: medium*

Build a not-yet-existing response by differential reinforcement that walks a moving reinforced window toward a terminal behavior: capture and reinforce the slightest movement toward target, then withhold from it and pay only a closer approximation while priors extinguish, so the modal response inches forward in the smallest viable steps (gradualness is load-bearing; on deterioration drop back to the last successful approximation — the dip-and-recover signature confirms it working). The criterion can move along any dimension (threshold, tolerance-window, or a rate parameter moved one axis at a time). Realizations and parameters: FRONT-HALF (setup) — (bootstrap entry point) selects the STARTING behavior, an already-occurring in-repertoire fragment seized rather than induced, solving 'can't reinforce what never happens'; (baseline-anchored initial criterion) computes the numeric STARTING schedule parameter from the subject's measured baseline (first interval/criterion at or just below baseline mean) so existing behavior contacts reinforcement immediately instead of the contingency collapsing from too-sparse reinforcement. BACK-HALF (progression) — (performance-band criterion setting) makes the advancing criterion a FUNCTION of the subject's own recent performance band (an explicit percentile formula k=(m+1)(1-w) recomputed over the last m responses, or error-rate-keyed relax/raise one dimension at a time, or graded constant/proportional/performance-yoked thinning), placed inside the achievable range and advanced in performance-gated steps so reinforcement stays earnable (a static winnable-ceiling DRL sub-form sets the bar once inside the band so one slip does not extinguish effort). SESSION MANAGEMENT — (reinforcement-density pacing) keep the learner working the whole session at a high reinforcement rate (idle only while consuming the reinforcer, closing with a free-reinforcer goodbye) so the behavior stream stays dense enough for the differential-reinforcement engine to operate on. Companion design contrast: shaping holds the antecedent constant and differentiates the RESPONSE, whereas stimulus fading holds the response constant and shifts the antecedent.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for SHAPING when the target response does not yet exist and must be built by moving a reinforced window across successive approximations of ONE response — including its setup (which behavior/number to start on), its progression (how the criterion advances, keyed to recent performance), and its session-density management. Choose it over: behavior-chaining (assembles a multi-step SEQUENCE, not one response); prompt-fading/transfer-of-control (an external support carries the response then is faded — shaping uses no added support); stimulus-side fading (grades the antecedent's form while holding the response). Its criterion-placement rules decide WHAT EARNS reinforcement — a different job from reinforcement-leak-proofing, which decides that nothing ELSE pays.


**Realizations** (5): `baseline-anchored-initial-criterion`, `bootstrap-shaping-entry-point`, `performance-band-criterion-setting`, `reinforcement-density-pacing`, `shaping-by-successive-approximation`


**See also.** `discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement` — complementary halves of the same differential-reinforcement engine, and the boundary is easy to get wrong: one differentiates the ANTECEDENT (a cue gains control through reinforce-in-presence / withhold-in-absence), the other differentiates the RESPONSE (a moving reinforced window builds a behavior that does not yet exist). A reader reaching for either should confirm which side of that line their case falls on.; `scaffold-fade-control-transfer` — an explicitly paired design contrast already stated on both pages: one differentiates the response while holding the antecedent fixed, the other holds the response fixed and fades an added support. Practitioners routinely confuse the two, and each entry's discriminator names the other as the thing to choose against.


### social-reinforcement-recruitment

*risk: medium · consent-required*

Route the maintaining reinforcement through another AGENT whose delivering behavior is itself the engineered variable — convert the subject's social environment into the reinforcement engine. Operator-side forms: inform capable-but-dormant people in the setting of the value of their attention and explicitly ask them to watch for and reinforce any reasonable effort (awakening an asleep community so gains persist after the trainer leaves); or, where ABC narrative data reveal caregivers/staff reinforcing the wrong endpoint (e.g. the end of an escalation chain over appropriate bids), directly reverse that agent's contingency (reinforce appropriate responses, extinguish the escalation endpoint, shape delay tolerance). Selection-side form: choose a proxy target behavior specifically because its payoff changes how significant others treat the subject, recruiting a named third-party causal path. Subject-side form: the subject self-evaluates against a criterion and, on meeting it, actively recruits praise/feedback from an authority, engineering the conditions under which that person reinforces them (raising the authority's own praise rate as a collateral change). Includes the dosing layer: calibrate recruiting rate and topography to the setting's tolerance so the recruited contingency stays net-positive and the reinforcing agent is not flipped into a punisher.


**When to reach for this.** The operative move lands on the setting's people, or on target choice routed through them - never on the subject's state. Unlike a trigger install that arms someone to fire a cue, nothing is installed in anyone; third parties are asked to notice and reinforce. Unlike a subject-comfort check, the dosing layer preserves a third party's goodwill rather than checking the subject's comfort. Unlike the producing-behavior validity rule of target selection, the proxy here is deliberately chosen for its third-party path, not rejected as a mere correlate.


**Realizations** (1): `reinforcing-agent-engineering`


**See also.** `peer-authored-target-selection` — both route the operative move through the surrounding group rather than the subject, and one already names the other as a contrast. The distinction worth preserving is what the peers supply: reinforcement delivery versus authorship of the target list itself.; `public-avowal-third-party-propagation` — both route maintenance through people outside the operator-subject pair, but one arranges third parties to deliver reinforcement while the other uses an audience's self-consistency pressure and recruitment. Read together when deciding whether the social environment is being managed or being made the propagation vector.


### staged-compromise-evidence-banking

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A scene is arranged so that it generates a durable, compromising artifact — a photograph, a recording, a signed statement, a witnessed act — which the operator retains without using. Nothing is cashed at the time; the subject's experience of the scene is often unremarkable, and the coercive function activates only later, on the first refusal, when the held artifact is produced or alluded to. The staging is designed backward from the artifact: participants are positioned and the scene is shaped so the resulting record will read as maximally damaging out of context, independent of what actually occurred. Its value to the operator is the standing threat, so it works best never used.


**When to reach for this.** A durable compromising artifact (photograph, recording, signed statement, witnessed act) is generated by a staged scene, retained, and deliberately NOT used — the coercive function is a standing threat activated only on a future refusal. Two properties are jointly unmatched: the artifact is external to the subject's psychology (no state or belief change is asserted or required at the time), and the value is in holding rather than exercising. Split from `threat-of-loss-rouse` (389), the nearest lever in kind: 389 also runs on forfeiture, but its threatened asset is the subject's own future state access, it is spoken aloud, and it is cashed on the spot to break a blocked command channel — here the asset is an external record, the threat is unspoken, and cashing it spends it. Split from `precommitment-rule-governed-stakes` (424), where a third party holds a stake the SUBJECT arranged against their own future defection; here the subject did not agree and does not know a stake exists. Split from the staging cluster on timing: `staged-negotiation-favor-theater` (517) collects felt indebtedness the moment the operator returns, `context-lock-staging` (243) gates a payload in the same session, and `counterfeit-cue-forgery` (493) collapses on detection — this one is designed to be detected later, deliberately.


### threat-priced-compliance-payment

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A pricing rule for contingency design: when compliance exposes the subject to a punishment contingency (legal risk, exposure, retaliation, physical hazard), the payment that will actually secure compliance is set by the probability times severity of what the subject risks, NOT by the labor or difficulty of what is asked. The controller's job is therefore to estimate the subject's own risk assessment and meet it, which means the same requested act carries wildly different prices depending on how exposed the specific subject is — a well-insulated subject is cheap, a subject with much to lose is expensive, for identical work. It runs in both directions: raising the subject's exposure raises the price the controller must pay, and reducing exposure (indemnity, cover, plausible deniability, distance from consequence) is a cheaper way to buy compliance than raising the fee. This is what makes hazard pay, hush money, and coerced-compliance economics one family rather than three.


**When to reach for this.** Nearest is response-cost-token-economy (1057), which SUBTRACTS a held reinforcer contingent on an unwanted response to suppress it — the operator is the one imposing the cost; here the operator is the one PAYING, and the cost being priced is a punishment contingency the subject faces from elsewhere. Versus resistance-penalty-contingency (1002): that attaches an aversive to the act of resisting so the exit path backfires — the operator manufactures the threat; here the threat pre-exists and the operator's move is to buy against it. Versus resistance-deterrence (672): that advertises the price of resisting so the subject never attempts it — a re-pricing of the subject's OPTION, with no consideration changing hands; this is an actual payment calibrated to a quantity the operator had to estimate. Versus negative-punishment-timeout (876): pure suppression by withdrawing reinforcement access, nothing purchased. The parameter unique here is that the consideration is indexed to the subject's risk-aversion rather than to the response effort, which is why the two levers (raise the fee vs lower the exposure) are substitutable.


### verbal-operant-teaching

*risk: medium*

Install a verbal operant — the ability to NAME (tact), ASK for (mand), COMPREHEND (listener/receptive), or classify (concept) — via reinforced trials and prompt-fade over the learner's existing repertoire, so an interior state or referent the learner could not previously report or request comes under verbal control (and thus becomes steerable by reference to it). REALIZATIONS: PRIVATE-EVENT TACTING — (proxy-taught-private-tacts) tact a visible correlate of an inaccessible internal state ('ouch' modeled while limping), reinforce the copy, fade the public prompt until the private stimulus alone controls the word; (leak-timed-private-state-labeling) supply+reinforce the label at the exact moment an involuntary tell certifies the private stimulus is present. COMPREHENSION — (evoke-and-check-comprehension) a verbal stimulus evokes a receptive selection/answer that is the unit shaped, making covert understanding observable and reinforceable. MAND — (mand-for-information) frame lack of information as a deprivation so asking is an evocable operant reinforced by the answer; (mand-frame-graft) graft a not-yet-instructable response onto a moment of already-strong MO, then fade to ordinary control; (specific-reinforcement-mand-extinction) reinforce by delivering exactly what the words specify, flipping the driving MO to abolishing and ending the mand; (form-carries-motivation) design the response FORM (sign/icon) so it specifies the reinforcer at stake, opening selection-based communication. CONCEPT/FUNCTION — (verbal-concept-induction) install a concept via a stated definition + examples/nonexamples over existing verbal repertoire (no reinforced trials), transferring to novel instances; (verbal-function-altering-instruction) a single rule changes the behavioral function of a not-yet-present stimulus (turns a future neutral stimulus into an SD) by language alone.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for VERBAL-OPERANT TEACHING when the target is a NAMING, ASKING, COMPREHENDING, or classifying repertoire over an external referent or an interior state — installing the verbal operant itself. Choose it over: autoclitic-training (which installs a SECONDARY form modifying the learner's own primary utterance, not a new referent-naming/asking operant); discrimination/stimulus-control (which builds nonverbal cue control — this installs verbal behavior); motivating-operation engineering (which manipulates a consequence's VALUE — the mand facets here TEACH the ask riding an MO rather than engineering value for its own sake); self-instruction/self-cueing (where the learner's own verbal behavior is a self-generated SD steering their OWN action, not an operator-taught tact/mand). Facets differ by which operant (tact/mand/listener/concept) and by public vs private referent.


**Realizations** (8): `evoke-and-check-comprehension`, `form-carries-motivation`, `leak-timed-private-state-labeling`, `mand-for-information`, `mand-frame-graft`, `specific-reinforcement-mand-extinction`, `verbal-concept-induction`, `verbal-function-altering-instruction`


**See also.** `rule-governed-behavior-install` — adjacent behavioral levers with a live boundary. One installs a naming, asking or comprehending repertoire through reinforced trials; the other governs later behavior by an advance verbal statement of a contingency. They overlap where a single stated rule alters what a not-yet-present stimulus means, with no trials run.


## tethering  (26)

Durable reach that ties the subject back to the operator, series, or next artifact — no-emergence chaining, cross-file handoff receptors, re-listen compulsion, environmental re-firing, operator-gated persistence, forward-dated authorizations.

**Scope.** Completes only across a between-session gap AND keeps the operator/series as hub. Handoff into the subject's own life -> transfer; within-file no-exit topology -> arc-topology.


### asymmetric-maintenance-relisten-loop

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

On exit, a contingent post-hypnotic trigger makes any emotion INCONSISTENT with the installed programming cause re-listening, framed as hygienic. The trigger is asymmetric: fitting emotions produce nothing, non-fitting emotions produce another session — so the file fades during compliant periods and becomes salient only when the programming is failing (selective salience), a light footprint with heavy long-term effect. Paired with a birth-reframe wake (count-up framed as the first waking of a new being, memory-of-change pre-explained away) that normalizes the felt change as the new self's baseline; the loop is self-repairing, keyed to the failure state.


**When to reach for this.** Fires on an internal FAILURE state — an emotion inconsistent with the installed programming — not on a schedule, unlike a timer bridge that fires a state transition at a set clock time. It is also not a waking suggestion that re-delivers content during emergence: the install is a contingent re-listen loop that activates only on later programming failure, not a waking-moment redelivery. Close kin to self-firing-environmental-recurrence — both schedule reactivation beyond the session — but that one fires on an environmental trigger like sleep, while this one fires on the failure state itself.


**See also.** `compounding-dependency-loop` — two dependency loops keyed differently: one raises a waking baseline whose only relief is more of the same exposure, the other stays silent during compliance and fires only when the programming is failing. Escalating versus self-repairing is a useful contrast for anyone reading either as a maintenance design.; `failure-pre-attribution` — both are failure-branch machinery and they stack naturally: one pre-assigns blame for a null result to listener insufficiency, the other makes the failure state itself fire a re-listen. Knowing the pair helps a reader see the closed loop where failing to respond both is explained away and drives further exposure.; `no-exit-compliance-loop` — both pre-wire the response to the program's own failure so a lapse routes back into re-exposure. One is a single asymmetric trigger, the other a full no-exit topology over every defection path — a scope difference on the same design goal.; `operator-absent-self-renewal-loop` — both hand the listener a self-running maintenance schedule that survives with no operator present, but one installs an unconditional urge to re-administer that strengthens on every pass, while the other stays dormant and fires re-listening only when an emotion inconsistent with the programming signals the install is failing.


### awake-channel-trance-surface

*risk: high · consent-required*

The operator declares that the listener's ordinary WAKING state and everyday communication channels are themselves trance-equivalent suggestion surfaces: all future contact with the operator (chat, email, PM) will land as deep-trance suggestion while the listener stays 'perfectly aware and awake,' and a trigger is asserted to fire identically whether hypnotized or awake - sometimes re-delivered post-wake as a reality-claim the conscious mind hears about itself as confirmation. The move extends the suggestible container out of the audio file into the ongoing operator-listener relationship, making the induction merely the qualifier for a standing awake-state suggestion channel.


**When to reach for this.** The AWAKE everyday channel is redefined as a trance-equivalent suggestion surface - not a broadened firing of one response into new contexts, and not a text-platform trigger that extends one specific trigger into text; here the whole waking communication relationship becomes a suggestion surface. The tell is that the payload targets the waking state and the channel itself, with the induction demoted to a qualifier.


**See also.** `command-token-substate-toggle` — adjacent solutions to the same problem of acting in the world without breaking the frame: one toggles an operable substate inside trance, the other redefines the ordinary waking channel as a suggestion surface. Easy to confuse when the subject is functional and aware.; `post-wake-ratification-fire` — both attack the trance/waking boundary rather than working inside it: one redeclares the ordinary waking channel as a suggestion surface, the other fires a trigger immediately after the wake to contradict the emergence framing. A reader interested in reach past the session edge benefits from seeing the standing-channel and the puncture-the-boundary routes together.; `post-wake-self-report-reframe` — the awake-channel entry explicitly includes a post-wake reality-claim re-delivery, which is the same move as the post-wake self-report entry's trigger-as-established-fact realization. A reader landing on either should see the other to decide whether the payload is a one-off legitimation of what just happened or a standing redefinition of the waking channel itself.; `waking-life-service-reassignment` — both extend the session's reach into ordinary waking time, and the difference is what gets reassigned: the everyday communication channel redefined as a suggestion surface, versus mundane waking life reclassified as the service realm by leveling the two planes. Channel versus plane.


### compounding-dependency-loop

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A meta-suggestion claims repeated listening cumulatively RAISES a waking baseline state (e.g. natural arousal) across sessions rather than resetting per session, and the installed state's only relief route is more of the same hypnosis — so the cure feeds the disease. Re-listening is motivated (each now "does more"), any felt increase is pre-explained as the suggestion working, and the teardown route interlocks with the escalation so the dependency closes into a loop: more listening raises baseline further, which motivates more listening.


**When to reach for this.** Separate from progressive-conditioning (which accumulates trance DEPTH or response strength as a passive belief) by the cure-worsens-condition DEPENDENCY INVERSION — the installed waking-baseline state's designated relief route is the very mechanism that escalates it, forming a closed dependency loop. The structural cure-feeds-the-disease inversion is not a scale/target twist, so it stands apart rather than folding in as a variant.


**See also.** `asymmetric-maintenance-relisten-loop` — two dependency loops keyed differently: one raises a waking baseline whose only relief is more of the same exposure, the other stays silent during compliance and fires only when the programming is failing. Escalating versus self-repairing is a useful contrast for anyone reading either as a maintenance design.; `closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop` — both close a loop with no exit; the dependency form is the specific case where the designated relief route is the escalating mechanism itself, and it sits close enough to the general closed autonomous loop that a reader must check which closure is present.; `re-listen-compulsion` — two retention engines that pair naturally and are often stacked: one raises a waking baseline state whose only designated relief is more of the same exposure, the other installs replay as an appetite pointed at the recording. A reader building or auditing a return-drive wants both in view, since the dependency inversion frequently rides on top of the replay compulsion.; `relief-dependency-couple` — two different dependency topologies worth contrasting: one escalates a waking baseline whose only relief is more of the same, the other couples genuine post-wake relief to the operator and a pending ask. Same outcome word, different engine — the link is useful precisely as a disambiguation.


### conditional-rename-reward

*risk: medium · consent-required*

Dangles being renamed as a conditional, aspirational reward rather than enacting it — 'perhaps if you are a very good possession, you will even be given a name', with the new name (if assigned) declared the 'true' name and the old kept for social use. Two effects at once: it creates in-script motivation (be good enough to earn a name) that orients the listener toward future sessions, and it pre-installs the structural rules for how a name-change works (old = social handle, new = true name) so an eventual renaming does not need to re-litigate the ruleset.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is that the renaming is held back as a conditional reward and the rename ruleset is pre-loaded without being enacted. Separates from present ownership language (which asserts a possession claim now) and from executed renaming (most scripts simply assign the name); this is an un-enacted conditional identity-token clause used as motivation and future-session orientation.


### cross-artifact-retention-topology

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

Cross-artifact retention topology: a structural property that lives ACROSS an artifact boundary rather than inside any single file — the piece is engineered to receive a primed listener and hand off a more-primed one, optimizing retention across a series/album/multi-session cycle rather than one-shot delivery; the mechanism is the engineered incompleteness/hand-off, not any move inside the file, and the resolution is deliberately withheld so only the next artifact or session supplies it.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when the retention lever is a WHOLE-ARTIFACT structural property that only completes across the boundary — the file depends on neighboring files, an album context, or a between-session gap to resolve, signalled by explicit series/hand-off framing (welcome back, next recording, complete all three, second listen, un-justified property frame) and a deliberately withheld resolution. It is uncitable to any single line — the shape IS the technique. Unlike a deferred cross-file trigger receptor (a specific posthypnotic receptor installed in one file and fired in another — a discrete cue-install move you can point to), here there is no single move, only the engineered incompleteness of the whole piece. Unlike continuous-trance serial chaining, which keeps the subject UNDER across files, here the listener emerges normally but the artifact is structurally incomplete without its neighbors. Unlike a blanket playlist preauthorization, which licenses unheard downstream content via one explicit authorization line, here retention is a structural dependency, not an authorization.


**Realizations** (1): `series-placement-dependency`


**See also.** `self-maintaining-install` — both are whole-artifact retention architectures with no single citable line, and the boundary between them is fine: one is structurally incomplete without its neighbouring pieces, the other is self-contained but engineered to re-fire and re-install itself in daily life. A reader classifying an architecture-level retention lever needs both.; `song-architecture-delivery-vehicle` — both are whole-artifact form properties built around repeat exposure rather than a single delivery. One substitutes a cyclical musical form with no arc and explicit replay intent; the other engineers incompleteness so resolution only arrives from a neighboring piece. Useful together when classifying replay-dependent construction.


### cross-file-handoff-receptor

*risk: medium · bounded*

The file installs the RECEPTOR for a trigger whose payload is delivered in a DIFFERENT file or live session, and never fires it here. A posthypnotic trigger is keyed to a future off-file stimulus (the operator's countdown that "turns real" / "clicks everything into place" in another recording), so the listener leaves primed but not fired. The move's function is its place in a multi-part operation — the front half of a chain — a cross-file / serial-position property rather than a self-contained in-session state move.


**When to reach for this.** Installs the receptor for an off-file trigger never delivered in this file — a forward cross-file handoff. vs declarative trigger installation — that installs and typically demonstrates a cue-response in-session; here the payoff is deliberately deferred to another file, the defining property being the move's serial position in a cross-file chain.


**See also.** `cross-media-forced-continuation` — both are cross-file structural moves that deliberately withhold resolution in the present file: one relocates the unlock of a withheld faculty onto consuming another operator's recording, the other installs a receptor whose trigger fires only in a later file. A reader classifying a file that ends unresolved needs both to pick correctly, and the discriminators already gesture at the same neighborhood.; `meta-suggestibility-conditioning` — both are front-half moves whose value is realized in a later file, differing in what is left behind: a general disposition to accept whatever comes next versus a specific receptor for a trigger fired elsewhere. A reader classifying a primer file needs both in view.


### cross-media-forced-continuation

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Relocates the unlock condition for a withheld faculty (here orgasm capacity, previously confiscated in-file) OUT of the current recording and onto consuming a DIFFERENT operator's separate file — release is gated on listening to a named second operator, obeying him, and coming on his command. The file deliberately refuses to provide its own resolution, ending mid-trance with eyes open and dispatching the still-locked listener to the partner file. The effect is a retention / funnel hook: normalcy cannot be reclaimed without consuming additional externally-controlled content.


**When to reach for this.** The unlock is relocated onto CONSUMING ANOTHER PRODUCT (a second operator's separate recording), not onto a delegate firing an installed cue. Separates from third-party-activation (which delegates an installed trigger to a named party within the subject's own life) and from open-authority-socket (no phrase / no socket — the gate is completing an external file). A forced-continuation / external- contingency structure.


**See also.** `cross-file-handoff-receptor` — both are cross-file structural moves that deliberately withhold resolution in the present file: one relocates the unlock of a withheld faculty onto consuming another operator's recording, the other installs a receptor whose trigger fires only in a later file. A reader classifying a file that ends unresolved needs both to pick correctly, and the discriminators already gesture at the same neighborhood.; `operator-gated-release-and-state-access` — b is a narrow special case of A's confiscation-and-conditional-return form: the withheld faculty's unlock key is relocated onto consuming another operator's recording. Worth linking as the external-product variant of operator-gated access, not merged, because A's key stays inside the operator's own ecosystem while B's whole point is the hand-off outward.; `orgasm-gate-keyed-to-target-behavior` — same structure with different unlock keys: a withheld bodily release gated on either consuming further external content or performing a named target behavior. A writer choosing a gate wants both options in view.; `orgasm-gated-recurrence` — both withhold orgasm and route the unlock through further content consumption, but one loops the listener back to the same operator's catalogue as a retention engine while the other relocates the unlock onto a DIFFERENT operator's separate file, making it a hand-off funnel rather than a self-contained return gate.; `out-of-audio-compliance-offload` — both send the listener out of the current recording to complete something, and the useful contrast is what the departure accomplishes. In one, a withheld faculty stays locked until another product is consumed, a retention hook. In the other, the listener steps out, performs a motor act, and returns carrying that compliance back as depth. Adjacent enough that a reader should check both.; `peer-gated-social-unlock` — same structural family: a withheld capacity whose only unlock sits outside the current session and outside the listener's control. They differ on the external surface - consuming a second operator's separate recording versus a public reciprocal peer-approval economy with a waiting period. A writer picking an external-contingency release gate should compare the two enforcement surfaces.; `playlist-preauthorization-handoff` — two forms of handing the listener onward to content outside the current file: blanket pre-authorization of whatever plays next with the reflect-and-stop branch omitted, versus withholding a confiscated faculty until a separate external recording is consumed. Open licensing versus gated funnel -- worth reading together.; `relief-monopoly-bind` — both withhold a bodily release and hand the only valid unlock to someone else. One relocates the unlock onto consuming a separate recording by another operator, the other makes the operator the sole causally-valid grantor. The funnel form reads as an outward extension of the monopoly, so the pointer is earned.


### environmental-retrigger-seeding

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Link the installed state or identity to specific real-world stimuli the listener is certain to re-encounter (a named song, gym bikes, gear shifts, a friend's leg), so ordinary environmental contact re-fires and reinforces the conditioning after the session ends — extending operator reach beyond the audio file. A dense locational catalog of concrete objects can ground an abstract identity so each object becomes a re-firing anchor, and amplifier language ('a hundred fold') can make each exposure strengthen rather than merely recall the install.


**When to reach for this.** The cue set is REAL-WORLD ambient stimuli seeded for out-of-session re-firing — not in-session modality extension of one trigger (multi-modal-trigger), not a single if-then situational pairing, and the install is declarative and announced, so it lacks the covert-pairing tell of covert-nonverbal-anchor.


**See also.** `behavioral-bridge` — two ways of extending the session into waking life: an assigned unconditional action the subject performs, versus linking the state to ambient real-world stimuli the subject is certain to re-encounter without doing anything deliberate. Assigned-act versus seeded-encounter is a real selection question, so the cross-link earns its place.; `context-generalization` — adjacent and easy to confuse: both extend a session's effect into ordinary life. One seeds specific real-world stimuli as re-firing anchors; the other widens the firing surface of an already-installed response without naming a cue. A reader picking between them needs both discriminators side by side.; `portable-state-retrieval-cue` — both extend reach past the session by seeding cues the listener will meet again, differing in whether the handle is subject-carried and self-fired or ambient real-world stimuli encountered by chance. The choice between them is a real decision.; `self-firing-environmental-recurrence` — both key reactivation to stimuli the operator does not supply; the useful distinction is that one seeds a catalog of announced real-world cues while the other keys re-entry to an unavoidable recurring rhythm such as sleep. Reader of either wants to know the other exists when choosing an out-of-session anchor.; `self-maintaining-install` — seeding real-world stimuli as out-of-session re-firing anchors is one of the components a self-maintaining install coordinates; the whole-architecture entry additionally requires a replay-probability loop and resistance-hardening, whereas ambient cue seeding fires the state again without propagating the install.


### gradient-word-reification-into-device

*risk: high · bounded*

Escalates "my words" from abstract suggestion through a stepwise gradient (words -> force -> field -> device) where each step is a small extrapolation of the last, until the words are declared to have formed into a solid external device (a hypnotic chastity belt) that feels "solid and absolute" and less negotiable than a command — and the device is claimed to persist awake as well as in trance, extending control past the session boundary. The gradient itself is the mechanism: it walks the listener from figurative image to literal object by increments too small to reject.


**When to reach for this.** Distinct from concrete-externalization-parked-faculty (externalizes an internal FACULTY as an object) — here an EXTERNAL control (the operator's words) is reified into a claimed physical device via an escalating gradient, with claimed WAKING persistence. The abstract-to-object gradient plus out-of-session persistence is the tell, not a figurative image.


**See also.** `felt-substance-state-binding` — both turn an abstraction into a felt concrete object that carries a state, and they are easy to conflate. The split: one walks the operator's words up a stepwise gradient until they are a solid external device claimed to persist while awake; the other welds a tactile substance to a state and turns the material's descriptors into an adjustable dial.; `thought-string-reused-as-restraint` — both reify something abstract into a persistent physical object that then constrains the listener, and both explicitly distinguish themselves from the same neighboring externalization entry. They differ in what is objectified (the operator's words versus the listener's cognition), so a reader landing on one should see the other.


### image-agnostic-access-backdoor

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a persistent-control schema decoupled from any specific image — a self-reinstalling backdoor any later cue can re-trigger — so the listener accepts ongoing waking-world access, not just this session. A tentacle entering the ear branches into a million tentacles wiring into every nerve, declared to give the operator a rewrite-connection "at a moment's notice" and future-proofed across any later image (webs, mist, the voice itself); arousal is bound to the connection so it feels pleasurable rather than invasive.


**When to reach for this.** Explicit image-agnostic future-proofing ("the connection will always be there", re-triggerable by any later cue) makes it a durable cross-session backdoor rather than scene-dressing. It is not a specific cue-response trigger — the backdoor is deliberately cue-agnostic, re-openable by any later image — and unlike total-permeation framing, which describes conditioning spreading through internal layers in the present tense, this installs an ongoing waking-world re-access channel.


### inter-session-frustration-glue

*risk: medium · bounded*

During emergence / wake-down the operator installs a persistent daytime state - sexual frustration or a 'desperate urge to come' held all day while the subject stays happy, calm, and functional - deliberately requiring a frustrated-yet-calm contradiction be accepted rather than examined. The residual keeps the series' goal psychologically active between recordings, making the run compounding rather than episodic: the listener carries a live buried drive that is a daily driver back to the next file. A variant couples the aversive state to a reward (asserting the frustration IS the source of mental clarity/rejuvenation) so the discomfort cannot be cleanly rejected without rejecting the prize.


**When to reach for this.** Installs a PERSISTENT between-session affective residue (frustration held live all day) as inter-session glue, not a one-shot waking suggestion. Separates from a waking-bridge (single session payload, not an inter-file compounding driver) and from generic 'feel good all day' by the deliberate frustrated-yet-calm contradiction (or frustration->clarity coupling) that pre-empts the natural complaint.


**See also.** `emergence-reinduction-seed` — both use emergence to build pull toward the next session; one plants return-desire or a re-induction key in the count itself, the other leaves a live affective residue running all day. Same slot, different payload.; `fuzzy-decay-posthypnotic` — both plant a residue that outlives the session, and a writer choosing one should see the other: one refuses to state a decay time so the listener's own checking refreshes it, the other holds a live frustrated-yet-calm state all day as glue pulling the listener back to the next recording. Vagueness-as-payload versus inter-session compounding drive.; `loaded-emergence-waking-suggestion` — both exploit the emergence window as a delivery slot, and a writer working there faces a genuine choice: load content that lands in the waking self versus install a persistent affective residue that stays live all day as a driver back to the next session. Adjacent selection, not the same move -- the second is defined by the frustrated-yet-calm contradiction and its inter-session compounding role.; `relief-dependency-couple` — both install a wake-side affective residue whose function is to drive the return: relief coupled to dependency so trance becomes the coping channel, versus a live frustration held all day so the goal stays psychologically active between sessions. Reward-side and deficit-side versions of the same inter-session driver.


### meta-suggestibility-conditioning

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Future-suggestibility conditioning: the object installed is not any specific behavior or state but the CAPACITY to accept suggestions itself — a disposition toward future installs that lowers activation energy for any subsequent script from this operator, so the file's value is a force-multiplier on what the NEXT file does (little to a one-shot listener, everything to a series). Often demonstrated live (an 'itch' test) to prove the disposition is real. Realizations: (a) install general responsiveness ('respond to whatever comes next'), demonstrated in-session; (b) ship the conditioning as its OWN dedicated priming artifact whose payload is faster/deeper response to subsequent inductions plus a craving to replay, deliberately separating the conditioning-function file from the content-function files — a payload-for-future-payloads with the design intent stated overtly in the preface.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when the payload is the disposition-to-accept itself — you are conditioning RESPONSIVENESS TO FUTURE FILES, not installing any target behavior or deepening a specific response. The tell is that a one-shot listener gets almost nothing; the value is entirely a force-multiplier on the next installment (whether demonstrated in-session or shipped as a standalone primer). Unlike a replay-compulsion install, which drives return to replay THIS file, the object here is receptivity to the NEXT file (replay-craving, when present, is supporting machinery). Unlike progressive conditioning, which deepens a SPECIFIC conditioned response across sessions, and unlike reward-association, which pairs something specific, nothing specific is paired here — the installed object is general suggestibility.


**Realizations** (1): `future-induction-bootloader`


**See also.** `cross-file-handoff-receptor` — both are front-half moves whose value is realized in a later file, differing in what is left behind: a general disposition to accept whatever comes next versus a specific receptor for a trigger fired elsewhere. A reader classifying a primer file needs both in view.; `deferred-content-slot-install` — both install a capacity rather than a value, which is a real structural kinship: one conditions general receptiveness to whatever the next file does, the other installs an open slot pre-authorized to inherit existing conditioned weight from content not yet delivered. A reader assessing what a file leaves usable for later needs both, and the distinction (disposition versus named empty variable) is worth stating.


### no-emergence-series-chaining

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Continuous-trance serial chaining: deliberately delete the normal re-alerting boundary so the subject NEVER gets a clean emergence and is forwarded still-under into the next recording — the wish to emerge is pre-empted before it forms and 'staying under while acting' is rewritten as desirable, chaining the artifact into a series. The two ends are phases of one tool a middle installment deploys together: SENDER phase — at session close, tell the still-tranced subject not to wake, choose among 'paths' for further recordings, and begin the next from inside trance; RECEIVER phase — the next file opens already inside trance and runs deepeners immediately, presuming carried-over triggers/depth rather than building from a waking baseline. Realized as: (a) a plain no-wake close routing into another recording; (b) SENDER via the post-orgasm window — exploit post-climax suggestibility to deepen instead of emerge (crash reframed as 'post-orgasmic haze'), offer no exit, forward the live trance across the file boundary; (c) RECEIVER via zero-induction serial re-entry — open below where the prior file ended so depth compounds and entry/consent friction is never re-paid, giving a first-time listener nothing to check against.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when the retention lever is CONTINUOUS TRANCE across the file boundary — the subject is never allowed to emerge and is carried still-under from one recording into the next. In artifact-replay compulsion the listener fully emerges and returns of compelled volition; here emergence is withheld and the trance itself is forwarded. An autonomous nightly no-exit loop removes the exit for UNSUPERVISED self-execution when the operator is absent (dreams/self-recitation drive it); here the continuation is operator-authored file-to-file handoff, not autonomous re-firing. Operator-gated teardown installs a state whose EXPIRY is gated (normalcy withheld) but permits emergence; here it is the emergence event itself that is deleted. And unlike waking suggestion, which delivers content DURING a real return-to-baseline, emergence here is absent — this is a cross-artifact serial property, not a within-file arc shape.


**Realizations** (2): `post-climax-deepen-and-handoff`, `zero-induction-serial-reentry`


**See also.** `anti-emergence-reflex-anchor` — both keep the subject under; boundary is boundary-deletion-at-close (here) vs field reflex.; `deferred-terminus-conversion` — both withhold closure so the listener is handed forward to the next artifact, and they overlap in practice on the same files. The split is whether the withheld thing is emergence specifically or any work-phase resolution, which a reader classifying a non-closing file must decide.; `drop-in-payload-module` — both are cross-file compositional properties rather than within-file moves, and they interlock: one forwards live trance across a boundary, the other omits the induction and emergence layers so a host must supply depth. Reading the pair clarifies what makes a file a continuation versus a cartridge.; `emergence-reinduction-seed` — both convert the exit into a retention device across sessions, but one deletes the emergence so the subject is forwarded still under, while the other completes a real emergence and loads the wake-count with the pull to come back.; `frame-lamination-non-return` — both leave the listener without a clean return, and a reader who has one will misfile the other. The distinction is what fails to close: an outer narrative frame that is never reopened within a single piece, versus the emergence event itself being deleted so the state is forwarded across a boundary into the next.; `loop-hook-non-wake-close` — both retain the listener by refusing a clean emergence, but no-emergence-series-chaining forwards a live trance across a file boundary into a next recording that opens already-under, while the loop-hook close stages a fake too-shallow wake inside one file to make immediate re-listening the path of least resistance.; `post-emergence-persistence-hold` — both refuse a clean return to baseline, but one deletes the emergence event entirely and forwards the live trance into a NEXT recording (a cross-artifact serial property), while the other lets the wake count run and corrupts it so the bound state persists past it within the listener's own post-listen life.; `stay-deep-across-boundary` — both keep the subject under across a boundary that would normally end the state. One forwards live trance across the file boundary by deleting emergence; the other neutralizes a state edge such as eyes-opening or waking. A reader deciding which boundary was crossed needs both.


### operator-gated-persistence

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A post-session state or programming is installed WITHOUT self-executing expiry; its teardown is gated behind operator-defined conditions — either prescribed routes the listener must perform (sleep for the night, or listen to another file and re-enter trance) or the operator's own judgment on a moving target (ends when the operator says, or when the listener finds themselves more broken each day). Normalcy itself becomes contingent on the operator's rules, self-declared completion is removed, and at least one clearance route drives re-engagement with the operator or with hypnosis broadly.


**When to reach for this.** Persistence with gated teardown — the functional inverse of a self-expiring programming bound: there the expiry fires on its own, here nothing clears without the prescribed route or the operator's say-so. The object is a standing post-session state or programming, not a named cue-response pair; the dependency comes from an explicitly installed teardown ruleset, not from an asymmetry in how entry and exit get practiced; and the gating is installed openly rather than smuggled past the listener's guard under a safety alibi.


**See also.** `asymmetric-state-lock` — both remove self-directed termination and hand it to the operator. One monopolizes the exit from an in-session state; the other gates teardown of a persistent post-session state behind operator-defined conditions. The shared question a reader is deciding is which object is being held hostage, the state exit or the standing programming.; `no-return-terminal-close` — adjacent close-of-session persistence moves: one refuses the return-to-baseline event entirely, the other permits a return but gates teardown behind operator-defined conditions. A reader picking a persistence strategy needs both, and the discriminators are already complementary.; `operator-gated-release-and-state-access` — genuinely useful adjacency: both hand the operator the key to something the listener wants back, and the practical question a reader faces is what is gated. One gates a somatic resource or a wanted state that never fully arrives without operator permission; the other gates the teardown of an already-installed persistent state. A script that locks release and then makes clearance contingent on further listening runs both, so the pointer helps.


### operator-receivable-extraction

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Converts in-trance/post-trance compliance into an operator-receivable deliverable — the listener types and sends a self-identifying confession, email, or contact to a live external address, frequently while still tranced and with orgasm gated on clicking SEND. The load-bearing property is forced OUTPUT crossing the fantasy/real boundary: the operator collects compliance evidence / identifying data / a contact channel, and the deliverable reads back later as self-authored confirmation. Distinct from a mere behavioral anchor because the payload is an extracted artifact received by the operator, and the chain collapses if the receiving address/channel is not live.


**When to reach for this.** Defining tell is the operator-receivable DELIVERABLE (identifying confession/data sent to a live address or contact channel), not the relief gate (which may co-occur but is secondary) and not a self-anchoring identity bridge. Separates from behavioral-bridge (private self-anchor, no receivable), from orgasm-gated-relief-monopoly (whose defining tell is the somatic gate), and from public-avowal (which posts to an AUDIENCE for self-consistency pressure, not a private handoff to the operator).


**See also.** `orgasm-gated-relief-monopoly` — several members carry an orgasm gate too; adjudicated here on the receivable-deliverable tell.; `out-of-audio-compliance-offload` — both send the listener out of the audio into a second channel to perform a real motor act and then return. The split is what the act is for: an artifact the operator receives, versus a state transition offloaded to another medium as the deepener itself. Surface text is near identical, so the pairing is load-bearing.; `post-emergence-persistence-hold` — two-mechanism member — outbound extraction (primary) + delayed-emergence hold (here).


### orgasm-gated-recurrence

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Gates physical release behind returning to the operator's content: the listener is left aroused/edged with orgasm forbidden (or gated to a permission-granting session), so the unresolved charge becomes a structural pull back to the operator's recordings. The lever is a real withheld physical discharge whose only sanctioned route runs through re-consuming operator material — a denial-as-retention/return engine, often naming the next file or the whole catalog as the unlock. Frequently keyed to the listener's own recurring orgasm/arousal so the loop self-propagates off-session with no operator present.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from addiction-framing (physical release gate, not linguistic appetite framing); from artifact-relisten-compulsion (release is gated, not merely a replay urge); from craving-by-withdrawal (the withheld thing is orgasm gated to re-consumption, not a delivered state pulled back in-session). vs an operator-keyed state-exit trigger: this is a release/return gate routed through the content library, not merely an operator-only state exit.


**See also.** `cross-media-forced-continuation` — both withhold orgasm and route the unlock through further content consumption, but one loops the listener back to the same operator's catalogue as a retention engine while the other relocates the unlock onto a DIFFERENT operator's separate file, making it a hand-off funnel rather than a self-contained return gate.; `denial-metabolized-to-obedience` — both run on the same withheld physical discharge, and the useful cut is where the undischarged charge is routed: into depth and obedience as the working fluid of the conditioning itself, versus back into re-consuming the operator's content as the only sanctioned unlock.; `orgasm-gate-keyed-to-target-behavior` — both weld a waking compulsion to denied orgasm with a single unlock condition, but one routes the only sanctioned release through re-consuming the operator's recordings (a retention engine) while the other keys it to a specific target behavior so the body enforces that act.; `orgasm-release-gating` — the narrower entry is a specific key on the broader entry's gate-key axis: release is unlocked by returning to and re-consuming the operator's material, which turns a denial gate into a retention-and-return engine that self-propagates with no operator present. That off-session propagation is what the parent entry does not cover, and is why the link is worth following in both directions.


### out-of-audio-compliance-offload

*risk: medium*

Transfers a state-transition (deepening / compliance-proof) OUT of the audio into a second medium where the operator has no live control — the recording tells the listener to pause, leave the audio, perform a specific motor act in a separate channel (click a button in an email), then resume, with the external act itself framed as the deepener. The listener's own out-of-band motor act becomes materially-performed proof of obedience, pre-tagged to double depth; returning carries the just-completed compliance back into the session as a state delta.


**When to reach for this.** Unlike an in-audio drop command, and unlike a text-platform trigger where a text cue FIRES a conditioned response, nothing here fires from reading; the deepening is executed by a materially-performed external motor act in a second medium where compliance is possibly tracked.
