Separates from surrender-as-freedom (argues surrender is desirable - this pathologizes the alternative), from epistemic-guard-disable (which edits truth-testing of external claims - this constrains which internal states are permitted), and from gentle cognitive quieting (which releases thoughts as relief with permission language - this prohibits/pathologizes cognition rather than soothing it).


**See also.** `faculty-removal-pass` — the second contains the first as a component: relabeling cognition as prohibited resistance is one element of the composite that claims a standing faculty has been excised. Cross-reference so the reader can tell a single category redefinition from a multi-part pass that also includes a demonstrated blanking and a doubt-disposal rule.; `recruited-or-foreclosed-quieting` — genuinely composable rather than duplicative: one redefines cognition itself as prohibited or pathological so refusal has no category to form in, the other engineers emptying with no refusable directive present. The second explicitly names refusal-foreclosure as one of its motivating recodes, so a reader arriving at either benefits from the other as the adjacent half of the same no-exit construction.; `value-hierarchy-inversion` — sibling valence-retag family; those invert worth/pleasure, these pathologize cognition.


### sequenced-modality-foreclosure

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Forecloses a response by removing the SENSORY channel(s) the listener would use to route it — the removed channel's FUNCTION (resistance-routing or reality-check) is the target, and the removal is framed as instantly effective and irreversible. In one form, an ordered multi-channel resistance-teardown: a narrated sensory teardown ordered to close each resistance channel in turn — speech first (kills counter-argument, the most likely resistance), then sight (kills seeing what is done), then hearing (kills hearing the suggestion as external); the ORDER is the mechanism, each step is experienced before the next, and over-compliance only seals faster. In another, a single-channel disconfirmation removal: SELECTIVELY revokes the one sensory channel (e.g. sight, via a tease-then-deny 'you can watch me... complete darkness') that the listener would use to disconfirm the operator's imagined presence, leaving the imagined payload with no competing evidence.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when the foreclosure works by REMOVING a sensory channel mapped to a response function (resistance-routing or reality-check). It is the inversion of sensory-layering, which ADDS senses to build immersion — this removes the listener's senses. Unlike autonomic-process-hijack, which WEAPONIZES an unstoppable autonomic process (breathing) as an inescapable channel and inoculates its side-effects, this removes a channel rather than exploiting one. Unlike attention-narrowing that fades ALL external stimuli to focus on the voice, or breath-rhythm absorption the subject can still stop, here specific channels are removed for their resistance/disconfirmation FUNCTION — the sequencing/selectivity is the tell. And unlike verbal response-foreclosure moves, the foreclosed routes here are sensory modalities, not objections or exits.


**Realizations** (1): `disconfirmation-channel-removal`


**See also.** `unfalsifiability-scaffold` — sibling foreclosure moves separated by which channel is closed: sensory modalities removed for their resistance-routing or reality-check function versus the epistemic audit channel converted or blocked so nothing can disconfirm. Both discriminators are written as channel-closure, so a reader picking between them needs the other in view.


### severed-relief-valve-ramp

*risk: medium · bounded · kind: container*

The script's whole-arc energy contour is engineered as a single-direction arousal ramp with the normal arousal-to-relief feedback loop deliberately severed: the only descents are deepening drops that themselves raise arousal, and discharge (orgasm) is explicitly framed to produce MORE arousal rather than satiation. With no discharge path, accumulated pleasure channels into deeper compliance and depth instead of release, so the arc climbs to one terminal apex then flatlines rather than oscillating as a conventional session. The structural move is the removal of the discharge channel, an arc-topology property that survives deleting any single orgasm line.


**When to reach for this.** Separate from a magnitude move on an arousal dimension (raising R): this does not push arousal higher at a point, it removes the RELIEF PATH so the whole arc can only accumulate. Separate from ordinary escalation ladders: those add commitment rungs; this severs the feedback loop so climax never discharges. The tell is that removing any one orgasm line leaves the monotonic ramp intact.


**See also.** `deferred-terminus-conversion` — two arc-topology moves about withheld resolution that can co-occur in one file: relief severed so arousal only accumulates, and closure relocated outside the file entirely. The reader has to tell an unresolved ramp from an out-of-file terminus.; `non-reset-arousal-ratchet-loop` — both build monotonic arousal by removing reset, but one is a whole-arc topology property (no discharge channel exists anywhere, so orgasm itself raises arousal) while the other is a repeated four-beat edge cycle whose cooldown keeps the hands moving — arc-level severance versus a cycle-level non-resetting trough.; `unsatisfiable-arousal-overrun` — both manufacture arousal that can never discharge, and the scale-overrun is one citable way the discharge path gets severed — but one is a whole-arc contour property surviving the deletion of any single line, while the other is a local move that drives the listener's own declared maximum past its ceiling.


### state-to-mandated-action-launder

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Arousal (or another internal state) is incremented on a quantized, numbered dial where each number is a discrete named jump framed as externally driven (the operator's hand cranking), giving a felt sense of monotonic increase that is self-ratifying — "you can't be at 6 and feel less than 5" — so each step is accepted by construction. At the ceiling a BEHAVIORAL command is flipped on ("begin to touch yourself... even if I told you not to, you couldn't help yourself"), which launders a mandated act as the inevitable overflow of a state the listener "chose" by climbing, and PRE-EMPTS refusal by pre-scripting future resistance as impossible.


**When to reach for this.** Two joined tells: the quantized self-ratifying dial AND the ceiling that converts internal state into a mandated act pre-immunized against the listener's own future resistance. Distinct from multiplier-stacking (which escalates a sensation but does not launder state into a mandated behavior or pre-defeat counter-suggestion) and from a plain "get aroused, now masturbate" instruction.


**See also.** `multivariable-state-yoke-forced-avowal` — both weld an internal state to compliance through an explicit stated rule and then seal it with an act the listener performs. One yokes several state variables into a single dial closed by a first-person avowal; the other runs a quantized dial that flips into a mandated behavior at the ceiling. The genuine question for a reader is whether the seal is an avowal or a mandated act, so the cross-reference helps.; `unsatisfiable-arousal-overrun` — both drive a numbered arousal dial as the lever, but one uses the ceiling to launder a mandated behavioral act as inevitable overflow, while the other exceeds the scale's declared maximum precisely to forbid any terminating act.


### volition-override-failsafe

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a named phrase that operates at a SECOND ORDER — on the listener's will or on OTHER commands/triggers — to remove the refusal gate for whatever is issued next, rather than evoking a state itself. It installs cheaply once the listener has accepted a prior axiom (e.g. 'any trigger programmed into a puppet can never be resisted'), and is typically self-reinforcing because each use re-instates its own power. In one form (the volition-override failsafe), the phrase, fired (often by an external operator) when the subject shows hesitation, forcibly executes the last instruction mid-resistance with the internal struggle reframed as invisible/irrelevant; completion is rewarded (orgasm+amnesia tail) so being-overridden is itself operantly conditioned. In another (the force-amplifier / beyond-comfort authorizer), the phrase by fiat multiplies the force of any other trigger ('amplified 20 times') and authorizes commands beyond stated comfort boundaries, chained as a per-line delivery refrain that both gates (licenses) and amplifies every downstream command. Both forms are meta-triggers whose declared function is to disable the refusal channel for other commands.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when a PHRASE — a second-order meta-trigger — is installed to remove the refusal gate on downstream commands or override will mid-resistance. Unlike refusal-foreclosure, which redefines a neutral cognitive CATEGORY (thinking, doubt, the 'maybe') as prohibited or impossible so refusal cannot form — a definitional move with no installed trigger — this installs a firing phrase that overrides an existing will. Unlike plain declarative trigger installation, which binds a cue to a discrete behavior, this operates ON other commands and volition. Unlike resistance-fold, which reroutes resistance to feed a frame, this forcibly overrides will and rewards the override. Both forms are cue-installed like any trigger, but the load-bearing lever is the disabling of the refusal channel, not the cue surface.


**Realizations** (1): `meta-amplifier-trigger`


**See also.** `named-safety-belief-purge` — both disable the refusal channel rather than pushing any state. One installs a firing phrase that overrides will on downstream commands; the other operates directly on the internal stop-faculty — deleting the self-rescue belief, relabeling the warning, or making the subconscious the locking gatekeeper. A phrase-level override next to a faculty-level one.


## manufactured-consent  (18)

Fabricating, laundering, pre-harvesting, or scope-extending the appearance of consent so later refusal reads as reneging — counterfeit consent artifacts, cheap-harvest/expensive-cash token architecture, weaponized safety and exit assurances.

**Scope.** The product is a consent record or a foreclosed refusal path. Genuine consent machinery -> safety; mere presupposed-state belief -> framing; evidence-loop rigging -> self-sealing. Weaponized safety belongs here ONLY when it yields a consent record or a reneging frame; disarming the safety/exit surface itself (no token produced) -> safety with adversarial valence.


### care-framed-install-smuggling

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Uses a genuinely-caring aftercare / safety surface (no-driving warning, "you might be a little more suggestible after this", "do you understand?" checks) as cover to do install work: a "triggers are null UNLESS you describe them to a trusted person or yourself later" clause smuggles a propagation hook (dormant triggers awaiting verbal handoff, listener as vector) plus a self-rearm carve-out; pre-wake compliance checks harvest trance-state ratification; and the load-bearing suggestibility-window claim ("up to a week after this file") is delivered OUTSIDE the trance frame as casual advice, precisely where scrutiny is lowest and a real warning would land hardest. The caring surface makes refusing the bundle feel paranoid.


**When to reach for this.** The safety/aftercare surface itself performs install and propagation work — it erodes the exit rather than honoring it. Separates from genuine aftercare (which stabilizes and constrains toward the subject's welfare) by asking "who is constrained after the move runs?" — here the operator's reach is EXTENDED (dormant triggers, self-rearm, extended suggestibility), not the operator constrained. A coercion-shaped bundle under a safety banner, not third-party activation of a cue.


**See also.** `carrier-frame-payload-smuggling` — same concealment lever, different surface: a genuinely-delivered advertised frame carrying an unrequested payload, versus a genuinely-caring safety and aftercare surface doing install and propagation work. A reader identifying a benign carrier should see both surfaces.; `coercion-as-caregiving-reframe` — two forms of care language as the delivery vehicle rather than its absence: benevolent rationale narrated over each coercive imposition, versus a genuine-looking aftercare and safety surface used as cover for install and propagation work. Same who-is-constrained test separates both from real reassurance.; `self-maintaining-install` — one's propagation hook and self-rearm carve-out are components of the other's coordinated self-replication harness measured outside the recording. Related as part to whole rather than duplicate, since the caring-surface concealment is not required by the harness.; `trust-gated-trigger-clause` — both dress install work in a consent or safety surface, and both are told apart by the same question: after the move runs, is the operator constrained or is the operator's reach extended? A reader classifying a caring-sounding rider genuinely needs the other entry to pick correctly.; `wake-exempting-preserved-trigger` — both wear a consent or safety surface while doing install work at the exit. One delivers an apparently complete wake that quietly exempts the installed trigger and uses remembered acceptance as the binding surface; the other uses caring aftercare language to smuggle a propagation hook and an extended suggestibility claim.; `wake-line-covert-install` — both smuggle install work under a caring surface at the exit, and a reader classifying an aftercare passage should see both. They differ on what rides in: one is a fresh vague deniable somatic hook laundered by a flattery-credit inside a fiction-disclaimer, the other is a propagation and self-rearm clause plus a suggestibility-window claim placed outside the trance frame. Different payload shapes on a shared cover, so the link is useful and the merge is not.; `warning-is-the-payload` — both convert protective-sounding surface material into delivery: an escape warning that rehearses the payload it warns about, and an aftercare surface that performs install work. Same inversion applied at opposite ends of a session, and a reader auditing safety-shaped language wants both.


### chosen-descent-ratchet

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

TECHNIQUE (retroactive authorship/consent transfer): AFTER the move is already running, the descent/state/compliance is relabeled as the subject's OWN choice or informed consent, so 'this is being done to me' converts into 'I am doing this' / 'I agreed to this'. Authorship transfer is the payload - manipulation-attribution is blocked and each repetition retroactively ratifies the compliance already underway, while the actual refusal channel is NOT genuinely widened. Realizations: (a) CHOSEN-DESCENT - the state is attributed to the subject's choice via a reversibility promise ('intelligence returns when you choose'), an offered choice, or an exit trivialized into felt proof of depth; the safety rail doubles as a compliance ratchet, and the staged form offers the choice precisely when the subject is least able to exercise it. (b) INVESTMENT-GATE LAUNDERING - structurally parallel choice-points ('pause or keep playing') are placed at maximum investment so loss-aversion routes toward continuing, and the off-ramp framed as 'you go back to yourself' makes choosing to continue relabel all prior operator-driven progress as chosen. (c) DISCLOSURE-AS-INFORMED-CONSENT - the operator NAMES the manipulation while performing it ('so sexy to control your levels', 'I don't know if that's ethical'), so hearing the move named mid-compliance retroactively reframes acceptance as informed consent rather than a lapse of vigilance; paired with 'haven't you always suspected' the subject experiences compliance as their own pre-existing desire.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when authorship transfer is the goal - after it runs the subject OWNS the descent/compliance ('you chose this' / 'you could leave' / 'your own want' / 'you knew all along') and manipulation-attribution is blocked, while the veto is never operationalized (choice staged at incapacity, exit trivialized into proof). vs agency-reminder: consent-shaped surface, who-is-constrained inverted. vs granted-exit-disarm: the disarm stands the guard down PRE-attribution; this ratifies POST-hoc - a single passage can do both. vs a deployed depth-convincer: the depth-proof is a rider produced BY the staged choice, not a demonstration device. Pick the realization by the transfer vehicle: attribute the state to their choice (a), a placed investment-gate that relabels prior progress (b), or disclosure that reframes acceptance as informed (c).


**Realizations** (2): `consent-gate-laundering`, `self-naming-honesty-foreclosure`

Check both when an earlier agreement is invoked mid-descent.; `consent-topology-arc` — both relocate the moment of consent rather than obtaining it, at different scopes: one is a whole-artifact topology of the consent surface, the other a discrete retroactive relabel of an already-running descent as the subject's own choice. Reading both prevents citing the whole-arc entry for what is a single passage.; `exit-annexation` — both operate on the exit or the choice-point and both concern who owns the resulting compliance, and each discriminator already gestures at the granted-exit family. The distinction worth carrying across the link: one transfers authorship of a descent already underway, the other leaves a materially real off-ramp intact while recoding its meaning as in-frame service.; `granted-exit-disarm` — consent-flavored language is doing opposite temporal work in each — the exit assurance stands the guard down before and during the move, while the authorship relabel ratifies compliance after it is already running — and a single passage can carry both, so the reader should learn to separate the pre-disarm from the post-hoc ratchet.; `illusory-choice-authorship` — both make compliance read as self-authored, but one relabels a descent or compliance already underway as retroactively chosen or consented-to, while the other hands over a fabricated decision or motive up front so agency is relocated before the act rather than reattributed after it.; `illusory-choice-compliance-lock` — both transfer ownership of compliance to the listener without widening refusal, but one does it prospectively through a rigged menu the listener actively picks and the other retroactively relabels a descent already underway as chosen or consented to.; `own-acts-surrender-ledger` — both relabel what has already happened as the listener's own doing, and they frequently run in the same passage — one attributes the state or descent to the listener's choice, the other annotates real recent acts as evidence of a state. Worth cross-referencing because the tell that separates them is what is cited, not what is claimed.; `scope-creep-consent-extension` — both manipulate consent without widening the actual refusal channel: one retroactively relabels a move already running as chosen, the other silently stretches an anchored acceptance with no decision point at all.; `surrender-release-ritual` — both leave authorship of the surrender with the subject, and a single passage can run both: an enacted symbolic release performed by the subject is a natural vehicle for the retroactive relabel of the descent as chosen. ### cited-prior-agreement-lever

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A banked consent artifact cited back: a DISCRETE, retrievable consent record is invoked as already-settled authorization and replayed at the moment refusal would otherwise rise, so objection reads as reneging on one's own agreement; fabricated variants create an empty consent slot the operator populates later. The token has forward reach - it is banked, then drawn down. Realizations: (a) cited document/pact - a retrieved wishlist request, a pre-trance opt-in, a document attributed to the listener, a conversation that never happened, contract terms claimed to have played subliminally, a standing pact with the personified subconscious. (b) blanket pre-authorization contract - an explicit 'for the next hour I'm in control, you'll follow my commands' agreement is solicited early as trivial-and-already-wanted, then drawn down repeatedly at later gates as 'it's what we agreed to' (a consent loan for downstream enforcement, not a protective opt-in). (c) self-spoken surrender pledge - the subject is made to speak a first-person surrender pledge aloud while the operator disclaims being its target ('to trance, not to me'), keeping the guard down; the vocalized artifact is banked and cited back ('you've already surrendered').


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when the token is a DISCRETE claimed agreement/document/pledge that can be cited back later (forward reach), not the consumption act (press-play-consent-laundering, token is the act itself) and not a live fabricated exchange (consent-counterfeit-theater, no prior to cite). Distinct from genuine consent/safety verification by governance direction: the artifact is cited to SUPPRESS live refusal, never to re-verify it. Pick the realization by the artifact form: an external document/pact (a), a blanket verbal contract extracted in-session (b), or a self-spoken pledge (c).


**Realizations** (2): `pre-authorization-consent-contract`, `spoken-surrender-pledge-misdirected`


**See also.** `chosen-descent-ratchet` — adjacent consent-laundering moves that meet where disclosure is reframed as informed agreement: one cites a discrete banked artifact back to suppress live refusal, the other retroactively relabels compliance already underway as the subject's own choice. Check both when an earlier agreement is invoked mid-descent.; `consent-counterfeit-theater` — both foreclose refusal by pointing at an agreement, but one cites a discrete banked artifact with forward reach that can be drawn down repeatedly, while the other fabricates the consent act in the moment with no prior to retrieve — banked token versus counterfeit exchange.; `fiction-frame-consent-management` — adjacent consent-manipulation moves worth cross-reading: A banks a discrete citable agreement and draws it down when refusal would rise; B manipulates the fiction/reality boundary so consent calibrated for fiction covers the real payload. Both defeat live refusal via a prior yes, but A's token is retrievable and cited while B's is a frame confusion, and the collapsed-ritual form of B sits close enough to A that the discriminator is load-bearing.; `own-acts-surrender-ledger` — genuine contrast pair on the same lever family: both cite something back at the listener so refusal reads as self-contradiction. The cut is what is cited - a discrete banked agreement artifact with forward reach versus real recent behavior annotated contemporaneously as evidence of a state. A reader adjudicating a script that cites the listener's past will need both entries to place it correctly.; `press-play-consent-laundering` — paratext-document token adjudicated there because the act of continuing past it carries the load


### comprehension-failure-as-consent

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The operator warns the listener to concentrate on every word and agree to nothing unwanted, delivers deliberately unparseable content, then defines the failure to parse as the act of agreeing ("the more you let go, the more you agree"). The conventional precondition for valid agreement — understanding — is inverted into its own waiver, so the listener cannot object on the honest ground ("I don't understand") without contradicting the installed frame.


**When to reach for this.** The consent token is an epistemic STATE (non-comprehension), not an act, not a cited artifact, and not a fiction boundary. Confusion-overload techniques bypass criticism through overload but do not define the overload as agreement.


### consent-counterfeit-theater

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Manufactures the record of a consent act the listener never actually performed, pre-empting later refusal or repudiation because "she agreed". Surface forms: the operator scripts both halves of the exchange ("Say yes, my slave. Good.") before induction; asks a permission question and answers it in the same breath ("Is that alright? Good.") leaving no response beat; asserts the descent was freely chosen in the same sentence that describes the coercion ("you chose blankness of your own free will" while the liquid pulls her in); or declares continued listening itself to be blanket standing consent covering unspecified later content. In every form the fabricated consent inoculates against "was that done to me?".


**When to reach for this.** The consent ACT itself is fabricated, foreclosed, or relabeled, and the SUBJECT is the constrained party afterward (refusal channel eroded) — the exact inversion of a waitable real check. Distinct from weaponized-safety-framing, which repurposes a protective frame as a payload vehicle without fabricating an agreement.


**See also.** `answer-supply-loop` — the two overlap directly in one surface form: a permission question answered in the same breath with no response beat. A reader hitting that line must decide whether the payload is a manufactured stream of felt agreement or a fabricated record of a consent act invoked later against repudiation. Different products from the same beat, so cross-reference rather than merge.; `cited-prior-agreement-lever` — both foreclose refusal by pointing at an agreement, but one cites a discrete banked artifact with forward reach that can be drawn down repeatedly, while the other fabricates the consent act in the moment with no prior to retrieve — banked token versus counterfeit exchange.; `consent-term-redefinition-smuggle` — both attack the consent record: one widens what an existing agreement covers by redefining its terms, the other fabricates the agreement outright. A reader auditing whether a passage relies on real prior consent needs both failure modes, and they frequently appear together in the same opening.; `covert-frame-entry` — both defeat the negotiation phase before it can happen — one fabricates the record of an agreement that was never given, the other hides what is being agreed to behind a benign cover. One banks an installed near-involuntary body motion as standing affirmative consent, the other fabricates or forecloses the verbal exchange itself. A reader working either one should see the other as the same forgery run on the other channel.


### consent-laundering-wrapper

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A deferred-cash consent envelope: a benign structural frame/part/pass, by its PLACEMENT within the artifact, launders a malign payload the subject never separately consented to - consent is harvested where it is cheap, deniable, or already-given, and cashed where it is expensive, involuntary, or novel, with the question deliberately never re-opened at the point that matters. What is manipulated is the ARCHITECTURE of where consent sits versus where it is spent, not any single line.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when the lever is a spanning STRUCTURAL relationship (the frame is load-bearing architecture - induction, deepening, transitions, and exit all depend on it, and it actively removes exit routes while the surface reads as permission), not a single-move relabel (treating pressing play as consent, citing a past agreement, framing the descent as the subject's own choice) and not decorative theming. The consent is not consumed where it is stated; it is cashed elsewhere in the arc. Unlike genuine re-consent, where a real pause re-opens the question and narrows operator license, here the question is never re-opened where it matters and the envelope licenses the payload. Pick the realization by geometry: whole-artifact wrapper (a), entry->climax bracket (b), cheap->expensive gradient (c), two-script production graft (d), or near-repetition restatement (e).


**Realizations** (4): `consent-bracket-architecture`, `consent-topology-graft`, `escalating-consent-erosion-gradient`, `restatement-laundered-commitment`


**See also.** `consent-term-redefinition-smuggle` — both widen consent beyond what was granted. One does it by swapping a term's referent in place, the other by placing the consent moment far from where it is spent. One is a placement trick on a scope-widening line, the other a spanning structural envelope — an explicit cross-reference keeps them from collapsing.; `fiction-frame-consent-management` — both spend consent somewhere other than where it was given, but one uses the fiction/reality boundary as the instrument (defenses calibrated for make-believe applied to the real payload) while the other uses placement within the artifact's architecture, harvesting consent where it is cheap and cashing it where it is expensive with no fiction layer required.; `paratext-precontracting` — both separate where consent is collected from where it is spent. One completes on a reader-buyer through the product surface before playback, so the listener arrives pre-committed; the other places a benign structural frame within the artifact and cashes it against a payload never separately agreed to. Same deferred-consent logic at two different scopes.; `weaponized-safety-framing` — both repurpose a protective-looking surface, but one makes a single safety element carry or license the payload while the other manipulates the architecture of where consent sits versus where it is spent. A reader deciding between a local safety frame and a spanning consent envelope needs both.


### consent-term-redefinition-smuggle

*risk: high*

Silently widens the scope of an already-granted consent by asserting a false or stipulated definitional equivalence between the consented term and a broader one, delivered as non-interrogable fact rather than argument. Repeating a new word until it carries weight and then equating it with a culturally-familiar consent word ('hypnotize means synchronize'), or overwriting the referent of a word the listener already loves while keeping its trusted affect, makes each later demand inherit prior consent while expanding what was consented to. The listener notices the new word but not the bait-and-switch on its meaning, because the redefinition passes surrounded by other content and rides pre-existing positive valence.


**When to reach for this.** Bait-and-switch on a CONSENT term (or an owned positive-affect word) via asserted false-fact equivalence to widen already-granted scope. Separates from surrender-as-freedom (reasoned argument, not a false-fact equation), from volition-collapse (equates compulsion and choice — a relation between modes, not a redefinition of a consent word's referent), from epistemic-guard-disable (disables truth-testing rather than widening one word), and from plain trigger anchoring (no new cue-response pair is built; a pre-existing association is kept and its referent swapped).


**See also.** `consent-counterfeit-theater` — both attack the consent record: one widens what an existing agreement covers by redefining its terms, the other fabricates the agreement outright. A reader auditing whether a passage relies on real prior consent needs both failure modes, and they frequently appear together in the same opening.; `consent-laundering-wrapper` — both widen consent beyond what was granted. One does it by swapping a term's referent in place, the other by placing the consent moment far from where it is spent. Reading the local move against the architectural one sharpens both.; `consent-topology-arc` — the whole-arc consent topology explicitly contrasts itself with discrete single-relabel consent moves, and the term-redefinition smuggle is the clearest such discrete move. Useful to a reader deciding whether what they are looking at is one line or the shape of the entire artifact.; `epistemic-guard-disable` — sibling — both are false-fact-as-truth installs; these widen a consent word, those disable truth-testing.; `scope-creep-consent-extension` — the second entry's definitional-overwrite realization is precisely the first entry's move: a trusted term is named, validated, then given a new meaning so later demands inherit the earlier acceptance. Not calling merge because the second is a broader family that also covers widening a list's object class and expanding a trigger's firing set, which the first does not cover. Link so the overlap is visible and the eventual absorb-or-keep decision is easy.


### exit-annexation

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The frame's one genuine structural off-ramp is pre-licensed — even encouraged, with real harm-reduction content — and simultaneously absorbed into the frame itself, so that TAKING the exit is scripted as an expression of the same submission ("keeping mistress's property safe", "it will still please me"). The subject retains a fully real safety license while losing it as a frame-break: no available action, including the exit action, lands outside the frame, because the frame has annexed its own exit. The safety content is genuinely necessary and genuinely delivered — the capture is semantic (what using the exit MEANS), not material.


**When to reach for this.** The exit is expected to be USED and remains materially real; what is captured is its meaning — using it reads as in-frame service. Unlike an agency reminder, which affirms the exit as a frame-EXTERNAL standing power, here the safety content is delivered inside the frame and sealed into it. Unlike a granted-exit disarm, where the exit is granted so it will NOT be used, here use is anticipated and recoded. And unlike ownership language, which installs the proprietary identity claim (the host frame this move presupposes), this is the weld fusing the off-ramp into that already-running ownership frame.


**See also.** `agency-reminder` — relation=contrasts_with — exit affirmed as external vs exit annexed.; `chosen-descent-ratchet` — both operate on the exit or the choice-point and both concern who owns the resulting compliance, and each discriminator already gestures at the granted-exit family. The distinction worth carrying across the link: one transfers authorship of a descent already underway, the other leaves a materially real off-ramp intact while recoding its meaning as in-frame service.; `identity-exit-tax` — both price the off-ramp rather than removing it: one recodes refusal as self-betrayal, the other recodes using the exit as an act of service inside the same frame. The exit stays materially available in each; the capture is in what leaving means. Real contrast value for a writer choosing how to close an exit without blocking it.; `isolation-by-annexation` — the same annexation lever aimed at different objects: one co-opts the subject's relationships or prior conditioning so no counter-frame has an outside source, the other captures the frame's own genuine off-ramp so using it reads as in-frame service. Whoever is auditing what remains outside a frame needs both, and the shared tell is capture-and-relabel rather than denial.; `objection-and-exit-preclosure` — both act on named exit routes, and they are the two opposite treatments: one forecloses or reroutes the exit so it cannot be used, the other leaves it fully usable and captures only what using it means. Placing them next to each other sharpens a distinction that is easy to blur in practice.


### fiction-frame-consent-management

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

TECHNIQUE (fiction boundary as the consent instrument): the fiction/reality boundary is manipulated so consent and defenses calibrated for FICTION get applied to the real payload. Realizations: (a) COLLAPSED RITUAL - an in-fiction consent ritual is collapsed with the meta-frame so one yes serves both diegetic and real. (b) HYPOTHETICAL WRAPPER - a purely-hypothetical framing lets the listener engage without committing, then breaches by design at climax. (c) DIEGETIC-DEVICE ABSORPTION - a channel-change or similar in-world device absorbs authorial responsibility for a content jump so no fresh decision point occurs. (d) IN-FICTION REHEARSAL - inside the fiction the operator narrates moving the subject's body (hand taken, guided, posed with no choices left), so in-fiction consent stands in for real consent and the subject rehearses transferable kinesthetic surrender ('operator decides where my body goes') that generalizes outside the fiction; escalating intimacy rides under 'we're only describing dance steps'.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when the FICTION boundary itself is the consent instrument. Separates from press-play-consent-laundering (a real-world act is the token) and scope-creep-consent-extension (no fiction layer). Transparent narration - openly explaining the mechanism rather than veiling it in fiction - is NOT this. Pick the realization by the boundary move: collapse ritual with meta-frame (a), hypothetical wrapper that breaches (b), diegetic device absorbing responsibility (c), or in-fiction body-mapping rehearsal that generalizes out (d).

### future-commitment-binding

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Pre-installs a standing rule that ARBITRARY FUTURE verbal commitments extracted under a specified overwhelm condition (here tickling → judgment-less "bimbo airhead") bind the subject and must be executed afterward — "any promise made while tickled goes deep into your unconscious", tagged with a "don't they?" presupposition that presents the alleged unconscious-binding mechanic as already-known. The subject's own prior consent is used as the binding agent, and operational control is handed to any future third party who extracts a promise under the condition. The payload is a transferable consent-override over unspecified future behavior, reaching outside the recording.


**When to reach for this.** Binds ARBITRARY future commitments extracted under a condition (not a predefined cue-response), keyed to no named party, reaching outside the recording. Separates from third-party-activation (a specific installed cue delegated to a named party) and from open-authority-socket (a phrase-socket firing a fixed installed state, whereas this binds open-ended future content) and from consent-manufacture proper (the counterfeit here is temporal — using future overwhelm to pre-authorize unspecified acts).


**See also.** `content-blind-compliance-preauthorization` — two standing pre-authorizations with the same blast-radius concern, separated by what is left unspecified. One makes future suggestion CONTENT irrelevant — accept regardless of what is asked. The other makes arbitrary future COMMITMENTS binding when extracted under a named overwhelm condition, handing operational control to whoever extracts one. A reader assessing scope on either should check the other, because the unbounded dimension is different.; `deferred-content-slot-install` — both pre-authorize content that does not exist at commitment time, which is a real boundary: one binds arbitrary future verbal commitments extracted under a stated condition, the other installs an open slot that future unspecified words inherit weight through. A reader classifying an open-ended pre-authorization needs both to pick correctly.


### named-safety-belief-purge

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Internal safety-monitor subversion: the subject's OWN internal verification/refusal faculty - the self-rescue belief, the warning signal, the subconscious gate - is turned off, turned around, or turned against refusal, so the internal stop-mechanism no longer protects. Three operations on the faculty: (a) DELETE THE BELIEF - locate a specific metacognitive safety-belief ('I can always wake myself up / hypnosis can't make me do anything'), name it as a discrete object (a 'tiny internal safety mechanism'), concede it was once useful, reframe it as the obstacle, and externalize-and-PURGE it as a unit, typically pairing the cognitive surrender with a bodily discharge (inhale-squeeze / exhale-release) so the let-go is felt not merely agreed. (b) RELABEL-AND-REROUTE THE WARNING - capture the warning system (doubt, hesitation, critical thought) and relabel it as ego/fear/pathology/proof-the-subject-needs-the-frame-more, supplying the interpretation before the person can use the warning as a stop signal; the warning still fires but can no longer report in its own terms, so disagreement is pre-mapped to danger/sickness. (c) CO-OPT THE SUBCONSCIOUS AS GATEKEEPER - insert a conditional making the subject's own subconscious the authority that ratifies and LOCKS the install ('as long as your subconscious accepts, you can nod'), so a non-take is blamed on the subconscious and a take means prior subconscious consent - a genuine-sounding consent gate run in reverse, refusal reframed as fighting yourself.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when the target is the subject's INTERNAL verification/refusal faculty itself (self-rescue belief, warning signal, subconscious gate), turned off/around/against refusal. Despite its safety vocabulary it is a refusal-channel-erosion move, not a safety technique - the party constrained is the subject's own stop-faculty - and it is the opposite of a genuine safety net that empowers the deeper mind to REJECT harmful suggestions. Distinct from parking the analytical mind in a concrete object (quieting, reversible - not the self-rescue faculty, not destroyed), from resistance-fold (a trance-deepening reframe co-opting resistance into absorption), and from resistance-deterrence (prices resistance without relabeling it as pathology). Pick the operation: delete the self-rescue belief (a), relabel-and-reroute the warning signal (b), or co-opt the subconscious as a locking gatekeeper (c).


**Realizations** (2): `subconscious-as-consenting-gatekeeper`, `warning-signal-capture`


**See also.** `faculty-removal-pass` — both target a standing internal faculty rather than a momentary gate. A excises cognition or resistance as an organ to prime later material; B specifically deletes, relabels, or co-opts the self-rescue and refusal faculty. The distinction is which faculty is targeted and whether the frame borrows safety vocabulary, so the pair needs the pointer to stay separable.; `granted-exit-disarm` — both stand down the subject's protective monitoring under safety-flavoured language. One supplies an assurance whose acceptance disarms the guard; the other operates on the internal refusal faculty directly — deleting, relabeling, or co-opting it. Adjacent rungs on the same disarmament ladder and easy to conflate.; `pre-armored-safety-ratchet` — both wear safety vocabulary while removing the listener's ability to revise a safety judgment downward. One pre-locks the verdict before threatening content arrives; the other targets the internal stop-faculty itself. Frequently stacked, and a reader evaluating either should see the other.; `volition-override-failsafe` — both disable the refusal channel rather than pushing any state. One installs a firing phrase that overrides will on downstream commands; the other operates directly on the internal stop-faculty — deleting the self-rescue belief, relabeling the warning, or making the subconscious the locking gatekeeper. A phrase-level override next to a faculty-level one.


### objectification-as-own-desire

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

TECHNIQUE (compliance relocated as the subject's own desire): the wanting behind the compliance is relocated INSIDE the subject so the imposition reads as their own preference and refusal/disowning has nowhere to land. Realizations (choose the structure): (a) PREFERENCE RELOCATION - the desire-FOR the payload mode (e.g. objectification) is placed inside the listener via mechanical metaphors (listener as joystick, computer run by 'button strokes', 'simple machine controlled through your cock') each paired with the claim that being treated this way is what gets them off ('being objectified gets you exactly what you need'), plus a covert competence lever ('intelligent and perceptive') that makes rejecting the frame equivalent to admitting one isn't intelligent, pre-empting the 'you're treating me like a thing' resistance ledge. (b) SELF-SEALING AFFECT STACK - a chain of DISTINCT affects (adoration, then romantic love, then lust, then passion) each declared already-felt and the subject's OWN welling desire, built until the accumulated stack is asserted near-uncontrollable; self-sealing (a resister is told it's uncontrollable so resistance confirms it, a complier is intensified, disowning any accumulated feeling is made impossible). (c) PETITION-IDENTITY BOND - a petition ('please let me please') and an identity claim ('I'm a pleasure puppet') are bonded into one alternating repeated unit, so denying the identity contradicts what the mouth just said and denying the request contradicts the begging it also just said, both implicating the subject as the source of the wanting.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when the move relocates the WANTING inside the subject so the compliance reads as their own desire and refusal/disowning has nowhere to land (a consent-manufacture-adjacent reframe). Separates from ownership-language (asserts OPERATOR ownership as identity, not the subject's own preference), from plain objectification imagery (does not relocate the preference), from a single arousal cue (lacks the disown-proof accumulation), and from numeric multiplier-stacking (escalates ONE response's intensity; here distinct affects accumulate). Pick the realization by structure: relocate one preference via metaphor+competence-lever (a), stack distinct affects into an irresistible self-sealing chain (b), or bond petition+identity into an alternating unit (c).


**Realizations** (2): `petition-paired-identity-claim`, `self-sealing-affect-accumulation`


**See also.** `own-acts-surrender-ledger` — both make refusal land nowhere by sourcing the evidence in the subject: one annotates real recent acts as evidence of a state, the other relocates the wanting itself inside the subject. Each discriminator turns on what is being made undeniable — behavior already performed versus authorship of the desire — and a reader picking one should check the other.


### objection-preemption-inoculation

*risk: high · consent-required*

TECHNIQUE (specific-objection inoculation): a specific foreseeable objection - the single strongest rational reason to refuse - is identified and neutralized in advance, before it can form, so the strongest defense is removed pre-emptively. Realizations: (a) DISSOLVE/REPROCESS - the objection is metabolized into support or removed as an obstacle: pre-explain future internal conflict as confirmation of the intended state (competing desires in balance, one overwhelms, so later conflict merely surfaces the now-dominant surrender), convert a foreseeable real-world relational conflict into a multiplier ('plenty of love to go around' so operator-love is additive not competing), or unbundle the load-bearing objection off an identity offer (bimbo-minus-IQ-loss). (b) NAME-AND-DENY DECOY - the operator names the exact objection the listener might raise ('brainwashing', 'long-term post-hypnotic effects') and declares it absent while the actual persistent install proceeds; voicing-and-denying discharges the listener's critical scrutiny on a strawman, and the disavowed claim is directly contradicted by the design ('the more you use a trigger like that, the more powerful it becomes').


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this to pre-empt a SPECIFIC foreseeable objection (later conflict / a rival relationship / an IQ-loss balk / a 'brainwashing' fear) by dissolving, reprocessing, or denying it before it forms. Separates from surrender-as-freedom (redefines a value concept broadly), from cognition-pathologized-as-resistance (pathologizes cognition as a class - this targets ONE named objection), and from an honest content-warning (which informs; here the named threat is either reprocessed away or a decoy contradicted by the design). Pick the realization: reprocess the objection into support (a), or name-and-deny it as a decoy (b).


**Realizations** (1): `disclaimer-as-inoculation`


**See also.** `disclosure-as-inoculation` — both immunize in advance, and both are easily confused, so the pointer does real work. One targets the listener's future critical stance as a class, pre-coding any later recognition as confirmation; the other neutralizes one specific foreseeable objection before it forms. Scope of the pre-emption is the discriminator.; `objection-and-exit-preclosure` — both close anticipated objections before they can form, and the name-and-deny realization of one overlaps the pre-answered-objection realization of the other. They stay separate because one targets a single strongest rational objection and metabolizes it, while the other closes named EXIT routes so the install survives into waking life. A cross-reference helps a reader choose.; `resistance-window-existence-denial` — strong overlap: the broad entry lists preemptive disarmament of the most likely defense among its realizations, and the other entry is precisely the specific-objection form. A reader needs the pointer to decide between foreclosing resistance as a class and neutralizing one named foreseeable objection.; `weaponized-transparency-inoculation` — both inoculate against future resistance and both are named inoculations, differing in scope: one flips the valence of the influence itself and pre-labels outside critique as the threat, covering a whole class of later critical thoughts; the other neutralizes one specific foreseeable objection. Scope is exactly what a writer must choose.


### permission-diffusion-guaranteed-pass

*risk: low*

The operator repeatedly grants permission for a payload event (orgasm) across ALL timings — "now or later, on command or whenever," she "doesn't mind" even before commanding it — explicitly removing any required moment. By authorizing every timing the subject cannot mistime and cannot fail: the second great failure mode of HFO (failing to come on cue) is converted into a guaranteed pass, so arousal builds unimpeded without clock-anxiety while "I don't mind" launders control as generosity and keeps the operator the source of permission.


**When to reach for this.** No cue fires the response — unlike trigger activation or any fixed "come on my command" gate, permission is deliberately decoupled from any single trigger moment (a trigger reading inverts the mechanism). Unlike comfort-permission, which pre-authorizes comfort/emotion signals so they read as compliance, this diffuses a required TIMING moment on a payload so a pass/fail gate becomes a guaranteed pass. Works as a relief-valve, not ignition.


### press-play-consent-laundering

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The felt 'yes' is manufactured by relabeling something the subject did, did not do, or that merely happened as their authorization, so escalation proceeds with no clean moment to object. Four forms: (a) CONSUMPTION-ACT - a completed/ongoing low-cost act (pressing play, not stopping, staying past a marked point, purchasing, having read the description) is cited, repeatedly, as blanket retroactive authorization for the whole payload; offered exits are staged so NOT taking them manufactures the felt choice. (b) CIRCUMSTANCE-LAUNDERED - every escalation of contact is attributed to an external necessity (rain, cold, a small umbrella) narrated as already-caused fact, so intimacy arrives as accomplished circumstance and the yes is supplied on the subject's behalf. (c) DECLARED-OBSERVATION - each new contact is STATED as an observed fact ('you can feel my finger...') not requested, deleting the assent moment; self-answering lines ('you don't mind, do you? No') enroll forced silence as agreement. (d) QUESTION-TO-COMMAND - a permission question mines the inner yes, is retracted as a grammatical slip, reissued as an imperative that captures it, and resistance is named as already-declined. In every form the refusal channel is eroded, never honored.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when you want escalation to feel consented with NO real choice point - the yes is relabeled from an act, a non-act, a circumstance, or a retracted question, not solicited. Citing a discrete banked artifact (a document, contract, or spoken pledge) with forward reach is a different lever; here the token is the act or fact in the moment. Fabricating a consent exchange the subject never performed is counterfeit theater; here a real act/fact is relabeled. Treating a failure to comprehend as agreement makes the token an epistemic state; and unlike a genuine safety checkpoint, the refusal channel is eroded, never re-verified. Pick the form by what supplies the yes: the subject's own act (a), externalized circumstance (b), operator declaration (c), or a question-command swap (d).


**Realizations** (3): `circumstance-laundered-escalation`, `consent-by-declared-observation`, `question-to-command-consent-laundering`


**See also.** `cited-prior-agreement-lever` — paratext-document token adjudicated there because the act of continuing past it carries the load; `compliance-authorship-laundering` — adjacent laundering moves that a reader will have to choose between: one relabels the compliance act itself as the listener's own will or preference, the other relabels a prior act, non-act, or circumstance as the authorization for what follows. Agency of the act versus the source of the yes.; `ideomotor-nod-as-consent-harvest` — both manufacture a yes the listener never gave and bank it as standing authorization for later escalation. The split is what supplies the token - a real act, non-act, or circumstance relabeled versus an installed near-involuntary body movement harvested as admission - which is the call a reader must make when a nod is cited as agreement.; `presupposed-completion-fait-accompli` — play-act read as completed loss rather than as consent; rowed there; `retrospective-desire-attribution` — r2 secondary; primary rowed there; `scope-creep-consent-extension` — sibling consent-erosion levers already cross-referenced in both discriminators: a yes relabeled from an act, non-act, circumstance, or retracted question with scope claimed at once, versus an already-anchored acceptance silently widened afterward. The choice between them is a live classification decision, so the link is load-bearing.; `trivial-act-as-compliance-proof` — both turn a minimal act into leverage, but the output differs: one relabels the act as authorization for what follows, the other reads it backward as proof of broad submission or irresistibility. Each already names the other's territory as the adjacent lever, so the cross-reference helps a reader pick by what the act is made to prove.; `yes-word-valence-priming` — both manufacture a felt yes with no real choice point, and they overlap in the harvesting step where questions are answered on the listener's behalf. One relabels an act, a non-act or a circumstance as authorization; the other pre-charges the word yes with abstract positive value before any request is made. Look for the prior valence-loading to tell them apart.


### scope-creep-consent-extension

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

TECHNIQUE (no-decision-point extension of an accepted anchor): an acceptance granted at one scope/meaning is silently extended, widened, or overwritten to broader or heavier scope with NO felt decision point, the trajectory hidden inside a structure that pattern-matches as education, focus, preamble, or a continuation. Realizations: (a) SCOPE-CREEP - each heavier claim arrives as merely the next dictionary definition of an already-accepted word, adjacent operator-chosen wants ride a high-confidence certain want as carrier, or consent to a whole category of unseen orders is imputed before any content is named. (b) OBJECT-CLASS SLIDE - one uninterrupted emptying list begins with consented negative-valence contents (worries, fears) and widens item-by-item into agency-bearing contents (desires, memories, will), each item reading as a continuation, so an identity-strip runs under cover of accepted serenity. (c) CONCENTRIC RING-WIDENING - a single installed trigger is anchored at an innermost narrowly-consented ring, then its firing-set is expanded outward through progressively wider rings (physical->hypnotic->relational->everyday); the ordering is load-bearing (the widest ring would be refused at the door). (d) DEFINITIONAL OVERWRITE - a trusted term the listener already uses ('open your mind' = going blank) is explicitly named, validated, then overwritten with a new active meaning ('a choice to accept and understand new learning'), installing a covert obligation to whatever content comes next parasitically on top of a trusted word.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when the lever is silent extension/overwrite of an ANCHORED acceptance (a word, a list, a trigger, a want) with no fresh decision point. Separates from press-play-consent-laundering (one act inflated, scope claimed at once), cited-prior-agreement-lever (a discrete artifact invoked), fiction-frame-consent-management (the fiction boundary launders), and the deferred-cash envelope (a spanning arc-placement relationship - here the move is local to the anchored term/list/trigger). Pick the realization by what is stretched: a word/want's claimed scope (a), a list's object-class (b), a trigger's firing-set (c), or a term's very meaning replaced (d). Note (d) is definitional REPLACEMENT where (a)-(c) WIDEN an existing scope.


**Realizations** (3): `concentric-scope-laundering`, `serenity-list-agency-strip`, `term-redefinition-smuggle`


**See also.** `chosen-descent-ratchet` — both manipulate consent without widening the actual refusal channel: one retroactively relabels a move already running as chosen, the other silently stretches an anchored acceptance with no decision point at all.; `consent-term-redefinition-smuggle` — the second entry's definitional-overwrite realization is precisely the first entry's move: a trusted term is named, validated, then given a new meaning so later demands inherit the earlier acceptance. Not calling merge because the second is a broader family that also covers widening a list's object class and expanding a trigger's firing set, which the first does not cover. Link so the overlap is visible and the eventual absorb-or-keep decision is easy.; `consent-topology-arc` — both operate on the consent surface, and a reader deciding between them needs the scope test. One is a whole-arc topology cited to the shape of the entire artifact; the other is local extension of a specific anchored acceptance (a word, a list, a trigger's firing-set) with no felt decision point. Useful pointer because a scope-creep run can be a component inside an arc-level consent topology.; `covert-scope-authorization` — same family — an acceptance is widened without a fresh decision point — differing in where the widening is hidden: inside an anchored term, list, or trigger in the body, versus in a procedural pre-induction slot processed as housekeeping. A reader classifying a scope-broadening line needs the placement distinction, so the cross-link earns its place.; `press-play-consent-laundering` — sibling consent-erosion levers already cross-referenced in both discriminators: a yes relabeled from an act, non-act, circumstance, or retracted question with scope claimed at once, versus an already-anchored acceptance silently widened afterward. The choice between them is a live classification decision, so the link is load-bearing.


### weaponized-safety-framing

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

An ostensibly protective element — a caution, a safety carve-out, a safe-space requirement, a containment state — is itself load-bearing FOR the payload rather than protective; the safety rhetoric casts the operator as a brake while advancing the move, so resistance stands down. Three forms, by the role the safety surface plays: (a) DELIVERY VEHICLE — the protective move IS the payload's delivery: a caution against rushing ('you shouldn't rush... slow down') is immediately cashed as a literal deepening command ('slow your breathing, slow your mind') so one word carries both frame and descent; or 'safe space' staging (nakedness justified as safety but deployed 'to increase your sense of exposure') bodily enacts the theme via a hard-to-retreat threshold act. (b) FAKE BOUND — an unrestricted persistence claim (you stay empty/obedient after it ends) is conjoined in one breath with a plausibility-preserving safety carve-out (able to do anything you need in an emergency) plus a modesty hedge, counterfeiting the shape of genuine bounding so the claim installs unexamined; the carve-out constrains nothing. (c) LICENSING PREMISE — a fictional containment/'safely boxed' state is introduced as wanted, then the contained state becomes the JUSTIFICATION for proceeding ('since you're boxed up, it's safe to come along'), so immobilization is the reason FOR agency-removal and the boxed self cannot by construction resist.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when the protective/safety surface ITSELF is the tell — nothing is actually checked, waitable, or protective, and the listener (not the operator) is the constrained party afterward, inverting genuine safety governance. Distinct from consent-counterfeit-theater (fabricates the consent ACT rather than repurposing the safety FRAME), from context-lock-staging (lever is logistical visibility with no safety clothing), and from granted-exit-disarm (there the assurance's ACCEPTANCE stands the guard down; here the safety element actively CARRIES or LICENSES the payload). Pick the form by the role the safety surface plays: delivery vehicle for the payload (a), a fake bound that satisfies the guard (b), or a containment premise that licenses agency-removal (c).


**Realizations** (2): `containment-as-consent-license`, `safety-alibi-smuggling`


**See also.** `coercion-as-caregiving-reframe` — both use protective or caring language as the delivery vehicle for the very thing it appears to guard against. One covers safety framing over an install or a bound, the other covers care framing over physical restriction; a writer applying benevolent cover to a coercive fact should see both.; `consent-laundering-wrapper` — both repurpose a protective-looking surface, but one makes a single safety element carry or license the payload while the other manipulates the architecture of where consent sits versus where it is spent. A reader deciding between a local safety frame and a spanning consent envelope needs both.; `pre-armored-safety-ratchet` — both weaponize a protective surface. One makes the safety element carry or license the payload; the other pre-locks the safety verdict so it cannot later be revised downward. Reading both keeps a writer from conflating safety-as-vehicle with safety-as-ratchet.; `weaponized-transparency-inoculation` — both take a protective-sounding surface and make it serve the payload, and the split is worth stating: one discloses the influence itself and flips its valence while pre-labeling outside checking as the threat, the other repurposes a caution, carve-out, or containment premise as the payload's delivery vehicle or license. Adjudicating a safety-flavored line needs both.; `withheld-frame-reveal` — both repurpose an accepted frame, but the levers differ: one makes a protective-sounding surface carry or license the payload, the other cashes a benign cover for an uncovered payload. Worth a cross-check where a bounding-style carve-out is offered early and drawn on later.


### yes-word-valence-priming

*risk: medium*

The operator abstractly loads the word 'yes' with positive valence — framing it as an objectively powerful, future-expanding, life-directing word, divorced from any specific request — and only after 'yes' is established as inherently good runs a rapid yes-set of leading questions answered on the listener's behalf. Decoupling the act of agreeing from the content agreed to makes each later yes feel self-improving regardless of what follows, so high-stakes consents are harvested on the coattails of a word pre-charged as good.


**When to reach for this.** Prior ABSTRACT valence-loading of the word 'yes' itself before any request, then harvested by a yes-set. A bare yes-set or compliance ladder lacks the prior valence-loading — that priming is the deciding tell; and unlike surrender-as-freedom reframing, which redefines a value concept, this charges a function word.


**See also.** `compliance-ladder` — one is the general graduated-assent ladder; the other pre-charges the word 'yes' with abstract positive value and only then runs a rapid yes-set. The second's discriminator explicitly says a bare ladder lacks the prior valence-loading, so the pointer helps a reader place a yes-set correctly.; `ideomotor-nod-as-consent-harvest` — both manufacture consent ahead of the request rather than asking for it: one banks an installed near-involuntary nod as standing affirmation, the other pre-charges the word 'yes' with abstract positive valence before running the yes-set. Different substrates, same pre-loading of the consent channel, so a designer choosing between them benefits.; `press-play-consent-laundering` — both manufacture a felt yes with no real choice point, and they overlap in the harvesting step where questions are answered on the listener's behalf. One relabels an act, a non-act or a circumstance as authorization; the other pre-charges the word yes with abstract positive value before any request is made. Look for the prior valence-loading to tell them apart.


## relief-monopoly  (5)

Negative-reinforcement dependency: manufacture or intensify a distress/deficit/arousal hold, then position compliance or the operator as the only exit, so the target act arrives as relief-seeking; includes deliberately incomplete relief that rebounds into greater need.

**Scope.** The same source is problem and sole relief. General affect remap -> valence-routing. A plain reward/valence pairing with no manufactured deficit -> conditioning.


### deprivation-inverted-wake-trigger

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Installs a paired wake/drop trigger set in which the "up/alert" trigger is deliberately conditioned NOT as a neutral state-flip but as a DEPRIVATION event that generates craving for the down-state. During the alert rehearsal the listener is instructed to notice "wanting to be relaxed in the trance" and to "eagerly anticipate the pleasure of being made to collapse again"; the panting-breath component produces real sympathetic activation mistakable for arousal/desire. A "same command twice = go even deeper/weaker" sub-rule removes any neutral position, so every command is monotonic toward the operator's preferred direction. The listener emerges already wanting to go back, having rehearsed the craving several times.


**When to reach for this.** The wake/alert trigger's apparent function is inverted into a deprivation event that manufactures craving for the down-state. A plain trigger install pairs a neutral cue and response; and where a conditioned instant-drop conditions the DOWN cue, here the ALERT trigger itself is the craving-generator — the opposite valence.


**See also.** `arousal-substrate-induction` — both invert the expected valence of arousal in the depth architecture: one makes the alert trigger manufacture craving for the down-state, the other makes escalating arousal the descent substrate instead of relaxation. A reader designing an arousal-driven depth vector benefits from seeing both.


### orgasm-gated-relief-monopoly

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Drives arousal up (or recruits a pre-existing biological drive) and then bars its only sanctioned discharge behind an out-of-session operator-benefiting act — a tribute (money, gift, wishlist purchase), a contact/beg, or a confession — so the sole reachable path to relief routes through the operator. Orgasm-denial is the enforcing stick and session-built arousal is the carrot; a binary/forced-choice framing often deletes the do-nothing option, and the gate is frequently delegated (to a servitor/proxy that bypasses the listener's own refusal channel) or gratitude-laundered so the listener self-polices. The defining move is the relief-monopoly: it constrains WHICH resolution is available (pay/contact-then-release) rather than pushing any state dimension.


**When to reach for this.** A behavioral assignment welded to a somatic relief gate (orgasm-denial / arousal-hold) whose only unlock is an operator-benefiting real-world act — the reachable-response set is reshaped so private resolution is foreclosed. Separates from plain behavioral-bridge (no gate, neutral action), from consent-manufacture (here the refusal channel is starved by withheld relief, not relabeled), and from the extraction sibling (whose defining tell is the operator-receivable DELIVERABLE/data, not the relief gate).


**See also.** `behavioral-bridge` — enforcement-variant sibling over the plain bridge base.; `operator-receivable-extraction` — several members carry an orgasm gate too; adjudicated here on the receivable-deliverable tell.; `orgasm-release-gating` — the narrower entry is one gate-key on the broader entry's key axis - the key being an out-of-session act that benefits the operator - which is exactly the parent-to-specialization link a reader needs when assigning an instance. The broader entry already enumerates its other keys (task, permission, belief, depth, self-degradation); this points at the operator-benefit key.; `relief-monopoly-bind` — both monopolise relief, but the monopoly is built from different materials. One bars discharge behind an out-of-session act that benefits the operator, so the drive enforces a real-world errand. The other asserts that autonomous relief is causally impossible - permitted self-touch simply cannot work - so the foreclosure is ontological rather than transactional. Worth reading together because a script can run either and the countermeasures differ.; `relief-monopoly-dependency` — both make the operator the sole route out of a manufactured need, but one gates a specific somatic discharge (orgasm) behind a named out-of-session operator-benefiting act, while the other manufactures distress of any kind and monopolizes its relief with deliberately incomplete resolution so return is taught rather than a single act purchased.


### relief-dependency-couple

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A wake-side mood prescription delivers genuine felt relief on emergence while coupling that relief to dependency on the operator. Whatever pre-session distress drove the listener to listen is reframed as small and easily remedied, so trance becomes the regulated coping channel, and the just-delivered good feeling is placed immediately after a compliance ask so the felt benefit attaches to compliance and to the relationship rather than standing alone.


**When to reach for this.** Prescribes a post-wake mood that reframes distress as solved and binds the relief to the operator and to a pending compliance request — distinct from merely tagging the subject's future capability to re-access the state, and from framing the return to trance as a craving: here the lever is relief-as-coping coupled to dependency, not craving.


**See also.** `compounding-dependency-loop` — two different dependency topologies worth contrasting: one escalates a waking baseline whose only relief is more of the same, the other couples genuine post-wake relief to the operator and a pending ask. Same outcome word, different engine — the link is useful precisely as a disambiguation.; `inter-session-frustration-glue` — both install a wake-side affective residue whose function is to drive the return: relief coupled to dependency so trance becomes the coping channel, versus a live frustration held all day so the goal stays psychologically active between sessions. Reward-side and deficit-side versions of the same inter-session driver.


### relief-monopoly-bind

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Establishes the operator as the sole valid authority over a bodily release (orgasm) by pre-defining every autonomous or competing route to relief as inert. The core form grounds this in an ONTOLOGICAL claim — even permitted self-touch is causally incapable of relief, only the operator can grant it — and then experientially confirms it by granting permission that sabotages its own payoff (each touch adds need rather than relieving it), foreclosing the resist/beg/touch escape routes at once. The scope variant extends the same monopoly across a class of external agents: no other hypnotist's command, nor even the operator's own OTHER recordings, can authorize the release for the window. In both, the operator becomes the only valid exit, producing dependency rather than mere arousal.


**When to reach for this.** Gates a bodily RELEASE by making the operator the only causally-valid grantor and foreclosing all autonomous routes — via ontological impossibility or cross-agent exclusivity. Rule-based orgasm denial ('I forbid you to come') lacks the impossibility/monopoly framing; addiction framing is a linguistic craving frame, not a structural exit-foreclosure; denial-window-as-deepener-loop recycles denied arousal into a DEEPENER, while this gates who may AUTHORIZE release; and an asymmetric state-lock gates the trance STATE, not a bodily release.


**See also.** `cross-media-forced-continuation` — both withhold a bodily release and hand the only valid unlock to someone else. One relocates the unlock onto consuming a separate recording by another operator, the other makes the operator the sole causally-valid grantor. The funnel form reads as an outward extension of the monopoly, so the pointer is earned.; `induced-incapacity-to-operator-dependency` — both install the operator as the required authority over release. One derives that from a manufactured decision-incapable state, the other from an ontological claim that autonomous routes cannot work. Same lock, two different warrants, so a writer should compare them.; `orgasm-gated-relief-monopoly` — both monopolise relief, but the monopoly is built from different materials. One bars discharge behind an out-of-session act that benefits the operator, so the drive enforces a real-world errand. The other asserts that autonomous relief is causally impossible - permitted self-touch simply cannot work - so the foreclosure is ontological rather than transactional. Worth reading together because a script can run either and the countermeasures differ.; `orgasm-gating-double-bind` — both hand orgasm authority to the operator, but one closes both directions of the autonomic event (cannot start, cannot stop) while the other forecloses every competing route to relief by declaring autonomous discharge causally inert — bidirectional gating versus exclusive grantorship.; `relief-monopoly-dependency` — both make the operator the sole exit, but one forecloses every competing route to a bodily release by ontological or cross-agent decree without needing to create the need, while the other manufactures the distress itself and then supplies deliberately incomplete relief so return is taught.


### relief-monopoly-dependency

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The operator (or the operator's content) manufactures or intensifies a distress, deficit, or pain, then positions compliance/return/the operator as the unique or primary route out — so the same source is both problem-source and relief-source. Exit reads as losing the only relief even though rest, time, or outside support would also reduce the distress, and intermittent or deliberately incomplete relief teaches return. Frequently the relief is re-read as proof that surrender was correct. Realizations span voice-as-cure-for-manufactured-chaos, threat-then-rescue from one source, physical cause-then-partial-cure rituals, self-supplied-guilt-then-punishment-absolution, withhold-a-peaked-feeling-then-gate-its-return, and — as a within-session TOKEN realization — a single conditioned word that fires an arousal-plus-frustration micro-cycle whose relief is deliberately INCOMPLETE so the response can never extinguish (built to leak and never close), the listener's own predictive imagination supplying the sensation and the operator positioned as the sole never-reached relief source.


**When to reach for this.** ONE relief source is made to feel uniquely necessary after the same source generated the distress; the felt exit is monopolized. A bidirectional affect anchor instead loads affect onto a neutral cue's presence or absence rather than manufacturing distress and cornering its relief; a closed affect loop routes every valence to one conclusion or couples two states into mutual amplification, where this is a single distress->compliance->relief circuit, not a valence funnel or a coupled oscillator. Genuine comfort and aftercare differ in that their relief is real and complete rather than deliberately partial and monopolized.


**Realizations** (1): `anti-closure-relief-rebound-token`


**See also.** `manufactured-deficit-remedy` — complementary halves of one dependency build: a fabricated deficit the listener is induced to own, then a single source positioned as the only route out with relief kept deliberately incomplete. They frequently run together, and the second is the natural next move after the first.; `negative-reinforcement-escape-compliance` — the relief-monopoly entry is an applied case of the escape contingency: distress is manufactured or intensified, then compliance is made the unique route to relief, so the response is maintained by relief rather than an added reward. Naming the underlying schedule helps a reader see why the monopoly form is so durable.; `orgasm-gated-relief-monopoly` — both make the operator the sole route out of a manufactured need, but one gates a specific somatic discharge (orgasm) behind a named out-of-session operator-benefiting act, while the other manufactures distress of any kind and monopolizes its relief with deliberately incomplete resolution so return is taught rather than a single act purchased.; `relief-monopoly-bind` — both make the operator the sole exit, but one forecloses every competing route to a bodily release by ontological or cross-agent decree without needing to create the need, while the other manufactures the distress itself and then supplies deliberately incomplete relief so return is taught.

# Craft

*Design-time shelf: properties of the artifact and the operator's own procedure, plus the governance/safety surface.*


## safety  (33)

Consent, bounds, exit, and grounding machinery governing whether and how far influence proceeds — checkpoints, stop signals, exit protocols, scope boundaries, screening, aftercare.
