Reading both prevents citing the whole-arc entry for what is a single passage.; `consent-term-redefinition-smuggle` — the whole-arc consent topology explicitly contrasts itself with discrete single-relabel consent moves, and the term-redefinition smuggle is the clearest such discrete move. Useful to a reader deciding whether what they are looking at is one line or the shape of the entire artifact.; `fiction-frame-consent-management` — both operate on the consent surface across a whole artifact. One is the arc-level topology of where the consent gate sits; the other uses the fiction/reality boundary itself as the consent instrument. Adjacent enough that a cataloguer picking one should check the other.; `reader-assent-architecture` — both are whole-artifact topologies about where agreement is captured rather than any one passage, and both explicitly disclaim single-line citation. They differ in target — one reshapes the listener's consent surface across the arc, the other primes the reader's stance toward a method or closes the resistance surface as a standing property. Adjacent enough that the boundary needs to be visible from either side.; `scope-creep-consent-extension` — both operate on the consent surface, and a reader deciding between them needs the scope test. One is a whole-arc topology cited to the shape of the entire artifact; the other is local extension of a specific anchored acceptance (a word, a list, a trigger's firing-set) with no felt decision point. Useful pointer because a scope-creep run can be a component inside an arc-level consent topology.; `whole-script-arc-shape-architecture` — both are whole-arc properties uncitable to any single line, but one names a specific lever (the arc relocates or forecloses the consent gate) while the other is a deliberately loose container of unrelated arc shapes, so a reader should check whether a candidate whole-arc observation is about the consent surface or merely about energy contour.


### covert-diegetic-install-shell

*risk: medium · consent-required · kind: container*

A two-layer script architecture in which an outer conventional envelope (breath induction, contract, trigger-install, wake) wraps an inner story envelope where nearly all operationally load-bearing content is installed as narration rather than as command. Once the story starts the operator switches from directing to narrating, so content lands at full rate with nothing asked of the listener at the surface; the shell exists only to make the listener compliant enough to receive the story as fiction while it works as suggestion. The lever is the directing-to-narrating shift, which removes the surface request there is to resist.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a simply framed story with intro/outro — the load-bearing moves all live INSIDE the fiction and the directing-to-narrating shift is what disarms defenses. Distinct from flat-surface- concealing-semantic-arc (surface-grammar uniformity) and from authorship-relocation containers (this is about install SITE inside diegesis, not about relocating who authored the state).


**See also.** `covert-fact-install` — two covers for the same trick: keep the analytical mind busy consuming surface material while the load-bearing install rides inside it. One uses expository theory-of-mind teaching, the other a fiction the operator narrates rather than directs. Useful together when choosing which cover to run.; `covert-install-under-cover` — both hide where the operative content sits, and the boundary is fine: one shifts from directing to narrating so the whole payload lands inside a fiction, the other disguises a specific install act as description, a concurrent task, exposition, or a backdated event. A reader can easily file a narrated install under the wrong one.; `delivery-form-as-induction-envelope` — two whole-file architectures that remove the surface there is to resist: the linguistic form itself denying exit ramps, versus an outer envelope wrapping an inner story where the operator shifts from directing to narrating. Both are file-level, and a reader analyzing one should rule out the other.


### deferred-terminus-conversion

*risk: medium · bounded*

A whole-script architecture that deliberately withholds its own closure — no internal discharge, emergence, integration or wake lands cleanly — and relocates the release or payoff OUTSIDE the file's boundary (to a downstream recording, a subsequent product, or a self-restarting loop). The unresolved terminal state is itself the conversion lever: the listener is parked in the deepest state as a launch platform, so the deferral drives continuation to the next artifact rather than resolving the current one. Realizations vary — a baton-pass final line handing off to an obey-file, a detachable trance preamble ending on a fired trigger, a monotonic arousal ramp cut off at peak with release confiscated to a partner recording, a perpetual-deferral reward loop where every payoff reopens, and a mid-sentence loop-splice that resolves only by restarting — but closure is structurally never reached inside the file, and that non-closure is the work.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a merely incomplete/truncated session by the DELIBERATE engineered absence of a work-phase resolution AND an out-of-file relocation target. Separates from an internal reserved-discharge ramp (where the single orgasm DOES land inside the file) by the terminus being outside the file, not merely late within it. Separates from a discrete deferral gate by being a whole-arc topology where every candidate closure reopens.


**See also.** `deliberate-non-closure` — both are whole-arc topologies whose work is the refusal to close, but one simply omits the close-down function so the installed state stays live into waking life, while the other relocates the withheld release to a specific destination outside the file (a downstream recording, a next product, a restart) so non-closure functions as conversion rather than as bleed.; `goal-state-topology-inversion` — both reshape a script's terminal state so closure never lands: one converts a promised discrete climax into an indefinite plateau, the other relocates the payoff outside the file entirely. A reader looking at an ending that refuses to resolve is choosing between these two, and the distinction is inside-versus-outside the file boundary.; `induction-less-work-as-onramp` — complementary whole-artifact moves: one deletes the entry threshold, the other withholds the exit. A writer working on either boundary benefits from seeing the other end of the same arc treated as deletable.; `no-emergence-series-chaining` — both withhold closure so the listener is handed forward to the next artifact, and they overlap in practice on the same files. The split is whether the withheld thing is emergence specifically or any work-phase resolution, which a reader classifying a non-closing file must decide.; `no-return-terminal-close` — both refuse the session's closure, and the difference is where the unresolved state points: sealed in place with the return-to-baseline cue simply cancelled, versus relocated to a downstream artifact so non-closure drives continuation. Adjacent enough to be miscoded for each other, so link rather than merge.; `severed-relief-valve-ramp` — two arc-topology moves about withheld resolution that can co-occur in one file: relief severed so arousal only accumulates, and closure relocated outside the file entirely. The reader has to tell an unresolved ramp from an out-of-file terminus.


### deliberate-non-closure

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A whole-arc DESIGN property (not a passage-local executable move): the script structurally refuses the close-down function as a deliberate choice. The final line may itself fire the trigger at the wake-cue, the count-out truncates to a bare "Up." with no closing bracket, or installs are voiced inside a five-line sealed wake ending on a fresh waking-state command — so the installed state, trigger, or addiction frame stays live past session end and bleeds into waking life instead of being dismissed. This is negative-space evidence about the arc (emergence/safety topology), promoted from Pass B effect_only S-observations on recurrence + authored-design evidence; it is a container because it is an arc-shape property, not an operator line one performs.


**When to reach for this.** Deliberate omission is the lever, not truncation. The anti-artifact tell is that the ending is load-bearing (trigger fired at the wake-cue; installs spoken between wake counts; orgasm-contingency forcing leakage). Separates from post-session-settling and aftercare (which PERFORM the closing function) by refusing it as a whole-arc property, and from installed post-hypnotic triggers by acting through whole-arc shape rather than a cue. NOTE: the passage-local executable realizations of "cancel the wakener / fuse sleep+obey" are the no-return-terminal-close ENTRY; this container is the design-time observation of the arc refusing closure.


**See also.** `deferred-terminus-conversion` — both are whole-arc topologies whose work is the refusal to close, but one simply omits the close-down function so the installed state stays live into waking life, while the other relocates the withheld release to a specific destination outside the file (a downstream recording, a next product, a restart) so non-closure functions as conversion rather than as bleed.; `loop-hook-non-wake-close` — both leave the session unclosed, but one is a whole-arc property of simply refusing the close-down function so an install bleeds into waking life, while the other stages a counterfeit too-shallow wake specifically to deny the evaluation window and route the listener back into replay.; `post-session-settling` — inverse-function pair; reconciliation should keep the contrast edge.


### drop-in-payload-module

*risk: medium · bounded*

The artifact is authored as a spliceable payload cartridge: the trance-producing and trance-exiting layers (induction, deepening, ratification, emergence, aftercare) are deliberately omitted, so the file assumes a trance state supplied externally and relocates responsibility for depth, exit and recovery onto a host session or sibling files. The omission is marked, not accidental — empty labelled brackets ([ INTRODUCTION ] / [ AWAKENING ]) reserving the host's slots, a line-3 hand-off opener ('I am going to give you some orders now') reading as continuation, series-prefix filenames with sibling deepener files, opening already-deep and ending mid-installation. The modularity is itself the mechanism: payload becomes composable infrastructure any host induction can arm.


**When to reach for this.** A marked, load-bearing omission of the induction/emergence layers WITH an explicit hand-off surface (empty labelled brackets, continuation opener, series-prefix filename). vs a broken/draft script (drafts lack the hand-off markers). vs arc-shape generally (the mechanism is place-in-assembly across files, not within-file ordering). vs cross-session-tethering (external dependency is compositional — a host supplies depth for THIS playback — not a scheduling/governance claim on future consumption). vs the payload techniques it carries (absorbing those would be composite-with-primitive over-merge).


**See also.** `artifact-as-policy-spec` — both are architecture-level reads of an entire file rather than moves inside a session, and they are near-complements: one defines itself by what the file leaves out and hands off, the other by the file being wholly a rule layer. Cross-referencing helps a reader classifying an unusual artifact decide which whole-file shape they are looking at.; `exposure-dose-object-not-session` — both are artifact-kind observations about a file with no induction or emergence, and the practical question is which one you are looking at: a payload cartridge expecting a host session, or a loop whose session functions are folded into its texture. A reader classifying an entry-less file needs the pair.; `no-emergence-series-chaining` — both are cross-file compositional properties rather than within-file moves, and they interlock: one forwards live trance across a boundary, the other omits the induction and emergence layers so a host must supply depth. Reading the pair clarifies what makes a file a continuation versus a cartridge.


### flat-surface-concealing-semantic-arc

*risk: medium*

A whole-arc property in which a uniform surface form conceals a steep semantic gradient. Either every line uses one identical grammatical chassis ('i love [x]') so sampling any span reads tonally flat while the start and end states are worlds apart (the arc lives in predicate ordering alone), or a small set of concept-words braid through the whole arc, each entering early and recurring so later single-word utterances become compression handles inheriting a specific earlier install. The lever is that surface uniformity masks the accumulation of commitment, so the listener cannot locate which stage of the descent they are in.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from an ordinary named-section script (structure carries the load) — the tell is the inverse: no headers/sections, the entire arc in the predicate sequence or concept-braid under one surface frame. Distinct from covert-diegetic-install-shell (that is narration-as-suggestion inside a fiction; this is surface-grammar uniformity regardless of fiction).


**See also.** `covert-role-frame-accretion` — both are whole-arc concealment properties and commonly co-occur: a relational frame built by trajectory with no declarative moment, delivered under a uniform surface that hides the accumulating gradient. Each explains why the other goes unnoticed.; `delivery-form-as-induction-envelope` — both are whole-artifact surface-form properties rather than discrete moves, and a text pipeline mis-reads both. One removes the punctuation and cadence off-ramps where evaluation could re-engage; the other keeps the surface uniform so the listener cannot locate their position on a steep semantic gradient.; `monotonic-no-reversal-contour` — both are whole-arc design-time properties cited to the shape of the text rather than any removable line, and both work by what the surface conceals. Useful pairing for anyone working at arc level.; `single-token-saturation-architecture` — both are whole-artifact surface properties where lexical uniformity is the structural load-bearer: one hides a steep semantic gradient under an identical grammatical chassis or braided concept-words, the other loads a single token with topic, content, trigger and delivery-key at once. A writer choosing a script-wide surface strategy benefits from seeing both options.


### form-content-fusion-topology

*risk: low*

The mechanism the script installs is named, modeled, and performed simultaneously by the script's own form, so that the artifact enacts what it describes. For a looping install the lyrics loop, the definitional chain closes into a ring that proves by its own closure there is no exit, and naming the loop is itself another iteration of it. Form and content are fused: removing any layer does not drop a feature, it breaks the demonstration — the reader/listener cannot hold the described structure at arm's length because encountering the description re-enacts the structure.


**When to reach for this.** Not the local self-sealing definitional chain it contains and not the address-gradient or multi-stream architecture — the tell is the whole-artifact FORM-CONTENT FUSION: the script performs the very operation it installs, a self-referential topology property distinct from any single move along a dimension.


**See also.** `closed-epistemic-self-validation-loop` — both are whole-artifact structural properties rather than local moves, and both close a circuit: one validates claims using states the text itself induced, the other fuses form and content so encountering the description re-enacts it. A reader classifying a text-level topology needs both options side by side.; `delivery-form-as-induction-envelope` — both are whole-artifact form properties rather than discrete moves, and the boundary is fine: form used as an envelope with no exit ramps versus form that performs the very mechanism it describes. Without the cross-reference the two collapse in practice.; `whole-script-arc-shape-architecture` — two whole-artifact structural observations that meet at a boundary: one is an explicitly loose grouping of arc shapes, the other a specific form-content fusion property. A reader classifying a non-executable design observation needs to know both exist.


### frame-lamination-non-return

*risk: medium · bounded*

The script stacks two or more narrative/procedural frames and then structurally fails to reopen the outer one(s), leaving the listener stranded in the innermost layer at exit, with a dependency-relation between layers that launders each into the next. Realized forms: a story-in-a-story where three nested layers fuse and the outer frames are abandoned so emergence wakes the listener from trance but not from the dream; a domestic-narrative envelope wrapping every hypnotic operation with no metalanguage break naming a procedure, never closing the outer frame so memory residue is narrative-not-procedural (which eases amnesia); and a three-layer ritual nesting where each layer launders the next (fantasy makes the prescription feel sacred, the prescription makes the fantasy feel like preparation, the chant acquires retroactive provenance). The lever is the topology of frames — laminating them so no line ever restores the outer reality — not any single utterance.


**When to reach for this.** The mechanism is the FAILURE-to-return / the dependency-relation between layers across the whole back half, cited only to the absence of a closing beat, never to one line. Distinct from a normal framed-narrative induction that returns to its frame at the end (the tell is that there is no 'and then I woke up'). Distinct from energy-contour engineering (that is about charge/depth shape; this is about frame topology and whether outer frames re-open).


**See also.** `emergence-negative-space` — both are whole-arc negative-space properties about frames that never reopen; one is about nested narrative layers left unclosed, the other about the missing emergence ramp. Close enough that a reader must be told which evidence assigns to which.; `foreclosed-emergence` — both leave no route back to ordinary baseline; one by never reopening an outer narrative frame, the other by deleting the clean waking end-state from what the close makes reachable. Structurally different but constantly confusable at the exit.; `no-emergence-series-chaining` — both leave the listener without a clean return, and a reader who has one will misfile the other. The distinction is what fails to close: an outer narrative frame that is never reopened within a single piece, versus the emergence event itself being deleted so the state is forwarded across a boundary into the next.; `operator-voice-absence`


### goal-state-topology-inversion

*risk: low*

An authored inversion of a genre's expected goal-state TOPOLOGY: a promised discrete climactic event (here an [HFO] hands-free orgasm) is never delivered as an event and is replaced by a sustained, indefinitely-continuous plateau explicitly named as never reaching its peak, with the structurally climactic beat relocated to the operator's cessation (turning the tap off). Recoding orgasm from event to continuous state buys durability-via-vagueness — a listener who cannot come on cue still receives the structure, and one who comes early is reframed as still inside the plateau. The lever is reshaping the target-state's temporal topology so the payload cannot fail against the listener's actual response.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a conventional climax/discharge move because there is NO discrete named release; the property is the state-vs-event reshaping of the whole arc's goal topology. Separates from arc-ordering-dependency because the mechanism is a single global topology inversion, not a dependency between ordered phases.


**See also.** `arc-ordering-dependency` — both whole-arc topology reads; this one is a goal-state (issue-#65) reshaping, not an ordering scaffold; `deferred-terminus-conversion` — both reshape a script's terminal state so closure never lands: one converts a promised discrete climax into an indefinite plateau, the other relocates the payoff outside the file entirely. A reader looking at an ending that refuses to resolve is choosing between these two, and the distinction is inside-versus-outside the file boundary.; `pleasure-as-currency-payoff-reframe` — both are whole-script reframes of the goal state and both hinge on withholding the expected discharge, but one reshapes the target's temporal topology (event to plateau) and the other reassigns which quantity counts as the payoff. Adjacent enough to be mistaken for each other.; `unsatisfiable-arousal-overrun` — both engineer a state that by construction never discharges. One does it as a whole-arc design choice, replacing a promised climactic event with an unending plateau; the other does it in-scene by driving an arousal scale past its own declared maximum while barring release. Not a merge: arc-level topology reshaping versus a scale-mechanics overrun are separately assignable.


### induction-less-work-as-onramp

*risk: medium*

A whole-artifact architecture in which there is no separate induction phase — no progressive relaxation, breath-count, eye-fixation, or body-scan opener. The induction boundary is deleted by design, realized two ways. (a) WORK-AS-ONRAMP: the file opens already inside the frame and the work content itself (a sustained single image, arousal/masturbation, or a payload-fused first descent) does the induction's job, so trance is built by the work rather than as scaffolding for it — state carried by rhythm, prosody, and repetition of the work material, presupposing an already-conditioned listener who drops on a learned cue. (b) AMBIENT OCCUPATION-OF-ROLE: the file opens in essayistic/conversational register and stays there, so trance is implied by sustained presence in the frame rather than marked by a felt entry threshold; the center of gravity shifts from state-change-by-induction to occupation-of-role (not 'going under' but 'putting on'), and residual emergence infrastructure (a terminal wake-count) may remain even though the induction it would reverse is absent, letting the piece run as background. In both, the induction-deepener-work-emerge sequence is collapsed or inverted and the reusable lever is deletion of the induction boundary; because no threshold is crossed there is no clear point at which the listener could have refused.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from guided-visualization (which uses an image as CONTENT inside a normal staged arc) and from progressive-relaxation (a discrete induction section): here there is NO discrete induction section at all — the work substrate carries entry. Separates from a broken/incomplete arc (the tell is deliberateness — an already-conditioned audience and a learned drop-cue, not a missing block). Not the diegetic/procedural collapse of scene-and-deepener (that fuses SCENE with DEEPENING mid-file; this deletes the OPENER). Separates from song-architecture-delivery-vehicle (that substitutes a cyclical musical form with no arc; this still runs a collapsed linear file).


**Realizations** (1): `non-induction-induction`


**See also.** `arousal-as-induction-substrate` — both delete the induction boundary so there is no threshold to refuse at, but one names arousal specifically as the substitute ramp while the other is the whole-artifact architecture of having no discrete induction section at all, of which arousal-as-onramp is one realization.; `arousal-substrate-induction` — genuine boundary: one deletes the induction phase entirely and lets the work content carry entry; the other still runs an induction but builds it on an escalating arousal or need baseline instead of a relaxational one. A reader classifying a script with no relaxation opener has to decide which of these it is.; `deferred-terminus-conversion` — complementary whole-artifact moves: one deletes the entry threshold, the other withholds the exit. A writer working on either boundary benefits from seeing the other end of the same arc treated as deletable.; `exposure-dose-object-not-session` — adjacent deletions of session structure: one removes the induction boundary while keeping a collapsed linear arc, the other changes the kind of object entirely to a dose-over-time loop with no marked entry or exit.; `recall-recognition-reentry` — both open without a discrete induction section and both presuppose an already-conditioned listener. They differ in what carries entry: recognition or recall of a previously owned trance in one, the work material or sustained occupation of a role in the other. Useful to link because a reader diagnosing a missing induction will want to check both, but the entry substrate differs.


### irreversible-ratchet-persistence

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

Reframes discrete resettable cycles as deposits onto a one-way, irreversible-feeling scalar, so each compliance-cycle feels like it leaves a permanent loss and resistance to any single cycle feels futile. In one instance each sink/sleep/drop is bound to a one-way decrement of an inner value (IQ), asserted automatic and cumulative ('it's accumulative'), with a 'you won't notice it at first' clause that pre-empts the introspective check by making a null result the expected result. In another, each loop's 'wake' begins from a physically worse posture than the last (bed to kneeling to crawling), so each iteration starts where the prior ended rather than at baseline — the same one-way ratchet, carried by external posture/mobility markers instead of a named scalar.


**When to reach for this.** An explicit one-way accumulative ratchet on a countable/repeatable event (each descent, each loop) reframing resettable cycles as permanent progress-toward-loss. Unlike intensity multiplier-stacking (which escalates an INTENSITY by naming doubling/compounding), this monotonically DECREMENTS/degrades and never resets; unlike fractionation (which oscillates depth around a baseline), this never returns to baseline; and unlike total-permeation (a spatial spread claim), this is a temporal one-way accumulation. The two variants differ only in vehicle: a named inner scalar vs external posture markers.


**See also.** `confirm-then-multiply-compounding` — both build conviction by monotonic accumulation across repeated cycles, and each already defines itself partly against the other's shape (one-way decrement versus per-pass multiplication). A reader choosing an escalation structure benefits from seeing the ratchet-versus-multiplier contrast in one place.; `non-reset-arousal-ratchet-loop` — two non-resetting accumulators built on repeated cycles: one carries the ratchet on a named inner scalar or on posture, the other on arousal baseline with a cooldown that refuses to reset. Same structural idea on different carried quantities, worth linking rather than merging.; `reified-depletion-inventory` — they frequently co-occur on the same depletion claim and both refuse to reset, so a reader will meet them together. Kept separate because the levers come apart cleanly: a one-way ratchet can be carried by external posture markers with nothing counted, and a countable self-generated depletion inventory can run without any repeated cycle to ratchet against.; `startle-back-disarm-ratchet` — same one-way ratchet topology, different substrate: repeated cycles reframed as permanent decrement versus a named sleep-onset reflex made monotonically costlier each attempt. The asymmetry claim is the shared tell and neither discriminator currently covers the other.; `total-permeation` — both persistence claims; ratchet is one-way accumulation on a countable event, not spatial spread


### monotonic-no-reversal-contour

*risk: medium · bounded*

A whole-arc energy/trajectory shape authored as a deliberate object: one or more named state-variables (arousal, depth, surrender, craving, lock-in, resistance-erosion) are driven in a single direction across the entire artifact and never permitted to reverse. The script omits fractionation, almost-waking passes, and contrast/relief beats, so the listener is given no rest interval in which resistance can re-assemble; depth is built by accumulation rather than contrast, and even 'release' beats (orgasm, a nominal wake) are coded as more locking rather than a return to baseline. Realized contours: a monotonic accumulation punctuated by discrete event-markers (avatar arrives, machine starts) that prevent plateau; a flat-flat-flat-spike-flat deferral storing charge across a long calm stretch for one terminal release; a strictly upward depth-and-arousal ramp refusing any relief valve so suggestibility concentrates into a single late window where the load-bearing payload lands; a descending dissolution gradient starving the listener of stable referents as depth increases; and — as the cycling-engine variant — a repeated sawtooth of induction/partial-wake where each apparent wake sets a fresh baseline the next drop compounds from, so depth accumulates cycle-over-cycle and cross-state trigger demos become possible. The signature is affirmative: a design fact named by its negative space (the ABSENCE of a reversal beat), a property of sequence and density across the whole text, not a per-move magnitude change.


**When to reach for this.** Cited to the absence-of-counter-direction / whole-arc gradient, never to one line — removing a single passage leaves the contour intact, removing the contour guts the effect. Distinct from any per-line induction or deepener (which IS citable). The cycling-engine variant (fractionation architecture) makes repeated wake/sleep cycles the deepening engine with cross-state trigger demonstration as its payoff; the pure-contour instances make the one-way SHAPE the object and any cycles present serve it. Separates from load-bearing dependency-ordering because no stage is a precondition for the next — any one stage is removable and the monotone property survives.


**Realizations** (4): `arc-energy-topology`, `medium-forced-monotonic-trajectory`, `monotonic-descent-contour`, `monotonic-descent-shape`


**See also.** `arc-ordering-dependency` — staircase members sit on the seam between monotone-contour and ordered-dependency; `arousal-as-deepening-medium-entangled-exits` — strong overlap without being one entry. The arousal-substrate topology satisfies the no-reversal shape -- no calm down-phase, no discharge, no relief beat -- so it reads as a realized instance of the broader contour. It adds something the contour does not cover: two exit routes entangled so leaving requires both to fire at once. Link them, but do not merge; the contour is a family of shapes and the exit-entanglement is a separate structural claim.; `emergence-negative-space` — both are whole-arc negative-space properties cited to what the text omits, and one of the contour realizations is precisely a refusal of the release or wake beat. A reader holding a script with no emergence ramp needs to know whether the finding is the missing close specifically or the broader one-way trajectory.; `flat-surface-concealing-semantic-arc` — both are whole-arc design-time properties cited to the shape of the text rather than any removable line, and both work by what the surface conceals. Useful pairing for anyone working at arc level.; `inverse-authority-gradient` — both are whole-arc gradient properties cited to the absence of any announcing line rather than to a passage, so they compete for the same evidence shape. They differ in the variable being driven and its direction, which is exactly why a reader coding a monotone arc should see both.; `no-exit-reachability-closure` — both are whole-arc properties that no single line carries, and one explicitly lists an unbroken monotonic ramp with no fractionation valley among its realizations. The boundary is worth stating: directional shape versus closure of the reachable-state set.


### named-seam-inverse-aftercare-act

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

A whole-arc structure of two acts joined by a hard, explicitly author-signed frame-break: Act 1 runs a fiction in second person with no meta; Act 2 has the producer speak as themselves (announcing their own stage name), restoring the listener, with the in-fiction operator never returning. The aftercare act is structurally complete (mirroring each erasure category) and roughly coequal in scale (~25%), so the guaranteed inverse Act 2 is what licenses Act 1's brutality — reconstruction is treated as a coequal load-bearing act, not cleanup, and the step-out happens under a different, named identity.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a wake-within-the-fiction close — the tell is the explicit author-signed seam and a coequal inverse-aftercare act performed under a different identity. Distinct from covert-diegetic-install-shell (single shell wrapping one fiction; this is two coequal acts with an identity switch at the seam).


### nested-arc-restoration-disguise

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Runs two nested descent-then-restore arcs (an outer standard induction and an inner sub-arc) and smuggles the heavy identity-rewrite content entirely into the inner arc, which is bracketed by symmetric countdowns that read as an innocuous 'deepen then restore.' The return countdown promises restoration ('returning to your normal age'), framing the regression as reversible and bounded, while the script simultaneously asserts the changes are permanent; the nesting makes the restoration/permanence contradiction easy to miss in single-pass flow.


**When to reach for this.** A trajectory-topology property: a NESTED inner arc whose symmetric restore countdown hides a permanence claim, contradicting its own reversibility framing. Separated from an ordinary deepen/wake cycle by the nesting and the concealed contradiction, and it is a whole-arc structural property, not a single countdown line.


**See also.** `pseudo-emergence-residue-retention` — both are arc-topology deceptions where a structurally complete-looking restoration conceals retained content. One nests the payload inside symmetric countdowns, the other mirrors the induction vector at emergence. Same family of concealment, different position in the arc.


### no-exit-reachability-closure

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A whole-artifact design property in which the listener's reachable-state / reachable-response set is arranged so that no reachable state hosts criticality or offers an exit back to baseline. The closure is realized by several interchangeable operations, all producing the same no-off-ramp topology: FUSING opposed states so every relief channel feeds the system it would relieve (relaxation<->arousal, choice<->compulsion, frustration<->deepening); DELETING competing referents (build a sensory referent, destroy it, fill the void with operator tokens until only the voice remains); RE-ROUTING every resistance behavior into a deepener (intrusive thoughts, startle-back, doubt, trying-to-stay-awake all pre-loaded with a reframe that routes them back to the target state); SEALING each escape route with a distinct mechanism so counter-moves feed the next seal (many entrances, no exit); running an unbroken monotonic ramp with no fractionation valley so no seam exists at which to reassert judgment; or PRE-VALENCING every listener action inside the operator frame (stroke=good, stop=good, embarrassment=service, hold-back=failure) before any move can be claimed as resistance. The lever is reachability- closure of the state/response space across the whole arc, not any single seal, fusion, or line.


**When to reach for this.** The property is the RELATIONSHIP across the whole artifact — removing any one passage leaves an exit or a valley, so no single line carries it. Distinct from a progressive deepener (which descends but leaves off-ramps), a compulsion loop (which repeats but is escapable), and ordinary escalation (a directional intensity increase, orthogonal to closure). Fusion vs deletion vs re-routing vs sealing vs pre-valencing are surface realizations of one closure topology, not distinct mechanisms. Distinct from switching-state-machine-topology, which REQUIRES a route back to baseline (gated switching) rather than sealing all exits.


**Realizations** (2): `exit-less-loop-architecture`, `no-exit-no-baseline-topology`


**See also.** `asymmetric-state-lock` — exact topological complements: no reachable state offers an exit at all, versus an exit that exists but is monopolized by an operator condition. The pair defines the boundary better than either entry alone.; `closed-affect-loop` — genuine genus/species relation: one is whole-artifact closure over the entire reachable response space; the other constrains which joint affective states are reachable. The narrower one is a specific coupling lock and must not be folded into the broader arc property.; `closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop` — one is a specific closed self-running circuit, the other a whole-artifact property of the reachable-state space having no exit. The specific circuit is one way to realize the general closure, and the general entry lists several others, so the link carries real information.; `monotonic-no-reversal-contour` — both are whole-arc properties that no single line carries, and one explicitly lists an unbroken monotonic ramp with no fractionation valley among its realizations. The boundary is worth stating: directional shape versus closure of the reachable-state set.; `monotonic-ratchet-one-way-valve` — both are reachability topologies and the discriminators already reference each other, so the pointer is load-bearing. The test is static versus dynamic: one is closure of the response space at a given moment (no reachable state hosts criticality or an exit); the other is strict per-use tightening across uses with no regressible state. A design can be closed without ratcheting and can ratchet while leaving an exit open.; `neutral-state-deletion` — both close off the route back to ordinary functioning, but one is a whole-arc property of the reachable response space while the other is a discrete edit to the inventory of available self-states. Useful for telling an arc-level design property from a single map-surgery line.; `no-lose-double-bind` — a discrete constructed bind versus a whole-arc reachability property. The first is a citable option set where every branch serves the frame; the second is the no-exit topology no single line carries.; `objection-and-exit-preclosure` — the cleanest pairing in the batch: one closes exits as a global property of the whole artifact where no single passage carries it, the other closes specific named objections and exit routes prospectively. Each discriminator explicitly gestures at the other. A reader deciding whether the exitlessness is emergent or itemized needs both.


### open-loop-delayed-payoff

*risk: low*

An unanswered question is posed early as genuine ('why do you keep coming back to me?', framed 'contemplate this'), re-posed, and finally 'answered' much later with content-bearing material NOT derived from the question ('because I am your dream girl'). The listener's own mind is recruited to search for the answer, so whatever the script eventually supplies arrives as a felt discovery/resolution rather than instruction, and the substitution goes unnoticed because a search was underway. The open loop keeps attention forward-leaning across the intervening material.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a rhetorical question (which expects no real search) by requiring the question to land as genuine and the answer to be content-bearing and dropped-in, not derived. Separates from closed-logic-and-inevitability by holding an OPEN question so an unrelated answer is experienced as self-reached resolution, rather than closing a self-confirming loop. Separate from plain expectation-seeding by the specific unanswered-riddle-to-substituted-answer structure.


### regime-change-threshold-gate

*risk: medium*

A discrete, one-way threshold (a red velvet curtain positioned as a point-of-no-return) is staged as a voluntary crossing that converts continuous deepening into a REGIME change — after crossing, the operator's words and the subject's are framed as identical ('your words' and 'her words' are the same). The subject does the stepping so lost control is self-attributed, the operator answers the readiness check on the subject's behalf, and the feared cost of crossing ('all your control will be gone') is named directly and then inverted ('but all your wants will be yours') so pre-validating the fear stops it from breaking trance. The distinguishing object is the discrete one-way GATE topology — a bounded regime boundary — not a graded deepener and not a symbolic release act.


**When to reach for this.** A discrete one-way point-of-no-return gate whose crossing installs a REGIME where operator words are experienced as own thoughts, with operator-supplied readiness answer and paradoxical fear-naming. Separates from surrender-release-ritual (a symbolic release act, not a topology object — the threshold structure itself is the difference); from the resistance-paradox reframe (the fear-inversion here rides a spatial one-way gate, not a resistance-into-deepening fold); and from a plain deepener (a discrete regime-change boundary, not graded depth). In the source material the 'no going back' is later structurally violated by re-crossing — a tell that the gate is a framing device.


### rigged-response-game-no-win

*risk: medium*

A call-and-response 'game' is framed with stated stakes (win = stay smart, lose = dumb) but is structurally rigged so every outcome delivers the conditioning payload. Two rigging modes: the produced 'right words' ARE the payload (each word-pair the subject races to say is itself a dumbing/arousal mantra, so trying hard to win is rehearsing the mantras at speed), or the game is unwinnable (accelerating, mutating word-lists the subject structurally cannot keep up with) and both branches — fail while trying, or give up and lose — converge on the same target identity. The lever is a closed-game reachability constraint: the subject's competitive effort is redirected into self-administering the content, and there is no reachable exit that is not the target state, so resistance-via-playing-harder tightens the trap. Win/lose is never actually scored — the stakes are bait, not a mechanic.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from call-and-response: there responding succeeds as genuine proof and the produced response is neutral; here the game is rigged so the produced words are the payload and/or no winning exit is reachable. The distinguishing property is the reachability constraint (all paths lead to the target state), NOT the affect/cognition it co-produces — the arousal/dumbing is downstream, the closed no-win game-shape is the mechanism.


**See also.** `forced-choice-wake` — both are rigged choice architectures where every reachable branch delivers the payload and apparent agency is the cover: one is an unwinnable or self-administering game mid-session, the other a binary offered at emergence whose branches both confirm the install. The shared reachability constraint is genuinely instructive across the two.; `manufactured-insufficiency-ratchet` — both guarantee the subject cannot reach a passing outcome, and both spend competitive or approval-seeking effort as fuel. The distinguishing property is worth stating in both: one is a closed game where every reachable branch delivers the payload, the other a standard reset upward at the moment success would land.; `no-exit-response-closure` — the rigged game is a bounded instance of the broader closure principle: every reachable path lands on the same outcome. Keep separate because one is a scored-sounding contest with bait stakes and the other spans the whole option space including inaction.; `rigged-verification-capture` — both are all-branches-confirm rigs and the discriminating question is what is rigged: a staged game whose every play route lands in the target state, versus the subject's own act of checking or reasoning, whose every verdict is pre-mapped to confirmation. Genuinely adjacent enough that a writer will mis-assign one for the other.; `self-sealing-frame` — worth linking because the narrower entry is a realization of the broader one. The rigged game maps every branch of a staged win/lose contest onto the same payload; the broader entry pre-maps the ENTIRE space of listener responses and post-session verdicts to confirmation. A reader who identified the game should know the same no-disconfirming-branch topology also appears without any game framing.


### self-maintaining-install

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A whole-script architecture whose primary side effect is to keep itself alive outside the session. The install is engineered so that (a) an out-of-session real-world trigger (dressing / wardrobe) re-fires the state without the operator present, (b) each successful listen raises the probability of the next listen (relisten compulsion), and (c) attempts to break the install produce the very phrase or drop that hardens it. Success is measured across days/weeks of normal life, not within the audio — the operator's continued presence is designed out. The lever is a self-replication harness layered over the payload, not any single trigger or suggestion.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a single out-of-session trigger install (which fires but does not propagate) and from a plain relisten hook (which retains but does not fire in daily life) — the tell is the COORDINATED loop where the install both re-installs itself (relisten probability up) and re-fires itself (out-of-session activation up) with each use, plus resistance-hardening. The success criterion sits outside the recording.


**See also.** `care-framed-install-smuggling` — one's propagation hook and self-rearm carve-out are components of the other's coordinated self-replication harness measured outside the recording. Related as part to whole rather than duplicate, since the caring-surface concealment is not required by the harness.; `cross-artifact-retention-topology` — both are whole-artifact retention architectures with no single citable line, and the boundary between them is fine: one is structurally incomplete without its neighbouring pieces, the other is self-contained but engineered to re-fire and re-install itself in daily life. A reader classifying an architecture-level retention lever needs both.; `environmental-retrigger-seeding` — seeding real-world stimuli as out-of-session re-firing anchors is one of the components a self-maintaining install coordinates; the whole-architecture entry additionally requires a replay-probability loop and resistance-hardening, whereas ambient cue seeding fires the state again without propagating the install.; `implementation-intention` — the self-maintaining architecture uses an out-of-session cue-to-response install as one of its three coordinated legs, so a reader building the larger harness needs the conditional-binding entry; the harness adds relisten propagation and resistance-hardening on top, which the plain conditional binding lacks.; `re-listen-compulsion` — replay compulsion is one of the three legs the self-maintaining architecture needs (alongside out-of-session re-firing and resistance-hardening), so a reader building the coordinated loop should see it; alone it only retains the listener, it does not re-fire the state in daily life.; `self-firing-environmental-recurrence` — the self-firing environmental cue is one of the three coordinated legs of the self-maintaining architecture. Read the narrower entry for the cue-source question and the broader one for the coordinated relisten-plus-refire-plus-resistance-hardening loop.


### single-token-saturation-architecture

*risk: medium*

The entire script is built around a single lexical token escalated through multiple co-dependent functions at once — stated topic, semantic content of the suggestions, the installed post-hypnotic trigger, and the delivery keyword — so each utterance of the word does simultaneous triple/quadruple duty and per-utterance payload density is unusually high. Because the token accumulates meanings rather than swapping them, it becomes the load-bearing structural element (a synonym will not substitute). Critically, the token is chosen so it also pre-occupies the listener's own refusal vocabulary — the very word one would reach for to refuse ("nothing, I won't" / "I am vulnerable") has already been installed as the operator's trigger, so the most likely resistance utterance is itself a submission/firing act. The lever is reachability: the operator narrows the rhetorical space so no unowned word for "I refuse" remains.


**When to reach for this.** Nearest neighbor is ordinary trigger-install conditioning — the tell here is that ONE token is topic + content + trigger + delivery-key at once AND colonizes the refusal channel, so quoting the script partially fires the implant on a primed listener. Distinct from single-word nominalization/pun MOVES (the individual functions this rides above). Distinct from arc-shape spines — the unit is a lexical token, not a multi-stage trajectory.


**See also.** `flat-surface-concealing-semantic-arc` — both are whole-artifact surface properties where lexical uniformity is the structural load-bearer: one hides a steep semantic gradient under an identical grammatical chassis or braided concept-words, the other loads a single token with topic, content, trigger and delivery-key at once. A writer choosing a script-wide surface strategy benefits from seeing both options.; `lexical-relay-semantic-lattice` — both build a lexical structure that later lets one cue fire a whole cluster, differing in whether the load sits on a chain of handed-forward terms or on a single token carrying several functions at once. A genuinely contrastive pair.; `symptom-word-weaponization` — both make one lexical token carry topic, content, trigger, and delivery at once so no unowned word remains. The difference worth linking on is provenance: one selects a token that colonizes the refusal vocabulary, the other takes the word the listener arrived with and collapses it into obedience so pursuing the stated goal rehearses compliance.


### switching-state-machine-topology

*risk: medium · consent-required*

A whole-script install shape that builds a two-state machine (e.g. normal / bimbo) with explicit gated transitions and an accumulation rule biasing drift toward the target state over repeated cycles — rather than pushing toward a single permanent end-state. It requires the listener to spend most time in the vanilla state and enter the target state only on cue; a protective amnesia rule shields the vanilla state from contamination so the script is re-runnable rather than one-shot. The on-trigger is the ongoing operational interface; the script itself is a one-time installer for repeated cross-session use. The lever is the state-space topology (switching with a drift bias), not a directional intensity push.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a destination-installer ('you are now permanently X') because the design deliberately keeps the listener mostly in the baseline state and gates entry to the target state — the tell is the two-state gated topology with an accumulation/drift rule and protective amnesia enabling re-runs. Distinct from no-exit-reachability-closure, which seals ALL exits; here exit back to baseline is REQUIRED by design.


**See also.** `neutral-state-deletion` — near-inverse edits to the same object — the inventory of reachable states. One builds a two-state machine that requires the return to baseline and protects it; the other deletes the neutral baseline from the map so only the triggered states remain. A designer choosing between a re-runnable switching topology and a closed two-state space benefits from seeing both.


### whole-script-arc-shape-architecture

*risk: medium*

A design-time CONTAINER (not a single script-executable move) holding a family of whole-script structural properties — corpus-shape observations about how a script's arc, energy contour, or topology is engineered, each uncitable to one line. Instances gathered here: a bipartite install-then-deploy architecture joined by a sensitizing hinge; a steady migration of control from internal suggestion to external felt body-hardware as a commitment device; a monotonic arousal ramp with one deliberate plateau-interrupt engineering a single high-leverage compliance window; an A-B-A loop with a mutated middle pass wrapped by a daily-re-read instruction; AA rhyming couplets acting as a covert forward-pull pacing metronome; a didactic-then-applied two-act structure factoring the deepener out as a reusable function; a single-word saturation session whose whole body is a trigger-construction; a two-chamber architecture with a recited consent form as the airlock converting browser to subject; a ~2:1 induction-to-payload ratio treating depth as the gating constraint; an ordered selfhood-erosion / domain-capture staircase where sequence is load-bearing; and an expanding-radius scope funnel (session -> emotional life -> other people) culminating in recruitment.


**When to reach for this.** Not any single operator move — each member is a property of the whole energy contour / arc / topology, uncitable to one line, and non-script-executable (a design-time / observation property). Distinct from carrier-frame-payload-smuggling, which is a concealment RELATIONSHIP (a cover frame smuggling a payload) rather than a whole-arc shape. This is a deliberately loose grouping of whole-script shapes, NOT a claim these members share one mechanism.


**See also.** `arc-shape-engineering` — one is a specific destabilize-then-sell-the-cure arc; the other is an explicitly loose container for whole-script shapes that disclaims any shared mechanism among its members. The specific arc meets the container's inclusion test (whole-arc, non-executable, uncitable to one line), so a reader classifying an arc-level observation should see the container. Not a merge: absorbing a well-specified causal arc into an admitted grab-bag would lose its mechanism.; `consent-topology-arc` — both are whole-arc properties uncitable to any single line, but one names a specific lever (the arc relocates or forecloses the consent gate) while the other is a deliberately loose container of unrelated arc shapes, so a reader should check whether a candidate whole-arc observation is about the consent surface or merely about energy contour.; `form-content-fusion-topology` — two whole-artifact structural observations that meet at a boundary: one is an explicitly loose grouping of arc shapes, the other a specific form-content fusion property. A reader classifying a non-executable design observation needs to know both exist.


## operator-craft  (26)

Design-time procedures that change the operator's knowledge, targeting map, materials, or delivery — behavior recording, target selection, well-formedness and fidelity gates, precision training, delivery congruence, diagnostic reads.

**Scope.** Never a subject state. Subject-facing consent gates -> safety; measurement methodology -> measurement.


### affect-disproportion-routing

*risk: medium · bounded*

A routing rule that decides WHICH technique applies before any is applied. When the subject's present affect is visibly out of proportion to its present occasion — the reaction is too large, too specific, or too fast for what provoked it — the operator treats the disproportion as an index pointing at an earlier scene of the same shape, and routes to a backward-search or retrieval technique rather than working the present situation. Proportionate affect routes elsewhere. The move produces a decision about method, not a change in the subject; its whole output is which door the operator opens next.


**When to reach for this.** Routes on ONE observable — present affect disproportionate to its present occasion (too large, too specific, or too fast for what provoked it) — and on that signal alone selects a backward-search/retrieval family over working the present situation. Against preparatory-diagnostic-read's routing face (840): 840's routing exemplars key on contingency structure (antecedent/consequence co-occurrence) or cross-state structure (resource-amnesia across states), read over accumulated observation; this keys on the magnitude mismatch of a single live reaction and needs no history to fire. Against descriptive-functional-assessment (1193): 1193 requires the behaviour to recur often enough to log A-B-C triples and yields a correlational maintaining-function hypothesis; this fires once, on affect size, and yields an origin hypothesis instead. Against the retrieval techniques it selects — abreactive-present-tense-reliving (1007), covert-age-regression-state-reaccess (346) — those presuppose that an earlier scene is already the agreed target; this rule IS that decision and never re-experiences anything. Critically not fabricated-memory-trigger-rehearsal: that MANUFACTURES autobiographical material to install a forward cue, whereas this searches for material assumed to exist — and the standing failure mode is that the two collapse when the search is unconstrained, which is why the finding must be scored against corroboration obtained outside the search.


### associative-chain-retrieval

*risk: medium · consent-required*

Reach concealed or blocked material sideways rather than by asking for it: take something the subject has already produced spontaneously — a substitute word, a slip, a stray image, a concrete object-element of a bungled action — and have them chain associations outward from it, one link at a time, with no requirement that any link be relevant. The operator supplies only the seed and the instruction to keep going; every term in the chain is the subject's own, so nothing is being suggested INTO them. The chain is run until it exhausts or begins to circle, at which point the recurring convergence point is treated as the withheld item. Because the subject is never asked about the target, refusal has nothing to refuse — the retrieval happens without a direct request ever being made. Two seed-selection realizations ride the same lever: seed from the spontaneous SUBSTITUTE that appeared in place of the blocked item, with exhaustion as the stopping rule; or seed from a concrete OBJECT-ELEMENT of the bungle and chain toward the charged material behind it.


**When to reach for this.** vs preparatory-diagnostic-read (840): the nearest neighbour and the one to beat — 840's faces are instrumented direct measurement (alone-test, latency, clean-condition isolation) that read a behavior the subject is already emitting; here the target is precisely NOT emitted, and it is reached only by convergence across subject-supplied links the operator never scores individually. vs recall-state-reinstatement (1210): also subject-supplied material, but the subject knows the target and reconstructs it on request; here the target is what the subject cannot or will not produce. vs parts-work-positive-intent-elicitation (136): the part is asked directly and answers; nothing here is asked about the target. vs self-supplied-gap-directive (675): opposite flow — an engineered absence makes the subject INSTALL a payload in themselves; here the flow is subject-to-operator and nothing is planted. vs lexical-relay-semantic-lattice (1074) and transitive-charge-chaining (486): both operator-authored chains carrying a payload IN. The tell: operator supplies only a seed and a stopping rule, every link is subject-supplied, and the answer is the convergence point rather than any single link.


### crisis-induction-live-readout

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

The operator deliberately names the group's most taboo material (even insulting a member) to detonate the habitual interaction sequence, then withholds all content engagement and observes, re-igniting with trigger mentions when it slows. The real, un-self-conscious sequence exposes who-triggers-whom that a polite session hides; fatigue and lowered later resistance are side effects, not the point.


**When to reach for this.** Operator stays a non-engaging igniter/observer harvesting a structural read-out - not arguing content, not running a covert-induction pretext, and not handling resistance: the provocation is diagnostic and resistance-lowering is only a byproduct. Sibling stage to influence-topology-node-selection, whose node choice the live read-out feeds.


**See also.** `influence-topology-node-selection` — a real sibling pair: the provocation stage harvests a structural read-out of who responds to whom, and the node-selection stage routes a minimal change through the node that read-out identifies. One supplies the map the other consumes, so a reader of either needs the other.; `preparatory-diagnostic-read` — a specific probe and the general diagnostic surface it belongs to. Detonating a group's habitual sequence and then withholding engagement is an elicitation designed to harvest a structural read-out, with lowered resistance only a byproduct. The broader entry covers the shared discipline: the payoff lands in the operator's map and nothing is installed.


### design-time-reconnaissance

*risk: low*

Before instruction/design, exhaustively map the space the plan must survive so gaps are caught on paper rather than in the field; nothing is delivered to the subject. Realizations: (a) GENERALIZATION-DOMAIN RECON — enumerate every setting and stimulus condition where the behavior should AND explicitly should NOT occur (treated as the unseen test, with discriminated alternative responses planned for inappropriate opportunities); list every desired response form and triage train-directly vs delegate-to-generalization; and survey the discriminative stimuli, schedules, and reinforcer types already operating in the target settings, so training is matched to what the environment will actually deliver; (b) EXHAUSTIVE-OBJECTOR CENSUS — before design work, demand a complete externalized (written) census of every objecting part and its function, sweeping every representational system rather than stopping at first responders, pre-warning that many typically object, so no suppressed objector is omitted from later design and cannot resurface as post-install sabotage. The shared lever is exhaustive design-time enumeration for completeness; the failure mode it prevents is a missed item (setting or objector) resurfacing after commitment.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for design-time-reconnaissance when the writer needs an exhaustive pre-design map so nothing is missed -- a completeness sweep on the PLAN before any teaching/install, subject untouched. Tells: enumerate should/should-not settings + response-form triage + standing-contingency survey (a); complete written cross-channel census of objectors (b). Distinct from target-selection (which FILTERS/picks targets rather than enumerating the space), from preparatory-diagnostic-read (which reads/measures the subject rather than enumerating on paper), and from intervention-gating (which branches proceed/how). Its contingency survey supplies the environment map that target-selection's maintainability criterion tests against.


**Realizations** (1): `exhaustive-objector-census`


**See also.** `operator-side-design-gating` — both are planner-facing pre-deployment checks on the design with nothing delivered to the subject: one exhaustively enumerates the space the plan must survive, the other tests whether the planned baselines actually determine the intended emergent relations and blocks the protocol if not. Enumeration and the go/no-go gate it feeds are naturally read together.; `target-selection` — adjacent design-time operator moves that are easy to conflate, and each discriminator already names the other: one filters and operationalizes which target to aim at, the other exhaustively enumerates the space the plan must survive. They also interlock, since the enumeration supplies the environment map the selection criteria test against. Filtering is not enumerating, so no merge.


### enactment-to-reflection-routing

*risk: medium · consent-required · bounded*

A live impulse aimed at the operator — anger, demand, seduction, contempt arising in the room and directed at them personally — is neither discharged as action nor deflected, but compelled back into description while it is still hot. The operator declines to respond in the register the impulse invites, absorbs the aimed heat without retaliating or gratifying, and requires the subject to say what is happening instead of doing it. It requires co-presence and an operator willing to be the target, because the impulse must be live and aimed at someone for there to be anything to route; recalled or hypothetical impulses do not supply the material. The subject ends holding an impulse they can observe rather than one they have already acted on.


**When to reach for this.** abreactive-present-tense-reliving (1007) is the direct counterpart and inverts the routing: there affect is deliberately let run in present tense so that charged re-experience surfaces never-verbalized material, and discharge is the retrieval mechanism. Here discharge is exactly what is blocked, and the target is a live impulse toward the operator rather than a re-entered past event. capacity-saturation-overload (173) loads the processing budget so evaluation starves — this demands the opposite, an increase in reflective capacity applied to an active state. enacted-embodied-proof (495) commands a physical action so the body manufactures evidence for a claim; this forbids the action the impulse is pressing for. crisis-induction-live-readout (524) also detonates real affect and has the operator withhold engagement, but the operator there is an igniter and non-participating OBSERVER harvesting a structural read of who-triggers-whom, and the affect is not aimed at them; here the operator is the impulse's target and the payoff lands in the subject's capacity to observe rather than in the operator's map. The tell against all four is the combination: aimed at the operator, live, and converted rather than either discharged or observed.


### imagined-completion-diagnostic

*risk: medium*

A guided imagined-completion ritual (gather the important people from a special vantage, state the decision, finish unsaid business, look into a future-without-them) that DOUBLES AS DIAGNOSIS: if the subject is congruently ready it organizes real final tasks; if not, it harvests the positive outcomes behind the decision and the still-meaningful attachments as change leverage. The subject- side imagery effects (mild absorption, a dissociated vantage) are real but faint and low-confidence; the load-bearing purpose is the operator-side diagnostic/harvest.


**When to reach for this.** The diagnostic payload is the tell (not a guided-imagery relaxation script — the operator reads congruence and mines unfinished business). vs guided-visualization: the imagery is instrumentation for operator-side information capture, not an absorption anchor. Off-axis for the subject-state dims — hence the residual flag.


### influence-topology-node-selection

*risk: low*

Map who-responds-to-whom, then route a minimal change through the single node whose change propagates system-wide - deliberately avoiding the symptomatic member (easy to flip, but the system flips them back) and preferring the most tenacious member others actually respond to. The system then does most of the work and the change persists.


**When to reach for this.** Selection of the intervention NODE by influence-graph propagation and tenacity - not any particular change technique and not work with the presenting member; tell is deliberate non-symptomatic tenacious-node targeting. The graph is read and routed through, not restructured. Sibling stage to crisis-induction-live-readout, whose read-out supplies the map this move selects from.


**See also.** `crisis-induction-live-readout` — a real sibling pair: the provocation stage harvests a structural read-out of who responds to whom, and the node-selection stage routes a minimal change through the node that read-out identifies. One supplies the map the other consumes, so a reader of either needs the other.


### intervention-ecology-correction

*risk: low*

The operator treats observed feedback (subject resistance, or the aftermath of a successful removal) as a signal to re-orient the intervention's AIM or ECOLOGY rather than to add force — a design constraint on the change's fit, not a subject-state push. In the resistance-as-targeting-feedback form, stalling or refusal is read not as an obstacle to push through but as evidence the operator is aiming at the wrong object: abandon the defended presenting symptom and redirect onto its substrate or secondary gains (the conditions that make the symptom necessary), so removing the need leaves the symptom nothing to defend — the lever is operator-side search re-orientation, not increased force. In the post-removal ecology-check form, after a technique strips an overgeneralized protective response, deliberately verify that ordinary adaptive caution survived and re-task some of the freed-up energy as a guardrail in the newly-open context, preventing the change from overshooting into recklessness (the useful core of the removed protection is confirmed intact and the liberated energy is redirected to safeguard). The shared lever is feedback-driven operator-side correction of the intervention's aim/ecology.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for intervention-ecology-correction when observed feedback tells the operator to ADJUST the intervention's aim or ecology (not its force) — a design constraint on the change's fit, with no consent channel touched and no struggle engaged in-frame. Tells: resistance re-aims the search onto the symptom's substrate; a post-success check confirms adaptive caution survived and redeploys freed energy as a guardrail. Distinct from resistance-fold and resistance-deterrence, which convert or absorb the subject's struggle in-frame (here the operator re-aims instead of engaging), from consent-manufacture (no refusal channel is eroded), and from consent/welfare governance (this is an ecology/aim constraint, not a license or refusal channel).


**Realizations** (1): `redeploy-liberated-energy-into-caution`


### intervention-gating

*risk: low*

An operator-side conditional branch that converts 'do X' into a go/no-go (or which-arm/which-form) decision keyed to an assessed precondition, changing the operator's plan rather than the subject's state. Realizations: (a) PRECONDITION-READINESS GATE — check readiness conditions before an advanced program (primary skills strong, learner self-listens, learner can tact her own behavior) and proceed only if all hold, else build the missing prerequisite first; (b) FAIR-PAIR PRECONDITION — block any reduction plan until a same-function adaptive replacement is named and scheduled (elimination is converted into construction, because removing a functional behavior leaves a vacuum); (c) CAUSE-ACCESSIBILITY TRIAGE — test whether the subject can state the cause consciously; if yes run direct suggestion, if no run uncovering first, then correct (a which-arm branch with an explicit failure signature: direct suggestion fails when the cause is unconscious); (d) METHOD/FEASIBILITY SELECTION — pick among methods by a rule keyed to downstream side-effects (default to the error-minimizing method when learning history is unknown or errors evoke problem behavior; escalate complexity only when simpler fails) and covertly gauge whether significant others can actually run the plan, filtering targets by treatment-integrity risk; (e) EFFICACY-AUDIENCE FILTER — an intake prerequisite that admits only a pre-conditioned listener (e.g. familiarity with a prior product) so hotter in-session work can run without onboarding. The gate itself enacts nothing on the subject; it branches the plan on effectiveness or feasibility grounds.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for intervention-gating when the writer's question is 'should this run, in what form, or which arm?' — an assessed-precondition test that branches the plan before/about intervention content, with no authorization surface on the subject. Variant tells: readiness checklist (a), same-function replacement required first (b), conscious-cause test picks the corrective arm (c), side-effect-keyed method/feasibility rule (d), listener-precondition intake filter (e). NOTE on (e): unlike a subject-facing consent or suitability screen, the efficacy-audience filter protects NOBODY — it serves hotter work, not welfare; that purpose-inversion is its tell. Distinct from target-selection (chooses WHAT to aim at), from well-formedness QA (validates the authored artifact), and from a subject-facing consent gate.


**Realizations** (3): `cause-accessibility-triage`, `efficacy-audience-filtering`, `operator-side-method-selection`


**See also.** `depth-verification-gate` — both are operator-side gates that block or branch action on an assessed precondition, and a writer looking for one may want the other. The narrower one refuses to infer depth from ambiguous outward signs and forces independent verification before a high-stakes act; the broader family branches the plan on readiness, feasibility, or which corrective arm to run. Gating on verified state versus gating on plan viability.


### operator-delivery-craft

*risk: low*

The operator shapes their OWN transmitted signal -- decoupling internal assessment from outward channel -- so the subject receives only the intended cue; the object is the operator's output, not the subject's state. Realizations: (a) COVERT-CHANNEL CONTROL — privately doubt the outcome but keep every observable channel (tone, manner, word choice, hand motion) free of doubt and leak only genuine warmth while suppressing any gesture readable as a trance cue, so the subject's threat-detection never catches the cue; or hold the question's wording constant and vary only intonation (neutral inquirer -> clean literal report; interested intonation -> covertly directs a tranced subject who reads paralinguistics as directive); (b) DELIVERY-CONGRUENCE CORRECTION — an observer interrupts a technically-correct move delivered with mismatched voice/posture and gives specific paralinguistic fixes (retune tone/tempo, change posture), splitting verbal content from nonverbal delivery so the analog channel stops contradicting the words; (c) DELIVERY-TEXTURE / FORM FUSION — a whole-script, design-time property (NOT a discrete move): the texture of the text is tuned to the target end-state -- a flat flip-less energy contour matched to loop/replay format, a density gradient (information down, trigger-firing up toward a mindless endpoint), a monotonic counter as coherence-scaffold letting interstitial prose stay loose, and grammatical form degrading in lockstep with described cognitive degradation. The common lever is control of the operator's paralinguistic/behavioral output and signal texture as a channel independent of the words.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for operator-delivery-craft when the writer is shaping what the OPERATOR transmits -- tone, manner, gesture, intonation, or whole-script texture -- rather than acting on the subject's experience. Tells: internal state concealed while an authentic channel is leaked / words held constant while intonation carries covert content (a); an observer retunes a self-cancelling mixed message (b); a corpus-shape texture property with no discrete move to perform (c). Distinguish from pacing-leading (acts on the subject's experience), from attribution-capture (relocates the subject's self-attribution), and from operator-training-via-monitor (drills procedural precision, not the transmitted signal).


**Realizations** (2): `delivery-contour-and-form-fusion`, `operator-delivery-congruence-correction`


**See also.** `operator-resource-generation` — both are operator-side disciplines whose object is the operator rather than the subject's state: one governs how the tactical material is sourced before anything fires, the other governs the transmitted signal itself. A reader working on operator craft rather than subject moves is served by the pair.; `operator-training-via-monitor` — both act on the operator rather than the subject and are easily conflated: one drills procedural precision by having a monitor or stand-in expose gaps the operator would otherwise fill silently, the other shapes the transmitted signal itself — tone, gesture, intonation, whole-script texture. Craft-of-procedure versus craft-of-delivery.; `representational-system-matching` — sensory-channel matching is a delivery-side craft move that shapes the operator's own transmitted signal, and both hinge on concealment of the operator-side adjustment. A reader cataloguing operator-output technique will reasonably wonder whether one subsumes the other; it does not, because one reads the listener's channel first.


### operator-receptive-suspension

*risk: low*

A design-time discipline on the operator's own attention rather than on anything transmitted: while the subject produces material, the operator deliberately suspends judgement, forms no expectation about what should come next, and makes no effort to fix anything in memory — holding an even, unselective attentional posture across everything heard. Suppressing selection is the point: any expectation about what matters causes the operator to attend to confirming material and skip the rest, so the material that would have contradicted the working hypothesis never reaches them. Refusing to consolidate deliberately keeps the operator's read revisable, because a note taken now is a commitment that shapes what is heard for the rest of the session.
