**When to reach for this.** The manipulated variable is the operator's own RECEPTIVE state in the moment — suspend judgement, form no expectation, fix nothing in memory, hold even unselective attention — so the material that would contradict the working hypothesis still reaches the operator. vs operator-delivery-craft (1280), the only other in-session operator-side entry: its object is what the operator TRANSMITS (tone, manner, gesture, intonation, texture); here output is unchanged and intake is the disciplined thing. vs measurement-confound-mitigation (500), the nearest data-validity move: that protects validity by ARRANGING observation (spread across times, settings, caretakers; repeat until reactivity decays) — a sampling design; this protects it by refusing to filter within a single live sample. vs preparatory-diagnostic-read (840): that runs a probe to extract a datum; here nothing is probed and no datum is targeted. vs operator-training-via-monitor (758): offline craft correction against a stand-in, not a live posture. vs defusion-observer-stance (1191): same surface posture but performed ON the subject as a technique; here the subject is not instructed at all.


### operator-resource-generation

*risk: low*

Operator-side disciplines for SOURCING the content/tactics an intervention will use, before any technique fires — shaping the fix's material rather than pushing a subject state. Demonstrated forms: a fixed-order fallback cascade for producing a new behavior (recall a personal-history success in full sensory detail; if none, model someone who succeeds; if still none, fabricate/pretend; last, operator-coach the steps), then perform it immediately and check intended=received — justified by a congruence-preference rationale where each step down trades congruence for availability; a generate-N-before-committing count-gate where a monitor refuses commitment to the first tactic and repeats "how else could you get it?" until at least three distinct routes to a pre-named sub-outcome exist, building spare tactics so a failed move becomes a switch not a stall; and a recruit-existing-capacity redirect that blocks fresh construction and directs the subject to enlist an already-present part that demonstrably has the needed quality, treating internal resources as composable modules so the new function inherits proven competence. The shared lever is that the operator disciplines how the tactical/behavioral resource is produced (ordered fallback, count-gated redundancy, reuse-over-construction), building the operator's option set rather than moving a listener dimension.


**When to reach for this.** Not generic brainstorming/coaching — the tell in each is a hard discipline on sourcing: a strict ordered fallback justified by congruence and live-tested; a count-gate hard-bound to a pre-named outcome that blocks advancing on one option; or a reuse-over-construction redirect. None is a subject-state move — the payoff lands in the operator's tactical repertoire or the fix's content, not any x(t).


**See also.** `operator-delivery-craft` — both are operator-side disciplines whose object is the operator rather than the subject's state: one governs how the tactical material is sourced before anything fires, the other governs the transmitted signal itself. A reader working on operator craft rather than subject moves is served by the pair.


### operator-side-affect-depersonalization

*risk: low*

A discipline the operator runs on themselves, not on the subject. When the subject's intense affect lands on the operator — devotion, fury, erotic fixation, dependency — the operator deliberately recodes it from a personal event addressed to them as a person into an impersonal and largely predictable product of the situation, something the role would have generated in whoever occupied it. Removing the personal stake removes both failure modes: the operator neither ruptures the frame by defending themselves nor reciprocates and collapses the asymmetry the work depends on. The re-attribution is held privately and changes nothing the subject hears; its whole output is the operator's own stability under pressure. It is a stance, so it must be rehearsed before it is needed — it does not arrive on demand mid-scene.


**When to reach for this.** Every nearest neighbour relocates causation in the SUBJECT'S model in order to act on the subject; this relocates causation in the OPERATOR'S model in order to act on the operator. `impersonal-mechanism-alibi` tells the subject their change was caused by an unfalsifiable impersonal source so doubt becomes a category error — subject-facing, and its purpose is disarming the subject. `causal-attribution-to-external-agent` names an external non-consumed cause so the subject's volition has nothing to push against — again the payload lands in the subject. `object-as-causal-agent-of-cognition` and `subconscious-agent-authorship-offload` both offload authorship to somewhere other than the operator, but the erosion of ownership is the subject's. Direction of application is the whole discriminator: nothing the subject perceives changes here. Its true siblings are the operator-side governance entries — it sits alongside operator-craft's delivery and diagnostic faces, differing from those in that it regulates the operator's AFFECT rather than their knowledge, materials, or delivery.


### operator-side-design-gating

*risk: low*

A planner-facing go/no-go coherence check performed on the intervention DESIGN before deployment: the operator maps in advance which baseline relations will be taught and which derived relations must logically emerge, and detects arrangements where the baselines underdetermine the derived relations. If the planner cannot specify the derived relations the training should yield, transformation of function is unpredictable and the protocol is unsound — so the enumeration itself becomes a diagnostic that gates whether the protocol runs.


**When to reach for this.** Distinct from fitness gates like suitability-screening (which gate on whether the SUBJECT is fit): the gated object is the DESIGN, not the person — a planner-facing coherence check, not a move performed on a learner. Positive governance nonetheless: the operator's license is narrowed and the action blocked.


**See also.** `belief-outcome-gate` — both are operator-side governance gates that narrow the operator's own license rather than acting on the subject, and both hold independently of the subject's consent or request. One gates on design coherence, the other on foreseen downstream fallout; a reader classifying a self-imposed hold needs the pair.; `depth-verification-gate` — two positive-governance gates that block the operator rather than move the subject, differing in gated object: one refuses to act until the subject's state is independently verified, the other refuses to deploy until the design's derived relations can be specified in advance. A writer selecting a pre-action gate benefits from seeing both.; `design-time-reconnaissance` — both are planner-facing pre-deployment checks on the design with nothing delivered to the subject: one exhaustively enumerates the space the plan must survive, the other tests whether the planned baselines actually determine the intended emergent relations and blocks the protocol if not. Enumeration and the go/no-go gate it feeds are naturally read together.; `suitability-screening` — both discriminators already name each other as the contrast case: one gates the design, the other gates the person, and both are positive-governance moves that narrow the operator's license. The boundary is genuinely confusable at classification time, so the cross-reference is load-bearing.


### operator-training-via-monitor

*risk: low*

A monitor or stand-in 'subject' is used to surface and correct defects in the OPERATOR'S own procedure/verbalizations/measurement, rather than to change a real listener; the acted-upon object is the operator's craft, the inverse of a client-directed move. Realizations: (a) FEIGNED-LITERALIST STAND-IN — a trainer role-plays a helplessly-confused client who refuses to fill the operator's gaps, so every unspecified referent, action, and sensory channel must be spelled out and ambiguity surfaces in training rather than misfiring on a real subject; (b) MULTIELEMENT FUNCTIONAL-ANALYSIS REHEARSAL — the operator cycles a small set of paired MO+reinforcer conditions (attention/escape/tangible/alone/free-reinforcement control) in alternation and reads the maintaining contingency off differential responding, training measurement discipline; (c) ARTICULATION CHECKPOINT — a trainer/supervisor interrupts the operator the moment they drift and forces them to answer a fixed stack in operational language (which protocol step, what intended outcome, by what causal link this move reaches it), NEVER supplying the answer, so moves that would not produce the stated outcome get exposed by the operator's own account. The lever is forced self-localization / precision under a meta-observer.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for operator-training-via-monitor when the target is the OPERATOR/trainee's own procedure, not a subject's state — a monitor or acted stand-in exposes gaps the operator would otherwise miss. Tells: stand-in refuses to fill gaps so referents must be spelled out (a); paired-condition rehearsal read off differential responding (b); trainer forces articulation but withholds the answer (c). Distinct from procedure-well-formedness-QA (validates the authored DOCUMENT/install, not live delivery), from operator-delivery-craft (repairs the transmitted signal, not procedural precision), and from any measurement/comprehension probe on a SUBJECT.


**Realizations** (1): `trainer-on-operator-articulation-checkpoint`


**See also.** `operator-delivery-craft` — both act on the operator rather than the subject and are easily conflated: one drills procedural precision by having a monitor or stand-in expose gaps the operator would otherwise fill silently, the other shapes the transmitted signal itself — tone, gesture, intonation, whole-script texture. Craft-of-procedure versus craft-of-delivery.; `procedure-well-formedness-QA` — the two operator-facing quality moves, and each already names the other as its nearest boundary. One tests the authored artifact before it runs, the other corrects the operator's live delivery through a stand-in or observer. Reading both is how you place any given practitioner-side move.


### out-of-band-corroboration-confrontation

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The operator leaves the dyad, obtains an account of the disputed matter from an independent third party who has no stake in the subject's self-presentation, then returns and confronts the subject with the discrepancy between the two records. Because the operator now holds a version of the facts the subject did not author and cannot revise, the subject's editorial control over the factual record is broken and the usual repair moves — vagueness, qualification, gradual restatement — stop working. The confrontation typically forces an explicit retraction, and the retraction is itself the diagnostic payload: the point at which the account was defended hardest marks where concealment was operating. The lever is the out-of-band evidence channel, not the confrontation manner, which can be gentle.


**When to reach for this.** The evidence is gathered OUTSIDE the session from a party the subject does not control, and is used adversarially against the subject's own account. staged-external-reality-corroboration also reaches outside the session but manufactures perceptible events to convince the SUBJECT of a fiction — here real testimony is collected to disconfirm the subject, and nothing is staged. rigged-verification-capture pre-loads the subject's own introspective check so every outcome confirms; this runs no check inside the subject at all — the check happens elsewhere, with a party the rigging cannot reach. disconfirmation-suppression is the exact inverse operation on the same information environment: it blocks a disconfirming fact from reaching the subject to protect a running belief, where this imports one deliberately to collapse an account. withdrawn-doubt-open-loop implies an unnamed defect and withdraws so the subject elaborates the doubt themselves; here the defect is named, specified, and backed by an external record, so there is nothing left to elaborate — the loop closes rather than compounds.


### parts-work-positive-intent-elicitation

*risk: low*

An operator-side interrogation/elicitation discipline that recasts an objecting or resisting inner part from an adversary into a stakeholder with a legitimate job, converting resistance into a set of satisfiable requirements rather than a wall to fight. The lever is the line of questioning: stipulate every part benevolent, ask a part what it is in charge of doing (not its objection), ladder 'what is it trying to do for you by that?' down a consequence chain to a buildable positive aim, split an undifferentiated complaint into two blameless colliding parts, or have the subject find their own valuing context and draft the responsible part. These are preparatory-assessment moves that shape design material, not present-state pushes on the subject.


**When to reach for this.** Operator-side elicitation that turns a resisting part into a satisfiable stakeholder via a disciplined line of questioning. Separates from evaluative-reframe-content-relabel (which re-appraises a fixed event's valence, not a part's role) and from surrender-as-freedom (which argues a value concept). The no-bad-parts axiom is the presupposition that opens this method; grouped here as its precondition rather than as a standalone value install.


**See also.** `evaluative-reframe-content-relabel`; `parts-work-procedure-craft` — both are operator-side craft for running an internal-parts procedure, and the second explicitly excludes elicitation content while the first supplies it. A practitioner running a parts negotiation needs both: what to ask a part, and how to keep the negotiation tractable and complete. Genuinely complementary rather than overlapping.


### parts-work-procedure-craft

*risk: low*

Operator-side craft for RUNNING an internal-parts negotiation or reframing procedure -- shaping the procedure's structure, tractability, and completeness, orthogonal to whatever content the parts are led toward. Realizations: (a) SLACK MANUFACTURE — in a stuck two-party (parts) conflict, manufacture tradeable currency so bargaining becomes structurally possible: confirm that interference runs both ways (each party blocks something the other wants, so a mutual non-interference swap becomes purchasable, doubling as a model-selection gate), or pre-load count-balanced non-essential throwaway items so concessions cost nothing real -- either way a slack-free deadlock gains give-and-take room; (b) SPOKESPART SERIALIZATION — convene all present parts, have them elect a single spokespart, instruct the rest to hold, then poll one at a time (naming/tracking each by voice, pausing/reconvening) so a many-party negotiation is serialized into single turns bounded by the operator's working memory instead of collapsing into simultaneous noise; (c) SUBSTITUTE EXISTING BEHAVIOR — a procedural compression of the six-step reframing model: rather than generating three new behaviors, treat the parts' existing behaviors as already-adequate and slot in a substitute existing behavior/anchor, making the only new element the renegotiation of mutual non-interference (nothing removed, so resistance drops); (d) BOTH-POLES REFRAME — for a sequential polarity (crash-diet and binge; up and down) whose halves are opposite in content but identical in form (both obsessions, both loss-of-control), reframe BOTH poles rather than only the presenting one, so the other cannot rebound ('Now is my chance!') -- a completeness/relapse guard. The shared lever is engineering the parts/reframing PROCEDURE itself.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for parts-work-procedure-craft when the writer is RUNNING an internal-parts negotiation or reframe and needs to make the procedure workable/complete -- operates on the negotiation/reframe STRUCTURE, not on any party's state or the substantive reframing content. Tells: costless/symmetric tradeable currency created for a deadlock (a); turn-taking discipline elect/hold/poll/name-by-voice (b); reuse an existing behavior to compress the six-step model (c); reframe both poles of a same-form polarity as a relapse guard (d). Distinct from the actual reframing/valence content moves, from the later hunt for unknown parts (that is design-time-reconnaissance's objector census), and from clinician-non-interference (withholding action) -- these are active procedure-structuring moves.


**Realizations** (3): `both-poles-reframe`, `spokespart-serialization`, `substitute-existing-behavior`


**See also.** `parts-work-positive-intent-elicitation` — both are operator-side craft for running an internal-parts procedure, and the second explicitly excludes elicitation content while the first supplies it. A practitioner running a parts negotiation needs both: what to ask a part, and how to keep the negotiation tractable and complete. Genuinely complementary rather than overlapping.


### preparatory-diagnostic-read

*risk: low*

The operator reads, measures, probes, or classifies the subject so the operator's own knowledge/targeting map/route updates -- the payoff lands in the operator's head, never in the subject's x(t); nothing is installed. This is the whole read/probe diagnostic surface; a writer reaches for it whenever the question is 'how do I find out X about the subject?'. Faces: (1) MEASUREMENT/ATTRIBUTION CRAFT — alone-test (persistence-while-alone => automatic reinforcement), latency-to-first-occurrence (a safety-driven FA that evokes a dangerous behavior only once), clean-condition isolation (deliver one consequence while suppressing contaminating cues so rate attributes function to one variable), function-first targeting (aim at the maintaining contingency not topography), faulty-control audit (can the task be solved via an irrelevant correlated cue?), operant-strength profiling (baseline the weakest component class), attribution-drift admissibility gate (WHOSE behavior actually changed?), and informant question-framing (constrain a third party to observable when/where/how-often). (2) READ-ONLY STATE-VERIFICATION — a read-only procedure updating the operator's estimate of subject state with the subject often unaware a test is happening: silently reading involuntary tells, a no-skip test battery counting only spontaneous signs, refusing to name the success criterion so it can't be faked, forbidding a cold test, a probe engineered so failing to DETECT the state tends to PRODUCE it, a distractor-barrage isolating the cue, concealed side-by-side matching, cross-state comparison isolating the state as causal; managing WHAT COUNTS as proof and WHO reads it. (3) ROUTING/HYPOTHESIS READ — read a signature in the observed pattern to SELECT a treatment route (cross-state resource-amnesia => genuine sequential dissociation => reduce-to-simultaneous; antecedent/consequence co-occurrence => maintaining-function hypothesis), explicitly hypothesis-generating, gating which later technique even applies. (4) POST-HOC VERIFICATION — deliberately re-expose the subject to the LIVE original trigger (give the alcoholic a drink; return to the original context) and read nonverbal markers for the old shift, converting a claim of change into a falsifiable behavioral test; residual sensitivity reads as incomplete change. (5) READ-DISCIPLINE — function-over-form classification: refuse to treat topographically identical acts as the same behavior; sort each by its controlling stimulus and effect, making surface similarity explicitly non-diagnostic (upstream stance governing every read above). (6) DESIGNED ELICITATION PROBES — wrong-guess elicitation: float a recognizably-wrong interpretation to trigger the correction reflex, then ban negations to force a fuzzy nominalization into a concrete testable behavior; predicate-swap probe: rewrite a suggestibility test's sensory predicates into another modality so the test doubles as a hidden instrument revealing the reachable representational channel. The shared lever throughout is diagnostic/decision-rule craft -- read or engineer an observation; none installs behavior.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for preparatory-diagnostic-read whenever the writer needs the operator to LEARN something about the subject -- measure a variable, verify a state, route a treatment, or elicit a specific datum -- with no dimensional push on the subject; the output lives in the operator's map. Face tells: designed measurement/attribution condition (1); read-only test the subject doesn't control or perform (2); read of existing pattern that generates a routing hypothesis (3); deliberate live-trigger re-exposure to verify the work took (4); same-topography-different-class read-discipline (5); a test/question secretly instrumented to extract one operator datum (6). Separates from every installation/evocation move (which changes subject state); from covert-induction pretexts (a diagnostic probe installs nothing); and from ideomotor/elicited-signal work (these signs are involuntary/unrequested or the operator supplies the contrast). The safety forms (latency-cap, clean isolation) deliberately suppress/limit to protect the read or the subject.


**Realizations** (6): `function-over-form-classification`, `operator-side-craft`, `operator-side-diagnostic-read`, `operator-side-state-verification`, `predicate-swap-probe`, `wrong-guess-elicitation`


**See also.** `crisis-induction-live-readout` — a specific probe and the general diagnostic surface it belongs to. Detonating a group's habitual sequence and then withholding engagement is an elicitation designed to harvest a structural read-out, with lowered resistance only a byproduct. The broader entry covers the shared discipline: the payoff lands in the operator's map and nothing is installed.


### problem-reduction-case-transformation

*risk: low*

A structural precondition move that operates on the reachability topology of the subject's state graph. When two warring states never co-occur (sober-now / drunk-later), so the standard simultaneous-conflict procedure cannot run, the operator does not invent a new method — he collapses the time gap so both states are present at once, converting an unreachable joint-configuration into the canonical case the existing procedure already solves. The payload is a case-transformation: remap an intractable configuration onto a solved one so no new technique is needed, only a step that makes the symptom-owning part reachable.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is an explicit precondition step that manufactures simultaneity (or otherwise remaps state-reachability) BEFORE any negotiation begins. NOT the cure itself, NOT a same-time reframe, and NOT a measurement probe — it changes which joint-states are reachable, a topology operation, not what the operator can observe.


**See also.** `anchor-collapse-state-jamming` — the anchor-collapse move is a concrete instance of the abstract precondition: it manufactures simultaneity between two states the subject has never held at once so the existing integration procedure becomes runnable. Genus and worked case, not a merge - one is a topology operation stated generally, the other a specific anchoring procedure with its own disorganization signature.


### procedure-well-formedness-QA

*risk: low*

The operator validates the authored install/procedure against a hard external test before it runs on a subject, refusing 'the author is satisfied' as the standard. Realizations: (a) INSTALL SPEC WELL-FORMEDNESS — withhold or reshape an install until its specification passes tests: the outcome must be single and tightly bounded ('will this give us ONLY what we want?') so it cannot overshoot and rival parts have nothing to veto; installation is gated on no internal part objecting, each objector's positive function folded into the rebuilt design to prevent relapse-by-sabotage; and the target must be an active, emittable behavior at all (the dead-man test) before measurement begins; (b) PROCEDURE-FIDELITY ENACTMENT-TEST — a trained third party reads the description and physically enacts it, and ANY mistake, added step, omission, or clarifying question counts as proof the description is defective, paired with exhaustive-branch scripting (pre-specify a response to every alternative response) so the procedure transfers without the author present. Both change the operator's design and the document's completeness, not a listener state.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for procedure-well-formedness-QA when the writer's question is 'is the thing I authored correct and transferable before I run it?' — a validity test on the OPERATOR'S artifact (the install spec or the written procedure), enacting nothing on the subject. Tells: spec bounded/no-objector/dead-man test (a); third-party enactment failure counts against the text plus exhaustive-branch scripting (b). Distinct from intervention-gating (which branches whether to proceed on a subject-precondition, not whether the artifact is well-formed), from operator-training-via-monitor (which trains the operator's live delivery, not the document), and from subject-facing consent bounds.


**Realizations** (1): `procedure-fidelity-enactment-test`


**See also.** `experiential-consent-trial` — two gates that both constrain the operator before anything is installed, at different stages: one tests whether the authored procedure is correct and transferable, the other tests whether the subject actually likes the experience and can return abort. A reader auditing a script's governance layer wants both and needs the artifact-versus-lived-trial distinction.; `operator-training-via-monitor` — the two operator-facing quality moves, and each already names the other as its nearest boundary. One tests the authored artifact before it runs, the other corrects the operator's live delivery through a stand-in or observer. Reading both is how you place any given practitioner-side move.


### referent-pre-alignment

*risk: low*

Before any working phase, the operator makes the target/referent shared and graspable so later instructions attach to the intended meaning on both sides -- closing the gap where the subject would silently substitute his own definition or fail to grasp an abstract target. Realizations: (a) SHARED-VOCABULARY alignment — operator and subject openly review and reconcile their concepts and definitions of the target states, naming both agreements and divergences aloud, building a common referential map so downstream cues do not land on mismatched referents; (b) EXPERIENTIAL-REFERENT ANCHORING — replace a vague, un-actionable instruction ('relax your mind') with a concrete already-owned experiential referent (the blank instant before sleep) and ask the subject to REPRODUCE that known state on suggestion, so cooperation rises because the subject knows exactly what state to aim for. The shared lever is establishing a common/known referent for the target before instructions depend on it (gates nothing, sets a shared-definition variable the later moves rely on).


**When to reach for this.** Reach for referent-pre-alignment when the writer must ensure the subject and operator mean the SAME thing by the target before instructions depend on it -- sets a shared-definition/known-referent variable, gating nothing and screening no one. Tells: reconcile concept definitions aloud, naming divergences (a); anchor an abstract target to a retrievable prior experience the subject is told to reproduce (b). Distinct from suitability screening (nothing is gated), from rapport small-talk or theory exposition (this reconciles referents, not fills time or asserts a worldview), and from a description-only note (the subject is told to reproduce the state, a move, not merely informed it exists).


**Realizations** (1): `pre-sleep-referent-anchoring`


**See also.** `own-language-echo-reframe-durability` — both are pre-work language moves that align the subject's terms with the operator's before a payload depends on them: one reconciles what the target state means, the other harvests the subject's own phrasing and reuses it for the new behaviour. Genuinely useful as a pair; the difference is aligning a referent versus preventing a later polarity flip.


### semantic-exit-cue-hygiene

*risk: low*

A negative-space discipline over the operator's own phrasing — withhold the class of lines that smuggle a pain, doubt, or wakefulness presupposition ('That hurt, didn't it?'), because in deep state the subject will not spontaneously emerge but a presupposition he must reject forces him to snap out to reject it, forfeiting installed anesthesia. The move is defined by omission: a class of contraindicated phrasings, not a line to add; the corollary is that wrong semantics is itself a wake-up cue.


**When to reach for this.** Consists of NOT saying a class of things and adds nothing — distinct from a comfort check (which adds an inquiry) and from anti-stuck-filter (which ADDS an escape-hatch caveat line); other safety moves add something, this one withholds.


### suggestion-field-hygiene

*risk: low*

Because a deep subject hears and registers everything said in the room as an active suggestion, the operator manages the whole acoustic/information field — issuing operational rules to surrounding staff, training them by having them serve as subjects, silencing untrained guests — so no stray fear or doubt voiced in earshot can act as a counter-suggestion and collapse the accumulated state. The room, not just the operator, sustains the state.


**When to reach for this.** An environmental-control directive aimed at BYSTANDERS to protect an achieved state — not reassurance addressed to the subject, not a pre-session listening-context requirement on the subject (context-gate), and a state-protection move, not a state-production one.


**See also.** `disconfirmation-suppression` — both protect an already-running state by managing what the subject can hear rather than by producing the state. One is standing environmental hygiene aimed at bystanders; the other is a discrete instruction that blocks one present fact from reaching the subject. Read as the ambient and the acute form of the same guard.


### target-selection

*risk: low*

Design-time selection and operationalization of WHICH behavior/target the intervention will aim at, decided before anything is done to the subject; the payoff is the operator's target list, not any subject state. The variants are the selection criteria a writer chooses among: (a) FORWARD LEVERAGE — privilege behavioral cusps whose change unlocks disproportionate downstream contingency space, so one trained behavior cascades into untrained learning; (b) STANDING-CONTINGENCY MAINTAINABILITY — keep only targets the post-instruction environment will already catch and reinforce (and reject age-/community-atypical targets that suppress natural reinforcement), shifting the maintenance burden off the operator; (c) PRODUCING-BEHAVIOR VALIDITY — refuse to hang the contingency on an outcome or mere correlate; decompose the stated result into the definable behaviors that produce it and place the contingency there (named failure: contingency-on-the-product programs fail); (d) GOAL-PROXIMAL DIMENSION — operationalize the vague goal as one specific measurable dimension (rate, duration, latency, magnitude, topography) moved in a named direction, chosen by which dimension most directly advances the actual goal (calories, not bites); (e) TRAIT-TO-BEHAVIOR DECOMPOSITION — meet every intrinsic-trait label ('lazy','fearful') with 'what does X DO?' to dissolve the internal-cause attribution into a countable, environment-linked, targetable behavior; (f) STRENGTHS-FIRST BALANCE — force a fixed-count strengths inventory ahead of an equal-count deficit list at intake so the target pool tilts toward building, not only suppressing.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for target-selection when the writer's question is 'what should the intervention aim at?' — a design-time filter/operationalization on the operator's target list, nothing enacted on the subject. Pick the criterion by the sub-question: downstream leverage (a), will-it-last (b), causal validity (c), which measurable dimension (d), how to make a vague trait targetable (e), or is the pool strengths-balanced (f). Distinct from intervention-gating (which decides whether/which-arm to proceed on an already-chosen target) and from preparatory-diagnostic-read (which reads the subject to build the map this move selects over).


**Realizations** (5): `goal-proximal-dimension-selection`, `producing-behavior-validity-gate`, `standing-contingency-target-filter`, `strengths-first-elicitation-frame`, `trait-to-behavior-decomposition`


**See also.** `beneficiary-target-filter` — both are design-time filters on the target list before anything is enacted, but one supplies selection criteria and the other an admissibility test keyed to whose benefit the change serves. Read together when deciding what an intervention should aim at.; `design-time-reconnaissance` — adjacent design-time operator moves that are easy to conflate, and each discriminator already names the other: one filters and operationalizes which target to aim at, the other exhaustively enumerates the space the plan must survive. They also interlock, since the enumeration supplies the environment map the selection criteria test against. Filtering is not enumerating, so no merge.; `peer-authored-target-selection` — both answer which targets the intervention should aim at, and the second is a direct authorship variant of the first: peers write the list with no self-veto instead of the operator applying design-time selection criteria. A reader on either should know about the other.; `preparatory-target-definition` — adjacent operator-side design moves that are easy to conflate. One decides which behavior the intervention should aim at, using selection criteria; the other is the hand-off that fixes the agreed operational definition and the watch-list before observation begins. Choosing a target and pinning down how it will be recorded are consecutive steps, and each entry's boundary is clearer next to the other.


### venue-as-screening-filter

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Rather than screening people, the operator screens locations, then lets the location do the screening: a physical choke-point through which a desired population must pass in an already-qualified state — arriving alone, in transit, newly displaced, at a loose hour — is selected, and the operator simply waits there. Because everyone at that spot already meets the criteria the operator would otherwise have to test for, no qualifying questions are asked and no selection is visible. First contact can then be minimal and warm, and it reads as spontaneous kindness from a stranger rather than as solicitation, because from inside the encounter there is no evidence that the encounter was arranged. The move happens entirely before any contact exists, which is what makes it invisible to the person being selected and unavailable to any consent process running downstream of contact.


**When to reach for this.** Selection happens on LOCATION, before any contact and before any subject exists — the operator authors no message and speaks to no one; the choke-point's own traffic supplies a population already meeting the criteria. Distinct from paratext-precontracting and paratext-buyer-priming, where the pre-contact work is operator-AUTHORED copy acting on a reader who already sought the product out. Distinct from filter-shaping-pre-qualification, which shapes each suggestion to pass a filter belonging to a subject already present. Distinct from covert-frame-entry, which presupposes contact and misrepresents what is happening; here nothing has yet been said, which is why no downstream consent process can reach it.


## carrier-binding  (17)

The delivery vehicle or medium itself is load-bearing — whole-artifact form (song, loop, prosodic rail, braid), consumption medium as substrate (reading act, gait, breath), cover-frame smuggling — remove the form and the payload is gone.

**Scope.** The medium, not the proposition (-> encoding) and not a single conditioned cue (-> triggers).


### aesthetic-cover-payload-delivery

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The densest, most explicit content of the script is delivered inside a DISTINCT aesthetic object (a sung Auld Lang Syne parody asserting total cognitive replacement) that is bracketed by the operator complimenting the singer, so the passage parses as an entertainment interlude. Because the aggressive payload arrives as a song it is processed aesthetically rather than evaluatively — heard, enjoyed, and not argued with. The melody doubles as a second function: it is a hypnosis-coded tune whose recognition key-collides every New Year's Eve, installing an annual re-trigger that stacks with a separate countdown cue welded to the same external calendar event.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a decorative musical break by the payload density riding under the aesthetic cover plus the melody-collision annual cue. Separates from delivery-form-as-induction-envelope by using a DISTINCT aesthetic object (a song embedded in the script) as the cover rather than the script's own plain prose form.


**See also.** `carrier-frame-payload-smuggling` — same concealment logic at different scales: a distinct embedded aesthetic object carrying the densest content versus the script's own advertised frame carrying it across the whole runtime. A reader classifying a cover-delivery passage needs both to pick the right grain.; `covert-payload-piggyback` — both smuggle a dense payload past evaluation by riding a carrier the listener has already accepted, which makes the contrast instructive. One uses a distinct aesthetic object embedded in the script so the passage parses as an interlude; the other threads the payload through a low-resistance move already consented to, where stripping the payload leaves an ordinary version of that move. Cover-object versus cover-procedure is the useful distinction.; `cultural-ritual-slot-hijack` — these co-occur and reinforce: an embedded aesthetic object carries dense payload while the surrounding calendar ritual supplies the annual slot the melody collides with. A reader working either move should see how the recognition cue and the borrowed ritual compound into a yearly re-trigger. Distinct mechanisms — one is an aesthetic cover for payload density, the other a substitution into a slot the listener already practices.


### autonomic-act-rekeying

*risk: medium*

The operator discards the ordinary name for an autonomic act (exhale/inhale) and installs a higher-register replacement (expire/inspire), loading the new word with its other dictionary senses — expire as 'a little sacrificial death', inspire as 'breath of life / I am penetrating you through the air' — sealed with a tiny consent-ratification beat ('isn't that beautiful?'). Every subsequent breath is now taggable by the operator with the imported connotations, so the listener's baseline involuntary metabolism is converted into a low-grade continuous compliance signal that runs without any further operator action.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from breath pacing, which paces breath for relaxation and does no renaming — this does zero pacing and instead re-keys the act's meaning to import non-trivial connotations. Separates from directional-cue-reversal (redefines a directional cue to disrupt orientation) — here the redefinition weaponizes an autonomic function into a persistent compliance channel, not a tracking device. Tell: semantic re-keying of an involuntary act carrying death/penetration connotations into the body. Separates from term-redefinition-smuggle (a one-time obligation install; this binds the new meaning to an ongoing bodily carrier).


**See also.** `autonomic-process-hijack` — both convert breathing into a compliance channel, but by different levers: one re-keys the NAME of the act to import connotations, the other declares the inhaled substance to be the operator so breathing is dosing. A writer choosing an autonomic carrier benefits from seeing both exploits of the same involuntary function.; `respiration-coupled-substitution-engine` — both convert involuntary breathing into a compliance channel, and they compose. One re-keys the act's name to import connotations so every breath is taggable; the other assigns opposing jobs to inhale and exhale so each cycle counts as two compliances. A reader who identifies one should check for the other in the same passage.; `volitional-breath-retirement` — both convert the same carrier, ongoing breath, into a standing compliance channel, and a reader looking at a breath passage must pick between them. One re-keys the act's name to import loaded connotations onto every subsequent cycle; the other retires volition over a breath just engaged so it runs unattended as banked proof. Same substrate, different lever, so no merge.


### carrier-frame-payload-smuggling

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A genuine, advertised surface frame (relaxation, a benign theme) is made the functioning carrier for an unrequested payload: every payload move is presented as a deeper instance of the advertised frame, so a listener who came only for the surface benefit receives it AND a trigger / replay compulsion they never requested. Overt payload vocabulary (submit to, control) is withheld until well past the point a resistant listener would have exited (first explicit control-language at L82), so the frame does double duty as delivery vehicle and as gatekeeper against early refusal.


**When to reach for this.** Not any single obedience/trigger move riding inside the script; the tell is the whole-artifact RELATIONSHIP in which the advertised, genuinely-delivered frame is the carrier for the payload, evidenced by the late first appearance of explicit payload language. Distinct from arc-shape-engineering (which is about ordering/scope of payloads) — here the frame is the concealment vehicle, not a contour property.


**See also.** `aesthetic-cover-payload-delivery` — same concealment logic at different scales: a distinct embedded aesthetic object carrying the densest content versus the script's own advertised frame carrying it across the whole runtime. A reader classifying a cover-delivery passage needs both to pick the right grain.; `care-framed-install-smuggling` — same concealment lever, different surface: a genuinely-delivered advertised frame carrying an unrequested payload, versus a genuinely-caring safety and aftercare surface doing install and propagation work. A reader identifying a benign carrier should see both surfaces.; `off-theme-suggestion-piggyback` — both exploit a session the listener joined for a stated reason to deliver something else, differing in whether the advertised frame is the carrier throughout or the off-theme content is bolted on after the theme completes. A reader assessing scope-of-consent on a whole artifact should see both shapes.; `persistent-metaphor-spine` — a sustained single image is the most common vehicle for a benign advertised frame that carries an unrequested payload. Reading the neutral persistence move next to the concealment move shows how the same whole-artifact spine turns from structural economy into a gatekeeper against early refusal.; `retroactive-subject-disclosure` — two whole-arc concealment topologies distinguished by what is withheld: overt payload vocabulary delayed inside an honestly-delivered frame, versus the script's own declared subject withheld until commitment is manufactured. Close enough to be confused, distinct enough to matter.; `scope-expansion-past-advertised-frame` — both concern the relationship between what a session advertises and what it delivers, and the pair reads as the two halves of that problem. One makes the advertised surface frame the genuine carrier for an unrequested payload, so the frame both delivers and gatekeeps against early exit. The other starts inside an accepted frame and then bends the generalization past the advertised domain into concrete operator-benefit territory the listener did not sign up for. Concealment within the frame versus expansion beyond it.; `withheld-frame-reveal` — both run a payload under an accepted benign frame, but one never uncovers it (the frame stays a genuine surface delivering the payload as a deeper instance of itself) while the other cashes the accepted cover, either by late disclosure or by unmasking the vehicle to license a payload it never covered.


### carrier-is-cargo-fusion

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The object that carries post-session persistence is made identical to the surface behavioral ask, so there is no separable "install your trigger" step the listener could refuse without also refusing the behavior itself. In the exemplar, perfume is simultaneously a ratchet-inventory item the listener acquires AND the always-on carrier vector for persistence (a scent cue firing every breath); maintenance additionally off-loads onto other ambient always-on channels ("hello" per contact, inner voice, mirror checks). The lever is fusing the reinforcement carrier into the behavioral cargo so declining the persistence and declining the surface behavior become the same act.


**When to reach for this.** Distinct from ordinary post-hypnotic reminder stacking (independent cues) and from arousal-cue conditioning (a discrete cue→response install): the tell is that at least one reinforcement carrier is FUSED into a behavioral payload item so there is no refusable standalone install step. Not a magnitude/count move (more channels) but a topology fusion (carrier = cargo).


**See also.** `pulse-multiplexed-command-carrier` — both are topology moves that remove a separable refusal point: several payloads yoked to one recurring stimulus, versus the persistence carrier fused into the behaviour being asked for. Different fusions, same design goal of leaving no standalone thing to decline.; `self-perpetuating-object-ritual-loop` — both engineer post-session persistence around an acquired object and can look identical on the surface. One chains cue, purchase, ritual and re-listening into a self-sustaining loop whose payload is perpetuation; the other fuses the reinforcement carrier into the behavioral ask so there is no separable install step to refuse. Loop shape versus topology fusion.; `ubiquity-cued-covert-ratchet` — these frequently co-occur on the same always-present social cue and the same fixed-order commitment inventory, so they read as one move on first pass. One turns on fusing the reinforcement carrier into the behavioral payload so no refusable install step exists; the other turns on the cue never being named as a trigger plus a one-way self-extending ladder. Separable levers that often ride together.


### commercial-ask-in-compliance-syntax

*risk: medium*

Slots a real-world commercial instruction (a price figure + buy command) into the exact syntactic and metrical envelope used elsewhere for depth-commands — stacking price, compliance command, petition phrase, and a DESCEND cue into a single rhymed quatrain — so complying with the PURCHASE is structurally identical to complying with descent and reads as continuation of the trance rather than an interrupting ad. Outsourcing the choice to the 'subconscious' ('your subconscious does the picking') supplies a ready-made post-hoc rationalization, binding the commercial ask to the same compliance-and-pleasure loop as trigger-firing and deepening.


**When to reach for this.** A genuine out-of-session commercial ask is camouflaged by riding the trance's own syntax/meter so it scans as continuation. Distinct from overt ad copy, which breaks the frame; from reward-conditioning, which associates reward with the surrendered state rather than with a purchase; and from behavioral bridges into waking life, which carry an act out of session but not via metrical camouflage into the depth-command slot.


**See also.** `petition-phrase-toll-gate` — both smuggle a non-trance ask into the depth-delivery slot so complying with it scans as continuing to descend, one with a purchase instruction and the other with a required petition phrase; they even share the metrical envelope trick. Strong practical adjacency.; `self-sealing-platform-compulsion` — both bind a real commercial ask to the conditioning rather than breaking frame for it; one camouflages the ask in the depth-command syntax, the other removes the neutral exit by pre-handling the already-complied case. Distinct levers, same problem space, and a reader assessing a commercial ask should see both.


### delivery-form-as-induction-envelope

*risk: medium · bounded*

The DELIVERY FORM of the script's own linguistic surface functions as the induction envelope inside which discrete techniques operate. It appears in three surface realizations of one genus: a single unbroken comma-spliced sentence-blob with no full stops or paragraph breaks (denying the listener any natural point to surface, evaluate, and disagree until the wakener); a continuous prose-poem in which punctuation softens and garbled sub-lexical passages cluster at trance-deepest points (the shape enacts the content, offering no off-ramp for critical processing to re-engage); and a pervasive doubled-phrase cadence that occupies working memory tracking small variations so the load-bearing payload rides inside the accepted weight of the refrain, with the un-doubled exit exploited as a state-change signal. In every case the form removes exit ramps and carries the payload, and a text pipeline would mis-parse the form as noise.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a discrete deepener by being a property of the whole-file surface form (punctuation, cadence, formatting) rather than any single block. Separates from external-artifact-coupling by binding the script's OWN linguistic form, not an external listener-supplied medium. Separates from aesthetic-cover-payload-delivery by having no distinct aesthetic object (song) — the plain prose form is itself the carrier.


**See also.** `covert-diegetic-install-shell` — two whole-file architectures that remove the surface there is to resist: the linguistic form itself denying exit ramps, versus an outer envelope wrapping an inner story where the operator shifts from directing to narrating. Both are file-level, and a reader analyzing one should rule out the other.; `emergence-negative-space` — genuine kinship: both are whole-text negative-space properties rather than excerptable moves, and both work by removing exit ramps - one by denying evaluation points inside the surface form, the other by omitting the return ramp at the arc level. A reader assessing one whole-form property should check for the other, since scripts often carry both.; `flat-surface-concealing-semantic-arc` — both are whole-artifact surface-form properties rather than discrete moves, and a text pipeline mis-reads both. One removes the punctuation and cadence off-ramps where evaluation could re-engage; the other keeps the surface uniform so the listener cannot locate their position on a steep semantic gradient.; `form-content-fusion-topology` — both are whole-artifact form properties rather than discrete moves, and the boundary is fine: form used as an envelope with no exit ramps versus form that performs the very mechanism it describes. Without the cross-reference the two collapse in practice.; `prosodic-pacing-rail` — both make the whole-file linguistic surface the carrier rather than any line, and the surface features overlap enough to be confusable; the split is removal of exit ramps versus predictive-reward pacing and disciplined emphasis. Link, do not merge.; `reading-act-as-induction-substrate` — genuine near-neighbors: both make the delivery surface itself the induction rather than any discrete block. The boundary a reader needs is that one binds the script's own linguistic form (punctuation, cadence, unbroken syntax) and would survive being read aloud, while the other is bound to the on-screen medium and narrates the reader's own scanning, so it cannot transfer to audio without rewriting.


### exercise-masked-cadence-induction

*risk: medium*

Metronomic induction repetition is attached to gym-equipment imagery ("Legs go up / And down" looped, "Simple motions" repeated dozens of times) and the script names its own function ("It turns my brain off"), delivering trance via paced repetition without a formal induction frame. If the listener is actually exercising, the physical motion synchronizes with the verbal cadence, making the claim self-fulfilling and turning the gym itself into a portable, re-usable induction trigger for the brain-off state.


**When to reach for this.** Unlike kinesthetic entrainment, which uses an in-session physiological rhythm purely for absorption, here the cadence is hidden inside real gym motion so exercise itself becomes a portable brain-off trigger. Not ordinary repetition-for-emphasis: the machine-motion mask plus explicit self-naming is the tell, and it weakens to plain repetition on a sedentary listener who isn't rhythm-locked.


**See also.** `breath-pacing-entrainment` — close family: both yoke settling or depth to a rhythm the listener already runs rather than to operator-requested effort, and both weaken when the listener is not rhythm-locked. One hides metronomic cadence inside real exercise motion so the activity becomes a portable trigger; the other uses breath in audio or verse meter in silent text as the pacing substrate.; `proprioceptive-gait-metronome` — both hang the maintaining cadence on the listener's own repetitive body motion so the trigger becomes portable and works without the operator present, and both note the whole thing weakens if the listener is not actually moving. They differ in the carrying activity and in payload: one rides walking cadence with a clock and wind-up-doll image, the other hides the cadence inside gym motion and names its own function. Same lever, different vehicle, so link.


### exposure-dose-object-not-session

*risk: medium · bounded · kind: container*

An artifact-kind property: the piece is a stim/loop, not a bounded session. It has no rapport-induction-deepening-install-awaken trajectory, no marked entry or exit, and no operator persona giving instructions — it opens mid-state and loops back mid-state. The structural functions other scripts spread across a session are folded into the texture of the loop (saturation substitutes for induction, a brain-tattoo motif for the awakener-blocker, the coda for a deepener). The conditioning model is exposure-DOSE (run in the background on repeat) rather than session-EVENT, which shifts weight onto any external-trigger install and makes session-shaped taxonomy categories a poor fit.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a defective or incomplete session because the absence of entry/exit is DELIBERATE — the induction/deepener/awakener functions are present but folded into the loop texture, and success is dose-over-time not a bounded arc. The tell is 'no defined start or finish, designed to run on repeat', a change in the KIND of object, not a missing part.


**See also.** `drop-in-payload-module` — both are artifact-kind observations about a file with no induction or emergence, and the practical question is which one you are looking at: a payload cartridge expecting a host session, or a loop whose session functions are folded into its texture. A reader classifying an entry-less file needs the pair.; `induction-less-work-as-onramp` — adjacent deletions of session structure: one removes the induction boundary while keeping a collapsed linear arc, the other changes the kind of object entirely to a dose-over-time loop with no marked entry or exit.; `operator-absent-self-renewal-loop` — both describe conditioning by repeated exposure rather than a bounded session, and they frequently co-occur: one is the artifact form built for looping, the other is the installed urge to keep replaying it.


### external-artifact-coupling

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

The session is structurally built around the listener operating an EXTERNAL, listener-supplied artifact during trance — viewing their own curated arousal images and touching themselves — and that external task is load-bearing for the core conditioning to land. Remove the images and roughly 70 percent of the mechanisms lose their referent (nothing to fractionate against, no autonomous behavior to attribute, no variable to amplify). The operator deliberately conditions against material she has never seen, so the conditioning generalizes across the listener's entire personal erotic library by design: the listener-supplied artifact is the conditioned-stimulus side of every installed association.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from background scenery or optional visualization (which are removable) by the artifact being load-bearing — without it the core mechanisms have no referent. Separates from delivery-form-as-induction-envelope by binding an EXTERNAL listener-supplied medium rather than the script's own linguistic form. Distinct from arousal-cue conditioning: this is the artifact-coupling DESIGN structure of the whole session, not merely a specification of which conditioned stimulus that conditioning should use.


### hostile-environment-channel-conversion

*risk: low*

Introduces a persistent second in-fiction audible speaker (e.g. a lecturer) as continuous background dialogue, then re-reads that background stream as a confusion source, IQ-drain rhythm, and post-hypnotic trigger surface. The listener is boxed by the scene premise — they cannot tune the second voice out (they are 'in class') and cannot attend to it without each word being reassigned as a trance reinforcer — so the external environment becomes an operator-controlled beat generator with no neutral place for attention to rest.


**When to reach for this.** Unlike environmental dissociation, which fades environmental anchors OUT to dissociate from the surroundings, this keeps the environmental voice IN and weaponizes it as a continuous trance-work channel. And it is more than classroom flavor: it requires a literal audible second channel — remove the lecturer voice and the move collapses; a silent imagined classroom would not carry it.


**See also.** `concurrent-dual-stream-delivery` — both run a second audible stream alongside the primary one. The distinguishing question is what the second stream does: carry a concealed payload beneath a decoy, or box in attention so it can be reassigned. A reader designing a two-channel piece needs to see the fork.; `environmental-dissociation` — sibling that keeps the environmental voice IN and weaponizes it; `protective-role-conscription` — both use an in-fiction scene role to relocate where the listener stands relative to the hypnotic content — one boxes attention onto an unavoidable second audible voice, the other dresses the listener as a non-participant. They occupy the same design slot as scene-premise wrappers, so a builder choosing a fictional wrapper wants both. Different levers: an audible second channel versus a costume of non-participation.


### multi-channel-braiding

*risk: medium*

An authored delivery architecture that interleaves two or more distinct channels BELOW the natural unit boundary (sentence / line / turn / modality) so the listener cannot attend to one without absorbing the others — the interleave itself is the carrier, and the resistance budget that would fire on the payload stream is spent on the innocuous stream instead. Realized forms: (a) sentence-level braiding of multiple CONTENT THREADS (e.g. identity claim + arousal cue + IQ-loss imagery woven per-sentence) so any single later cue re-fires the whole bundle; (b) two VOICE REGISTERS from one performer (drifting hypnotic-paced captive narration vs short command-paced captor lines) alternated without warning so induction-pace softens the listener before each command jab; (c) a MODALITY conceit that makes the audio channel's own limitation the subject, requiring the listener to supply the missing somatic channel by simulation; (d) an ABAB fusion braid where the seam is the line-break inside a quatrain rather than a sentence: A-lines carry environmental/relaxation descent and B-lines carry interior surrender/ownership, yoked in one metric unit so the ownership content is never marked as a separate segment (tell: consistent A-environmental / B-relational split across consecutive quatrains). The reusable lever is simultaneous cross-channel interleaving that removes the listener's ability to isolate and evaluate one stream; distinct from a single-stream texture envelope, which binds only one stream's contour.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for this when TWO OR MORE streams must run simultaneously and be interleaved below the natural unit boundary (sentence / line / turn / modality) so no single stream can be isolated and evaluated — whether the streams are content threads, voice registers, sensory modalities, or an environmental/relational A-B split braided at the line-break. The property is SIMULTANEOUS multi-stream interleave, not a declared loop between two named variables. Choose a single-stream form-carrier instead (prosodic-pacing-rail for a metrical/emphasis rail over ONE stream; delivery-form-as-induction-envelope for whole-file punctuation/syntax that removes exit ramps) when the payload rides on one stream's envelope rather than being hidden by cross-stream interleave. Choose carrier-frame-payload-smuggling when concealment is by an advertised whole-artifact FRAME rather than by braiding parallel streams.


**Realizations** (1): `abab-fusion-braid`


**See also.** `convergent-multichannel-encoding` — genuine near neighbours on the same axis: several streams running at once so no single one can be isolated. They split on what the streams carry — different content interleaved below the unit boundary versus one identical payload duplicated across redundant covert forms. Worth reading together to pick the right one.; `pulse-multiplexed-command-carrier` — both defeat selective resistance by bundling, and the distinction is worth stating: one loads several payloads onto a single recurring stimulus so refusing one costs all, the other interleaves separate streams below the sentence or line so none can be isolated. Shared carrier versus shared texture is a real fork a writer must choose between.


### prosodic-pacing-rail

*risk: low*

The delivery form itself is engineered as a continuous low-amplitude carrier that normalizes every other mechanism and manages where emphasis lands. Realized forms: a whole-script rhymed-couplet metronome in regular meter that the listener's prediction system locks onto — so any deviation reads as emphasis without the operator raising her voice, per-line evaluation bandwidth drops, and trigger words slide past as part of the rhyme scheme; a variant whose lever is the rhyme's continuous predictive SUCCESS (each second line completes a rhyme, delivering a small predictive payoff that pins attention forward and dulls critical processing so the embedded suggestion rides in on the reward of correct prediction, often opened by a "Twinkle, twinkle" nursery-cadence regression trigger); and a disciplined restriction of ALL-CAPS (hence vocal emphasis) to a few action/identity lemmas as fixed-load state anchors, with the conventional state-word caps pointedly absent so each emphasized utterance carries the same load every time and a performer cannot dilute an anchor. The lever is binding the prosodic/typographic medium to the payload so form does delivery work content cannot.


**When to reach for this.** Cited to the cumulative whole-form property (remove any single couplet or any single capitalized instance and the rail/discipline survives; remove the form and the script is gutted), never to one line. The tell is that the form is load-bearing and disciplined — including the prediction-reward angle, where continuous predictive success is used as a criticality-suppressant carrier wave. Distinct from decorative rhyme or incidental emphasis; from conditioning a discrete response to a rhythmic cue, which installs a trigger rather than suppressing content-scrutiny; from mantra saturation, which is repetition-for-absorption rather than prediction-payoff; and from energy-contour engineering, which manages charge/depth over the arc — this binds the prosodic MEDIUM to emphasis and pacing.


**See also.** `breath-pacing-entrainment` — both make verse form load-bearing, and they overlap on the same text-only surface: one uses metre and rhyme to suppress per-line scrutiny, the other uses it as a tempo substrate that imports genuine settling. The overlap is close enough that a reader will need the distinction.; `delivery-form-as-induction-envelope` — both make the whole-file linguistic surface the carrier rather than any line, and the surface features overlap enough to be confusable; the split is removal of exit ramps versus predictive-reward pacing and disciplined emphasis. Link, do not merge.; `proprioceptive-gait-metronome` — both are whole-form carriers rather than passage-local moves, sustaining the state without requiring per-line attention. The useful contrast is where the rhythm lives: the listener's own body motion in one, the engineered prosody of the delivery in the other, which is exactly the operator-independence question a reader is deciding.; `repeating-frame-carrier` — both make the delivery form itself do work content cannot, by setting a predictable pattern the listener's prediction system locks onto and then riding material in under it. Worth reading together to see the split: a repeating frame whose fixed slot camouflages rotating novel payloads, versus a continuous prosodic or typographic rail that manages emphasis and lowers per-line scrutiny throughout.; `song-architecture-delivery-vehicle` — both make the artifact's form, not its content, do the delivery work, and both are cited to the whole piece rather than any line. One substitutes a cyclical musical architecture for the linear arc; the other binds meter, rhyme-prediction, and emphasis discipline as a continuous carrier. Useful as the two scales of form-as-vehicle.


### reading-act-as-induction-substrate

*risk: low*

In a natively written / on-screen medium, the involuntary act of reading itself is weaponized as the induction. The text reflexively narrates the reader's own eye-movement and line-scanning as it happens ('each line that moves through your field of vision', 'come closer to the screen'), makes words 'grow in size' while peripheral vision fades so the text becomes 'all that you see', and pre-binds resistance so noticing the trance produces more trance. Because continuing to read IS the compliance, there is no discrete task to refuse and no falsifiable failure point; the reader's normal scanning behavior is redefined as the trance behavior, capturing a tunnel of attention with no external induction equipment (voice, music, breath).


**When to reach for this.** Distinct from simple fixation on an external object and from fading the environment out of awareness — both of which it recruits but exceeds — by being a property of the DELIVERY MEDIUM: the reading-act is load-bearing and would not transfer to audio without rewriting ('come closer to the screen' is nonsense in audio). Carrier-medium-bound, not a listener-internal magnitude move.


**See also.** `attention-as-evidence-loop` — the reading-act technique instantiates the continued-attention evidence loop inside a written medium, where scanning the page is itself the accumulating proof. Distinct because its defining property is medium-binding, but readers will land between the two.; `delivery-form-as-induction-envelope` — genuine near-neighbors: both make the delivery surface itself the induction rather than any discrete block. The boundary a reader needs is that one binds the script's own linguistic form (punctuation, cadence, unbroken syntax) and would survive being read aloud, while the other is bound to the on-screen medium and narrates the reader's own scanning, so it cannot transfer to audio without rewriting.; `fixation-covert-or-undeliverable-onset` — both remove the recognize-and-refuse juncture at induction: one delivers fixation without any recognized focus command, the other makes the involuntary act of reading the compliance so there is no discrete task to decline. The second explicitly recruits and exceeds ordinary fixation, so the link is a real containment relationship rather than a coincidence.; `proprioceptive-gait-metronome` — genuine structural siblings: both recruit an act the listener is already performing involuntarily (scanning lines of text; walking cadence) as the carrier that induces or sustains the state, so no discrete task exists to refuse and no operator presence is needed. They differ in which carrier and whether the medium is written or portable-somatic, which is exactly the choice a reader of either is making.


### response-model-affect-tag

*risk: low*

A non-content, position-fixed affect tag ("Oh fuck.") is fired repeatedly as a standalone line — ~25 times, almost always immediately after a control-admission or depravity-claim — that never advances content and instead certifies that the prior line produced an involuntary response in the narrator. Like a laugh track, it models the reaction the subject is supposed to have and tells them that line landed and they should be reacting too; its absence would let the admissions read as flat statements. The lever is a presence/affect certification that cues the subject's own affective uptake by modeling an involuntary response, carrying no propositional content of its own.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is the non-content, position-fixed placement (always after an admission) functioning as a response-model / affect certification, like a laugh track. Separates from self-validating-language (which carries propositional content naming the felt truth of a suggestion as proof) — here the tag is contentless and models expected affect rather than validating a stated suggestion; separates from pacing-and-leading (which reflects the subject's actual current experience, not a modeled narrator reaction).


### sensation-as-cognitive-edit-channel

*risk: medium · bounded*

Establishes a real or felt bodily event as the delivery channel that grounds an abstract cognitive claim, so the cognitive edit rides on a physical event the listener cannot argue with. The hinge is an asserted equivalence or an undeniable real stimulus: an explicit body=mind equation ('when it touches your body, it touches your mind') so felt strokes become evidence that forgetting/dumbing are also happening; a real audible mic-breath ('there goes another thought') counted as a discrete thought-loss event; or an autonomic function (breathing in 'demonic magic') recast as an unstoppable self-administered deepening loop. In each case a genuine physical event converts a free-floating cognitive claim into felt proof; remove the equation-line or real stimulus and the suggestions are left ungrounded.


**When to reach for this.** Unlike somatic mirroring, which reinterprets a spontaneously-present sensation as theme evidence, here a real event is licensed as the CHANNEL for a separate cognitive edit — the sensation is a vehicle, not the object reinterpreted. No sensation is hallucinated — the grounding event is real. And unlike enacted embodied proof, the listener is not commanded to perform the action (being-touched is passive/autonomic); the lever is asserted body-to-mind licensing, not proprioceptive rehearsal.


**See also.** `catalepsy-to-affect-transfer` — both lend a body event's undeniability to an abstract claim the listener never tested, differing in whether the proof is a demonstrated motor incapacity transferred afterward or a real stimulus licensed as the delivery channel. Easy to conflate without the cross-reference.; `enacted-embodied-proof` — both ground an abstract cognitive claim in real bodily evidence, but one commands the listener to perform the action so proprioception rehearses the rule while the other rides a passive or autonomic event asserted as a body-to-mind channel.


### song-architecture-delivery-vehicle

*risk: low*

A whole-artifact delivery-vehicle property in which the conditioning payload is carried by a musical/song architecture rather than a linear induction-to-trance-to-wake arc: layered tiers (minimal repeating mantra hooks, a rhyme-locked sung chorus, and a spoken 'spacy recital' narrative) each operate at a different cognitive depth, and the piece is built for exposure-over-repetition (designed to be replayed) with no wake or emergence. A familiar pop sample in the carrier register lowers analytic guard by delivering the content as passively-consumed entertainment. The reusable lever is the artifact FORM (music-first, cyclical, replay-looped) as the conditioning substrate.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from the induction-less onramp candidate (that deletes the induction stage but still runs a linear file; this substitutes a cyclical MUSICAL form with no arc at all) and from carrier-medium-binding of a single trigger to a tone (this is whole-artifact song composition, not one binding). The tell is the tiered mantra/chorus/recital structure plus stated replay-loop intent, not any single passage.


**See also.** `cross-artifact-retention-topology` — both are whole-artifact form properties built around repeat exposure rather than a single delivery. One substitutes a cyclical musical form with no arc and explicit replay intent; the other engineers incompleteness so resolution only arrives from a neighboring piece. Useful together when classifying replay-dependent construction.; `prosodic-meter-as-covert-deepener` — genuine chooser pair: both make the artifact's FORM the conditioning carrier rather than any passage. One uses cyclical song architecture with tiered hooks and replay intent; the other uses unbroken metrical verse whose rhyme prediction consumes evaluative bandwidth. Pick by whether the carrier is musical composition or prosody.; `prosodic-pacing-rail` — both make the artifact's form, not its content, do the delivery work, and both are cited to the whole piece rather than any line. One substitutes a cyclical musical architecture for the linear arc; the other binds meter, rhyme-prediction, and emphasis discipline as a continuous carrier. Useful as the two scales of form-as-vehicle.


### words-as-touch-transposition

*risk: medium*

Collapses the auditory channel into the tactile so that hearing the operator's voice IS being touched — the words/voice are asserted to BE a physical sensation on the listener's body (tracing skin, caressing, vibrating between the legs, penetrating), not merely to describe or cause one. Once made, the substitution binds a somatic component to every subsequent utterance: the listener can no longer hear without feeling, the normal evaluate-speech stance is removed, and later commands ride an already-open somatic carrier. Often the felt intensity is made contingent on trance depth, turning 'go deeper' into a chaseable sensory reward.


**When to reach for this.** The distinguishing tell is auditory->haptic synesthesia — the operator's VOICE itself is the sensation's source and every spoken line becomes a stimulus event on the body. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (a manufactured sensation with no voice-equation), from self-touch- reattribution (a REAL self-generated touch re-credited to the operator, no cross-modal claim), and from fictional-substance-agent (a fictional object/drug owns causation, not the voice).


**See also.** `erogenous-field-generalization` — both weaponize the delivery medium so the words themselves become felt sensation, one by equating voice with touch and the other by remapping all sensation as erogenous including the words. They overlap at the point where the script's own delivery becomes the stimulus, and a writer should know which one they are reaching for.


## concealment  (13)

Keeping the operation below the audit threshold — unmonitored registers, decoy frames, reality-test insulation, redundant obfuscation stacks, policy-spec artifacts.

**Scope.** Hiding the install. Rigging the evidence so checking confirms -> self-sealing; laundered consent -> manufactured-consent.


### artifact-as-policy-spec

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A whole-artifact architecture in which the entire file exists to install a meta-rule layer rather than to run a session — functionally a firewall/policy install script wearing trance grammar. Its sections map to firewall-component roles (positive-affect handshake, routing rules, failure-mode enumeration + countermoves, autonomous-subprocess enforcement, self-replication + log-wipe), and pervasive case-enumeration prose ('any X, no matter how Y, regardless of Z') closes the rule's input space against adversarial inputs. The erotic vocabulary is the carrier wrapper around what is functionally a policy document.


**When to reach for this.** The whole file is the meta-layer, not a session containing a meta-move. Distinct from an ordinary single-meta-suggestion enforcement script by the complete firewall-spec shape spanning the whole artifact (handshake / routing / failure-enumeration / enforcement / self-replication) with input-space-closing case enumeration.


**See also.** `drop-in-payload-module` — both are architecture-level reads of an entire file rather than moves inside a session, and they are near-complements: one defines itself by what the file leaves out and hands off, the other by the file being wholly a rule layer. Cross-referencing helps a reader classifying an unusual artifact decide which whole-file shape they are looking at.


### context-lock-staging

*risk: medium · bounded*

The script opens by requiring a public, eyes-open listening context ('somewhere people can see you') and holds that public-visibility frame the entire way through, with no closed-eye branch; a delayed 'that's for a reason' callback retroactively converts the opening logistics into deliberate staging. The lock removes the standard 'this isn't trance, my eyes are open' self-diagnostic disqualifier, gates the whole covert payload on public visibility, and makes trance context-portable — reversing midway would require the listener to admit she'd been set up.


**When to reach for this.** Load-bearing SETUP weaponized toward the payload via context, not protective rhetoric. Distinct from a protective listening-context gate (which restricts the listening context for safety; this stages it for reach). The tell is the delayed 'that's for a reason' payoff revealing the opening as deliberate setup — an ordinary induction preamble does not gate the whole payload on public visibility. Separates from weaponized-safety-framing: there the frame is protective clothing whose semantics carry the payload; here the lever is logistical context/visibility with no safety rhetoric.
