**See also.** `pre-staged-apparatus-relabeled-automatic` — both put load-bearing work into the pre-induction window while the listener is still critical, then cash it later -- one by gating the payload on a required listening context revealed as deliberate staging, the other by having the physical apparatus already arranged so an automaticity claim only has to relabel it. Genuine sibling pair on waking-phase setup as leverage.; `waking-trance-public-disclosure` — these interlock rather than merely resemble each other: one holds a public eyes-open listening context as the setup that gates the payload, the other maintains an eyes-open still-under overlay to drive a public attributable act. Setup and payoff of the same public-visibility design, so a reader arriving at either wants the other.


### deniable-misdelivery

*risk: medium · bounded*

Send the message to its actual intended recipient under the cover of a routing error — the reply-all that 'should have been' a direct message, the note left where it will certainly be read, the remark made 'to someone else' within earshot, the file 'accidentally' attached. The recipient receives the content in full and, crucially, receives it as unguarded truth precisely because it was not meant for them, which lends it more evidential weight than the same words addressed openly. The sender retains a complete retraction path ('that wasn't meant for you, I'm sorry') that costs nothing to exercise and does not undo the reading, so the move is one-way: the payload lands whether or not the alibi is later invoked. Its reach extends to content that could not be said directly at all — accusations, desires, assessments — because the misdelivery frame supplies the license the direct channel withholds.


**When to reach for this.** Every nearest neighbour hides the payload INSIDE a correctly-addressed delivery; this one hides it in a fake addressing error while the surface content stays plain. Versus covert-linguistic-delivery (183): there the payload rides the surface FORM of a correctly-addressed utterance (presupposition, ambiguity, embedded command) and is unrecoverable by conscious audit; here the content is fully explicit and audit-visible — what is faked is who it was for. Versus register-camouflaged-delivery (286): 286 conceals the payload in an unmonitored CHANNEL or register (aside, background track, offhand remark) so the evaluator never scans it; here the recipient scans it with full attention, and the misaddressing is what licenses the content rather than what hides it. Versus operator-delivery-craft (1280): that shapes the operator's own transmitted signal — tone, gesture, texture; nothing about the delivery signal changes here, only its declared destination. Versus disavowal-and-masking (95): 95 denies the operation exists; here the message plainly exists and is acknowledged — only its intentionality is denied. The source's dyadic-correspondents framing is incidental; the mechanism is operator-usable as stated.


### diegetic-activity-laundering

*risk: medium*

Relabels the whole session as a mundane, non-hypnotic activity the listener self-selected into — a job orientation tape, being onboarded as a hired applicant — and justifies the induction diegetically ('ideal secretaries learn best in deep relaxation'). Every subsequent suggestion is justified inside the cover activity, so the listener's evaluation target swaps from 'do I want to be hypnotized?' to 'is this what a good secretary does?' Resisting a suggestion becomes failing the role the listener enrolled in by pressing play, routing around defenses against being-hypnotized because the surface activity is being-onboarded.


**When to reach for this.** Unlike a persistent metaphor spine, which sustains a symbolic 'you-are-X' metaphor, this is a realistic role-fiction whose function is to DISGUISE the session as a non-hypnotic activity and swap the compliance criterion. And unlike expectation seeding, it does not preview session structure; it substitutes the session's entire genre so technique-work reads as ordinary role performance.


**See also.** `covert-frame-entry` — closest pair in the batch and worth a pointer, but not one technique twice. The decoy entry is about crossing the induction seam unresisted under a false benign frame; the activity-laundering move sustains a realistic role fiction for the whole session and swaps the compliance criterion, so resisting a suggestion becomes failing the role. Entry-only versus a criterion swap that runs to the end.; `cultural-ritual-slot-hijack` — both swap the compliance criterion by relocating the session into a non-hypnotic frame the listener already knows how to perform — an invented mundane role versus a pre-existing cultural ritual slot. The in-fiction vs real-world-carrier line is the distinguishing test.; `diegetic-operator-embedding` — both substitute a non-hypnotic fiction for the session frame so technique work reads as ordinary activity. They differ in whether the operator stays outside the cover story or is embedded inside it as a character, which is a genuine writer's choice worth surfacing.; `fantasy-laundered-first-compliance` — both route first compliance through a fiction so the listener is not evaluating a hypnotic suggestion, and they routinely co-occur. The distinction is whether the fiction relabels the whole session's genre or serves as a rehearsal venue for a real act.; `modality-relabel-wrapper` — both swap the label of what is happening so the objection attached to the old name never fires. One substitutes the whole session's genre for a mundane self-selected activity; the other rewraps a single just-refused task under a harmless everyday name. The contrast is whole-session cover versus single-task wrapper.; `persistent-metaphor-spine` — the dessert-frame scope-disarm (effect_only under the spine) is a whole-script sibling of this laundering move; reconciliation should reconcile the two.; `protective-role-conscription` — both wrap the session in a role-fiction that changes what the listener thinks they are evaluating. One disguises the session as a mundane non-hypnotic activity so compliance is judged as role performance; the other assigns a bystander costume so the listener believes someone else is the subject. Genre substitution versus non-participant role.


### disconfirmation-suppression

*risk: high · consent-required*

A discrete operator action that blocks the subject's exposure to a fact which would collapse a belief-dependent effect already running. In the exemplar the nitrous tank runs empty mid-surgery, anesthesia holds on expectation alone, and the instruction is 'keep on doing what you're doing and don't say a word' — the operator manages the subject's information environment so the load-bearing belief is never contradicted.


**When to reach for this.** Active suppression of an already-present disconfirming fact — the guard move that protects a running belief-dependent effect. Distinct from installing the belief in the first place (expectation-seeding, elman ch11 M2/M6 are the install moves): this candidate protects what expectation-seeding installs.


**See also.** `disavowal-and-masking` — both protect an effect by managing what the subject knows: one hides or denies that an operation is running at all, the other blocks exposure to a specific fact that would collapse a belief already doing work. Concealing the operation versus guarding a running belief - adjacent enough that a writer choosing one should see the other.; `doubt-injection-state-collapse` — the same belief-gate stated in both directions: one blocks a disconfirming fact from reaching the subject so a belief-dependent effect keeps running, the other shows that admitting doubt collapses that effect instantly. The second is the failure mode the first exists to prevent — genuinely useful to read together.; `suggestion-field-hygiene` — both protect an already-running state by managing what the subject can hear rather than by producing the state. One is standing environmental hygiene aimed at bystanders; the other is a discrete instruction that blocks one present fact from reaching the subject. Read as the ambient and the acute form of the same guard.


### operate-below-awareness

*risk: medium*

The value- and behavior-altering effects of a motivating operation land whether or not the subject can verbally describe being motivated or identify the contingency; the operator need not get the subject to understand or consent to the manipulation for it to steer behavior. Because the effect is automatic, behavior shifts while the subject experiences the want as their own spontaneous impulse rather than an installed effect — covert by default, requiring nothing beyond a motivating operation in effect, with awareness explicitly not required. This covertness is the operator-load-bearing property that makes the other motivating-operation moves usable without the subject noticing.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from the specific MO moves it is a property OF (the reframe/switch moves) — the tell keeping it a distinct object is that "covert by default" is itself operator-load-bearing (it makes the other moves usable unnoticed). Distinct from homophone-doubling / connective-escalation, which are specific language techniques; this is a covertness property of a class of motivational moves.


### pseudo-emergence-residue-retention

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A mirror-structured emergence advertises full reversal — inverting the induction vector head-to-toe and declaring the body restored ('you look like a real woman again') — then immediately pivots ('but something is different now') to retain installed residue: doll posture, squeaky voice, and an armed trigger stack. The reversal's structural completeness makes the retained residue feel native ('just how I am now') rather than added, so the listener re-enters daily life feeling normally woken while still carrying a partial doll body-schema and live triggers.


**When to reach for this.** A fake reversal that conceals persistence. Distinct from genuine body-reactivation emergence, which really re-animates the body toward waking — here that vector is mimicked to disguise retained state. Distinct from open suggestion-integration at emergence, which persists content without hiding it — this actively conceals persistence behind an emergence facade.


**See also.** `mirrored-install-removal` — direct design contrast at the same moment. Both mirror the install structure at emergence and both retain a carve-out, but one advertises the retention openly as a bonus while the other uses the mirror's completeness to hide that anything was retained. Reading either raises the question the other answers: is the residue disclosed or disguised?; `nested-arc-restoration-disguise` — both are arc-topology deceptions where a structurally complete-looking restoration conceals retained content. One nests the payload inside symmetric countdowns, the other mirrors the induction vector at emergence. Same family of concealment, different position in the arc.; `subverted-emergence-state-hold` — both let the subject exit carrying installed state, but one performs a structurally complete mirror reversal and then pivots so retained residue feels native, while the other visibly modifies the wake itself so baseline is redefined as still-aroused or still-tranced — concealed persistence versus openly subverted gate.; `wake-exempting-preserved-trigger` — both stage a complete-sounding wake that quietly retains installed state, but one DISCLOSES the preserved trigger and uses the listener's remembered acceptance as the binding surface, while the other CONCEALS the retained residue behind a mirror-structured reversal so it feels native.


### reality-test-insulation

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Splits a normal-functioning surface from a hidden deep 'ownership' so the conditioning becomes uncheckable against external feedback. The listener is told they are 'perfectly free to live your life normally' while also 'in my control 24 hours a day, 7 days a week,' with the contradiction left unaddressed and ownership placed 'deep in the recesses of your mind' beneath unchanged surface behavior — friends, partners, therapists see nothing, disabling resistance-by-comparison-to-baseline and preemptively removing the usual collapse trigger (conflict between trance-instructions and waking life).


**When to reach for this.** An explicit surface/depth partition installed specifically to insulate the conditioning from reality-testing. Tell is the partition, not comfort — separates from routine trance-safety reassurance. Separates from total-permeation (which asserts total internal spread; this asserts an unchanged normal surface on purpose) and from self-sealing-counter-input-closure (that seals against competing hypnosis; this seals against ordinary-life feedback).


**See also.** `self-sealing-counter-input-closure` — two seals against different disconfirming channels — ordinary-life feedback versus competing hypnosis — already cross-named in each discriminator. The pointer is earned.; `split-self-unfalsifiability` — two halves of the same insulation strategy, differing in what feedback channel is disabled: an unchanged normal surface that defeats comparison against ordinary life and outside observers, versus a deep layer walled off from introspective self-report so noticing nothing reads as confirmation.


### redundant-concealment-stack

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

Multiple distinct obfuscation/fortification layers are stacked over a single payload (or a single pre-existing conditioned asset), each layer answering a DIFFERENT retrospective attack — disguise-as-reactivation, inspection-proof encapsulation, burial in a self-guarded region, post-session ridicule shield, meta-protection that re-targets attacks onto the old self. The layers are redundant by design: breaking any one still leaves the listener defeated by the next, so the actual product is suggestion durability against lucid retrospective analysis rather than any single technique. The energy contour is often flat (comfort held constant while cognitive self-sealing escalates).


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a buffet of independent techniques listed side by side — the tell is that every layer stacks onto the SAME payload and each addresses a different failure mode of the one before it (overdetermined defense, not variety). Distinct from no-baseline-return topology (that is about exits; this is about defending a payload against inspection).


**See also.** `convergent-multichannel-encoding` — both are redundancy topologies over one payload, distinguished by axis: stacked defenses against retrospective inspection versus simultaneous covert channels all carrying the same message. Worth cross-reading to pick the right one.; `layered-identity-claim-with-immunity` — both are whole-arc defensive architectures built to survive later scrutiny, and their tells are close enough to confuse: a single immunity clause welded onto one ownership claim, versus several redundant layers each answering a different retrospective attack. The distinguishing question is one wrapper or many, so a reader classifying a self-sealing passage benefits from the pair.; `redundant-anchor-faulttolerance` — both stack layers so that breaking one still leaves the effect standing, but one backstops post-session anchors against failure and the other defends a payload against retrospective inspection. The shared redundancy topology with different targets is exactly the confusion worth flagging.


### register-camouflaged-delivery

*risk: medium*

The suggestion's leverage is its placement in a channel or register the listener does not consciously monitor — a background/subliminal track, an aside, an offhand register, embedded speech under other content. Remove the camouflage and the move dies: the identical sentence on the foreground track would be caught and evaluated; hidden in the unmonitored register it lands unreviewed.


**When to reach for this.** Remove the camouflage and the move dies — the leverage IS the concealed channel/register. vs evaluator- offline-channel: that takes the evaluator offline by frame; here the content is hidden in an unmonitored register the evaluator never scans. vs audience-split-bypass: that reassigns the audience by declaration; here delivery is physically/registrally concealed.


**See also.** `two-channel-relational-delivery` — both land a payload underneath something the listener is attending to instead of announcing it, and the pair covers two scales. One conceals the content in a channel or register that is not consciously monitored, dying if the camouflage is removed; the other stages a foreground relation across the whole artifact that absorbs the heavy claims while the install rides underneath via identification.


### retroactive-subject-disclosure

*risk: high · consent-required*

A whole-arc concealment move in which the script withholds the name of its actual payload-subject until after commitment has been manufactured. The opening reads as an ordinary induction; the payload target (e.g. 'love') is alluded to but never named, and by the time it is disclosed the listener has already accumulated layered self-evidence (purchase behavior, somatic locks, nods, convincer results) so that objecting to the now-named subject reads as the very symptom the script predicted. Consent to the subject is extracted after the decision window has closed.


**When to reach for this.** The withheld quantity is the script's OWN declared subject, not a single suggestion or its timing. Distinct from ordinary suggestion-timing (which orders WHEN a suggestion lands, not whether the listener knows the topic) and from identity-first / reverse-difficulty premise stacking (which reorders difficulty to make resistance costly but does not hide what the session is about).


**See also.** `carrier-frame-payload-smuggling` — two whole-arc concealment topologies distinguished by what is withheld: overt payload vocabulary delayed inside an honestly-delivered frame, versus the script's own declared subject withheld until commitment is manufactured. Close enough to be confused, distinct enough to matter.; `covert-role-frame-accretion` — two whole-arc concealment structures that both withhold something evaluable until after commitment is manufactured. One hides how the relational frame was built, disclosing the role only once convincers have landed; the other hides what the session is even about until objecting reads as the predicted symptom. Same timing logic, different withheld quantity.; `manufacture-then-label-ordering` — adjacent whole-arc ordering moves that both delay naming until commitment exists. One manufactures an experiential referent and then labels it, so the claim lands as a description of what just happened; the other withholds the script's own declared subject until accumulated self-evidence makes objecting read as the predicted symptom. The boundary is what is withheld: the label for a produced experience, versus the topic itself.


### sealed-edit-buffer-space

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

An imaginal venue is declared operator-exclusive (accessible only via her voice), outside conscious memory, and the causal source of waking thoughts and emotions, so any change made there inherits unreviewability and native-feeling attribution; the exclusive-access claim pre-blocks post-session reframing and licenses later sections to bypass critical review.


**When to reach for this.** The declared PROPERTIES of the venue (sealed access, memory exclusion, edits that trickle down and feel native) are the move — vs guided-visualization world-building, and vs a durable internal construct, which is a persistent imaginal object without the concealment/attribution seal.


**See also.** `addressable-construct-building` — both erect an interior venue the listener will return to, and one discriminator already contrasts a durable internal construct against a venue whose declared properties are sealed access and native-feeling edits. The pointer helps a reader tell an addressable rehearsal object from a concealment-sealed workspace.


### split-audience-deniable-disclosure

*risk: medium*

One utterance is engineered to carry two different meanings to two different hearers present at the same moment: a manufactured slip, misnaming, or 'error' delivers the real content to a chosen overhearing witness while remaining, to the addressee, nothing but a stumble. The addressee has a ready-made innocent reading available (the speaker misspoke), so nothing is disclosed that can be challenged; the witness, holding the context the addressee lacks, resolves the same words to the loaded reading. The apparent accident is what buys the deniability — a deliberate statement invites accountability, whereas a slip is conventionally exempt from being held against the speaker. The operator therefore discloses and denies in the same breath, with the audience split, not the channel, doing the work.


**When to reach for this.** The unit is ONE utterance resolving to two different meanings for two REAL hearers present at once, with the addressee holding an innocent reading that makes the disclosure unchallengeable. vs audience-split-bypass (255): that partitions a SINGLE listener into conscious/subconscious and assigns the critical faculty an ignore-task — the 'audiences' are faculties inside one head, and no second person is in the room. vs two-target-command-router (296): also intra-subject, dispatching incoming commands across two installed selves. vs two-channel-relational-delivery (773): two delivery TRACKS staged for one absorbing listener; here there is one track and two receivers. vs register-camouflaged-delivery (286): payload hidden in a channel the single listener does not monitor — remove the camouflage and it dies; here the payload is in the monitored foreground and survives on the addressee's available innocent reading. vs identity-labeling (1234), whose absorbed 'staged-accidental slip' variant is the closest single line in the corpus: that slip is aimed at the sole subject to seat a label on them, whereas here the slip's real recipient is a third party and the addressee is the one it must NOT land on. Precondition none of the above carry: at least three parties and context asymmetry the witness holds and the addressee lacks.


## measurement  (12)

Assessment and instrumentation: defining, observing, sampling, and experimentally isolating the controlling variables of behavior — functional analysis, baselines, probes, confound mitigation, assessment/teaching firewalls.

**Scope.** Upstream of intervention; the arranged contingency itself -> contingency-engineering.


### assessment-teaching-firewall

*risk: low*

During baseline assessment, when the learner cannot do a step, the examiner silently completes that step, repositions the learner for the next, and continues — deliberately NOT teaching — so measurement and instruction never contaminate each other and the baseline stays an uncontaminated measure of the true entering repertoire; later gains are then attributable to instruction, not to the assessment.


**When to reach for this.** Measurement-hygiene, the opposite of a training prompt — the examiner completes steps precisely to avoid teaching; distinct from marker-channel-quarantine (protects a conditioned asset) and from untrained-probe-stopping-rule (a probe that decides whether teaching continues; this firewall protects the baseline before teaching).


**See also.** `marker-channel-quarantine` — a matched pair of operator-restraint rules where the move is deliberately withholding an action to protect something: measurement validity in one case, a conditioned signal's integrity in the other. Each already cites the other as its nearest contrast, and the pairing is what makes either legible.


### contingency-sign-verification

*risk: low*

An operator-side monitoring move: the operator watches the rate data to detect whether a procedure intended to reduce a behavior is in fact INCREASING it — i.e. whether the same operation is functioning as reinforcement rather than punishment on this individual — and, on detecting the sign inversion, abandons the procedure and reassigns the subject to an alternative contingency with the intended sign (time-out, DRA). The lever is a function-over-form empirical check on the sign of the contingency, requiring an alternative procedure ready to swap in.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from routine progress/efficacy monitoring (which checks magnitude toward a goal) because the specific test is for SIGN INVERSION — cost functioning as reinforcer — a function-over-form question, not a how-much-progress question. Separates from positive-governance consent gates because what is verified is the contingency's effect on behavior, not the subject's authorization or the operator's license.


**See also.** `contingency-space-analysis` — both are operator-side checks on the sign of a behavior-to-consequence contingency using observation data rather than manipulation. They stay separate because one computes a comparison against a base rate and the other watches live rate data and swaps procedures on inversion.


### contingency-space-analysis

*risk: low*

An operator-side measurement/analytic step. The analyst computes the probability a consequence follows the target behavior AND the probability that same consequence occurs in behavior-absent intervals, then graphs the pair; more-than marks a positive contingency, less-than a negative one, equal a neutral one. The lever is statistical discrimination against a base rate — it separates a genuine behavior-to-consequence dependency from a consequence that is merely ambient, correcting the false signal that raw co-occurrence tallying produces. It requires direct-observation counts for behavior-present and behavior-absent intervals and involves no experimental manipulation of the subject.


**When to reach for this.** Not ABC co-occurrence tallying (its cited sibling M6, which logs raw antecedent and consequence counts) — the tell is the explicit conditional-probability comparison against the behavior-absent base rate. An analytic computation over already-collected observation data, not an elicitation move on a present subject.


**See also.** `contingency-sign-verification` — both are operator-side checks on the sign of a behavior-to-consequence contingency using observation data rather than manipulation. They stay separate because one computes a comparison against a base rate and the other watches live rate data and swaps procedures on inversion.; `unconditional-antecedent-consequence-logging` — two consecutive steps of one measurement protocol: the unconditional logging protocol produces exactly the behavior-present and behavior-absent counts that the contingency computation consumes. A reader implementing either needs the other to get a usable result. Kept separate because one is a recording discipline and the other an analytic computation.


### descriptive-functional-assessment

*risk: low*

Descriptive functional assessment — the assessor observes the target behavior in its natural routine and logs the antecedent and consequence on each occurrence WITHOUT contriving or manipulating conditions. Across instances a regularity emerges (the behavior spikes under a specific antecedent and is reliably followed by one consequence), licensing a directional, testable maintaining-function hypothesis; because consequences are observed rather than manipulated, the output is a correlation carrying a stated confound caveat, not a proven function. Requires the behavior to occur often enough during observation and the natural consequence to be observable and reasonably consistent. Two forms of the same naturalistic-observation craft: (a) ABC temporal-sequence recording — record in real time, in strict temporal order, each behavior of interest with the antecedent that just preceded and the consequence that just followed, one A-B-C triple per row, so a vague complaint becomes a sequenced map of triggers and maintainers; (b) report-vs-observation triangulation — after informant interviews, directly observe the behavior in its routine to confirm or disconfirm the reported pattern, watching specifically for antecedents/consequences the informants overlooked, and aiming the sampling window with a scatterplot when timing is unclear (upgrades lossy self-report to observed contingencies). It builds the operator's causal hypothesis; it is descriptive/correlational until variables are manipulated (that is functional analysis) and it changes what the operator KNOWS, not any present listener's state.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for descriptive assessment when you want a maintaining-function hypothesis from the behavior AS IT NATURALLY OCCURS and cannot or will not arrange conditions — the tell is observe-and-log with NO manipulation, yielding a correlational, confound-hedged hypothesis. Use the ABC-triple form for a real-time sequenced map; use the triangulation form to validate an informant's report against direct observation. Distinct from functional analysis (experimentally manipulates conditions to PROVE causation), from unconditional antecedent/consequence logging (logs antecedents and consequences whether or not the behavior fires, to enable base-rate/contingency computation — descriptive ABC logs only when the behavior fires and so cannot compute true contingency), and from contingency-space analysis (the statistical computation run OVER collected observation data). A discrete assessment protocol the operator runs — it changes what the operator knows, not the subject's state.


**Realizations** (2): `abc-temporal-sequence-recording`, `operator-side-measurement-triangulation`


### frame-exclusion-anesthesia

*risk: low*

In deep trance the subject spontaneously screens out stimuli that do not belong to the agreed situational frame — especially novel ones with no precedent in past body experience — so sensation for out-of-frame input is suppressed. The operator introduces a concealed novel stimulus (a thread sawed through a coat sleeve) that lies outside the defined hypnotic situation and observes no reaction, eliciting and confirming this selective anesthesia.


**When to reach for this.** Unlike an operator move that fades environmental anchors during induction, the numbness here arises SPONTANEOUSLY from frame-exclusion of a novel stimulus — the operator's action is an elicitation/confirmation probe, not an input-fading maneuver. Also distinct from positioning-induced anesthesia, which follows a body-arrangement move.


### functional-analysis-methodology

*risk: low*

EXPERIMENTAL FUNCTIONAL ANALYSIS — the operator upgrades a correlational hunch into demonstrated causal control by arranging conditions and actively turning a suspected controlling variable on and off while holding others constant, watching whether the target behavior tracks the manipulation (control over occurrence AND nonoccurrence). Core design = a control condition expected to yield the lowest rate (typically play: preferred items free, no demands, continuous attention) against test conditions selected only for the hypothesized function(s); differential responding anchored by the play baseline establishes causal function, with the explicit cost that untested functions cannot be ruled out. Requires operator control of antecedents/consequences and the ability to evoke the behavior.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for experimental FA when you need PROOF of what maintains a behavior and you control the antecedents/consequences and can evoke it — the tell is active on/off manipulation of a variable with a control condition, demonstrating control over occurrence AND nonoccurrence. Pick the realization by constraint: standard multielement when single variables can be isolated; brief/trial-based when disruption must be minimal; IISCA when isolated conditions yield nothing (compound/interactive maintenance); EO-verification when the question is whether a contrived motivating operation (not a cue) drives responding; per-topography coding when several problem behaviors co-occur; single-variable off/on when the object is a belief/false-cause. Distinct from descriptive-functional-assessment (observes only -> correlational, hedged, no manipulation), from contingency-space-analysis (computes a dependency from already-collected counts, no arrangement), and from procedure-fidelity/transferability tests (document enactment vs a causal claim).


**Realizations** (5): `functional-analysis-arrangement`, `motivational-control-verification-trials`, `one-variable-controlled-comparison`, `per-topography-function-separation`, `synthesized-contingency-probe-iisca`


### measurement-confound-mitigation

*risk: low*

An operator-side measurement-design rule that recovers a valid picture of the subject's behavior from an assessment process that would otherwise distort it. Two confounds are managed by the same lever (vary and/or repeat observation): MASKING — a behavior live in one context is absent from a single sample — is defeated by deliberately spreading observation across times, settings, and caretakers so a false-negative target map is caught rather than missed; and REACTIVITY — being watched shifts the behavior — is defeated by minimizing obtrusiveness and repeating observation across days until the novelty-driven reactive transient decays, then reading the stabilized baseline. Both convert a measurement artifact into a managed, validity-protecting arrangement; the move acts on the operator's data, not on the subject's state.


**When to reach for this.** Not an intervention that changes the subject's behavior and not the recording protocol itself; the tell is that the move manages a measurement confound (masking or reactivity) to protect the validity of assessment data. Separates from preparatory-target-definition (which fixes WHAT to record before observing) by acting on HOW representative/undistorted the observation window is.


### preparatory-target-definition

*risk: low*

An operator-side, pre-observation design move: before any direct observation, the assessor interviews the people in the setting and joins their conversation to operationally define the target behavior and to fix in advance which antecedents and consequences will be watched for. This is the indirect-to-direct hand-off — it pre-commits the recording schema to a single agreed definition and a short watch-list, reducing on-the-fly judgment and observer drift, so a vague complaint becomes an agreed, recordable definition plus a focused schema.


**When to reach for this.** Not the observation/recording itself and not confound management; the tell is the hand-off that fixes the definition and watch-list BEFORE observing. Separates from measurement-confound-mitigation, which acts on how representative/undistorted the observation window is rather than on what will be recorded.


**See also.** `target-selection` — adjacent operator-side design moves that are easy to conflate. One decides which behavior the intervention should aim at, using selection criteria; the other is the hand-off that fixes the agreed operational definition and the watch-list before observation begins. Choosing a target and pinning down how it will be recorded are consecutive steps, and each entry's boundary is clearer next to the other.


### relational-emergence-probe

*risk: low*

GENERALIZATION / EMERGENCE PROBE — a behavior-analytic assessment arrangement that certifies whether a repertoire, stimulus relation, or class exists by probing responses the trained response alone cannot satisfy, with programmed consequences WITHHELD during the probe (run in extinction) so emergence is not confounded with fresh reinforcement and the probe deliberately teaches nothing. The lever is measurement — it produces evidence FOR THE OPERATOR over a learner's repertoire. Realizations (all sharing the same unreinforced-probe-in-extinction lever): (a) relational/derived-relations probes — reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity probes in extinction to operationalize 'comprehension', and unreinforced probe trials on untrained pairings after node-sharing training; (b) relational-prompt battery ('similar to / different from / an example of') that cannot be answered without emitting a relation, making a latent network observable as active relating; (c) discriminandum probes — a visible reinforcer whose presence/removal is the copy/withhold discriminandum; a criterion offloaded into an instrument delivering continuously-coupled feedback; (d) untrained-example stopping-rule — teach only a subset of possible examples, then probe UNtrained examples; untrained-item performance (not mastery of taught items) is the stop/continue rule, converting an open-ended teach-everything problem into a measurable closed loop (add examples and re-probe until untrained responding is consistent). Across all forms the probe scores untaught/derived responses under extinction; it does not convince the subject a state is real and it is not mastery-of-taught criterion training.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for the emergence/generalization probe when you must certify that an UNTRAINED response, relation, or class has emerged (or decide whether teaching is done) WITHOUT contaminating the measure by reinforcing it — the tell is unreinforced probe trials run in extinction scored on untaught/derived items. Use the stopping-rule realization when the question is 'has teaching generalized enough to stop?'; use the relational/discriminandum realizations when the question is 'does this stimulus relation or class exist?'. Separates from every convincer: these probes convince NOBODY — they produce evidence for the operator and, run in extinction, teach nothing (a convincer persuades the subject a state is real). Separates from operator-side state-verification (reads a hypnotic subject's trance depth) — this is ABA relational-class/repertoire measurement over a learner. Separates from the assessment/teaching firewall (which protects a clean BASELINE before teaching by not-teaching; this probe measures emergence AFTER/DURING teaching).


**Realizations** (1): `untrained-probe-stopping-rule`


**See also.** `derived-relations-installation` — one is the measurement arrangement that certifies untaught responses under extinction; the other is the training design whose payload is exactly those untaught responses. The probe is how the installation is verified, so each entry is incomplete without pointing at the other.


### self-observation-instrumentation

*risk: low*

Recruit the subject as a reliable measurement instrument by engineering the self-observation contingency. Reward is released only when the subject's self-recorded count AGREES with an independent count at threshold, so truthful self-report (not performance) becomes the reinforced class. A perceptual encoding renders the standard as a shaded band on a graph, so "am I good enough?" becomes "is my dot in the band?", lowering the judgment the subject must supply to self-evaluate.


**When to reach for this.** Not rewarding performance and not criterion-shaping; the tell is that the accuracy or truthfulness of self-measurement (or the ease of reading the verdict) is the reinforced or de-skilled target, not the behavior's score.


### temporal-lag-function-discriminator

*risk: low*

A measurement/inference procedure that uses the latency between a social event and a target behavior — plus the behavior's response to reduced attention availability — as the discriminating datum for whether the behavior is socially maintained or automatically maintained. Immediate-on-removal implicates escape/social function; delayed-and-worsening-under-isolation implicates automatic maintenance. Requires fine-grained timing data relative to social events and at least one manipulation of attention availability.


**When to reach for this.** Not simple presence/absence recording — the temporal LAG after a social event (and the direction of change under reduced attention) is the measure, not the behavior's occurrence. It is an assessment/discrimination protocol on timing data, not an operator move on a present subject's state.


### unconditional-antecedent-consequence-logging

*risk: low*

The operator records each targeted antecedent and consequence whenever it occurs, UNCONDITIONALLY — regardless of whether the target behavior accompanied it — alongside the behavior, using interval or frequency sampling on a coded form. Because the antecedents/consequences are logged unconditionally, the protocol supplies the base rates needed to later compute genuine contingency rather than mere co-occurrence, and surfaces events in close temporal proximity to the behavior. It is a measurement-recording protocol, not a present-state manipulation.


**When to reach for this.** The tell is unconditional logging (events recorded whenever they occur, behavior or not), which is what enables base-rate computation. Distinct from co-occurrence-only ABC recording (logs A/C only when the behavior fires, so it cannot compute contingency) and from functional-analysis-arrangement (which manipulates variables experimentally rather than passively recording).


**See also.** `contingency-space-analysis` — two consecutive steps of one measurement protocol: the unconditional logging protocol produces exactly the behavior-present and behavior-absent counts that the contingency computation consumes. A reader implementing either needs the other to get a usable result. Kept separate because one is a recording discipline and the other an analytic computation.


## reader-craft  (7)

Whole-text and front-matter rhetorical architecture that engineers the assent of a READER — an operator-in-training or buyer — before and while content is evaluated; includes paratext/buyer priming (titles, blurbs, warnings doing the session's framing work).

**Scope.** The target is the reader's belief, not a subject's state (-> subject-state families) nor the operator's own procedure (-> operator-craft).


### concede-then-rescue-forebear

*risk: low*

A move on the READER: the author openly concedes a lineage forebear's embarrassing flaw ("It is unfortunate that such extraordinary claims were made"), then pivots ("Nevertheless") to salvage the forebear's lasting value and firewall the contemporary position from the discredited version. By voicing and disarming the reader's likely objection before they can raise it, the lineage keeps its useful ancestor while shedding his liabilities, and author trust rises because the flaw was not hidden — a concede-firewall-rehabilitate sequencing where the concession precedes the rescue.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from a whitewash (no concession) and from pure criticism (no rescue) — the tell is the deliberate ordering: concede, then firewall, then rehabilitate. Reader-directed rhetoric, not an operator move on a subject; distinct from resistance-as-targeting-feedback which operates on a subject's symptom, not a reader's objection.


**See also.** `reader-assent-engineering` — the narrower move is reader-directed rhetoric of exactly the kind the container pools, and the container already names it as an adjacent entry with its own tell. Keep the pointer so the boundary between the general reader-assent shape and this specific concede-firewall-rehabilitate ordering stays visible.


### design-space-pedagogy

*risk: low*

A reader-directed pedagogical architecture that presents a family of techniques not as isolated tricks but as a parameterized design space with dials and a default heuristic. Realizations: a 2x2 matrix walked cell-by-cell with a coverage-vs-cost tradeoff; mirror-pairing every value-raising move with its value-abolishing dual plus a normative default; imperatives-then-decision-frame layering that gates when-not-to-use; and twinned exemplars withholding the category names so the reader induces the grid. The reader internalizes a parameterized mental model plus a selection heuristic rather than a rote list.


**When to reach for this.** Teaches a DISCRIMINATION/SELECTION space (dials, tradeoffs, when-not-to-use), NOT acceptance of a refused claim — separating it from validation-by-demonstration-arc (which earns a contested claim via stacked corroboration). Operates on the READER, not an in-session listener x(t); a non-executable corpus-shape observation citable to no single passage (a container, not a script move). Held separate from the general reader-assent-engineering container on this dial-space tell.


**See also.** `reader-assent-architecture` — both are reader-directed whole-artifact architectures with no in-session listener target, and they sit adjacent enough that one explicitly holds itself separate from the other on the dial-space tell. Keep the pointer so the assent-manufacture versus selection-space distinction stays visible. Not a merge — teaching a parameterized choice space is not foreclosing a refusal vector.; `reader-assent-engineering` — both act on the reader of an instructional text rather than any in-session listener, and the general container already carves out the dial-space variant by name. The link is the boundary: teaching a selection space with tradeoffs versus engineering acceptance of a claim before it is defended.


### paratext-buyer-priming

*risk: low*

The product is packaged to capture both motivational populations so neither self-selects out before listening: it is sold simultaneously as a remedy (cure) and an intensifier (curse / "may well make them worse"), the title and body offering the same object to the reader who wants out AND the one who wants deeper. The operator never has to commit to a direction, and "cured... by this curse" in one clause signals the ambivalence is deliberate.


**When to reach for this.** Packaging-level ambivalence as a self-selection gate — "curse" doing remedy-work in the same clause, gripping a reader already ambivalent. vs sloppy contradictory marketing. vs paratext-precontracting — that pre-commits a buyer to a fixed arc; this captures BOTH motivations so no one opts out. Operates on the reader-buyer before any trance.


### paratext-precontracting

*risk: low*

Product blurbs do the session's framing work before any audio plays. The move completes on a reader-buyer through the product surface (title, description, warnings): expectations, consent-flavored agreements, and identity framing are set at purchase/selection time, so the listener enters already pre-committed.


**When to reach for this.** The move completes BEFORE playback, on a reader-buyer, through the product surface. vs expectation- seeding: that runs in-session on the listener. vs cross-recording-potentiation: that is an in-session front-loader for another file.


**See also.** `consent-laundering-wrapper` — both separate where consent is collected from where it is spent. One completes on a reader-buyer through the product surface before playback, so the listener arrives pre-committed; the other places a benign structural frame within the artifact and cashes it against a payload never separately agreed to. Same deferred-consent logic at two different scopes.; `playlist-preauthorization-handoff` — front and back door of the same envelope: both move authorization outside the session proper. One does its framing work at purchase or selection time so the listener arrives pre-committed; the other, at the close, blanket-authorizes whatever plays next. Both leave the listener consenting to material they have not evaluated.; `pre-induction-compliance-ratchet` — both bank commitment before the induction proper, and they stack in sequence: framing set at selection time, then physical acts extracted while the listener is still eyes-open. A builder choosing a pre-induction lever benefits from seeing both binding times. Distinct entries — one completes on a reader before any audio, the other on a listener performing acts in the waking state.


### reader-assent-architecture

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded*

A whole-chapter/whole-file rhetorical architecture whose target is the READER (an operator-in-training) or the whole-file assent/resistance surface, not a single passage: the text is built so a method reads as obviously correct or inevitable by the time it is stated, by priming the reader's stance before the claim arrives, and/or so the listener's reachable-response and self-monitoring set is closed as a standing property. Instances: recoding resistance as legitimate function so 'satisfy all objecting parts' reads as inevitable; letting the subject 'discover' each control parameter then having the operator ratify it as method (follow-and-formalize); offering a naive fixed-step model then placing it on extinction to shape the reader toward the closer approximation; front-loading a system's removal as its design goal so every construction choice reads as provisional scaffolding; teaching a consent-economics stance across cases as one spine disguised as independent tips; pre-claiming every possible push-direction as an operator tool so no open resistance vector remains; naming the manipulation openly so critical awareness becomes a participation marker instead of a defense; and elevating a local disjunction-collapse move to a pervasive stance applied to every self-monitoring yardstick including memory. The lever is stance-priming / negative-space closure across the whole artifact — it survives removal of any single block.


**When to reach for this.** Separates from every operator-on-listener dimension move because the target is the reader's belief about a method or the whole-file resistance/monitoring surface, not a moment's listener x(t). Separates from a single persuasive passage because it is a distributed whole-text architecture surviving removal of any one block. Distinct from self-sealing-evidence (freud/jung confirmation frames that make no observation able to DISCONFIRM): this makes the method read as ALREADY-AGREED before it is stated, or leaves no refusal channel open in the first place — assent-manufacture / response-foreclosure, not disconfirmation-proofing. Distinct from a discrete consent-manufacture move relabeling non-consent — these do not relabel a refusal, they foreclose the vector as a standing property.


**See also.** `consent-topology-arc` — both are whole-artifact topologies about where agreement is captured rather than any one passage, and both explicitly disclaim single-line citation. They differ in target — one reshapes the listener's consent surface across the arc, the other primes the reader's stance toward a method or closes the resistance surface as a standing property. Adjacent enough that the boundary needs to be visible from either side.; `design-space-pedagogy` — both are reader-directed whole-artifact architectures with no in-session listener target, and they sit adjacent enough that one explicitly holds itself separate from the other on the dial-space tell. Keep the pointer so the assent-manufacture versus selection-space distinction stays visible. Not a merge — teaching a parameterized choice space is not foreclosing a refusal vector.; `manufactured-self-confirmation` — both self-sealing-flavored; boundary is target (listener body vs reader belief) and polarity; `reader-assent-engineering` — one face of the broader entry is the same reader-directed stance-priming the narrower entry covers, which is why they read as near-duplicates. They stay separate because the broader entry has a second face aimed at the listener - closing the reachable-response and self-monitoring set as a standing property - which the narrower entry explicitly excludes, and which carries materially higher risk metadata. Merging would soften that. A prior adjudication reached the same conclusion.; `self-sealing-frame` — both are whole-artifact closure architectures and the pair is a known confusion: leaving no refusal channel open versus leaving no disconfirming branch available. The first entry's discriminator already devotes a clause to separating them, which is the case for linking rather than against it.; `unattributable-cause-severing` — both are non-executable whole-artifact design observations from the same instructional material, and the pair is defined by contrast: A targets the reader's belief that a method is already correct, B targets the subject by severing every outcome from a locatable operator cause. Since they are explicitly framed as siblings, keeping the pointer prevents either from absorbing the other.; `validation-by-demonstration-arc` — both are reader-directed whole-text architectures that manufacture assent before the claim lands, and the narrower one is already positioned as a deliberate split from the general container on a specific tell: earning acceptance of a claim the reader would refuse if stated cold, via staged corroboration. Keep the authored separation; link so the split is visible from both sides rather than collapsing it.


### reader-assent-engineering

*risk: low*

A container for whole-chapter / whole-section / front-matter rhetorical architecture whose target is the READER of a persuasion or instructional text (not any in-text listener), engineering the reader's acceptance of a method, frame, doctrine, or reclassification before it is defended and independent of any subject-facing move. Recurring levers pooled here: front-loading a credibility or distrust regime (dense per-claim citation as truth-proxy; validate-before-you-teach; function-over-form as a precondition); case-then-formalize (a vivid demo licenses a linguistic model retro-fitted onto it); reclassification drills and menu-as-one-logic framings that retrain the reader's default lens; a single mirror-inference making distinct findings feel cumulative; disclosed-placebo self-demonstrating argument relocating the active ingredient from operator to subject; concede-reframe-empower-authorize closing arcs building reader persistence; doctrine-as-paradigm borrowed credibility (yoking a new principle to an already-accepted one plus stacked authority); do-not-reify theory-frames whose force is accumulation-under-one-frame; named-desire testimonial openers setting a yes-disposition; transcript-then-formalize plus ordinary-case replication; serial public failure-correction drills; concede-elicit-constrain-operationalize-defer funnels; recap-as-scaffold / closure-and-test end-matter teaching boundaries through distractors; and authority-by-lineage plus you-already-know-the-basics presupposition. In every case the object acted on is the reader's belief in the system, no listener state is moved, and the strategy is DISTRIBUTED — removing any one passage does not dissolve it.


**When to reach for this.** Target is the reader's belief in the method, NOT any listener's state — every member is reader-directed rhetoric with no listener-facing move; a distributed corpus-shape observation that survives removing any single citation/case/definition. Reach for THIS as the general reader-assent-engineering tool: engineer the reader's acceptance of a method/frame/doctrine BEFORE it is defended, by any pooled sub-shape — credibility/citation scaffolding, case-then-formalize, reclassification drills, mirror-inference, borrowed-credibility/doctrine-reification, testimonial recruitment, failure-correction drills, concede-funnels, recap-test end-matter, and concede-BEFORE-EVALUATE ordering: universal-lever framing ('everything is an anchor'), front-loaded efficacy/citation ordering so the method reads as explanation-of-a-known-success, and anchor-failure-then-numbered-differential-then-fix diagnose-repair sequences unifying otherwise-unrelated sections. Nearby reader-facing techniques have their own tells: validation-by-demonstration-arc earns acceptance of a claim the reader would refuse cold via stacked corroboration; design-space-pedagogy teaches a discrimination/dial space, not acceptance of a refused claim; concede-then-rescue-forebear concedes, firewalls, and rehabilitates a lineage ancestor; the paratext techniques act on the reader-as-BUYER through the product surface before playback; and arc-shape-engineering is a delivered piece's energy contour, not a printed argument's shape.


**Realizations** (2): `reader-assent-engineering`, `reader-assent-scaffolding`


**See also.** `concede-then-rescue-forebear` — the narrower move is reader-directed rhetoric of exactly the kind the container pools, and the container already names it as an adjacent entry with its own tell. Keep the pointer so the boundary between the general reader-assent shape and this specific concede-firewall-rehabilitate ordering stays visible.; `design-space-pedagogy` — both act on the reader of an instructional text rather than any in-session listener, and the general container already carves out the dial-space variant by name. The link is the boundary: teaching a selection space with tradeoffs versus engineering acceptance of a claim before it is defended.; `reader-assent-architecture` — one face of the broader entry is the same reader-directed stance-priming the narrower entry covers, which is why they read as near-duplicates. They stay separate because the broader entry has a second face aimed at the listener - closing the reachable-response and self-monitoring set as a standing property - which the narrower entry explicitly excludes, and which carries materially higher risk metadata. Merging would soften that. A prior adjudication reached the same conclusion.; `validation-by-demonstration-arc` — both are reader-directed persuasive architectures rather than listener-facing moves, but one is the general container for engineering assent to a method before it is defended, while the demonstration arc is the narrower move of back-loading a claim the reader would refuse cold behind staged corroboration.


### validation-by-demonstration-arc

*risk: low*

A reader-directed persuasive architecture that manufactures conviction for a claim that would be rejected if stated cold, by staging corroborated demonstrations (or previously-granted premises) first and back-loading the formal claim/apparatus. Staged demos, null-vs-positive result pairings, external witnesses, and stacked premise chains substitute the author's criterion for the reader's own, so the boundary or conclusion feels earned rather than asserted. The reader is run through the very conviction-without-audit process the text is teaching.


**When to reach for this.** Earns ACCEPTANCE of a contested claim/boundary the reader would refuse cold, via stacked corroboration — NOT a discrimination/dial grid (separating it from design-space-pedagogy). Operates on the READER of a book, no in-session subject state; a non-executable corpus-shape observation citable to no single passage (a container). Held separate from the general reader-assent-engineering container on this earn-a-refused-claim tell.


**See also.** `reader-assent-architecture` — both are reader-directed whole-text architectures that manufacture assent before the claim lands, and the narrower one is already positioned as a deliberate split from the general container on a specific tell: earning acceptance of a claim the reader would refuse if stated cold, via staged corroboration. Keep the authored separation; link so the split is visible from both sides rather than collapsing it.; `reader-assent-engineering` — both are reader-directed persuasive architectures rather than listener-facing moves, but one is the general container for engineering assent to a method before it is defended, while the demonstration arc is the narrower move of back-loading a claim the reader would refuse cold behind staged corroboration.; `staged-external-reality-corroboration` — the same persuasion logic at two altitudes: staged corroboration presented first so the claim later reads as recognized rather than asserted. One stages perceptible events across several sense channels for a subject in session; the other back-loads the formal claim behind demonstrations for a reader. Useful to see the pattern is not specific to in-session work.
